tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum nor bu'i bang mdzod bzhugs so//

mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la bstod phyag 'bul ba 'gro ba'i bla ma// 104) 'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje ston pa ni// dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// bsam gyis mi khyab bskal par tshogs bsags pas// mnyam nyid byang chub brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum kun dang dbyer med dus gsum du// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad 'khor lo yis// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral dbyer med pas// 'gro rnams smin par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyis skyon rnams spangs shing yon tan bsgrub// skyon med yon tan rab rdzogs rgyal ba'i sku// 'khor 'das yon tan ma lus kun gyi gter// mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo// shākya'i rgyal po 'gro 'ong spros dang bral// gdod nas ma skyes lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// thub pa khyod la skye 'gag yong mi mnga'// rnam dag ngo bo nyid la phyag 'tshal lo// bden gnyis dbyer med rtag tu bden gsungs pa// mi shes mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'jig mdzad pa// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor don gnyis ston pa po// snang mdzad yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa nyid kyi bstan pa rin po che// brtse chen nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas// 'gro ba'i re bskong bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa// thabs mkhas bla med ston la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa khyod dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// nyid kyi bstan pa bla med rin po che// 'gro ba ma lus thams cad smin byed cing*// bla med dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral shog/ // 105) ༄// rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa sku mched gnyis kyi zhu chos// oṃ swasti/ lha na mo/ bdud dang bgegs dang log 'dren dgra bo dang*// rlung dang bad kan mkhris pa 'dus pa dang*// las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams// nyi ma'i mdun du mun pa mi gnas bzhin// rdo rje 'chang gi mtshan gyis 'jig par 'gyur// bsam gyis mi khyab bde dang skyid pa dang*// phrin las bzhi dang grub chen brgyad dang ni// bla med mchog gi 'bras bu dam pa yang*// rdo rje 'chang gi mtshan 'di sus 'dzin pa// de dag thams cad myur du 'thob par 'gyur// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// 'khor 'das ma lus kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// phan dang bde ba kun gyi 'byung gnas gtso// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po yis// rgyun chad med par rtag tu bskyab mdzad gsol// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// yum gyur 'phags ma 'od zer can// shes rab pha rol phyin pa nyid// yum gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi mtshan tsam shes pas kyang*// nyes pa thams cad zad byed cing*// phan bde thams cad rab ster ba// gnyen gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dgra dang chom rkun 'jigs pa dang*// gzhan yang 'jigs pa thams cad las// dran pa tsam gyis skyob mdzad pa// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag nyes pa thams cad dang*// 'jigs dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyis// rnam par gzir ba'i sems can rnams// rje btsun 'phags mas bskyab tu gsol// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma gcig rje btsun ma// sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las dpag med mtha' yas pas// las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal nyes tshogs ma lus rnams// ma gcig dran pas nyes tshogs yang dag bsal du gsol// phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal rje btsun ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad ma// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig ma// 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig ma// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel mdzad ma// bde ba thams cad ster mdzad ma// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// nyes tshogs skyon dang bral mdzad cing*// yang dag shes rab bskyed pa mo// lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum// byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi ma// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi// lha mo khyod ni ma ma nyid// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// bde legs phun tshogs gang yin pa// lha mo khyod las byung ba'o// 'gro ba kun gyi mgon dang skyabs// gnyen dang dpung gnyen khyod yin te// ma gcig dpal ldan sgrol mdzad ma// rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la// bdag dang 'gro drug thams cad kun// phyag 'tshal nyam thag nga ro yis// snying nas skyabs gsol 'o dod 'bod// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams// dran pas snying yang 'gas gyur pa'i// sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba las// skyob par mdzad pa'i skyabs gcig ma// gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba ni// dran yang sgyid lug ga chad pa'i// nyes tshogs mu mtha' med pa las// dbugs 'byin mdzad pa'i lha mo khyod// mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang*// reg pa dang ni dran pas kyang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// rje btsun 'phags mas skyob par mdzad// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yi// log pa'i shes pas 'khrul pa rnams// phyin ci log bzhis mdongs pa yi// mi shes mun sel khyod nyid lags// lam log zhugs dang dman pa'i lam// lam gyi bar chad bdud dgra las// skyabs mdzad skyob pa'i skyabs gcig ma// skyabs su mchi'o bskyab tu gsol// ma gcig thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// phyin ci log gi shes rab dang*// sdug bsngal rgyu dang 'bras bu las// bdag cag thams cad skyabs mdzad cing*// rnam dag bde ba'i gnas mchog tu// lha mo khyod kyis phyin mdzad gsol// sngon gyi dam bca' ma bsnyel bar// thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol// ri bo ta la legs par brgyan pa na// drang srong chen po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje mchog mnga' la// nyams thag nga ros gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs// dag pa gnyis ldan dri med chos kyi sku// gzung 'dzin spros pas rab dben blo las 'das// bya dang byed pa mi mnga' mnyam nyid sku// 'gro ba'i mgon pos bdag cag zhi bar mdzod// de dang de yi rang bzhin dbyer med nyid// chos kyi sku dang yon tan ro gcig pa// dpag med phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug gis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor byings pa bdag cag skyobs// nyes tshogs sdig dang sgrib pas bkab pa'i yid// dwangs ba'i mtsho la gzugs brnyan mi snang bzhin// mgon po khyod ni blta bar ma nus kyang*// brtse ba'i bdag nyid khyod kyis bdag cag skyobs// gus pa'i yid yod blo mig ma dag pas// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa ma rdzogs shing*// khyod la gsol 'debs rnams dang 'gro ba kun// bdag cag skye dgu thams cad skyabs mchi 'o// phan par 'dod pas zang zing sna tshogs kyi// spros pa'i rgya mtshor lhung ba'i chags sdang gis// rang rgyud tshigs nas gzhan rgyud bsreg pa yi// gdug pa'i me 'di mgon pos zhi bar mdzod// nags khrod dgon pa ri bo bag yangs par// chog shes zas dang gos kyis nyer 'tsho zhing*// zhi gnas lhag mthong dbyer med ting 'dzin gyis// 'gro ba'i mgon dang mi 'bral gyur zhig gu// yon tan rgya mtsho sems nyid rnam dag la// sgrib byed nyon mongs rnam rtog sprin phung 'di// dben dang sdom dang sna tshogs brtul zhugs dang*// ye shes rlung gis rnam par gtor gyur nas// bcom ldan 'gro ba'i dbang phyug skyob pa po// kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i bdag nyid sku// sems can kun dang mnyam pa'i skur snang ba// lus can kun gyis mchog gi sku thob shog

/'khor ba'i nyes tshogs dri ma rab sbyangs nas// bla med yon tan rgya mtsho rab rdzogs te// rtag tu sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa// sku mched gnyis kyis bdag la zhus pa'o/// / 106) ༄// theg chen chos 'khor gtan la phab pa 'ong ges zhus pa'i rtsa tshig/ oṃ swasti/ bla ma rnams dang dus gsum rgyal ba dang*// rgyal ba'i yum gyur zhi ba 'dod bral chos// gang gis nyams su blangs pa'i 'phags rnams la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// rab 'byams bka' la thogs med smra ba'i dpal// bslab gsum rgyan gyis legs mdzes rnal 'byor pas// yul 'di bdag gi min yang yang yang zhus// de phyir bla ma'i gsung sgros zur tsam 'bri// thub pa chen po'i gsung rab rgya mtsho rnams// legs par dgongs shing thugs su chud pa dang*// de yi don 'grel legs par bsdus pa rnams// gang gi blo la shar yang mi dga' med// thub chen chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan des// dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// rab 'byams mtha' yas bskal par tshogs bsags pas// byang chub shing dbang drung du sangs rgyas pa// bcom ldan mgon po de la rgyal ba'i sras// tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyis gsol btab nas// rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum// wā rā ṇa sī dang ni rgyal po'i khab// rtswa mchog grong khyer chen po la sogs par// 'gro ba'i bla mas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// rin chen chos kyi 'khor lo 'di gsum yang*// phun sum tshogs pa rnam lngar gshis kyis gnas// lnga gsum ji ltar yin pa rgyal ba'i gsung*// ston pas gsungs pa mdo tsam brjod pa la// shākya'i rgyal po byang chub sangs rgyas nas// bdun phrag bdun gyi zhag gi grangs snyed cig /'das pa'i dus su wā rā ṇa sī yi// drang srong lhung ba ri dwags rgyu ba'i tshal// sngon gyi thub pa chen po bcom ldan gyis// bla med chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gnas mchog der// thub pa chen pos sngon nas smin mdzad pa'i// gtso bor gyur pa lnga sde bzang po dang*// zhar las byung ba lha rnams brgyad khri dang*// ma pham la sogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// sngon gyi smon lam stobs kyis nges byung ba// rgyal sras sems ni bskyed ma thag tu yang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul 'debs pa// de la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// brjod du med pa'i rgyal ba'i zhing rnams nas// zhing 'dir lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yis// khyad 'phags chos kyi seng ge'i khri bshams shing*// zhing 'di legs par brgyan cing mchod pa'i tshogs// dpag tu med pas mchod nas 'di skad ces// thub chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad du gsol// yang dang yang du gsol ba btab pa las// bcom ldan 'das kyis lnga sde gzhir mdzad nas// dge slong khyed kyis 'di ltar shes par bya// phung po lnga dang skye rga na 'chi bzhi// sdug bsngal phung po grangs las 'das pa rnams// nyon mongs las kyi rgyu las byung ba ste// nyon mongs yod na las 'byung de las ni// 'bras bu sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ba yin// nyon mongs de yang rnam pa gsum yin te// dang po brgyad dang dgu pa nyon mongs te// dang po ma rig 'gags pas 'du byed sogs// bcu gnyis 'gag pa ston pas gsungs pa 'di// dbang po 'bring po rang rgyal gtso bor mdzad// nyon mongs gnyis pa sred pa gzhir 'gyur te// srid dang bral la yang srid yod min te// 'dod pa med pas mya ngan 'da' ba 'di// de yi rigs can nyan thos rnams kyi yin// len pa'i ngo bo zhe sdang nyid yin phyir// zhe sdang spangs pas zhe sdang med pa yi// sems gsum stobs 'phel byang chub sems dpa' rnams// tshogs gnyis bsags pas chos kyi rgyal por gyur// 'di la bcom ldan chos kyi rgyal po yis// dge slong dag ces bos nas bka' bstsal pa// rigs can gsum gyi sras la cig car du// gsungs pa yin gyi tha dad yod ma yin// nyon mongs 'di yod pas na las 'byung zhing*// las las 'bras bu rnams kyang 'byung ba la// nyon mongs gsum po gang rung 'gags pa yis// las dang 'bras bu 'gag pa khyad med na// gsum du gsungs pa ji ltar yin snyam na// sred dang len pa ma rig nyid yin te// ma rig pa yang sred dang len pa yin// 'dus byas mi rtag chos 'di thams cad kun// phan tshun gcig la gcig ni ltos pa'i phyir// rten cing 'brel pa mdung khyim lta bu zhes// bcom ldan gsung dang rig pas myong ba shes// rigs can gsum yang dang po 'jug pa'i sgos// tha dad gyur kyang 'bras bu gcig gyur pa// rgyu mtshan 'di las khyed kyis shes par mdzod// nyon mongs gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las// lus dang ngag dang yid kyis gang byas pa// bsam gyis mi khyab dpag tu med pa nyid// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong du// dpag med legs par gsungs pa 'di dag kun// bsam ngan stobs su gyur bas byas pa de// rgya dang rgya yi 'bur bzhin snang zhing grub// da lta bdag cag la sogs sems can rnams// rang gis byas pa smin pa'i bde sdug rnams// 'di dang 'di yis byas zhes byed por blta// bzang po byas la chags pa skye bar 'gyur// ngan pa byas na zhe sdang skye ba yi// bzang ngan 'dis byas snyam du sems pa 'di// byed pos byas pa'i log lta ji ltar 'gag

/mtho dang dma' ba gang du mi sems par// nga dang bdag ces rtag par 'dzin pa'i yid// da rung 'di la 'chal zhing kha 'dzin na// log lta chen po rtag lta gang na yod// de sngon phan chad rgyu dang 'bras bu dang*// phyi ma phan chod ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul// rgyu dang 'bras bu sems par mi byed cing*// brkam pa'i yid can 'dod pa'i yon tan la// chags pa'i bsam pas ye rngam 'dod pa'i blos// hab shi hub shir 'dod chags spyod pa las// mu stegs chad lta bram ze gang na yod// 'di dag la sogs log par lta ba rnams// 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa yis// da lta rang gi bsam pa 'di yin gsung*// phung po lnga la bdag dang bdag gi zhes// dbye ba nyi shur byung ba 'di nyid la// 'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri rtse mthon po zhes// sangs rgyas kyis gsungs slob dpon 'phags pas bsdus// 'jig tshogs lta bar lta ba drug cu gnyis// 'dus pa srog gi dbang po dper mdzad pas// lta ba thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'dus// gzung dang 'dzin pa gti mug ma rig pa// 'di yod pas ni de yi las dang 'bras// 'byung phyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chen po ni// kun 'byung rgyu las 'byung ba nges pa'i phyir// sdug bsngal ba dang kun 'byung rgyu 'bras bstan// de las ldog pa rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul// lam ni 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad po dang*// 'bras bu 'gog pa zhi ba gya nom pa// rnyog med bsil ba zhi ba nyid gsungs te// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin chen dang*// rgyal ba rnams kyis mdo rgyud thams cad du// sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid// bsnyen dang bsten dang bkur las 'byung bar gsungs// de bsten pa las yang dag lta la sogs// 'phags pa'i lam rnams rgyud la skyes gyur nas// 'phags pa bsil ba zhi ba 'gog pa yi// 'bras bu dgra bcom chen por 'gyur ba la// lam gyi bden pa nyams su blangs pa las// 'bras bu 'gog pa'i bden pa 'byung bar gsungs// sdug bsngal sdug bsngal nyid du bden pa dang*// kun 'byung rgyu las 'byung bar bden pa dang*// 'gog pa sdug bsngal 'gags par bden pa dang*// de yi lam ni bla ma bsten pa las// 'phags lam skye dang bden pa rnam pa bzhi// thub pa chen pos legs par gsungs pa'i don// chos kyi 'khor lo dang po bskor ba 'dis// lnga sde bzang pos dgra bcom thob par gyur// lha rnams brgyad khris 'phags pa'i bden pa mthong*// rje btsun byams sogs bla med theg pas smin// tshangs dbang rgyal pos rang gi bsam pa grub// rgyal sras lha mir bcas pa dga' ba skyes// 'jig rten khams 'dir dkon mchog gsum byung bas// bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs dgongs dang po rdzogs// bcom ldan 'das kyis dang por bskor pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo 'di ni 'jig rten du// bskor ba med pa dang po byung ba'i phyir// chos kyi 'khor lo dang po zhes par grags// bla med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// 'khor lo gnyis pa legs par gsungs pa'i don// thub pa chen po rgyal po'i khab tu byon// lam gyi bar du nye lnga bzang po dang*// drug cu bzang sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa btul// dga' mo dga' stobs bden pa dag la bzhag

/ltengs rgyas yul gyi 'od bsrungs ral pa can// lnga brgya'i tshogs bcas ga ya 'od bsrungs dang*// chu klung 'od bsrungs tshogs dang bcas pa yi// ral pa can stong thub pa chen pos btul// ga ya'i 'go la cho 'phrul chen po bstan// ma ga dha yi rgyal po chen po nyid// gzugs can snying po rnam grags lha tshogs dang*// 'bum phrag du ma'i tshogs bcas dpag med pa// thub pa chen pos bden pa dag la bzhag /thub pa'i sras mchog rgyal po chen po des// thub pa chen po ji srid bzhugs kyi bar// chos gos gzims cha la sogs yo byad kyi// bkur sti chen pos bdag gis bkur bya zhes// rgyal po'i khab tu spyan drangs mchod pas mchod// 'o ma'i tshal yang dus 'dir phul nas bzhes// bya rgod phung por rnam grags dpal gyi ri// dus gsum rgyal bas spyad cing bzhugs pa'i gnas// ri mchog de la chos kyi rgyal po yis// nyid kyi bzhugs gdan seng ge'i khri bshams nas// sku lus drang por bsrang nas thugs dgongs pa// mdun du bzhag nas ting 'dzin rgyal po mchog /seng ge rnam par rol pa mnyam bzhag pa// 'jig rten khams ni rnam pa drug tu g.yos// mi mjed rgyal ba'i zhing 'di thams cad kyang*// padmo can gyi zhing khams rnam dag na// bde gshegs padmo dam pa 'jam dbyangs bcas// ji ltar bzhugs pa de ltar zhing 'di snang*// de tshe mgon po'i sku las 'od zer tshogs// mtshan dang dpe byad ba spu thams cad las// 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dag /drug cu drug cu dpag tu med pa byung*// 'od des phyogs bcu 'jig rten mtha' yas pa// gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnams kun// gsal zhing shin tu snang ba nyid du byas// dog sa cher g.yos 'od zer snang ba'i rgyu// so so'i zhing gi bcom ldan 'das la zhus// so so zhing gi sems dpa' chen po yis// zhu ba zhus nas btang ba'i rgyal sras kyis// padmo gser gyi mdog can 'dab stong ba// thub pa che la phul ba bzhes nas kyang*// phyogs bcu zhing du gtor bas padma las// rgyal ba'i sku bzhugs dpag tu med pa yis// zhing rnams thams cad shin tu gang bar gyur// pha rol phyin pa drug gi chos bstan pas// gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad// bsam gyis mi khyab cho 'phrul mchog bstan nas// zhing rnams kun nas 'dus pa'i sems dpa' dang*// nyan thos dge 'dun lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu dang*// gnas brtan chen po shā ri dwa ti'i bu// shes rab chen po nyan thos mchog nyid la// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams// thams cad chos rnams byang chub 'tshang rgya bar// 'dod pas shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// bslab par bya zhes ston pas gsungs pa dang*// ji ltar bslab ces zhu ba yang yang zhus// chos kyi 'khor lo dang por gang bskor ba// sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa lam bden nyid// gdod nas ma skyes spros pa kun dang bral// zhi zhing nye bar zhi ba chos rnams kyi// 'dug lugs gdod nas rnam par dag gyur pa// gzugs nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar// mya ngan 'das pas gdod nas zhi zhing dag

/chos kun mnyam pa nyid du thub pas bstan// nyon mongs med mchog 'phags pa rab 'byor la// chos 'dir spobs par gyis gsung byin gyis brlabs// zhu ba zhus shing spros pa rnam par bcad// skyon med legs par shin tu gtan la phab// de yi tshe na mkha' las lha rnams kyis// ca co ga zha'i sgra dag phyungs nas kyang*// lha yi gos dag 'thor zhing 'di skad ces// kye ma 'dzam bu gling 'di dam pa'i chos// chos kyi 'khor lo lan gnyis bskor ro zhes// sgra skad dbyangs su brjod cing dam par byas// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin po ches// rgyas 'bring gsum dang sde tshan drug la sogs// ston pas legs gsung chos kyi 'khor lo 'di// shes rab pha rol phyin pa blo las 'das// 'di ltar sems ni sems ma mchis pa ste// sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gsungs pa'i don// nyon mongs gsum dang chos rnams thams cad dang*// ma bral mi ldan bsal bzhag med pa'i don// snying por gsungs pa 'di nyid kho na ste// gzhan rnams phun sum tshogs pa rnam bzhi dang*// zhu dang zhus pa'i lan gyis gtan la phab// spros pa legs par bcad pa bsdus pa'i chos// thub pas lung bstan slob dpon 'phags pa yis// smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal zhes// sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa chen po las// gsungs pa 'di nyid yin zhes bka' stsal gsungs// 'das dang ma byon phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi// rgyal ba sras bcas lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi// phan bde'i gzhir gyur bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la skyabs su mchi'o// thub chen 'gro ba'i bla ma bcom ldan gyis// bla med don gyi snying po rmad byung ba// chos kyi 'khor lo gsum par rnam grags pa// thub pa dus gsum byung ba'i bde gshegs rnams// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag dang yon tan rdzogs// mthar thug 'bras bu de las mi g.yo ba// nges pa'i don gyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'di// rtswa mchog grong khyer chen por legs gsungs pa// mya ngan 'das pa chen por gtan la phabs// de yi bar du mnyan yod lha gnas dang*// gangs can ri bo yangs pa can la sogs// gdul bya sna tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa// 'dul ba'i thabs tshul dpag tu med pa yis// smin cing grol bar mdzad nas gdul bya'i tshogs// sku yi dkyil 'khor de yis mi 'dul zhing*// le lo can rnams brtson 'grus brtsam phyir dang*// 'khor lo gsum pa bskor bar bya ba dang*// rtag par lta ba bzlog par bya phyir dang*// gdul bya dpag med 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar nub med pa bzhin// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs na yang*// gdul bya bsod nams zad pa'i snang ba la// nyi ma nub par gyur pa ji bzhin du// shākya'i rgyal po dgung lo brgyad cu gcig

/bzhes pa'i dus su mya ngan 'da' bar dgongs// rtswa mchog ldan pa'i grong khyer rmad byung ba// stobs ldan gyad rnams stong phrag sum cu gnyis// 'byung ba'i gnas gyur sa la zung gi tshal// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ku sha dang*// legs mthong chen po la sogs bcom ldan 'das// sngon tshe byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i tshe// dpag med spyod pa rlabs chen spyod pa der// thub pa chen po gnas der gshegs par mdzad// stong gsum 'di na gnas pa'i 'khor rnams dang*// dpag med zhing nas lhags par gyur ba dang*// lha klu gnod sbyin srin po mi 'am ci// bya dang ri dwags seng ge bung ba dang*// stong gsum 'di na yod pa'i srog chags kun// bde gshegs byin gyis brlabs kyis drung du lhags// 'od bsrungs ba glang bdag po ma gtogs pa// rgyal ba'i nyan thos rnams kyang drung du lhags// rnam bzhi 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu yis// legs par mchod nas seng ge'i khri bshams te// ston pa de la bzhugs pa'i dus kyi tshe// gtso bor gyur pa thub chen rgyal ba'i sras// byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'od bsrungs dang*// tsun dhe la sogs gzhir mdzad bka' bstsal pa// nga ni do nub nam gyi gung thun la// mya ngan 'da' zhes ston pas gsungs pa dang*// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag phal mo ches// ngu zhing smre sngags 'don dang brgyal bar gyur// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba rgya chen btab// rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang*// mya ngan mi 'da' gnad la babs pa yi// zhu ba rgya mtsho yang dang yang du zhus// de yi tshe na sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// sangs rgyas rnams ni mya ngan mi 'da' ste// dam pa'i chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur zhing*// dge 'dun dkon mchog rgyun chad med ces gsungs// bcom ldan gsung la ngo mtshar ha las nas// 'jam dbyangs 'od bsrungs seng ge sgra la sogs// rgyal ba'i sras po dkon mchog gdung 'dzin pa// mngon shes gzungs dang spobs pa thogs med pas// thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho ma lus kun// legs par bzung ba de dag thams cad kyis// dkon mchog gsum po nub par mi 'gyur zhing*// sangs rgyas mya ngan nam yang mi 'da' na// gnas kyi bye brag 'di dang 'di rnams su// 'khor gyi khyad par 'di dang 'di rnams la// dam chos bka' bstsal 'di dang 'di skad gsung*// 'di ni ji ltar lags zhes zhu ba zhus// legs par shin tu gtan la phab pa dang*// legs par shin tu gtan la phab gyur nas// dkon mchog gsum po rtag tu rtag pa la// dga' ba skyes nas bstod pa rgya mtshos bstod// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ci yang mi smrar gyur// de yi tshe na ston pa bcom ldan gyis// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor de la 'di skad ces// nga ni do nub nam gyi gung thun la// mya ngan 'da' ste sang ni khyed rnams kyis// ston pa mi mthong the tshom dri sa med// nga la dris shig nga la dris shig ces// yang dang yang du lan gsum bka' bstsal kyang*// 'jam dbyangs la sogs 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams// sgro 'dogs chod pas ci yang mi smra gyur// shākya seng ge dgyes nas 'di skad gsungs// legs so legs so khyed rnams shin tu legs// nga la khyed kyis sgro 'dogs legs bcad pas// zhu ba zhu rgyu med pa legs zhes gsungs// ji ltar bud shing zad par gyur pa na// me yang shi bar gyur pa ji bzhin du// sku des 'dul ba'i gdul bya zad gyur na// thub pa chen po mya ngan cis mi 'da'// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag dang yon tan gyi// pha rol phyin pas sangs rgyas skyon med cing*// des gsungs chos kyang rgyun chad med pa dang*// chos de nyams su len pa'i dge 'dun yang*// rgyun mi chad par rgyal bas dam bcas pa// de la rgol ba'i dri ba sna tshogs kyis// brgal zhing don 'di gtan la phab pa las// theg pa sna tshogs ston pa'i mdo sde zhes// mi mkhas rmongs pa'i skye bo rnams kyis smra// mdo sde gtan la phab pa zhes smra ba// legs par smras pa yin te ci zhig cig

/gtan la phab pa shes pa dka' bar 'dug /dper na ljon shing rtsa ba bcad nas ni// yal ga phra'u la bstod byed pa ltar// nges pa'i don ston bla med snying po yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba gsum pa la// smod par gyur pa de dag ci 'gyur snyam// 'di la dgongs nas rje btsun mi pham pa// chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan thugs rje can// bstan pa'i bdag po rje btsun byams pa'i mgon// rgyal tshab mchog brnyes chos kyi rgyal po mchog /dga' ldan gnas na bzhugs pa'i mgon po des// theg pa chen po bla ma'i rgyud ces pa// mtshan 'di btags shing don dang ldan pa'i mtshan// dpag med bstod pas bstod cing bkur mdzad pa// rdo rje'i gnas bdun mchog tu bsdus pa 'di// chos kyi 'khor lo gsum pa'i don 'grel du// bcom ldan mgon pos mdzad par gyur 'di dang*// deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar// skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med pa dang*// mi pham mgon la zhu ba zhus pa dang*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stong bar// ma lus 'gro ba sems can thams cad la// chos 'dis rtag tu smin cing grol bar shog /bdag dang ji snyed 'gro ba ma lus kun// chos kyi 'khor lo bla med snying po'i don// bla ma'i rgyud la skyabs su nye bar mchi// thub pas lung bstan 'gro ba'i bla ma rje// snyigs ma'i dus su rmad byung rje btsun pa// 'tsho byed ming can bla ma rje btsun des// nga yi chos 'di theg pa chen po'i rgyud// bla ma 'di nyid yin zhes gsungs pa dang*// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gyur 'gro ba'i mgon// chos kyi rgyal po bla ma rin chen gyis// nga yi chos 'di theg chen rgyud bla ma// 'di nyid yin zhes bka' stsal yang yang gsung*// phyag rgya chen po theg chen bla ma'i rgyud// 'di yi khrid la 'bad pas nan tan byas// 'jig rten mgon las yang dang yang du thos// snying gi pu lur rtag tu bcangs pa las// spu rtse shas tsam nges shes skyes pa des// bdag gzhan kun la phan par re ba 'o// bla med chos kyi 'khor lo gsum po yi// 'dug lugs zur tsam dus 'dir bstan par bya// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang po ni// bden pa bzhi po gsungs pa 'di nyid de// lha yi skad dang klu yi skad dang ni// grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji snyed pa// de snyed skad du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// 'gro ba kun gyi khams rgyud ji snyed par// de snyed chos kyi sgo dang thabs rnams kyis// 'gro ba smin cing grol par byed pa 'di// dang po sems bskyed rgyu 'bras nyid du nges// der 'dus tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu yis// 'bras bu tha dad thob cing chos kyi sgo// bsam mi khyab par 'khor lo de nyid du// rgyas par phye ste dpag tu med par gsungs// rgyal po'i khab tu gsungs pa gnyis pas kyang*// rgyal po'i khab ni rgyal po'i khyim yin te// bzang ngan sna tshogs ci yang 'du ba'i phyir// chos 'di 'khor 'das kun gyi gnas yin te// 'dug lugs bstan pa rgyal po'i khab nyid de// ma rig nas bzung thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes rtogs pa'i phyir// sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid 'byung ba'o// chos kyi 'khor lo phyi ma gsungs pa la// mu stegs rnams kyis dgra bcom thob par gyur// kun tu rgyu ba rab bzang la sogs pa// dpag tu med pas yang dag don chen grub// tsun dhe 'od bsrungs la sogs thub pa'i 'khor// bsam yas rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa yis// 'khor lo gsum gyi nges don gtan la phebs// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba re re yang*// gang zag dbang po tha dad rim pa yis// chos kyi 'khor lo gsum gsum dag tu 'gyur// de ltar 'gyur ba'i gtan tshigs zab mo rnams// 'khor lo de dag nyid la so sor snang*// rim pa gsum po rim gyis nges pa yang*// de dag nyid du nges par mi snang ste// de nyid 'dus pa ta tha sang kra har// 'og min gnas mchog dam pa bla med par// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas nas ni// chos kyi 'khor lo de nyid 'dus par gsungs// rdo rje gdan du rdo rje rnam 'joms dang*// de nyid du ni sangs rgyas phal chen te// ri rab rtse mor chos snang le'u gsungs// mtshe ma'i gnas su mi zad gter bcu gsungs// dga' ldan gnas su rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi// bsngo ba bcu po gsungs par gyur pa dang*// dbang gyur gnas su sa bcu'i mdo gsungs shing*// yum gyi lhums su dpag med 'gro ba rnams// phyir mi ldog sogs rigs can sar bzhag ste// bya rgod phung por 'jam dbyangs lung bstan dang*// gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po'i mdo rnams gsungs// sa la'i zung du rab bzang la sogs pa// gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad la// theg pa gsum po so sor byung gyur na// rim pa 'di zhes bdag cag ji ltar smra// de ltar min yang thub pa'i gsung gis nges// bdag cag mgo bo 'khor zhing phyogs rnams bslad// thub pa'i bka' yang mos phyogs dag tu bzhag

/gzhig long byas na je spun je spun 'gro// sangs rgyas gsung la the tshom som nyi skyes// phu pa byang pa mtha' 'khob bsod nams can// chos la 'khris pa'i sdig med gsung re mad// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// chos kyi rgyal po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// chos kyi bdag po chos kyi rgyal po yis// chos 'di mkhyen gyi bdag 'dra gzhan gyis min// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nas// dung gi tshems bar nas ni skyes chen gyi// ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas 'di skad gsung*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnam gsum 'di// gang zag dbang po'i bye brag gsungs pa yin// cig car ba dang rim gyis pa zhes pa// sems can khams kyi byang chub thob byed pa// rim gyis thob kyi cig car ma yin zhes// yang yang bka' stsal gsung ba 'di re mad// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// 'khor lo gsum po rim gyis bgrod pa dang*// thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs sgam dkyel po che// rku ba'i thabs kyis byang chub sems bskyed nas// dgra bcom rang rgyal sa lnga sa drug pa'i// mngon rtogs rgyud la skyes nas e ma ho// rgyal ba'i sras su bdag cag ma gyur ces// gser la shin tu dga' bar gyur ba'i mi// gser sgrog dam pos bcings pa ji bzhin du// sa gnyis thob nas de la 'dod med cing*// 'gyod pa'i sems gdungs sangs rgyas thob 'dod tshe// rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad ces// dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas thob pa la// gtan du gegs byed ma yin nyan thos sras// gtan gyi gegs su 'gyur zhes gsungs pa dang*// ljon pas pi wang sbrengs pa 'od bsrungs sogs// gar byed gar byed dge sbyong tshul las nyams// rgyal sras rnams kyi de 'dra dpag med pas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i blo skyes pas// dam chos padma dkar po zhes bya bar// nyan thos dge 'dun tshogs la 'di skad gsungs// khyed rnams dgra bcom ma yin zag ma zad// bya ba ma byas byed pa ma byas te// sems bskyed nas ni da gzod sangs rgyas zhes// thub pa chen pos gsungs par gyur pa dang*// dga' ba skyes nas thams cad tshig mthun par// sangs rgyas sras su bdag cag da gyur ces// dbugs ma phyin pa ston pas dbugs dbyung mdzad// shes rab chen po 'phags pa shā ri'i bus// dgra bcom zag pa zad par mnyam pa la// yon tan mi mnyam 'di ci snyam sems pa// ston pa nyid la zhu'o snyam pa 'di// bcom ldan 'das kyis de ring bka' stsal ces// ched du brjod pas yang yang ched du brjod// dgra bcom tshogs rnams de dag thams cad kun// rdzogs pa'i byang chub kun gyi lung bstan thob// kau'u di na ya sogs nyan thos dgra bcom rnams// 'khor lo dang pos smin par mdzad nas kyang*// 'khor lo gnyis pas shin tu smin par mdzad// gsum pas shin tu rab tu smin mdzad par// thub pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum du snang*// 'di yang rgya cher 'jig rten mgon po yis// blo gros 'jug par ji bzhin gsungs pa dang*// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid du rgya cher gsungs// tshig tu nyung la dpag med don rgyas pa// legs par ston pa'i bla ma rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// gnyis pa khyed kyis zhus pa'i don 'di yang*// legs par phye zhing bu la bstan par bya// gzung ba med pas der 'dzin med ces pa// mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par gsungs pa'i don// lugs su 'byung ba rten 'brel skye ba la// dgongs nas gsungs te phan tshun gcig la gcig

/ltos pa mdung khyim lta bu'i rten 'brel du// ston pas legs par gsungs pa 'di yi don// 'phags pa yab sras thogs med sku mched dang*// rgyal sras mkhas pa rnams la mi mthun med// gzung don rtog pa spangs phyir dang*// 'dzin pa mi spong phyir na de// rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam// bcom ldan mi pham mgon pos gsungs pa ste// rten cing 'brel pa lugs las ldog pa yis// phung po lnga la bdag dang bdag gi 'jig tshogs su// lta ba'i ri rtse ye shes rdo rjes bcom// ye shes rdo rje rtogs pa'i don nyid la// ma yengs rgyun chad med par bsgom pa 'di// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' yis// sgom lam thun mong yin pa de yi phyir// ston pas de gsungs de don de yi sras// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras dang*// 'phags pa thogs med sku mched gang la yang*// 'khrul pa mi mnga' 'di la mi mthun med// zhu ba gsum pa legs par zhus pa'i don// nyan thos rnams dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen por rtogs// sdug bsngal de las rang nyid brgal 'dod pas// bsod nams tshogs bsags smon lam btab pa'i mthus// rang nyid nye bar zhi ba'i bsam pa brtan// rigs gsum theg pa chen por nges pas na// dman pa'i blo can nye bar zhi 'dod phyir// byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed mi nus// nye bar zhi ba'i blo gros rab sbyangs pas// nyan thos rnams kyis bden pa rnam pa bzhi// ji bzhin rtogs pas dgra bcom 'bras bu thob// rang sangs rgyas kyis rten 'brel mngon du gyur// rang rgyal byang chub nyid du thub pas gsungs// dang po nyid nas bsam pa rgya che zhing*// theg chen dge ba'i bshes dang phrad gyur pas// rigs gcig theg pa gcig tu nges bstan phyir// de la blo nges yid rab brtan gyur nas// sangs rgyas dag gam byang chub sems dpa' la// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed blangs nas ni// dge ba thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo// bla med theg pa'i rigs su skyes pa des// chu bo gzhol ba'i phyogs su 'bab pa 'am// nyi ma mkha' la 'gro ba ji bzhin du// gong nas gong du shugs kyis 'gro bar 'gyur// tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi lam las 'das gyur na// mthong ba'i lam nyid mngon du 'gyur ba yin// rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog la blo brtan nas// bsod nams tshogs kyi thabs chen shugs 'dzin pas// gong nas gong du khyad par 'gro bar 'gyur// sa lnga thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des// bden pa rnam bzhi rtogs par gsungs pa dang*// sa drug thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yis// rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs par 'gyur ba ni// sa bcu'i mdo nas rgya cher rnam par bshad// nyan thos rang rgyal dag dang sems dpa' che// bsam dang sbyor dang 'bras bu mi gcig na// rtogs tshod mthun pa 'thad pa min snyam na// ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu// blon po'i bu dang lo grangs mnyam pa bzhin// bsam sbyor 'bras bus dman par gyur pa 'di// lo grangs mnyam pa lta bu'i rtogs pa la// tha dad byung yang 'gal ba med pa nyid// sa bdun rang rgyal sa las ring du song*// mar me mdzad dpal bcom ldan mgon po las// utpal lnga gtor skye ba med pa yi// chos la bzod pa chen po thob pa yis// sa brgyad byang chub sems dpar gyur pas na// mar me mdzad kyi lung bstan de nyid du// chos la bdag med dus 'dir rtogs pa yis// sangs rgyas der gzod bdag gis zhal mthong gsungs// dag pa'i sa gsum legs par bgrod byas nas// dbang bskur chen po rgyal ba thams cad kyis// legs par dbang bskur rnam par grags gyur pa// pha rol phyin pa'i theg par bshad pa dang*// bya spyod rgyud du cung zhig bstan pa yang*// lus ngag ji ltar dag pa'i rim pa las// dngos grub ji ltar 'byung ba'i rim pa rnams// dbang skur tshul gyis ji ltar 'byung ba las// rgyu med 'bras bu mtho dman tha dad pa// mi 'byung nges phyir ston pas ma gsungs so// dbang bzhi legs par bskur ba ma nges na// sku bzhi thob par 'gyur ba mi srid phyir// zab mo mthar thug gsang sngags dbang bzhi yis// sku bzhi mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir// rgyal sras mchog gis dbang mchog thob par nges// thob nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog 'tshang rgya// ji ltar ri dbang yungs 'brur 'dud pa dang*// ba glang rjes la rgya mtsho chen po bzhin// skyes chen khyed kyis bdag la zhu ba 'di// rigs par gyur pa ma lags na yang 'dir// dad dang gus dang gdung ba'i shugs nyid kyis// bla mas gsungs pa'i rin chen phreng ba 'di// spyi gtsug rgyan du thogs nas rang gzhan gyi// re ba skong bar 'dod pas yang yang zhus// 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs shing gus blo can// de gsung gces par byed pa'i bsod snyoms pa// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i ri khrod pas// bla ma'i gsung bzhin bris par gyur pa las// 'gal 'khrul byung na gong mas bzod par zhu// 'di las byung ba'i dge bas nyer mtshon nas// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod par gyur pa yi// dge bas byang chub mchog rab thob par shog
/chos kyi 'khor lo legs par gtan la phab pa/ theg pa chen po'i tshul zhes bya ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'ong ges zhus pa rdzogs so// //

107)༄// bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgya mtsho rnam nges sgom pa gsal ba dbang phyug la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa rdo rje 'chang*// skyabs chen 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma yi// zhabs kyi padmor rtag tu gtsug gis 'dud// dam pa de yi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs// byin gyis rlabs kyis chos 'di blo la shar// brtse ba'i shugs kyis rang gi bu la gdams// 'gro ba'i don la skyo ba spang phyir 'bri// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho yin na yang*// dus deng sang gzung 'dzin 'khor ba 'di// byang chub sems gnyis dbye ba med pa yis// 'bad pas 'gro don byed pa de ltar lags// bya byed nyes pa'i rtsa ba yin na yang*// dbyer med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// bya bas mi skyo rlabs chen rgya mtshor 'jug /spros med zhi ba'i las 'di sos re dal// bstod dang bkur bstis dregs par mi 'gyur zhing*// smad dang phongs kyang zhum par mi 'gyur te// srog la blta ba med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// rang gzhan don rnams thams cad cis mi 'grub// snying nas dam chos mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pa// rdzun dang phra ma nga bzang khyod bzang gi /cung zad rlung gis ri rab ga la g.yo// dam bca' brtan pos bsdams pa'i snying rje can// rang dbang yod cing dus la bab dus 'dir// bre mo'i gtam sogs bdud kyi las rnams dang*// nad dang rgas pas zhum pa ga la rigs// dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// rdo rje slob dpon dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// ma lus sems can thams cad dpang bzhag nas// sngon gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi// rjes su slob par bdag gis dam bcas pa// mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la nor bzang gis// dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// dpag med dka' bas bla ma bkur ba ltar// deng sang dus su bdag lta cis mi 'bad// thog med dus nas da lta phan chad du// dpag tu med pa'i lus po zhig gyur kyang*// 'di 'dra'i don la lus srog btang ba med// su zhig chos phyir lus dang srog la blta// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro 'khor ba yi// sdug bsngal dpag tu med pas g.yen spyos shing*// don med log par ltung bar bzod gyur na// rlabs chen don rnams bsgrub la cis mi bzod// 'khor bar 'khor tshe skye gnas thams cad du// rga dang na dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang*// rdeg dang gsod dang go rar 'jug pa dang*// gshin rje'i skyes bu brtse ba med pa dang*// bran dang yang bran rje bos nyen pa dang*// stobs ldan dgra yis rnam par gtses la sogs// snyan pa'i tshig 'ga' tsam yang mi thos shing*// spyo ba drag pos rtag tu spyo byed pa// yi mug re thag chad pas bzod byed na// su la gces ka byed cing 'dir mi bzod// snying stobs chen pos de ltar go bgos nas// brtul zhugs drag pos nyams su blang ba'i thabs// gong ma'i rnam thar gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po'i rten 'brel sgrub// snang srid 'khor 'das skyid sdug thams cad kun// rang gi bsam pa yin zhes bla mas gsungs// rdzun po min na bzang sems bsgrub par rigs// de yang bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// rgyud tshod mtho dang lta ba mthon po dang*// btsun po rgyud mtho chos pa bzang po rnams// snang ba chos kyi sku dang yi dam du// blo gros nges pas gzhan du mi 'tshol zhing*// g.yo sgyu med pas rtag tu bkur na yin// yang dang yang du bka' stsal yang yang gsungs// tshe thung nad mang 'phral 'phral 'gyur dus 'dir// bla ma dam pa'i gsung dang 'gal ba 'dis// sa la bar mthongs bye nas lus 'di nyid// rdo rje dmyal bar lhung bar ma gyur mtshar// sku gsum zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yi// rten 'brel sgrubs shig chos las skyes pa'i bu// bzang po'i rgyud mtho mthar thug sangs rgyas kyang*// 'di las gzhan med khyed kyis go bar zad// sa gzhi lta bur 'di la rten bcas nas// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi brtul zhugs mchog

/bla med theg pa chen po bgrod gcig pu// pha rol phyin pa drug gi brtul zhugs gzung*// 'di 'dra'i zhing la mgo dang rkang lag kyang*// bskal pa dpag tu med par gtong rigs na// bu dang chung ma lus dang longs spyod kun// 'jungs par gyur pas ci'i phyir gtong mi byed// tshul khrims phung po yon tan kun gyi gzhi// stobs dang mi 'jigs rgyal ba'i ma 'dres chos// tshe 'dis sangs rgyas thob pa tshul khrims phung po nyid// rgyal bas gsungs pas srog las gces par srungs// kha mi zol 'bum wa mos seng ge'i sgra// bla med theg pas tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyang*// bzod pa'i go cha med la mi snang ste// bzod pa gsum gyi go cha bgo bar bya// brtson dang 'grus pas rang gzhan don kun 'grub// chang dang 'dod yon gnyid kyis non na ko /'phags pa zag pa med pa'i yon tan rnams// thob pa srid dam bu gcig yang yang dgongs// bsam pa brtan pos zhe bcad brtan pa'i mthus// ru sbal khog mas rgya mtsho zad nus pa// bsam pa brtan pa'i mthu yin gzhan ma yin// rtse gcig yid dang ma 'bral rnal 'byor pa// kun mkhyen thams cad 'khor 'das bde skyid kun// ji snyed mkhyen dang ji bzhin mkhyen pa yi// mkhyen pa gnyis po thub pa'i gsung mkhyen pa'i// dam pa'i zhabs pad spyi bos blang ba gces// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po de lta bur// snying nas nyams len de ltar byas pa las// dngos grub bar chad ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul// bla ma'i gsung dang mdo rgyud thams cad du// rgya mtsho lta bur mtha' yas bzhugs pa rnams// legs par bsdus nas bu la bstan par bya// gnyen po rgya mtsho nyams su blangs pa yis// spang bya rgya mtsho spong bar 'gyur ba ste// spong ba'i lugs ni 'di ltar shes par bya// thog med dus nas tha ma da yi bar// nyon mongs gsum po mtha' yas grangs las 'das// gong du bstan pa'i gnyen po nyams len gyis// spang bya slongs pas ji ltar slongs tshod du// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel gsum du 'byung*// nang dang gsang ba'i rten 'brel go bar zad// phyi yi rten 'brel cung zad ngo sprad na// nyon mongs gsum las skyes pa'i lus can rnams// bsam pa'i bar chad lus kyi bar chad dang*// longs spyod bde ba'i bar du gcod pa rnams// rten 'brel che bas cis kyang 'byung bar nges// sems can gnod pa a cang ches lags te// 'phags pa rnams kyang dus 'dir gnod par byed// mkha' 'gro rnams kyang ting 'dzin drod nyul te// thub pa chen pos 'char ka phul nas btang*// sa gsum dbang phyug lha dbang brgya byin gyis// brtul zhugs spyod pa rnams la shin tu 'tshe// shin tu dri med grags pas bstan par gsal// nyams su ji ltar blang zhing bzlog pa'i thabs// chags par gyur na sbyin pa btang ba dang*// byams dang snying rjes sdang ba mtha' dag sel// gti mug 'dzin pa'i nyes pa chen po las// mkha' la rgyu ba'i bya bzhin ma chags pas// nyes tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu'i bdud las rgyal// nyon mongs gsum gyis rang nyid bdud du 'gro// de phyir khyed kyis bcu dang gsum po yi// chos 'dis ma lus thams cad bsgrub par mdzod// de ltar go cha chen po bgos byas nas// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya mtsho bkur ba dang*// dam chos rgya mtsho khong du chud pa dang*// dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhabs tog byed pa dang*// legs spyad rgya mtshos rang gzhan smin pa dang*// grogs mchog rgya mtshos mtho dman sna tshogs kyis// rang rgyud rgya mtsho sbyong bar byed pa dang*// bskal pa rgya mtshor skyo ba med pa dang*// zhing rnams rgya mtshor rgyan rnams sgrub pa dang*// yon tan rgya mtsho rgya mtsho rgya mtsho dang*// sems can rgya mtsho smin par byed pa rnams// thabs mang rgya mtshos rang gzhan smin byed pa// ded dpon thugs rje chen po gtsug gi rgyan// bram ze'i rigs byung dge slong skar ma sogs// dad pa'i sar spyod chen po'i chen po rnams// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang*// phrag dog la sogs spyod pa mtha' yas kyis// 'gro ba mtha' yas 'dul bar byed pa rnams// dam pa'i skye bo mkhas pa phal cher kun// rin chen gdugs dpes mchil lham 'gebs snyam byed// nyon mongs spyod pas nyon mongs can 'dul kyang*// dul bar gyur nas sbyangs sdom spyod phyir dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas zla 'od gzhon nu'i bkas// zab cing rgya che nyams rtogs rin po che// bla ma gong ma rnams la mnga' mod kyang*// bdag gis gzhan la phan par gyur pa 'di// jo bo'i rjes su 'brangs par gyur pa yis// 'di ltar phan zhes bka' stsal yang yang gsung*// bla med gsang sngags rab tu byung rnams kyis// legs par spyad du yod par gyur pa 'di// kho bo bka' drin che zhes gsung phyir dang*// rgyud sde kun gyi snying po bla med don// dam pa dang po sangs rgyas rgyud chen las// snying po don bsdus 'jam dbyangs kyis phyung ba// dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud rgyal gyi// 'grel pa dri med 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa// mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyis bka' bkrol pa// tshad ma'i tshad mar gyur pa de nyid las// bla med rdo rje theg pa'i gsang sngags la// rten ni rab dang mchog rab dge slong ste// 'bring na dge tshul rdo rje 'dzin pa yin// tha ma dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa las// gzhan gyis min te mkhas la sogs pa yi// yon tan che yang khyim na gnas pa yi// rdo rje slob dpon tshogs kyi slob dpon yang*// dge slong rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal zhes// rdo rje 'chang chen thub pas gsungs phyir dang*// bla med theg pa'i gsang sngags rgyud rnams su// rdo rje 'chang gis dpag med gsungs pa'i don// thub pa'i lung bstan mnos pa bcom ldan 'das// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan// mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che// 'phags pa klu sgrub yab dang sras bcas kyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa dri ma med pa rnams// legs par dgongs shing thugs su gang chud pa// thub pas lung bstan dpal ldan a ti sha// dpal ldan nā ro pa yi rigs las byung*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug jo bo chen po de// tshad mar gyur ces bdag gi bla ma des// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung phyir dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag po ste// che ba'i che mchog dpal ldan rin po che// tshad mar gyur pa bdag gi bla ma des// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu thams cad du// thog ma bar dang tha ma kun tu dge

/thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul stobs bcu'i rgyu// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i thabs// tshul khrims rin po che 'di gtsug gis bzhes// theg pa mchog dang yang na dman yang rung*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i yon tan dang*// rdo rje theg pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho rnams// sbyang sdom tshul khrims brtul zhugs spyad pa yis// 'grub par 'gyur gyi de las gzhan min zhes// rgyu dang 'bras bu rten cing 'brel 'byung ba// mngon sum gzigs pas 'das dang ma byon dang*// da ltar dus su 'di dang 'di zhes pa// lung dang rigs pa man ngag rgya mtsho yis// sbyang sdom brtul zhugs spyad pas legs grub pa// 'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra bsgrags shing*// khyu mchog rlabs chen rnams la dam bcas pas// che ba'i che mchog rnams kyis yi rang nas// zhabs pad spyi bos blangs pas bla ma des// bu la legs par gdams pa'i snying po'i don// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs zungs zhes yang dang yang*// nan tan dpag tu med pas gsungs pa'i phyir// rang la snying brtse yod cing mig yod pas// thub pa'i gsung 'di gus pas spyi bos blangs// de yang tshul khrims gcig pu 'di nyid ni// khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags zhes thub pas gsung*// thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba na// nyams su myong zhing nges shes skye ba'i tshul// myong ba tha dad so sor smra na yang*// lung dang rigs pa rang gi nyams myong gis// bdag la nges pa'i shes pa 'di ltar skyes// tshul khrims sbyangs pa'i yon tan legs spyod pa// dka' thub dka' spyod yin par ma go ste// tshe 'di da lta nyid du che thabs dang*// bzang thabs skyid thabs chos brgyad sgrub pa'i thabs// rang gzhan kun la mi gnod phan pa'i rgyu// rgyun chad med par chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du// sangs rgyas thob kyi bar du skyid pa'i thabs// sbyangs sdom tshul khrims yin pa nyid du go

/lung rig man ngag bla ma dam pa'i gsung*// gong du bstan pa de dag kho nar zad// bdag gis nyams su myong ba 'di lta bu// g.yo sgyu med par bu la bstan par bya// yon tan rgya mtsho tshogs las dben gyur cing*// thos dang bsam pa'i yon tan las kyang dben// rigs dang rus dang nor gyi rnam dben cing*// bla ma yun ring bsten pa las kyang dben// dben par bzhugs pa'i sprang po smra bcad pa// phas kyang ma sos mas kyang ma khyogs shing*// dug lngas g.yen spyod dug chen 'thung la dga'// kha chag sna ral skyon gyis ma tshor gnas// dran pa tsam gyi sgyid lugs ga chad 'u thug pa pa'i// dman pa'i skye bo rmongs pa tha shal gyis// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal mthong gsung thos pas// bdag nyid chen pos rtag tu gang gsungs kyang*// thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab 'ching gyur pas// thabs med shes rab nam mkha'i padmo bzhin// rgyu med 'bras bu rigs pa ma yin dang*// dang po thabs dang ldan par gyur pa yis// shes rab mngon par rtogs pa skyes na yang*// phyi nas thabs la nan tan chung na yang*// byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus chung ba rnams// bskal pa mang por 'gyangs pa go bar zad// thabs dang shes rab tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rnams// rdzogs nas byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa'i// rgyu 'bras cung zad go bar gyur pa yis// thub pa'i gsung bzhin bsgrub par ma nus kyang*// mgon po 'di gsung 'o dod bos pa dang*// gus pas phyogs tsam nyams su len pa'i tshul// g.yo sgyu tshul 'chos 'jig rten bsam pa yis// byas la byed lo byed par 'gyur los kyang*// thos dang bsam pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho yis// blo mig bye ba'i mkhas pa chen po rnams// 'di yi byed pa bzang zhes bkur par snang*// smra bcad rgyu lto lug na 'bros par nges// bstan pa'i babs mkhyen che ba'i che ba nyid// sgrub pa gtso mdzad ma nor lam zhugs pa// dpal ldan a ti sha yi rjes 'brang ba// chos dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa ni// thub pa'i bstan pa gces par 'dzin pa rnams// 'di yi bstan pa 'jig par mi 'gyur zhes// snying la bu bzhin rtag tu brtse bas dgongs// skyon gyi phung po 'chab par mdzad pa dang*// yon tan phra mos bstod cing spel ba yis// padma rgyas pa lta bur chos brgyad 'phel// nang cha mthong ba'i dus kyis ma rnyings na// da rung 'gribs par mi 'gyur tshul 'chos pa'o// deng sang che zhing bzang ba dpag med rnams// mngon du gyur pa khyed kyis ma gzigs sam// tshul 'chos 'di las 'di tsam 'byung ba la// chang kha nas btsags pa yang 'di 'dra na// chang zhabs nas btsags pa 'di ci 'dra zhes// dpag med 'gro ba rnams kyi mgon gyur pa// skyes bu dam pas gsungs pa 'di re mad// thub pa'i bstan pa srungs shig rgyal ba'i sras// bstan pa 'jig pa'i gnyer ka nged la med// lam 'phrang ma shig chos kyi ag tsar can// tshul 'chos nyams su myong ba'i rnam thar 'di// shan pas srog gcod bu la gdams pa ltar// tshul 'chos khyed la gdams pa ma yin te// tshul 'chos med par sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs zungs// sha chang khams gsos 'di yang ma dgos te// bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho zhes khyod nyid gsungs// gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa lon par nges// srog la bab kyang sbyangs sdom mi gtang ngo*// thub pa chen po bcom ldan chos kyi rjes// gnas brtan chen po 'phags pa nye sde la// khyod kyang mdzes la khyod kyi 'khor rnams mdzes// mdzes pa'i rgyu rkyen gang yin smros zhes gsungs// nye sdes bcom ldan 'das la 'di ltar zhus// rab tu 'byung ba bdag gi drung 'ongs na// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis sgrub nus sam// sgrub par nus na rab tu 'byin pa dang*// mi nus zer na rab tu ma byung bas// bdag gi 'khor rnams shin tu mdzes zhes zhus// thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mdzes gyur na// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun la cis mi mdzes// tshe 'di khe grags 'dod na brtul zhugs spyad// 'jig rten chos brgyad khe grags 'byung ba'i tshul// sa gzhi lta bu yon tan dang po 'o// yon tan gnyis pa 'phags pa nyan thos kyi// dgra bcom la sogs yon tan 'byung ba yang*// sbyangs sdom tshul khrims 'di nyid gzhir gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po mkhas dang dam pa rnams// zhal mthun tshig dang dbyangs su mthun par gsungs// drang srong chen po mi dbang bcom ldan gyis// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rnams// dus gsum kun tu byung ba dpag med pa// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyad pas zhi gnas dang*// lhag mthong yon tan skyes par gyur pa yi// tshul lugs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa rgya chen yang*// ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pas// sangs rgyas bcom ldan spyan chen bla ma dang*// chos dang dge 'dun sde gnyis lhar bcas kyi// 'jig rten thams cad dpang du bzhag byas nas// dang po sems bskyed brtul zhugs 'di ltar bzung*// deng nas ji srid byang chub thob bar du// rnam dag dge slong dag tu ma gyur na// sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lhar bcas 'jig rten thams cad bslus gyur cing*// nam yang byang chub 'thob par mi 'gyur zhing*// nyes tshogs kun gyis ldongs par gyur cig ces// dam bcas smon lam de ltar btab pa dang*// rnam dag dge slong mchog tu gyur nas kyang*// dgon pa ba dang

1 bsod snyoms 2 phyag dar khrod 3 // stan gcig pa dang 4 zas phyis mi len dang 5 // dur khrod 6 bla gab med dang 7 shing drung dang 8 // tsog pu pa dang 9 gzhi ni ji bzhin dang 10 // chos gos gsum pa dang ni 11 phying pa 12 ba// sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis 'di dag bzung nas kyang*// 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes chos la mkhas// dam chos ston par bdag ni ma gyur na// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bslus gyur ces// dpa' bo de yis smon lam de ltar btab// ji ltar sems bskyed de ltar spyad pa las// mngon dga'i zhing du da lta sangs rgyas pa// bcom ldan mgon po mi 'khrugs pa zhes pa'i// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i srid sbyong zhing*// byang chub mchog las nam yang mi ldog pa// sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing dang 'khor gyi tshad// bsam pa'i yul las 'das par gyur pa de// bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs dang mgon gyur pa// shar gyi phyogs na bzhugs zhes thub pas gsungs// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod thams cad du// rnam dag dge slong 'di 'dra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin// rgyal ba rnams kyis bstod pa rgya mtsho yis// legs par bstod pa klog mkhan bdag gis mthong*// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang tshe dpag med pa dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho dpag tu med pa yi// smon lam rgya mtsho 'di dang 'dra ba ste// khyim nas rab tu byung zhing brtul zhugs spyod// yon tan rgya mtsho sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs bsnams// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs rgya mtsho sbyong mdzad pa// drang srong chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyi// 'bras bu 'di la dpag na rgyu dang lam// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyod pa 'di nyid las// lam gzhan med par bdag gis snying la nges// sa gzhi lta bur yon tan gzhi rten du// thub pas legs par gsungs pa gsum pa 'o// yon tan gzhi rten bzhi pa bstan pa ni// dpal ldan a ti sha dang 'jig rten gyi// mgon po phag mo gru pa rin po ches// nyan thos sdom pa so sor thar pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bstan pa dang*// gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa gsum// rten can nyid du bzhed par gyur pa 'di// bla ma de yi zhabs kyi rdul la reg

/nyi ma'i zer gyis ngar snabs 'od 'byin ltar// gsung 'di spyi bos blangs shing nges pa skyes// rjes su 'brang bas grub pa'i mtha' 'di 'dzin// lung dang rig pas nges par gtan la phab// nyams su myong bas 'di la nges shes skyes// de yang mgon po 'jam dbyangs rtsa rgyud las// tshul khrims 'chal bas sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba ni// yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no// ji ltar ta la'i shing gi mgo bcad pa// skyes zhing 'phel bar gyur pa mi srid ltar// tshul khrims 'chal la gsang sngags 'grub pa yang*// de dang 'dra bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dag tu// bde gshegs bka' 'das ltung bar gang gsungs pa// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa spangs pa yis// gsang sngags sgrub par byed pa 'di yin zhes// mnyam med bla ma de las yang yang thos// tshad mar gyur pa 'phags pa yab sras dang*// gong du smras pa'i thub pa'i rgyal sras rnams// sbyangs sdom bstan pas theg chen gsang sngags kyi// yon tan rgya mtsho mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub mtha' yas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob// mang po smras pas su la ci bya ste// sa bcu man chod kun la sgrib pa yod// sgrib pa gnyen po sbyangs dang bsdom pa yi// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa 'di las gzhan pa yi// med cing mi srid nyid du nges pa yin// de ltar gyur na gsang sngags dam pa'i tshig /rang spyod 'dor ba ches zhes grags pa'i don// rig pa brtul zhugs ji ltar spyod pa'i tshul// glang chen myos pa stag dang seng ge bzhon// sbrul gyi ske rags phyag rgya khrid cing 'gro// dpag tu med pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston pa dang*// 'gal lo zer zhing snyam par gyur na yang*// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyad par gyur pa yis// nyon mongs dag pa'i gnyen po'i lag rjes su// ting 'dzin skyes las byung ba ma yin nam// de ltar gyur na 'di la 'gal ba ci// 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa rnam 'phrul ba// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa nyid la yang*// rgyal bas bkag pa med pa nyid du snang*// 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po mo'u 'gal bus// rang gi slob ma dgra bcom khyer ba la// gdug pa gshed ma'i dmag tshogs sprul nas kyang*// sku yi sras gyur bzang po sgra can 'dzin// gling bzhi 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal po la// btsun mo brgyad khri bu pho stong dang bcas// rin chen sna bdun dmag dang bcas pa sprul// yon tan de la nyes pa gleng ba med// sgra gcan bzang po tshul khrims brtul zhugs las// nyams pa ma yin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// dge slong brtul zhugs spyod la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mtha' yas pa// sprul pa sprul nas gzhan gyi don mdzad pa// sbyangs sdom ting 'dzin nyid las byung ba ste// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur 'bum pa las// shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di spyod pa// ngan song gsum du nam yang mi skye gsungs// rgyal ba'i sras po 'phags pa rab 'byor gyis// de ltar gyur na 'di ltar bcom ldan gyis// byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs dpag med las// ngan song gsum du skyes pa mang po gsungs// ngan song gsum du skyes par gyur pa'i tshe// dge ba de dag gang du mchis zhes zhus// ston pas de la 'di skad bka' bstsal pa// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gang du yang*// sus kyang mi nus spyad pa spyod byed pa// phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yi// spyod pa mtha' yas spyod par gsungs pa'i phyir// dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i sems dpa' che// gdul bya dpag med 'dul bar byed pa dang*// zhing rnams rgya mtsho sbyong bar byed pa dang*// spyod pa rgya mtsho spyod par byed pa rnams// dka' thub brtul zhugs rnams las nyams pa med// gsang sngags theg pa spyod pa'i sems dpa' yang*// 'di las gzhan pa yod pa ma yin te// gsang sngags sgor spyod byang chub sems dpa' zhes// rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud du gsungs pas so// de ltar tshul khrims brtul zhugs kyis// de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rnams// ma lus thams cad 'di las 'di 'byung ba// mtshan dang dpe byad rab tu 'bar ba'i sku// tshul khrims bsrungs pa 'di las 'di 'byung zhes// bram ze sen rings zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs// tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// 'phags pa sdud par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// pha rol phyin drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// sa bcu lam lnga yongs su rdzogs pa yis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub rdo rje 'chang gi sku// thob par 'gyur pa gsang sngags rgyud du gsungs// slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten gsungs pa'i don// yon tan gzhi rten bstan pa bzhi pa 'o// dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyad las nges 'byung zhes// bla ma'i gsung sgros bdag gis bris pa las// dge ba gang thob des ni 'gro ba kun// sgrib gsum dag nas byang chub mchog thob shog

/tshogs gnyis rgya mtshos nam yang mi ngoms shing*// bla ma dkon mchog rgya mtsho mnyes byed pa// rgya mtsho lta bu'i slob mas zhus pa lags// bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgya mtsho rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong sgom pa gsal ba dbang phyug gis zhus pa rdzogs so/// / 108) ༄// bsam mi khyab pa'i rnam thar sdong po rgyan pa gsal ba dbang phyug la gnang ba// sems kyi de nyid rnam dag nam mkha' la// gnyis med byang chub sems kyi nyi dkyil rgyas// kun tu bzang po 'od zer drwa ba 'gyed// nyes tshogs mun sel bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// smig rgyu'i rgya mtshos ri dwags skom grir shi// thag pa sbrul du bzung bas byis pa bred// ser ba'i 'bru gu rin chen yin snyam 'khrul// bdag tu 'dzin pa yod ma myong bas bslus// bdag 'dzin bral ba brtan pa'i sa gzhi la// snying rje chen po byang sems sa bon btab// dgag sgrub bslab pa'i so nam yur khugs byas// rtse gcig ma yengs dus la bab pa dang*// smon lam rgya chen char zhod snyoms pa yis// dpag med yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// rtsa ba lo ma me tog 'bras bur smin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i yon tan rnams// nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin lhun gyis grub pa dang*// rtsol ba med cing rgyun chad med pa yis// rang gzhan 'tsho ba'i gter chen mi zad pa// tshad ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs pas rnyed// rgyal ba rnams dang de yi sras rnams dang*// tshangs dbang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*// u tum wa ra ltar mdzes mi dbang gi /spyod pa rab spangs gsal ba dbang phyug gis// 'khor 'das ma lus 'tsho ba'i rin chen 'di// bsod nams bsags dang bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed// sems kyi ngo bo rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// chos rnams ma lus bde chen lhan cig skyes// gnyis med byang chub sems su ro gcig pa'i// bde ba chen po rol pas rnam rol nas// spang blang med pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa// bcom ldan 'das 'di mos gus can gyis rnyed// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa nam mkha' yi// mdud pa dam pos 'gro ba bcings gyur nas// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gting mtha' med pa ru// snying brtse med pa gshin rje'i skyes bu yis// brlag par byed pa'i rtsa ba gang yin pa// gcod par byed pa'i mngon rtogs ral gri de// tshad ldan bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed pa yin// sems can khams mang bskyed pa'i pha dang ma// gti mug dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi dang*// sred pa'i rgya mtsho zhe sdang 'khor yug ri// dus mtha'i me ltar bsreg pa dam pa'i chos// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis gang gsungs pa// lugs las 'byung dang ldog pa'i rten 'brel 'di// rgyu 'bras mkhyen cing gzigs par gyur pa yi// zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa'i drin gyis rnyed// kun 'byung sa bon las dang nyon mongs las// 'bras bu sdug bsngal gsum dang phung po lnga// 'khor ba'i 'khor lor thub pa chen po yis// thugs su chud nas bkag pa gnang med cing*// ma chags pa dang zhe sdang gti mug med// thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba yi// 'phags pa'i lam mchog mi g.yo gya nom pa// de las byang chub rnam pa gsum 'byung bas// gnang zhing sgrub pa'i bslab pa rgyal bas gsungs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i gnad dang snying po'i don// bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs pad la// gus pas gtugs shing yun ring bsten pas go

/rgyal sras sangs rgyas rigs las byung ba rnams// yab kyi pha phogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis// 'dir bde phyi mar bde zhing rtag tu bde// skye dgu mang po'i bu dang zas nor dang*// rang gi srog bas phangs pa'i dngos po yis// bdag bde sgrub pa'i thabs mchog gang yin pa// mkhas pa rnams kyis bsten par cis mi byed// sems nyid spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba la// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dri mas ma gos pas// khams dang bag la nyal dang bsam pa'i tshogs// byad dang me long dkyil 'khor ji bzhin du// nor 'khrul med par mngon du gyur pa yis// padma'i mtsho la ngang pa ji bzhin du// rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'gro ba'i don du 'jug /pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel yi dam lha// mthar thug chos sku yon tan phrin las bcas// rang nyid yin par ma rtogs sems can la// nam mkha'i dbang phyug dpa' bos 'gro don byed// mthong dang thos dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// spro zhing dga' ba skye bar gyur pa dang*// 'di yis nam yang bslu bar mi 'gyur zhing*// nyes tshogs phung po'i 'byung khungs ma yin zhes// blo gtad snying bzhag byed pa'i gdul bya la// zab dang rgya che theg pa'i snod yod na// byang chub sems dpas gdul bya smin par byed// pha bzang mes po bzang zhing rigs rgyud btsun// nga bdag bzang zhing sus kyang 'gran med pa// kun gyis bkur ba'i bla ma bdag rlom na// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba dam pa'i chos// bcu dang gsum du yongs su grags gyur pa// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bla na med pa 'dis// rang rgyud smin cing gzhan rgyud grol ba yi// brtul zhugs ci'i phyir 'dzin par mi byed ces// rang gi rang la gzhen skul yang yang 'debs// rigs rus lang tsho yon tan bsnyems pa yis// khad kyis bya long yod pa'i log shes kyis// rgas 'khogs gtugs pa'i lus su byung gyur na// sdom pa rnam gsum rten mchog gzhon lus kyis// nyon mongs bdud dang skye 'jig med pa'i lus// nam zhig thob ces snying la yang yang bskul// bla ma rnams dang dus gsum 'phags pa dang*// bstan pa'i bka' srung dpang du bzhag gyur nas// 'gro ba thams cad smin par dam bcas pa// rang nyid dbang ba'i rdzas dang yo byad dang*// phan bde sgrub pa'i dam chos rin po che// ston pas bu la bzhag pa'i pha nor yang*// 'gro ba gzhan la gtong bar mi nus na// nam mkha' mdzod dang lag na rin po che// dpag bsam shing dang nor bu rin chen ltar// chos dang zang zing phun sum tshogs pa yis// sbyin pa'i dbang phyug chen por ji ltar 'gyur// phyi yi rdzas dang nang gi gnyen 'brel dang*// 'dod chags spyod pa'i yul la 'chums

zhen pa gyur pas// bla ma dkon mchog ya rabs grogs mched la'ang*// 'dzems pa med cing mgo bo bcad gyur kyang*// ngo tsha med par chags zhen 'chums gyur na// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis mi zad gter// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan// dus gsum bde ba'i 'byung gnas tshul khrims la// klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu ji bzhin du// ci yi phyir na 'chums par mi 'gyur ba// bdag lta rab tu byung ba dgos pa ci// zhe sdang 'khrugs pa'i yid kyis ches 'khrugs pas// rang nyid gsod pa'ang dka' ba ma yin na// bla ma pha ma la sogs ci smos pa// mi bzad gdug pa'i sems 'di skyer rung na// rang gzhan mnyam dang rang bas gzhan gces pa'i// thog ma bar dang mtha' mar dge ba yi// tshad med byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// rnam par 'khrugs shing smyos par gyur na ko /gzhan don su yis byas pa su ma byung*// shin tu mi bzad ngar 'dzin dug shing gi /rtsa ba lo ma me tog 'bras bu rnams// dam chos ltar snang chos brgyad chu lud kyis// 'phel bar byas pa'i nga rgyal dug sdong gis// rang gzhan phung bar byed pa'i che thabs 'di// thabs dgus btsal bar byed pa sha thang ba// rang bzhin rtogs pa'i sta re rnon po yis// nga rgyal dug sdong ci'i phyir gcod mi byed// tshogs sam dben pa gang du 'dug kyang rung*// nyon mongs tshogs la 'gran sems brtul zhugs bzung*// rang sems rin chen dri ma yang yang phyi// bslab gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bya// bla ma dam pa rnams dang dkon mchog gsum// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu yi// zhabs 'bring zhabs tog tshul lugs 'di lta bu// brtson 'grus rlung gi shugs ltar khyod kyis bsgrubs// rang gi pha dang ma dang gnyen gyur cing*// dpag med yon tan rgya mtsho bskyed pa yi// bla ma dam pa bla mar 'os gyur cing*// rigs gcig skyabs gcig lta spyod gcig pa yi// dam pa rnams kyi yon tan rgya mtsho la// snying nas mi dga' brjod par mi 'dod cing*// thos par gyur na kha nas khrag skyugs pa// rang gi rgyud la da lta skyer rung na// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// gnyis med byang chub sems su ro gcig cing*// rang las gzhan med byams chen ting 'dzin gyis// phrag dog nyes rtsa ci'i phyir bsreg mi byed// nyes tshogs rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa yi// kha 'dzin zhe 'dzin 'di ltar 'chums gyur na// yon tan gzhi rten bdag med brtul zhugs la// ci yi phyir na bdag cag mi 'bad ces// rang gi sems la dri ba yang yang dris// tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang*// tshe yi tshad ni ci tsam mi shes pas// ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar// thub pa'i dgongs pa tshad ldan bla ma yis// gdams ngag rin chen nyes tshogs skyon bral ba// bu gcig khyod kyis snying gi dbus su chongs// mnyes pa gsum gyis bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrub// bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes par gyur pa dang*// brtul zhugs drag pos sgrub la brtson pa yi// slob mas bskul nas bris par gyur pa yi// dge ba gang yin des ni 'gro ba kun// thub pa'i dgongs pa mchog la rab gzhol te// skyon dag yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs nas// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog

/rje btsun byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa sdong po rgyan pa zhes bya ba/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong gsal ba dbang phyug gis zhus pa rdzogs so// //

109)༄// lam rim rin po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dge bshes dpal dro la gnang ba// spangs dang ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// de yi dam chos bslab gsum kun tu dge ba'i chos// gang gis nyams su blangs pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dang*// smin cing grol mdzad bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud// thub pa'i gsung la blo gros yangs pas ma grol zhing*// rtogs pa'i shes rab mkha' la nyi dkyil ma rgyas pas// 'di don gsal bar bdag gis nus pa ma yin te// gus pa'i shugs kyis slob ma dam pas skul ba yis// bla ma'i gsung bzhin cung zad tsam zhig 'dir brjod bya// spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par bya// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes gsung pa 'dir ma 'dus pa med gsungs/ de yang bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum yin te/ de yang sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing bya ba ni/ sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi 'dul ba'i sde snod/ bslab pa na lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ dge ba phun sum tshogs par bya ba ni/ sde snod na mdo sde'i sde snod/ bslab pa ni lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul ba ni/ sde snod na mngon pa'i sde snod/ bslab pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa yin la/ de yang rten gyi gang zag gcig gis nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ rim gyis nyams su len pa ma gtogs pa/ yon tan rin po che rgyud la skye ba mi srid gsung ste/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ sems rnam par grol ba dang*/ shes rab rnam par grol ba dang*/ zhe sdang dang gti mug 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyir/

sems dang shes rab rnam par grol ba'i chos ston to// zhes gsungs pas/ nyon mongs pa gsum la 'dod cing chags pas ni/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye ba la yang bar du gcod na/ thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa lta ci smos te/ dge slong lhung bzed la chags pas sbrul du skyes nas/ dge slong gi ro dang*/ nags kyi sbrul dang*/ rnam par shes pa dmyal bar bsreg pa'i me gsum dus gcig 'bar ba gzigs nas/ nad pas lhung bzed 'on cig byin cig zer nas sbyin par bya'o// zhes bcas pa mdzad pa lta bu ste/ mdo 'ubs kyis bsdus na/ ston pa'i dgag par bslab pa thams cad ni/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ba'i phyir na/ thog ma dang*/ bar dang*/ tha mar mi dge bas bcas pa'i rten zhes bya ba'i tha snyad yin min med par/ thams cad mkhyen pa dus gsum gzigs pa des/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi nyes pa'i skyon thams cad ni/ rgyu mi dge ba 'di dang 'di las byung bas/ gleng gzhi 'phros pa dang*/ nying 'phros thams cad las/ dge slong khyed kyi de ltar mi bya'o// zhes dgag pa'i bslab par bcas pa las/ ngas ma gnang ngo zhes bdag nyid bya dang byed pa por khas blangs pa ni ma yin te/ stong pa nyid rgyu 'bras kyi skor gsungs pa ni/ sde snod gsum dang*/ sngags dang mtshan nyid thams cad kyi nges pa yin pa'i phyir na/ nyon mongs pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las/ lhung bzed gzhan gyi yin pa 'dod pa mi sbyin pa tsam yang bkag pa ni/ ltung ba sde lnga pas bsdus pa/ nyon mongs pa che 'bring gis bsdus pa'i las yin par dam pa thams cad zhal mthun pa yin pas spang bar bya'o// dgag bya de 'gog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ston pas phan yon bcu yang dag par gzigs shing*/ de'i nyes dmigs bcu mi 'byung ba'i phyir bslab pa bcas par gsungs pa dang*/ yang rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa spangs pas 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po mi 'byung zhing*/

sems dang shes rab rnam par grol bar gsungs pa dang*/ bya dang byed pa mang*/ las dang lam la sgrib/ ngan song gsum du skye/ gzhan dag ma dad par 'gyur ba dgag pa'i dgos par gsungs pas/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyi gsung gi rjes su 'brangs pa las/ tshe 'di nyid la byang chub rnam pa gsum mam/ dge sbyong gi 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi thob pa'i lam gyi rim pa'i dbang du byas na/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'byung ba gnas yin zhing*/ 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa 'byung ba ni gnas ma yin pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'i gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi stobs su bzhed pas/ 'dir de'i rjes su 'brang bar bya'o// de yang ji ltar nyams su blang bar bya zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung*/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las rab tu byung nas/ ston pas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du gdams ngag bcu gcig dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar khas blangs shing*/ dam bcas pa 'di che long du bzhag pa dang*/ zhib tu gzhan du shes par bya ba ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du rab tu byung ba'am/ dge slong gi brtul zhugs sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas pas ting nge 'dzin skye/ chung ma 'chang ba dang*/ phru gu spel ba dang*/ zhing gzhi 'dzin pa dang*/ rta phyugs spel ba dang*/ las ngan ci byed kyang ma gnang ba cig kyang med pa 'di nged kyis byar rung ba zhig yin te/ 'on te gong mas bzhed pa'i yon tan ni su la yang mi snang*/ rtogs gnyis cig car yang mi 'jug spang bya dang gnyen po lhan cig tu mi gnas pas/ rang nyid rang nyid la yid mi ches pa kho na'o// skyes chen bdag nyid chen po rnams// nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyis// 'khor ba'i pha rol 'gro ba dang*// yon tan dpag med 'byung bar gsungs// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// cis kyang nges par 'byung ba la// rang la skye ba'i 'dod chags dang*// skye bzhin pa yi zhe sdang dang*// bdag tu 'dzin pas 'khrugs pa'i yid// 'jig tshogs lta ba 'di nyid las// 'byung bar 'dod pa'i blo med na// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la// chags thogs med pa'i shes rab can// gzhan la mang po bshad na yang*// rgya mtsho'i dbus su gzhigs pa'i grus// pha rol dag tu 'gro ba med// nyon mongs gsum gyi rjes 'brangs pa'i// lus ngag yid kyi las rnams kun// mkhas pas spong ba'i brtul zhugs spyad// las dang nyon mongs spangs pa las// 'bras bu rnam smin mi 'byung zhes// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas na// ston pas rjes su 'brang bar bya// de ltar so sor thar pa'i sdom pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor rnams bzhis bsrung ba spyi'am/

rab tu byung bas khas blangs shing dam bcas pa ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ sbyang pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs la gnas pas/ sngon gyi 'phags pa drang srong chen po rnams kyis rjes su 'brangs te/ dgon pa'i gnas ri khrod dang gangs khrod la sogs par/ gyi na tsam gyi zas gos la brten nas nyams su blangs bar bya ste/ ci zhig nyams su blang bar bya zhe na/ nyon mongs pa gsum gyis dben pa'i yid/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa zhes yongs su grags pa/ sems ting nge 'dzin la yid g.yo ba med par mnyam par bzhag par bya ste/ bsam gtan gyi sgrib pa rgod pa dang*/ 'gyod pa dang*/ gnyid rmugs dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ 'dod pa la 'dun dang*/ the tshom rnams spang te/ byams pa'am/ snying rje'am/ dga' ba'am/ btang snyoms sam/ bsam gtan bzhi la sogs pa sems gang du 'gro ba zhig la mnyam par bzhag pas/ bsam pa'am ting nge 'dzin de nyid stobs 'phel nas/ dang po ni bsam pa de nyid ji lta ba bzhin du bkol du btub pa 'byung*/ de nas ni rang gi lus kyang de ltar du 'gyur/ de nas ni snang ba'i dngos po yang de ltar du 'gyur te/ 'di la ni sgom yun ring thung gi bye brag lo grangs mang nyung gi rtsi bgrang*/ mo mo btsun gyi sgom chen/ mi kha lce gcod kyi chos pa/ ma nyan pa med pa'i sob sgom gyi mi phan te/ chags pa'i yul rnam pa gsum las/ sems dang shes rab rnam par grol ba/ slob dpon shan ta de ba'i zhal snga nas kyang*// zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes bya ste// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// ces pas nges te/ zad par sngon po la mnyam par bzhag pas/ zad par ram mtha' dag sngon po zhes bya ba/ sngon po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems de gzhan thams cad kyang sngon por mthong ba dang*/ de'i dgongs pa bsgrub pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs spong ba la sogs pa 'byung ste/

sngon po ni bai ḍūrya la sogs pa yang yin no// gser ni ser po yin/ dung dang dngul dang mu tig ni dkar po yin/ nam mkha' ni thogs pa med pa yin/ sa ni thogs pa dang bcas pa yin/ de thams cad gang la yang mnyam par bzhag pas/ dmigs pa'am ting nge 'dzin gyi shugs yul dang yul can gyi shes pa gnyis med par/ rtse gcig tu yun ring la dar drag par goms par byas pas de kho nar 'gyur te/ thod rgal rnam pa sna tshogs kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pas/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa mngon par shes pa rnam pa lnga mngon du byas nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen po byed pa dang*/ mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ gong ma thams cad kyi zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog tu 'gro ba dang*/ pha ma dang nye du dang*/ gnyen 'brel thams cad khong dgod 'chor ba dang*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad re ba skye ba/ sems rtse gcig pa 'di nyid las 'byung zhing*/ 'di yod na ni 'di 'byung*/ 'di med na ni 'di mi 'byung ste/ sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di yod na/ de'i khyad par ram bye brag sngon po dang*/ ser po dang*/ nam mkha' la sa dang*/ sa la nam mkha' bsgoms pas de dang der 'gyur ba ma gtogs pa/ rje btsun ma a lce sgom skyid la zhus pa'i gdams ngag zer lo dang yin lo'i dam chos/ a me khams pa'i yang zong*/ khur gcig dang pang gang gi be'u bum/ 'dres khyer gyi sgom chen rnams kyi lag cha/ chu'i chu bur la nor bu rin po cher 'du shes pa yin pas/ sems rtse gcig la 'bad par bya'o// de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor// rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par 'grub// ces gsungs pas shes so// bsam gtan 'di yi gnas dang*/ rgyu dang*/ rkyen dang*/ yan lag gi bye brag bshad pa shin tu mang yang*/ dben pa'i gnas su rtse gcig gi sems gang gis thob bltas la/

mi mthun pa'i phyogs lus dang yul la chags pa la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi sgrib pa rnams 'chi ba mi rtag pa la sogs pas bzlog nas bsgoms pas/ dus gsum la 'jug pa'i sems 'chi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa byung ba las/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba'i rgyu lta bu'i bye brag rnam pa sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin yid kyi las des/ 'khor ba'i skye gnas thams cad du skye zhing*/ 'khor bar go ba gal che ste/ 'di ma go na ni phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi bsam gtan la log pa'i lta ba rnam pa sna tshogs pas/ lha tshe ring po la sogs pa lta ba log pas mi khom pa'i gnas ngan song du 'gro ba srid de/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ mngon shes yod kyang log lta'i snod// ces pas/ 'khor bar skye byed kyi rgyu/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa yin la/ ma rig pa gang zhe na/ bdag tu lta ba/ bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di kho na ste/ rtsa ba 'di yod na de'i khyad par gyi chos bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa dang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ mtha' yod pa dang*/ mtha' med pa dang*/ dben pa dang*/ mi dben pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ma zhi ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ mi stong pa la sogs pa lta ba 'di rnams thams cad ni/ phung po lnga la bdag tu bzung ba/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ srid pa thams cad kyi ma rgan/ ma rig pa ma mo chen mo/ phyi rol mu stegs byed yin pas bdag med pa bsgom par bya'o// de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis// bdag med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pas// mu stegs ri dwags ngan 'jigs byed// ces pas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa spong ba la 'bad par bya'o// 'di la spong lugs zad pa'i mtha' med pa zhig bshad kyang*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ sngags dang mtshan nyid thams cad du/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun 'di/

'phags pa nges par 'byung ba rnams kyi gzhung lam dang gshegs shul yin pas 'di kho na bsgom par bya ste/ de yang dang por sngon du 'gro ba dran par nye bar bzhag pa bzhi las/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa phyi nang gi lus la brtags pas lus bdag ma yin pa dang*/ tshor ba la brtag pas tshor ba bdag ma yin pa dang*/ sems dang chos la brtag pas nye bar zhi ba'i phyir bdag med pa'am/ bdag tu zhen yul lus dang sems so sor phye ste/ gzhig long byas pas bdag med pa'i shes rab skye ste/ 'di'i don phyin ci ma log pa cig bdag gis gang nas rnyed ces/ bdag nyid kyi mngon par shes pa'i rtsal gyis mthong ba'am/ yi dam gyi lha'am/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas lung bstan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags lung bstan pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang la bla ma brgya rtsa bcu lung bstan pa'am/ jo bo nā ro pa la yi dam gyi lhas slob dpon chen po tilli pa lung bstan pa ltar/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa bsten pas/ yon tan gong ma rgyud la skye ste sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro// de la 'di ni spyi'i don legs par snyan du gsol ba lags so// ༈ //bye brag gi don theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang du byas na/ dang po kho na mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa gcig dang 'phrad dgos te/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi brjod bya bla ma gcig pu yin te/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// zhes pa dang*/ yang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma la ni skyabs su mchi// zhes pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhig dgos la/ rdo rje de yang*/ gzhogs pa shing gi rdo rje dang*/
