brdungs pa lcags kyi rdo rje la sogs pa 'dzin pa la mi zer te/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbyer med pa gcig tu gyur pa la gsung ste/ de ltar yang*/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang btud de// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi rgyud du bla ma'i mtshan nyid ji ltar bshad pa/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa zhig btsal nas/ dang po kho na dbang blang bar bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rtsa ba'i rgyud chen po las kyang*// sngags pas dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar// gang zhig rnal 'byor pa nyid 'dod// mkha' la khu tshur gyis brdeg dang*// smig rgyu'i chu ni 'thung dang mtshungs// zhes gsungs pas shes so// de yang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa 'di ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo lha de nyid kyi 'khor du gtogs pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ de'i 'khor du gtogs pa tshangs pa dang*/ drag po dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ sgrub pa byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin la sogs pa bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren de rnams dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rim du gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs na ni sdong grogs byed cing ci nus pa'i dngos grub ster la/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs na ni bar du gcod pa byed pas/ rgyu mtshan 'dis dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya ba/ tha na nad kyis zin pa dang*/ 'jigs skyob la yang dbang bskur bar rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyis gsungs pa dang*/ mtshams med pa rnam pa lnga la sogs pa sdig pa mi dge ba dpag tu med pa byas pa la sogs pa dang*/ shi ba'i ro dang rus pa dang*/ rus gcig pa dang*/ bran dang*/ ming gcig pa la yang dbang bskur na/ sdig pa mi dge ba byang nas mtho ris dang thar pa thob par rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du gsungs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud du dbang rnam pa bzhi bskur bas/

tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum po 'di dang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad bral nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mtha' dag thob pa la sogs pa med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras/ tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs chen po/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan rin po che thams cad kyi gter yin par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor du mi 'jug tu mi rung bar gsungs so// de la dbang zhes bya ba'i don gang yin na/ sdig pa'i grogs po zhig la brten na 'dod chags drag po rgyud la skye ste/ 'dod chags kyi dbang du gyur na 'dod chags spyod pa dang 'dra ba'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas snying rje drag po'i dbang gis byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa dang*/ dbang mchog thob pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la brten nas/ dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum gyi nang du zhugs te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byin gyis rlabs pa gsum gyi dbang gis/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs su 'gyur pa 'di ni mi srid pa ma yin te/ srid pa'am de ma yin pa gzhan gang gis kyang de ltar 'gyur du mi btub pa ni shin tu yang nges pa'o// 'o na de ltar dbang thob pa de gcig pus chog gam snyam na/ sa bon gcig pu yod pas mi chog ste/ rkyen chu lud dang*/ dus yongs su 'gyur bas smin pa ltar/ bza' srung gi dam tshig dang*/ nyams su blangs pa'i dus kyi 'gyur bas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob pa mi dka' na/ dus gzhan dag tu lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ dbang bskur ba ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i sa bon grung po/ yon tan rin po che thams cad bskyed par byed pa'i sa gzhi/ gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gro ba'i them skas/ med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras yin pas/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya'o// dbang bskur nas dam tshig bsrung dgos sam mi dgos zhe na/

de rang nyid la 'dri bar bya ste/ mtho ris lha mi'i go 'phang thob pa la/ de skyed byed kyi rgyu las dge ba rnam pa bcu rgyu'am srog tu song dgos sam mi dgos/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sems bskyed pa de sdom pa blangs pa yin nam ma yin/ blangs pa yin na de bsrungs pas de'i 'bras bu thob bam mi thob/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur bas tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum po 'di kun rdzob mi bden zhing brdzun pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs ni bden pa/ mi bslu ba/ rtag pa yin na/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum la sogs par mi ltung ba'i sdom pa 'dzin dgos sam mi dgos ji ltar yin pa dang*/ khas blangs pa dang sdom pa mi shes pa'i rten gyi gang zag 'ba' shang ro drud bdag cag lta bu gang gis gang la tshul dang thabs ji lta bu'i 'gro ldog spu'i rtse mo tsam yang ma mthong ba rnams ni/ smyon pa smyo ba'i gtam kho na sgrogs par zad do// 'dir yang skyes bu dam pa mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can rnams ni/ dang por khas blangs pa nyams 'og tu chud par byed pa yin la/ mkhas pa rnams ni dam bca' la skyon khel lam mi khel zer ba yin la/ gang zag dra ma rnams kyang*/ chad

khas blangs pa dam ma chad kha la glo gtad yod dam med zer ba ltar na/ khas blangs shing dam bcas pa'i sdom pa de srog gi snying po yin pas/ de'i bslab bya mtha' dag kyang tshig de nyid la gnas pa ni/ sdom pa gsum char la de ltar shes par bya zhing*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags la dam tshig sa ma ya 'bum sder bshad pa yang*/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje thob par byed pa la mang ba ma yin te/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ brtson 'grus che la yid thung ba'i// don du gsang sngags theg pa bstan// ces gsungs nges so// de ltar gyur na gsang sngags sbrul shun gur bcug pa dang 'dra/ dbang bskur ba ni mang*/ dam tshig bsrung ba ni nyung*/ ma bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu ni rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro bar bshad na/ gyong chen po ma byas sam snyam na/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la dam tshig sa ma ya 'bum sde bsrung dgos kyang*/ yi ge drug pa lan gcig brjod pas mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa'i sdig pa ni 'byang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug ni rdzogs/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa ni dkyil 'khor du zhugs par 'gyur/ tshangs par mi spyod pa ni tshangs par spyod par 'gyur ba la sogs pa skyon dag cing yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung na/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig gi nang na de dang 'dra ba'i pha spun dod thub/ mnyam hrug ge ba ma mang po yang yod la/ gang de dag gi gdong du blta ba tsam du yang mi nus pa'i lha mang po yod par gsungs pas/ lha de rnams kyis 'khor ba nas 'don pa ma lags sam/ slob dpon ārya de bas/ byi las ne tso bsad pa'i sdig pa gang ga'i lha mos sbyong gsung skad na/ de dang 'dra ba ma lags sam/ de nyid 'go bsgre/ de nyid kyis tshar bcad pas 'brel dgos zer na/ skyabs su song zhing byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ lus phul ba dang*/

smon lam btab pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs gcig tu gyur pa ci rigs tsam zhig yod na/ de yang 'brel pa ma lags sam/ med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags so// de ltar dbang bskur ba'i dam tshig ni/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal snga nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya bsrung nus na/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la yang tshegs med gsung skad pa shin tu mad gsungs/ 'gro ba'i mgon chen po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig bsam pa'i bye brag gis bsgyur bar jo bo chen pos bzhed pa yin gsungs/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mtha' dag gsang sngags kyi sdom pa rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang sdom par gsungs pa yin gsungs/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud nas/ 'di ltar nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag de/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa/ spyod pa thams cad kyi yang rab mthar thug yin gsungs so// de ltar dbang dang dam tshig dang ldan pa des/ bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rnam par grags// rdo rje'i skye mched thams cad ni// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor nyid// sa chu spyan dang ma ma ki /me rlung sgrol ma gos dkar mo// rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum dang*// gsang chen rigs gcig gang bshad pa// thub pa rgyal bas legs bsngags pa'i// dben pa'i dgon pa yid 'ong bar// theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags bsgom// tha mal lus ngag rjes 'brangs nas// nga mi khom zhes mi gsung bar// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs nyid gcig gyur pa// yid dam lha dang mi 'bral zhu// gal po che la lan gsum zhu// gdams ngag be'u bum mang na yang*// rdo rje 'chang gi lung bstan cing*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub brnyes// gling mchog lho yi 'dzam gling 'dir// nyi zla ltar grags rje btsun pa// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyi// chos drug chos bzhir rnam grags pa// grub thob brgyud pa ma chad cing*// mos gus rgyun chad med pa yis// nyams rtogs rgyud la ma chad pas// byin rlabs rgyun chad med pa dang*// thos pas sdig pa zad par byed// mnyan pas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'du// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// nyams su blangs pas 'byung ba yi// rnyed dka'i gdams ngag rin po che// cis kyang nyams su blang bar zhu// rin po che yi zhal snga nas// pha med gdams ngag mang po yis// byin rlabs nyams par 'gyur zhes gsungs// tha snyad chu yi gnyer ma la// brtsi bgrang byas pas mi lang ba// mkhas pa khyed kyis ma khums sam// rang la skyes pa'i nyams rtogs 'di// dben par bsgoms pas 'phel lags pa// rnal 'byor pa yis ma dgongs sam// mtshan ma'i spros pas g.yengs pa la// zhi bar gnas pa'i gnyer med pa// sgom chen khyed kyis go bar mdzod// bla ma yin pa'i gnyer ka yis// tshogs dang dpag dang dus kun tu// kha zad gre ba ral ral tu// rtag tu snying tshig gdams pa rnams// thugs la zhogs la nyams su longs// spyi dang bye brag dam chos kyi// nyams len gnad kyi tshul bstan pa// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// byang chub sems kyi rjes 'brangs pas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyis// byin gyis rlob cing bzod par bzhes// shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong bsod snyoms pa// rin chen zhes bya dpal gyi mtha' can la// thos dang bsam pa'i blo gros rab yangs shing*// dam pa rnams kyi zhabs pad gtsug gis blangs// bla med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis thugs rgyas shing*// bdag la gus pa'i yid can rnal 'byor pa// dge bshes dpal dro ba zhes rnam grags pas// yang dang yang du gsol btab bris pa las// byung ba'i dge ba gang yin de nyid kyis// ston pa'i bstan la legs par gzhol gyur nas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa myur du rgyas par shog

/bslab pa gsum legs par bsdus pa dang*// gsang sngags kyi nyams su blang ba'i rim pa rin po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 110)༄// sdom gsum gsal byed dri med snying po dge slong sding po la gnang ba// stobs bcu ting 'dzin ye shes mche ba can// gang zhig skye ba'i rang bzhin gzeb bral nas// mya ngan 'das pa'i 'brog dgon zhugs gyur pa// ston pa glang po de la mgos phyag 'tshal// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// gshis sam rang bzhin ngang nyid kyis// mi dge ba zhes sde snod gsum// gsungs pa de yi gnyen po yin// cha mnyam pa dang rnam bzhi las// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// bla med rgyud sde man chad dang*// sde snod gsum po kun tu gsungs// mkhas pa rnams kyi de yi don// dgrol bar byed pa'i 'grel pa mdzad// da lta yongs su grags pa la// mi mkhas blun po gti mug can// nyes dang nyes pa med pa yi// rnam gzhag don la rmongs pa rnams// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin gyi// rgyu 'bras ji ltar 'gyur ba dgongs// nyes dang nyes med gsungs pa ni// rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya// gshis kyi nyes pa med pa ni// nyon mongs las dang de yi 'bras// med par gyur pa ma lags sam// de la ston pas gnang bar gsungs// nyon mongs med cing de yi las// rnam smin 'bras bu bde 'byung ba// sgrub pa'i bslab pa ma lags sam// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// 'bras bu rnam smin mi bzad pa// sdug bsngal rgyun par gnas pa la// gang gis spong bar bya ba yi// bsgrub par nus pa ma yin phyir// nyes pa med ces gsungs pa ste// 'chi bar nges pa'i skyes bu la// nam yang phan par mi 'gyur na// shi ba nyes med smra dang mtshungs// nyes pa gtan med yin smra ba// log pa'i 'khrul pa ma lags sam// de ltar min na 'jig rten du// dkon mchog gsum po ma byung na// nyes pa med par 'thad pa dang*// smyos dang sems 'khrugs tshor bas nyen// 'du shes sems pa yod bzhin pa'i// rmi lam nyes pa med gyur na// nyin par gnyid pa bkag pa dang*// srod dang tho rangs mi nyal zhing*// nyal na seng ge nyal thabs dang*// thum 'phras

gnyid srab mo 'du shes don med 'gyur// gal te gnyid la nyes med cing*// de yi khyad par chos la yang*// nyes pa med pa yin na ko /dgra bcom rnam par grol ba yi// 'bras bus su la ci zhig bya// 'bras bus dgra bo ma choms shing*// 'khor ba'i g.yul las ma rgyal na// 'bras bu gang yin dgongs dang kye// nga la btsun po'i dam bca' med// mi ngom cha phyung zhe 'dod med// gal te gshis sam rang bzhin gyis// las dang lam la sgrib pa dang*// bya dang byed pa mang ba dang*// gzhan dag ma dad thob pa dang*// ngan song gsum du mi ltung na// sangs rgyas byung ba don med cing*// dam pa'i chos 'di don med de// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun don med cing*// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan kyang*// thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin zhing*// phywa dang dbang phyug byed por 'gyur// rjes zhugs slob ma phung bar 'gyur// sangs rgyas drang por mi gsung bas// rdzun pos 'jig rten bslus par 'gyur// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin gyi// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mi bden phyir// rtag gam yang na chad par 'gyur// gal te gti mug nyes med na// 'gro ba gang zhig 'khor bar 'khyams// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ma 'dres chos// stobs bcu'i spyod yul 'dul ba yis// rgyu dang 'bras bu las rnams la// rmongs par gyur pa'i ma rig dang*// nyon mongs rgyu lam ldog pa yis// 'gog pa'i bden pa thob pa'i tshul// de kho na nyid la ma rmongs pa'i// ma rig pa 'di ji ltar spong*// 'di dang 'thad pa dpag med pas// gzhan la smra ba'i gnyer kha med// bu rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma rnams// mthar thug stobs bcu ma thob bar// lus srog phye mar gyur kyang bla// ston pas gsungs pa'i tshul khrims dang*// skad cig tsam yang ma 'bral cig /'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba thams cad gcig gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// lus kyi tshul khrims rnam dag na// lus kyi ting 'dzin rnam dag thob// lus nyid grol ba'i shes rab thob// ngag dang sems kyang de bzhin te// sems dang shes rab rnam grol ba// ma thob thob pa tshul khrims yin// thob pa brtan pa tshul khrims yin// brtan pa bogs 'don tshul khrims yin// mthar thug sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug tshul khrims yin// nga la nye ba gzhan med pas// bu slob rnams la smra ba yin// snying gtam kha chems 'di las med// sor gcig sor gnyis yan chad dang*// mang po sder longs man chad kyi// slob mas yi ge gang zhus pa// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu dang*// gegs sel bogs 'don rten 'brel rnams// 'di las med do gces se rnams// bsdur la zhu thug mdzod dang mngon// 'di na bag med 'ga' zhig gis// nyon mongs gsum la chags pa'i blos// 'di kun dman pa'i tshul khrims yin// dman pa'i tshul khrims bsrungs pa yis// mthar thug byang chub mi thob ste// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*// 'jug sdom tshul khrims blangs pas chog

/snyam pa'i bsam pa skye na yang*// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i sa nas kyang*// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa de// sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin par gsungs// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// dang por byang chub sems bskyed nas// bar du bskal pa dpag med du// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs par byas// tha mar byang chub sangs rgyas pa// stobs bcu stobs la gnas pa yi// thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur zhes grags// brgya la gal te bden srid na// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa 'di// spangs pa'i pha rol phyin lnga 'dis// stobs bcu thob pa rgyu 'bras min// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// gang gis spyad par 'gyur ba des// 'bras bu thar dang thar pa ches// so sor thar pa yin srid na// nyon mongs las dang rnam par smin// gang gis ji ltar spangs pa 'di// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skye dang gnas dang mthar thug gi /rten du ci yi phyir mi 'gyur// rmongs pa khyod la go ba med// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin gyis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal 'byin pa 'di// nged kyis na ning snga nas shes// nged kyi slob dpon che ge mo// mang tang tha se rnyog ge mor// 'di skad zer bas 'di skad bshad// de ltar min pa'i so sor thar// gzhan zhig ya gi ma gir spyod// pha gi tshu gi na yang yod// snyam zhing smra ba yod na yang*// ston pa'i 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod du// bdag nyid dang ni gzhan dag gis// ngan song gsum dang 'khor ba'i rgyu// sa dang lam gyi bar chad dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar chad du// ston pas gsungs pa 'di las gzhan// khyod kyi mtshar po yar po ste// lung dang rigs pas mi 'grub cing*// ston pa'i gsung dang 'gal ba'i phyir// mkhas pa su zhi dga' ba skye// 'di yang gzhan la smra ba yi// gnyer kha nga la yod pa min// rang bas gces pa'i bu slob kun// khyed kyi rnam par thar pa gang*// bdag gis ji ltar nyams su blang*// snyam zhing zhu ba'i bu slob la// dbang gi rgyal po rin po che// bye ba khrag khrig 'bum pas kyang*// lhag par gyur pa'i snying tshig 'di// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// rdo rje gsung yin thugs la zhog

/kye ma khyod kyi dam chos 'di// mgo bas gsus pa phyi phyir sra// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// rang nyid khams gsum 'khor ba las// thar bar byed pa nyan thos yin// bdag dang sems can thams cad kun// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal pa yi// nyon mongs 'ching ba las grol byed// gong ma las kyang phyi ma dog /zab cing rgya che gting mtha' med// tshul khrims phung po bsrung mi nus// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// zab pa'i gdams ngag cig gcig yod// don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas phyir// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// dka' thub spyod pa mi zad de// bsgrubs pas 'grub par yong mi 'gyur// 'dod pa kun la longs spyod cing*// bsgrubs pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur// ma dang bu mo chung ma dang*// mna' ma dang ni sgyug mo ma rgan ste// phyag rgya rnam pa lnga pa ni// rnal 'byor pa yis bsten ces grags// chang med pa la dngos grub ci// ye shes kyang ni de bzhin gsung*// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// ya mtshan can zhig dus 'dir byung*// sla 'o gsang sngags theg pa la// dus 'dir bdag gis spyad par bya// snyam pa'i bsam pa skye 'gyur na// legs par dgongs dang skyes bu kun// bsam gzhig mdzod dang mkhas pa kun// rtog dpyod gyis dang shes rab can// mar khrid ma mdzad tshogs dpon kun// blo 'di babs dang gshis la zhogs// thub pa'i gsung rab dpang por byas// bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar blta// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa// slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyis// ji ltar gsungs pa tshad mar bzung*// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa yi// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// mtha' drug rdo rjes rgyas btab pa// mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya grol ba yi// nyon mongs bdud bzhi bcom gyur pa// dpa' bo rdo rje slob dpon gyi// bdag cag bka' dang 'gal mi bya// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor sgo phye zhing*// mtshan mchog dung gi tshems bar nas// ljags kyi dbang po brkyang mdzad de// dpag med tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// khyu mchog seng ge'i 'khor rnams la// nyan thos byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rdo rje theg pa'i rim pa rnams// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gsungs// nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa bas// bsags pa'i stobs kyis blo log pa// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi// ma rgan nyon mongs dbang song zhing*// de yi las kyis 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yi// don du byang chub sems bskyed pas// 'khor ba sgrol bar byed pa'i thabs// bdag nyid brgal nas sgrol ba dang*// grol nas dgrol bar bya ba dang*// dbugs phyin nas ni dbugs dbyung ste// mya ngan 'das nas mya ngan 'da'// de las gzhan pa mi nus par// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod rnams// 'di nyid du ni rnam par gsungs// bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni// mi yi lus kyang mi thob na// bla med byang chub smos ci dgos// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rgan rnams// las dang nyon mongs dbang song ba// bdag gi spong sems 'di tsam dang*// brtul zhugs spyod pa 'di tsam gyis// rang gzhan ma lus thams cad kun// byang chub mchog la ji ltar 'god// snyam pa'i bsam sbyor drag po yis// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi// brtul zhugs spyod pa gang yin pas// cha dang dper yang mi bzod pa// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis spyod// lung dang rigs pa thams cad kyis// grub pa mkhas pa rnams kyis dgongs// skyes bu dam pas thugs su chud// shes rab can gyis gting nas go

/bdag gi slob ma mgo ldog pa// lham nag can la smras pa yin// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che// brtul zhugs spyad pa de 'dras kyang*// bsod nams bsags pa'i blo stobs kyis// rang snying gang bar ma gyur nas// tshe 'dir byang chub sangs rgyas nas// 'gro ba smin par byed pa la// nyon mongs las dang shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing sa bon dang*// bag la nyal dang bcas pa rnams// spong bar bya phyir zhugs pa des// chang 'thung ma sring spyod pa yi// khrel med ngo tsha med pa 'dis// tshe 'dir byang chub ga la thob// bla med thugs stobs de 'dra la// chang dang ma sring spyod pa yi// bya bas rang la ga la mgu// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing ma bsregs par// rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi sku// thob par theg chen gsang sngags kyi// rgyud sde bzhi po gang du yang*// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa med// bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gsungs pas// skur pa gdab par mi bya ste// rdo rje dmyal bar 'tshed par nges// bsags pa rab tu gyur pa yi// snying rje brtson 'grus shugs can gyis// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon las// smin par byed pa dbang bzhi zhu// grol bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis// rgyun chad med par nyams su blang*// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa bzung*// rgyun chad med par nyams blangs pas// sgyogs dang 'khrul 'khor ji bzhin du// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar// the tshom med par myur du phyin// ma smin smin par byed pa yi// gsang sngags dbang gi go ba 'di// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// de gsum dag par 'dzin pa'i blo// dag par byed pa dbang du gsungs// yang na dbang gi sgra don ni// bsgyur ram dbang du byed pa yin// sgyur byed rdo rje slob dpon ni// bla ma rdo rje 'chang cig dgos// jo bo chen po'i rjes 'brangs ba// skyes chen gong mar bzhugs pa rnams// bka' stsal gsungs pa 'di re mad// lus ngag yid gsum 'gyur ba'i dngos// sku gsung thugs nyid rdo rje de// nyin mtshan med pa thams cad du// bskyed pa'i rim dang rdzogs pa'i rim// zung du 'jug par nyams su blang*// gcig gi bogs 'don gcig gis bya// rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung*// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa 'di// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// dam tshig 'bum sde sa ma ya// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa 'di// man ngag gnad dang bcas pa yis// rgyud sde bzhi yi dgongs pa'i don// gnad rnams ma lus phyung ba 'dis// gnad rnams ma lus phyungs nas 'dug

/ma lus gnad kyi man ngag 'di// bu snying dang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa// tshe 'dir dngos grub 'dod pa yis// snying gi dbus su bcang bar bya// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// bu gces par bsam kyang khar mi thon// snying khrag kha ru skyugs pa 'dra// nga byin pa las kyang god pa dang*// khyed khyi la ma phan ma byed par// gcig pu dben par nyams su blang*// bcom ldan dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// chos kyi sku dang gzugs kyi sku// dbyer med zung du 'jug pa las// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum du// skad cig tsam yang ma shor ba// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum du// shor na dam tshig nyams gyur te// gal te mkha' 'gro brda yi skad// sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gsung na// mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan 'das// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// chos kyi rgyal po rin po che// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i gsung*// snying gtam yin gyis sems la zhog /sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid dang*// rgyun chad med par ma bral zhing*// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yid// gti mug ma rig chen po de// spangs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// chags dang sdang ba cis mi spong*// nyon mongs gsum po spangs pa la// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa'i sku// stobs dang mi 'jigs yongs rdzogs pa// gar dgu'i rnam par rol mdzad pa// dus gsum khams gsum ngo bo nyid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i skur// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// de ltar gyur na khyod nyid kyis// ji ltar gong du bstan pa yi// brod pa de rnams ji ltar thal// gsang sngags tshul dang 'gal snyam na// gsang sngags brda yis bshad pa la// blo dman rnams la ci cha yod// thabs mang dka' ba med pa de// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pa// sku gsum rang la yod pa yin// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// bral ba sku gsum sangs rgyas kyis// yul dang yul can gnyis med pa// 'dod pa lnga yis de nyid spyod// phyag rgya lnga po gang bstan pa// dug lnga rnam par dag pa'i brda// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// bde chen ro yi btung ba la// chang zhes rnam par bshad pa dang*// tha mal chang du gang gsungs pa// rje btsun 'khor lo sdom pa yi// sdom pa 'byung bar gsungs pa yang*// kha dog dri ro nus pa rnams// sngags pas med par bya bar gsungs// de bas gzhan pa'i gang gis chang*// 'thungs shing myos par 'gyur ba ni// ngu 'bod chen por skye bar gsungs// 'di ni rdo rje 'chang gi bka'// chang med pa la dngos grub ci// de na yod de de na med// he ru ka dpal rdo rje la// ye shes bdud rtsis ma mchod cing*// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kyi// 'khor lo chen por ma gyur cing*// sngags pa chang gis myos pa ni// ngu 'bod dmyal bar skye bar gsungs// nyams len bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis kyis// thams cad mkhyen par 'gro ba la// dam tshig bsrung bar bstan pa 'di// nyon mongs gsum las bsrungs ba yin// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// tshig ni de yi bka' yin pas// dam tshig nyams par gyur pa de// rdo rje dmyal ba la sogs pa// 'khor ba'i chad pas phog pa yin// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa yi// sdom pa rin chen gsum po 'dis// nyon mongs gsum po spong bar gsung*// 'dir mang smos pas ci zhig bya// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// dam tshig sdom pa gang yin pa// nyon mongs gsum po spong bar mtshungs// las dang nyon mongs spangs pa la// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhes brjod pas// don de gong du brjod pa bas// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa yi// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi// rnam par bzhag pa bstan pa 'di// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i gsung*// zur tsam bdag gis bris pa las// nor 'khrul gyur pa ci mchis pa// bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis// byin gyis rlob cing bzod par bzhes// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab kyis// thub pa'i gsung la nges shes skyes// rdzas dang zhabs tog sgrub pa yi// mnyes pa gsum gyis bla ma la// mnyes par byas pa'i skyes bu yis// bslab pa gsum gyi tshul lugs 'di// yang dang yang du zhus nas bris// 'di bris bsod nams dam pa des// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// nyes tshogs sgrib pa rab spangs nas// sangs rgyas sku gsum thob par shog
/sdom pa gsum gsal bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dge slong sdings po bas zhus pa rdzogs so// //

111) ༄// dug gsum gnyen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len bslab khog chen mo// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang*/ gsung dang*/ thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du lhun gyis grub cing*/ rgyun chad med par sems can thams cad smin pa dang*/ grol bar mdzad pa'i rje 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// spyir nged rang thams cad skye shi la rang dbang ni ma thob/ mi rtag pa'i srin pos ni bzung*/ 'jig rten pa'i 'di bya ba dang byed pa la zin pa'i dus ni med/ gnyen dang mdza' bar gyur pa rnams kyang ci tsam du btud pa bzhin du/ byis pa 'ja' la bda' ba bzhin du 'bros/ 'dus byas kyi dngos po thams cad chu'i chu bur dang 'dra bar/ cis kyang mi rtag par ni nges/ tshe phyi ma phan chad kyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po la gting mtha' ni ma mchis pa lags pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen po 'jig rten gyi bya ba gtong bar zhu/ de la 'jig rten ni gang*/ bya ba ni gang*/ gtong lugs ni gang*/ btang ba'i phan yon ni gang yin snyam na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'jig rten sna tshogs las las byung*// zhes gsungs pas da ltar gyi rang gi bsam pa 'di la nyon mongs pa skyes/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las byas/ las de'i 'bras bu 'khor ba dang ngan song yin pas/ ngan song du smin pa 'di ni 'khor ba 'jig rten zhes bya'o// bya ba gang zhe na/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po dngos sam brgyud par bskyed pa'i bya ba dang byed pa la ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba zhes bya'o// gtong lugs ni rnam pa gsum ste/ sems can thams cad kyi gshis la nyon mongs pa dug rnam pa gsum yod pa 'di'i gnyen po phyi yul dang nang sems can la chags pa'i gnyen por lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/

zhe sdang gi gnyen por lhag pa sems sam ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ gti mug gi gnyen por lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gsungs te/ de la kha cig tshul khrims las ting nge 'dzin skye/ ting nge 'dzin las shes rab skye bar gsung pa dang*/ kha cig tu nyon mongs pa gang shas che ba'i gnyen po bsgoms sam go ba skyes pas/ nyon mongs pa de dul nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bslab pa'i gzhi khas blangs nas/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa gsha' mar chud nas/ bden pa mthong nas bzod 'byung bar dpag tu med pa gsungs pa yin pas/ cig car ba dang rim gyis 'jug pa gang bden pa dang*/ gang yin pa rtsod par mang yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab kyi gzhi gnyis po 'dir gyur pa lags pas/ de kho na nyid nyams su blang bar bya'o// 'di las gzhan du gyur pa ma mchis kyang*/ bla ma rin po che'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi nyams len cig car du 'jug pa'i man ngag skad cig ma'i bsam pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i de nyid/ gsung rab thams cad kyi nying khu/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes la sbar zin byed pa'i man ngag sems rang grol bas 'khor ba rang grol ba'i tshul lugs ni/ theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa/ theg pa chen pos dang po zhe sdang gi gnyen po byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ phyi yul la chags pa'i gnyen po gzhal yas kyi khang*/ 'byung ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ yul ris dang sa bcad sa rdo dang khang khyim la smon pa med pa'i bzang po bsgom pa dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa'i gnyen por/ bu dang tsha bo nye du dang*/ gnyen 'brel la smon pa med pa dang*/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhi rang gi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ rang gi chung ma la chags pa'i gnyen por/ mi mo nu ma can la smon pa med pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum/

rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la sogs pa la blta ba dang*/ dgod pa dang*/ lag bcangs dang*/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa la sogs pa shes pa ji ltar 'jug pa'i dga' ba dang*/ bde bas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum sras dang bcas pa mchod pa 'di ni/ myur du lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs/ rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i rgyu/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la/ gsung brjod pa dang bral ba'i myong bas/ de kho na nyid ston par byed pa'i rten 'brel/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i 'bras bu nges pa yin pas/ lus lhar bsgom par bya'o// de la bla ma dam pa bsgom pa ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po skem par byed pa'i bskal ba'i me dpung chen po/ ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sel bar byed pa ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen pos/ dngos por 'dzin pa'i blo brag gi ri bo lta bu dang*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa ma gtogs pa gzhan med pas nyin par spyi bor bsgom par bya/ mtshan mo snying gi dbus su bsam gsung*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i mtshams sbyor/ nyon mongs 'khrud par byed pa'i 'khrud shing*/ thar pa'i khang bzang bgrod par byed pa'i them skas/ lam gsum rgyud la bskyed par byed pa'i ma ma/ de nyid ston par byed pa'i ston pa/ bla ma dam pa yin pas mos gus kyi tshad du bskyal bar bya'o// gti mug gi gnyen po yang dag pa'i shes rab don dam pa'i bden pa rgyud la skyes na/ phyi gzung ba'i yul dang nang 'dzin pa'i shes pa nga snyam pa dang*/ nga yi snyam du log par rtog pa smon pa med pa/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa bsgom pa ni/

'di shes nas bsgom mam mi shes nas bsgom/ mi shes kyang bsgom snyam na/ log pa'i shes pa bsgom pa'am/ don spyi bsgom par mi 'gro'am/ log shes don spyi don rang gi mtshan nyid du mi btub par/ khyed rang gi thugs su chud pa yin mod/ don dam pa'i bden pa mthong na mthong lam/ de la goms pa sgom lam yin na yang*/ de dag gi rgyud la mi 'dug snyam na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ lhan cig skyes pa gang skyes pa// lhan cig skyes pa de brjod bya// zhes pas ston pa'i gsung dang ma 'gal ba zhig bsgom pa ma yin du zad mod/ de ji ltar zhe na/ lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ba ni rang nyid lhan cig skyes pa la zer/ rang nyid lhan cig skyes pa de rang gi sems yin mod/ de la lag pa g.yas g.yon ma spos shing ma bcos pa de/ lhan cig skyes pa gang skyes pa// zhes gsungs la/ de nyid la lhan cig skyes pa zer ba yin no// zhes pa'i gsung gis/ lhan cig skyes pa de brjod bya// zhes gsungs so// de'i spros pa gcod pa'i gsung*/ gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// chad pa med par rtag med pa// skye ba med pa 'gag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi zhir bstan pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa 'di la 'gro ba'i mgon po chen po slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dbu ma'i don bstan bcos chen po mdzad pa rnams kyi log par rtog pa spros pa'i mtha' rnam pa brgyad du ma 'dus pa med la/ de dang bral ba'i don de la/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ mnyam med dam pa rin po che// 'od gsal chen po'i ngang la bzhugs// mtha' brgyad skyon gyis ma gos pa// rje chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pas/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa bsgom par bya'o// dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zab mo thabs la mkhas pa/

sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba byas tshad zad mi shes pa'i gter mdzod/ nag po mi dge ba'i phyogs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i rdo rje/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba 'di gcig pu yin pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba la 'bad par bya ste/ de yang dge ba gang yin pa dang*/ tshul ji ltar bsngo ba dang*/ bsngos pa'i 'bras bu gnas skabs dang mthar thug tu ji ltar 'gyur ba gsum du shes par bya ste/ dang po bsngo rgyu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /ces gsungs pas rang nyid kyis byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ 'dod chags med pa'am/ zhe sdang med pa'am/ gti mug med pa'am/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rang nyid kyis byas pa dang*/ gzhan la byed du bcug pa dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba shes pa la dran tshad bdag gir bya/ snying por bya/ ched du bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'i dus 'dir nag po mi dge ba'i rtsa ba dran par mi bya/ 'dres par mi bya/ dge ba dkar po bzang yag tu byas nas bsngo bar bya ste/ de yang 'jig rten mgon po rin po che de'i zhal snga nas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta phan chad kyi bar du/ mi dge ba'i las ji snyed cig byas pa/ sgos bla lhag tu dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pa la 'jig rten gyi sems dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa 'dres na bshags par bya ste/ sdig pa bshags pas mi 'dzad pa mi mchi gsung*/ sdig pa bshags pas sdig pa mi dge ba mi 'dzad pa yin na/ sdig pa rtag pa dang*/ sdig pa sems la gnas par thal ba ma yin pa'i skyon yod pas/ bshags pas 'dag par nges te/

de ltar yang mtshams med pa rnam pa lnga dang*/ sdig pa mi dge ba rgya chen po byas pa thams cad kyang 'gyod pa skyes pas dag pa rgyal po ma skyes dgra lta bu gsungs/ bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ lo stong lon pa'i mun pa 'thug po yang*// sgron me skyes ma thag gis sel ba ltar// 'khor ba'i bag chags rgya chen 'thug po yang*// rang sems rtogs pas skad cig gcig gis zhi// zhes pa dang*/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang*// dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol gyur ba// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi bsten// zhes pa dang*/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig can rnams// skad cig gcig gis nges par bsreg par byed// ces gsungs pa ste/ spang bya dang gnyen po lhan cig tu mi gnas pa'i 'gal ba yin pas/ 'gyod pa skyes pa tsam gyis sdig pa 'dag par nges pas/ skad cig ma'i shes pa de nyid la dag cing dri ma med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dran tshod kyi mtshon nas/ rang nyid dang sems can thams cad kyis/ dus gsum du byas shing bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tshul ji ltar du bsngo na rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya ste/ de ltar yang 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa nas/ byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rtog pa thams cad spang phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nas/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba bya bar gsungs pas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das par ro gcig rang dang gzhan dang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems nyid ma skyes pa phyag rgya chen po gcig tu byas nas bsngo bar bya ba ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces bsngo bar bya'o// bsngo ba'i gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/

'dzad par byed pa'i rgyu rnam pa bzhi la sogs pa gang gis kyang 'dzad par mi nus pa dang*/ dag pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dri ma med pas dkon mchog gsum dang rtag tu mi 'bral ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po ches rang gzhan thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa ste/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya'o// de la 'jig rten gyi bya ba gtong lugs chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad 'di rnams yin/ des sems su mi btub/ bya ba gtong ba la yang mi dgos dgu dgos/ gangs khrod dang ri khrod 'grims dgos/ dka' thub dang sdug bsngal byed dgos snyam na/ de gong ma rnams kyis phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams kyi brtul zhugs su gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor ba dang mya ngan 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bram ze chen po'i don dam pa'i rig pa las kyang phyi rol gyi yul bgrod pas grol ba dang*/ lus gdung bas grol ba dang*/ ngag bzlas brjod kyis grol ba gtan tu mi srid par lung dang rig pas gtan la phab pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ lus ngag gi dka' thub 'ba' zhig ston par byed pa phyi rol mu stegs byed/ sems 'dul ba nang pa sangs rgyas pa yin gsung*/ nyon mongs pa rang gi bsam par 'dug na/ de rgyu 'bras 'jig rten pa yin mod/ nyon mongs pa de nyid ngo shes na de rtogs pa'i shes rab zer/ shes rab skyes pas rnam par grol ba gong ma rnams kyis bzhed pa lags pas/ 'khor 'das lag pa'i lto rgyab yin// sems 'jig rten pa yi bya ba btang*// go ba tsam gyis byar med yin// 'khor 'das lag pa'i lto rgyab 'dra// gong mas gsung ba 'di re mad// 'jig rten bya ba btang thabs so// bya ba'i btang ba'i yon tan ni// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// 'jig rten 'di yi bde skyid dang*// 'jig rten pha rol bde skyid dang*// sa dang lam la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa'i bde skyid dang*// mthar thug rgyal ba'i bde skyid rnams// sems 'dul sangs rgyas bstan pa la// nyams su blangs pa'i lag rjes lags// bya ba btang ba'i 'bras bu'o// ku sā li yi nyams myong 'di// tshig dang tha snyad ma sbyangs pas// mtho dman phog thug mang na yang*// rang gi chos las skyes pa'i bu// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yis// gsol ba btab nas bris pa lags// byung ba'i dge ba rtsa ba 'dis// byang chub dam pa mchog thob shog

/nyams len bslab khog chen po rdzogs so// // 112) ༄// tshogs gnyis rgya che zab par bstan pa yid dbang 'dren pa'i shing rta// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dbyer med bde chen dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs 'chang ba// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la gtsug gis 'dud// sprang po sa mthar 'khyams pa yi// nags dang dgon pa ri dwags ltar// skyid sdug phyogs ris med pa yi// shākya'i dge slong ldom bu la// sngon sbyangs bsags pa'i las 'phro can// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bdag po mchog /stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur pa ltar// 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gyur pa// bdag nyid chen po'i gsung phrin las// yi ge skur cig gsung ba la// blo gros chen po khyod nyid kyi// mkhan slob sangs rgyas 'dra ba yi// legs bshad gsung dang mi 'gal zhing*// skyob pa shākya'i rgyal po yis// ji ltar gsung pa de bzhin du// skyes bu khyed kyis mdzad par zhu// bdag la gdams pa'i gnyer med kyis// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// rtag tu 'chi ba bsam pa dang*// las su bsags pa bgrang ba dang*// dkon mchog gsum po mchod pa dang*// ngo bo gnyis med bsgom zhes gsungs// cung zad de yi don bshad na// bdag nyid chen po i ko ma// ku re min te 'chi bar 'dug /lung rigs bshad bshud mi 'tshal te// cis kyang mas kyang 'chi bar 'dug /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang*// lha klu gnod sbyin gdug pa can// dbang po lags te 'chi bar 'dug /pha dang ma dang gnyen 'dun dang*// rang la brtse bar gyur pa yi// gong ma de rnams gang du song*// thams cad 'chi bar nges pa la// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// sha dang pags pa rus pa rnams// bdag cag rnams kyis spyod pa gang*// de dag shi ba ma yin nam// cis kyang 'chi bar 'gyur zhe na// zhag gcig sdod pa'i nyal sa 'dir// gtan gyi gnas mal mi yong bar// mkhas pa kun gyis shes pa ltar// gtan gyi so tshis

'tsho thabs bsags pa bgrang*// de la rnam pa gnyis yin te// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis po// pha rol phyin drug dbye ba yis// lnga ni bsod nams tshogs yin te// shes rab ye shes tshogs su gsungs// gnyis po'i rtsa ba byang chub sems// lhag bsam g.yo dang bral ba yis// tshogs gnyis bsags na byang chub thob// de la dang po sbyin pa yang*// zhing dang bsam pa dngos pos bsgrub// 'di ltar sa bon 'debs pa'i zhing*// bzang ngan bdam pa ji bzhin du// zhing ngo bzang ngo rnam gzhag gis// me dang chu dang gangs khrod du// sa bon btab na mi smin ltar// gang la brten dang bdag nyid kyi// lus ngag yid gsum bya byed rnams// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// dam pa rnams la bsten par mdzod// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa nyan thos rang sangs rgyas// dam pa rnams kyis bstan pa yi// tshul khrims dri med rin po che// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// skyes bu chen pos srog bzhin srungs// re rag yod cing ma thub pa// khe nyen len pa'i bzod pa la// thub pas bzod par ma gsungs te// mtho 'am yang na dma' yang rung*// dgra 'am yang na gnyen yang rung*// phyogs ris med pa thams cad la// gnyen bshes bdag las med pa ste// 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig tu// bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do// bdag gi dgra gnyen mthong ba ko /ji ltar rigs par 'gyur snyam nas// gzhan la phan dang bde ba bsgrub// mi rigs gnod pa'i bsam pa yi// go skabs dbye bar mi bya 'o// cung zad gnyen po stobs chung bas// gnod pa'i dgra dang sems can kun// pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel dang*// yi dam lha dang rang gi sems// chos kyi sku dang bla mar bsam// rig pas nges pa skyes gyur na// khro dang gnod pa'i bsam pa ldog /'di la nan tan bya 'o zhes// 'jig rten mgon po bla mas gsungs// sa bcu dbang phyug man chad dang*// khams gsum sems can yan chad kyi// dkar po dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams// 'bad dang brtson 'grus brtsams las byung*// dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba la// btang snyoms tsam du mi bzhag par// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams// ji ltar mdzad pa'i rjes bsnyags te// rang gis 'bad pa ma byas na// rang gi bya ba su yis byed// legs par gzigs la soms dang kye// brtson chen shākya'i rgyal po yis// rang byung brtul zhugs ma spyad na// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyis// nyid la phan nam gzhan la phan// bdag cag sems can thams cad kun// brtson chen bcom ldan bka' drin gyis// bde zhing skyid pa ngo mtshar che// nged kyang ston pa'i rjes su bslab// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// rnam par rtog pa mang ba las// sdug bsngal che ba gzhan med gsung*// rnam par rtog pas g.yen spyos pa'i// rgyal po bdag nyid che na yang*// gshed mas mtha' ma bskor snyam pa'i// smyon pa 'o dod 'bod pa sdug

/bla ma rin chen shin tu mad// rnal 'byor dbang phyug lū hi pa// shākya'i rgyal po sras dang bcas// phyags dar khrod kyi gos 'chang zhing*// bsod snyoms zas la brten nas kyang*// nags khrod ri khrod dgon gnas su// rtsa ba 'bras bu lo ma dang*// tha chad nya rgyu gsol na yang*// rnam rtog dgra bo spangs pas skyid// mtho gcig dma' gcig rnam rtog rnams// ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal 'dra// ji ltar bsams pa de ltar dmyal// bsams pa'i thog tu 'bab pa dka'// bsam pa bzhin du byung na yang*// nyes pa thams cad kun gyi gzhi// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// bu gcig thub pa'i gsung bzhin sgrubs// 'di rnams bsod nams tshogs yin te// nyams len lam gyi gnas skabs su// mkhas pa'i thabs su bstan pa yin// mthar thug grub pa'i 'bras bu ni// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku yin// rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad du// thabs mchog 'di dang mi 'bral zhu// thog ma bar dang tha mar yang*// dge zhing skyid par 'gyur ba yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yum gyur shes rab pha rol phyin// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa'i don// rtogs pa'i ye shes nyid yin pas// de rtogs tshogs pa ye shes tshogs// 'di la nan tan chen po yis// bdag nyid chen pos bsgrub par zhu// shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'di// gti mug ma rig chen po yi// gnyen po yin par shes par bya// ma rig rnam pa gnyis yin te// rgyu 'bras las la rmongs pa dang*// de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'o// de bzhin nyid la rmongs pa yi// gnyen por thub pas stong nyid bstan// stong nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshul// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa ste// sngags kyis myong ba gtso bor ston// tshu rol mthong ba'i gang zag gi

/rigs pa gtso bor 'dir mi smra// rtog ge rnams kyi yul min zhes// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs// gnam gyi ya ca sna tshogs dang*// sa yi srel zhi mang po zhig /gcig tu bsdus pa'i tshogs pa rnams// mkhyen pa'i ye shes spyod yul ba// ko la khya dang ko la ba// chags can mi mo bsten pa las// rang byung don dam lhan skyes skye// ku sā li pa 'di la ston// mkhas pa chen po paṇḍi tas// gcig dang du bral la sogs pa// gtan tshigs chen po rnam pa lngas// shes par bya ba'i yul rnams dang*// shes byed yul can shes pa rnams// sna tshogs tshul gyis gtan la 'bebs// gcig dang du bral la sogs pas// shes bya gtan la phebs pa rnams// ji ltar byas kyang rnam rtog ste// dbab pa'i yul dang 'bebs pa rnams// gtan la phab pa'i shes pa gsum// 'khor gsum yongs su ma dag cing*// 'dzin rtog gsum gyi rang bzhin pas// mkhas pa'i skyes bu thams cad kyis// 'di la blo gtad byed mi nus// rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar phyin pa// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen sogs// ku sā li yi sgom chen pa// bram ze chen po tilli pa// dam pa'i zhabs pad la gtugs pas// don dam shes rab pha rol phyin// gnyis med ye shes rang gi sems// bde ba chen po rtogs pa yis// rang don gzhan don rdzogs pa yin// ku sā li yi rnal 'byor pa// rang gi myong ba gtso bor smra// lung rigs gnyis kyang de la tshang*// rgyal bas gsungs par 'dra na yang*// mtshan nyid pha rol phyin pa la// grangs med gsum gyi dam bca' yod// tshu rol mthong ba'i rigs pa yis// sgro 'dogs phyi nas gcod pa 'di// phyi rol mu stegs byed rnams dang*// so so'i skye bo mkhas pa rnams// dga' bar byed pa'i dam chos te// thar par 'gro ba'i them skas yin// stong pa nyid la dga' ba yi// bag chags bzhag par gyur pa yis// nam zhig don dam rtogs pa yi// rgyur 'gro tsam du 'gyur ba srid// theg pa chen po gsang sngags la// tshe 'dir byang chub thob pa yi// dam bca' sngon du song bas na// rang byung lhan skyes ye shes nyid// da lta nyid du thob pa'i thabs// ku sā li yi gzhung lugs la// brten nas don dam rtogs bzhed na// mnyam med 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// tshe gcig mchog gis sangs rgya ba// tshig dang spros pas ma bslad pa// mar gyi snying po lta bu yi// gdams ngag tshig gsum 'di yin te// rang la yod pa'i rang gi sems// rang byung phyag rgya chen po 'di// rtogs par byed pa thabs kyi mchog

/gsang sngags gdams ngag zab mo dang*// rtogs ldan bla ma dam pa la// mos gus tshad du bskyal ba yi// gdams ngag rnam gsum 'di nyid kyis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par ni// nges par khyed kyi thugs la zhog /de yang kye yi rdo rje las// gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// gsungs pa nyid kyis nges pa yin// de ltar tshogs gnyis lag len 'di// rgyun chad med par nyams len pa// las su bsags pa bgrang ba 'o// de ltar nyams len byas pa yis// dkon mchog gsum po mchod par 'gyur// bla ma dam pa mnyes pa yin// ngo bo gnyis med bsgom pa yi// de yi lag len 'di lta ste// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la bsam nas// bsam gtan yan lag lngar gnas te// nyams su blang bar bya ba 'am// spyod lam gang yang rung ba yis// rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa nyid// nyin par spyi bor bsgom par bya// mtshan mo snying gi dbus su bsam// rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa yi// lung khungs bcas te yang yang gsungs// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// rang sems gshis su gnas pa la// smras dang bsam dang shes pa dang*// tshig dang blo las 'das pa zhog /gtang yang mi btang dgug kyang mi dgug ste// bsam du med pa bsgom du med pa nyid bsgom na// lta sgom rtogs pa ro gcig dbyer mi phyed// spyod lam bzhi la khyad par med// lhun grub sgom la rgyun chad med// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i phyogs ris med// med do med do med pa'ang med// thams cad mnyam nyid bde ba che// bde chen kun bzang rang gi sems// bu rang gi sems dang ma 'bral mdzod// rtag tu mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig ste// rjes thob yul na ma mchis na// de dang gnyis su ma mchis par// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngos// mnyam gzhag rjes thob 'dug gyur na// mnyam gzhag dge ba bsngo ba dang*// rjes la mnyam gzhag rgya yis thob// zung 'jug ro gcig tsam gyur na// tshogs gnyis rgyun chad med pa yin// de ltar tshogs chen gnyis po 'di// dang por bsod nams tshogs yin te// de nas ye shes tshogs su 'grub// phyis ni tshogs gnyis zung 'jug ste// mi slob zung 'jug mthar thug pa// 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang du gsungs// mi rtag khar tshud chu yi chu bur 'dra ba yi// gnas dang mnga' ris gzhi dang rgyal srid yul rnams la// yi dwags lta bur 'jungs par gyur cing mnar ba'i yid// log 'dren bdud tshogs 'di dang nam zhig 'bral bar 'gyur// sems nyid zhi ba spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba la// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa gshin rje'i lto ba na// rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal drag pos g.yen spyos pa// bdag med skye shi med pa'i gnas su nam zhig phyin// zhe sdang mnar sems bskal pa'i me chen rab 'bar bas// dkar po dge ba'i phyogs rnams bsreg par byed pa yi// phung byed gdug pa'i sems dang bral bar gyur nas kyang*// byams dang snying rje bde chen rol mtshor nam zhig phyin// mtho la phrag dog dma' la rngan chen sna tshogs kyi// bya byed dur khrod me mched pa dang 'dra ba yis// nye du dgra gnyen thams cad phung bar 'gyur ba las// re dogs med cing mnyam pa'i sprang por nam zhig 'gyur// nyon mongs stobs rnams 'phel ba'i rang mthong ri 'dra ba// rgyal ba rnams kyi yon tan nyi ma sgrib byed pa// gnyis med ye shes sems kyi rdo rjes bshig nas kyang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan rgya mtsho mthar phyin 'gyur// sngon bsags bsod nams dbang chen gser gyi gzhi 'dra dang*// sangs rgyas byin rlabs nyi ma stong gi 'od zer kyang*// mi shes sgrib pa'i sprin nag srab mos sgrib byed na// nor bzang bzhin du bla ma ji ltar bkur bar 'gyur// snga bsam phyi mno ma byas shing*// lung dang rig pas dben pa yi// snying la yod pa'i gdams ngag rnams// gsung bzhin bdag gis bris pa las// bla ma mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// brtse bar dgongs nas bzod par zhu// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// mtshon nas bdag dang 'gro kun gyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog/

// 113) ༄// tshad ma bzhi yis rjes su 'brangs nas gsung la tshad mar byas pa// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshad ma bzhi yis tshad mar gyur// tshad ma'i skyes bu khyu mchog gi /rjes 'brang gsung la tshad mar byas// a bo a nu a jo dang*// gzhan gyis ci zer mi kha yi// a po'i rjes su ma 'brangs pas// nyams myong tshad ma bag tsam byung*// tshad ma gsum gyis de la bstod// a po yig nag bltas pa dang*// gzhan pas ci zer bshad pa min// bdag gis sdig pa byas pa yis// bdag la sdug bsngal chen po byung*// bdag gis gnyen po bsten pa yis// bdag gi sdug bsngal dag pa yin// bdag la nyams su myong ba yod// de la kha cig 'di skad ces// sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin ni// gnyen pos zad par mi 'gyur zhes// smra ba 'di kun ci zer ang*// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal ni// cis kyang mi 'byung zer ba yang*// rgyu las 'bras bu mi 'byung ba// 'di la nges shes ma skyes lags// las kyi rnam par smin pa kun// zab mo chos kyi 'dag pas na// lto gos zas tsam don gnyer ba// rtag chad gnyis por na 'phos na// bsod nams bsags pa'i che ba yis// blo sna gong mar skyed byung nas// tshe gcig sangs rgyas bzhed pa 'dis// thog med dus nas bsags pa yi// sdig dang sgrib pa 'byang ba yis// sangs rgyas btub pa yin nam snyam// sdig pa byas pa'i 'bras bu yang*// thog med dus nas bsags pa yi// sdig dang sgrib pa thams cad kun// zab mo chos kyi bsdus gyur pa// shig nad na tsha sdug bsngal dang*// mi mthun phyogs rnams rgyal pa yis// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs 'gyur bas// de la 'di dang 'di bya yi// zab pa'i gdams ngag gsungs pa yod// snying gi dkyil dang mchin pa'i drungs// grod pa'i rdzems su btums pas na// da lta a po mkhas sam snyam// mkhas par 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis// mkhas pa rnams kyis mkhas so zhes// phye gtor med par bstod par 'dug

/lung khungs 'ga' zhig drang snyam ste// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// gsang sngags brjod bya thams cad kun// rin chen gsung dang mthun gyur pas// lang lung drangs bas yong ma lang*// 'on kyang cung zad smos pa la// gnas brtan chen po kun dga' bos// 'jim pa'i dan gong ril lu yis// rang rgyal mgo la bsnun pa yis// spyi bor phol mig byung ba de// sman pa'i rgyal pos ma bcos sam// gnas brtan chen po gang bo yis// bran mo'i bu zhes smras pa yi// las kyi sgrib pa rgya chen kun// gnyen po spyod pa'i stobs kyis ni// chung ngus byang bar gsungs pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod du// sangs rgyas phal chen la sogs par// byang chub sems kyis 'byang tshul dang*// 'gyod pa bsal ba la sogs su// rang sems rtogs pas 'byang tshul dang*// nam mkha'i snying po la sogs par// rigs sngags cho gas 'byang tshul dang*// ngan song sbyong rgyud la sogs par// theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// sngags dang phyag rgya lha dag gis// sdig dang sgrib pa 'dag par gsungs// gzungs chog nus pa'i nyams myong yod// khyi sngags sgal sngags byed pa mthong*// seng ge'i nyal thabs bya 'o zhes// chos kyi rgyal po chen po yis// rab tu byung ba rnams la bcas// mgon po mi 'khrugs tshe dpag med// rin chen gtsug gtor shākya'i rgyal// bcom ldan mgon po sangs rgyas rnams// mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang*// reg pa dang ni dran pas kyang*// sdig dang sgrib pa 'byang 'gyur ba// ma mo sman dges mi gsung ste// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pas gsungs// chos rje bla ma rin chen bka'// tshad ma bzhi yi bdag nyid kyi// gdams ngag nyams su blang bar rigs// //

114) ༄// bstan bcos rin chen dbang phyug nam mkha' lding nye gnas grags 'byung gi zhu chos// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyabs gcig 'gro mgon rin po che// pha mi bskyod rgyal po sman gyi lha// rje thugs la thogs shig 'gro ba'i mgon// sems ma bde rtogs pa'i dug tsher gyi// zug rngus sems la zug pa'i tshe// skyabs gzhan med bla ma'i nges shes skyes// byin gyi rlabs kyis bde bar shar// mi nga la mi bde dbang med byung*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon du// skyabs med long bas bong gzhug shor// mgon med re thag chad pa'i tshe// 'ju sa bla ma rin chen rnyed// mi bde ma mchis bde mor gda'// dus gsum sangs rgyas gcig pa'i sku// bla ma yin pa'i nges shes skyes// gang zag yin no snyam na yang*// lung rigs man ngag myong bas grub// nges shes skyes pas blo re bde// mthar thug 'bras bu chos sku de// nyon mongs rnam rtog dngos su gda'// nyes tshogs rtsa ba yin snyam na// mtha' brgyad spros pas stong bas nges// nyams su myong bas 'gyur ba med// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam de// byang chub sems su kho thag chod// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pa'i phyir// gzhan du btsal sa med par go /bsam pa'i rang gzugs blo thag chod// 'gro ba'i bla ma gcig pu ma// dam chos chos sku nyag gcig nyid// dge 'dun bsam pa mthun pas gcig /zhing dang bsam pa gcig dril bas// mi 'grub med de blo re bde// yang cig ku re kyal ka zhu// dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' drin gyis// mi nga bde ba chen po'i chang gis bzi// bzi gtam cal col smra ba la// khyed phyogs ris bka' bkyon mi mdzad zhu// chos kun spros dang bral bar go /rtag chad la sogs grub mtha' la// mi nga la bzang ngan phyogs ris med// mu stegs byed kyang nga dang mthun// bsha' mar gyer na bon yang mkhas// bsam mi khyab la longs spyod pas// yul dang yul can chos rnams la// zab mo gnad kyi man ngag rnams// 'di shes mi shes rtsis gdab chung*// mkhas pa thams cad dga' bar byed// mkhas pas bsten pa de ltar lags// dngos po rdzas la zhen pa spangs// 'khor gsum yongs dag rten 'brel mkhas// khyad du mi gsod 'bras bu blta// kho bo cis kyang phyug por mchi// ka ca gsog skrun ma byas kyang*// nga yi rjes su 'brang ba yi// nye gnas ltogs grir mi 'chi snyam// rin chen pha phogs rgyu 'bras kyi// rten cing 'brel 'byung brtsi tshad che// sdom gsum gnad kyi man ngag mkhas// a po mi btsun dbang med yin// gnad ka rgyu mtshan de dag gis// nga yi slob ma btsun pa yin// gzhan du gyur na slob ma min// stong nyid rtogs shing zhe 'dod med// snying rjes 'gro ba mi gtong bas// rnal 'byor nga la khong khro med// tshig rtsub bam rdeg na rang skyon spong*// drung na gnas pa'i nye gnas kun// mos gus yod na rjes 'brang 'gyur// rko long mdzad na ci bder gshegs// tshad ldan bla ma'i ded dpon bzang*// thabs shes rab gnyis kyi gru rdzings legs// smon lam 'dod phyogs rlung gis bdas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dbang med brgal// lam zab rdo rje theg pa yis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par nges// gdul bya'i khams rnams ji snyed pa// 'dul byed gnad kyi man ngag shes// mi mang ngam yang ni nyung yang rung*// blo gtod na ting 'dzin mi skye re// tshig smras pa nyon dang dge 'dun rnams// mgo bskor nas ngan sar gtong re shi// chos kun shes rab pha rol phyin// gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad du// ma skyes pa la skye ba med// sus kyang ma byas lhun gyis grub// dus ring po gcig gi chos kyi sku// spang bya gnyen pos rtogs pa min// mos gus gyis dang rnal 'byor pa// dpal phag mo gru pa'i rdo rje'i gsung*// zab mo yi ger bris pa la// bla ma mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// thugs rje chen pos brtser dgongs nas// byin gyis rlabs shing bzod par bzhes// mkhas pa'i skye bo ma mnyes na// tshig la rno ste don la rtul// lo gsum sgom la 'gal 'brel gzigs// nyams myong skyes na 'thad nas mchi// dad ldan mos gus che ba dang*// pha rol phyin drug dbang phyug rgyan// dpa' brtan seng ge lta bu yi// grags pa'i 'byung gnas nye gnas kyis// skyo bsangs ched du zhus pa lags// rje btsun byams pa dgyes pa'i chos// zhig po bdud rtsi bla ma'i gsung*// rin chen dbang phyug nam mkha' lding*// bstan bcos 'di yi ming lags so//

// 115) ༄// tshul khrims rin po cher sngags pa dpe re med na 'o re che zhes pa// gnas skabs kyi yon tan/ tshul khrims kyis bde 'gror 'gro zhes pa'i lung la brten nas/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i go ba med kyang*/ sdom pa bsrung ba 'di kun dpe re med de 'o re che/ bram ze'i khye'u skar ma dang*/ ded dpon snying rje chen po'i lung la brten nas/ so sor thar pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sdom pa yin gyi/ sangs rgya ba la gtan mi phan snyam pa yod kyang*/ tshul khrims bsrung ba 'di kun dpe re med de 'o re che/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi sdom pa nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum gyi rjes su 'brangs pa/ che 'bring ltung ba sde lnga yin par bshad kyang*/ nges shes med pas bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam gzhag mang po bsrungs kyang btub/ ma bsrungs kyang btub snyam pa la/ sdom pa bsrung ba 'di kun dpe re med de 'or re che/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'ju sa dang rten phur/ tshul khrims ma yin pa gzhan mi srid pa'i nges shes yod kyang*/ 'di bas bag drag cig mi byed pa snying re na la ngu re bro/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du spang bya yod pa spong zhing*/ gnyen po yod pa bsten dgos pa'i nges shes yod kyang*/ yul mtha' 'khob kyi rmu rgod rnams dang khyim thab byed cing nyams len mi byed pa 'di snying re na la ngu re bro/ bsam pa bzhi'i sgyur thabs kyi phan pa dang bde ba/ tshul khrims gcig pu las med pa'i nges shes yod cing bla ma dam pa'i bka' stsal gsung yang*/ 'di sdom pa bzhi gang yin gang yin snyam pa'i rtog pa skyes pa 'di snying re na la ngu re bro// // 116) ༄// gces pa'i snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes pa dge slong grags 'byung gi zhu chos// skyes chen gang zhig thugs gnyis dbyer med pas// gdul bya'i khams rnams ma lus ji snyed par// chu snod zla ba bzhin du kun tu snang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bo'i gtsug gis blangs// ltem rkyang med pa'i gus pas mnyes par byas// dge blo cung zad skyes phyir bskul ba yi// yin lugs cung zad dus 'dir bdag gis 'bri// rgya mtsho cher yangs rus sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi lus thob par shin tu rnyed par dka'// dal 'byor rnyed pa de bas shin tu dkon// sdug bsngal rtsa ba nyon mongs dug gsum 'di// gangs khrod nags khrod dgon pa thag ring du// phyin pas nam yang spongs par mi 'gyur zhes// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas 'o dod 'bod// gang du 'dug kyang rang gi nyon mongs spongs// gzhan skyon mig bzhin mi bsrung rang skyon snang*// me long bzhin zhes bla ma dam pas gsung*// snang srid 'di kun chos kyi sku yin te// yon tan phrin las dag dang lhan cig ces// thub mgon rgyal ba rnams dang rin chen gsung*// bu gcig log par ma blta rgyal ba'i sras// log lta can gyis 'phags lam mi thob ces// nyid kyis dam bcas rtag tu yang yang smra// tshig don 'gal bar ma mdzad ag tsar can// lus dang srog sogs gang la'ang ma ltas par// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang ji bzhin du// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi drung du bsdad// nyon mongs zhe sdang yid kyis g.yengs pa'i tshe// bla ma dam pa mnyes par ma gyur cing*// dug gi me tog rdo rje ser ba bzhin// ye shes mthu yis bdag gi log rtog bcom// 'gro ba'i don phyir 'o brgyal chen po yis// phongs par gyur tshe zhabs 'bring zhabs tog byas// khe dang grags pa chos brgyad bsam pa yis// cung zad zhabs tog byas pa'i mthong chos kyis// rgyu dang 'bras bu phan tshun dpag pa'i tshul// dge 'o legs so khyod kyis bzang byas zhes// gdung ba'i shugs kyis 'di skad tshig gis bstod// skyid la lkog snogs byed pa kun gyis rtsom// sdug la lkog rnogs byed pa'i snying rus can// bdag gi bla ma'i nye gnas yin zhes zer// gnyen pos spang bya bcom pa'i yon tan gyis// rgyu las 'bras bu bslu ba med pa'i phyir// brtse bas gnas pa'i yid la dga' bde skyes// bzang po'i grags pa phyogs rnams kun tu rgyas// shākya'i sras kyi dge slong 'jigs med pa// bla ma dam pa'i bu sdug yid 'ong zhing*// srog la mi blta rtag tu mnyes byed pa// dpon mchog des kyang mar khu ldud dam zer// tshul 'chos phra ba'i bya ba 'di 'dra na// nyon mongs khong du gsod pa'i brtul zhugs can// phan bde gzhan la ster bar gyur pa dang*// yang dag lta ba zab pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// de dang mthun pa'i spyad pa spyod byed na// 'bras bu ci 'dra 'byung zhes dga' ba'i shugs// yid la skyes pas bu la bdag gis smras// sngon gyi drang srong chen po brtul zhugs can// shākya'i rgyal po la sogs rgyal ba yis// nyon mongs bdud kyi tshogs las rgyal bar mdzad// bdag cag rnams kyang thub pa'i brtul zhugs bzung*// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma dang*// dpal ldan a ti sha sogs gong ma yis// gzhan skyon ma gzigs yon tan rgya mtshor spyod// bdag cag rnams kyang gong ma'i rjes su 'brang*// don 'di bdag la rag las gzhan dbang min// mgo dang rkang lag dum bur song yang bla// gong ma'i brtul zhugs zungs shig chos kyi bu// gces pa'i snying po dri ma med pa'i dpal// rin chen phreng ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan 'di// nyes tshogs spang phyir bdag gi slob mas zhus// 'gro bas bla med byang chub mchog thob shog

/shākya'i sras kyi dge slong grags pa 'byung gnas kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 117) ༄/ phag gru'i rnam thar gsol 'debs byang chub grags la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho gting mtha' med// ro langs ji bzhin rtog pa'i dbang song ba// gnyis med ye shes mthu yis 'jig mdzad pa'i// mnyam med bla ma de la skyabs su mchi// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rtog pas rnam g.yengs shing*// chos brgyad byis pas 'ja' tshon bdas pa yis// ngoms pa ma byung lus sems khur gyis dub// dus 'dir rang sems gso phyir bla ma dran// lha min g.yul gyis rab nyen lha rnams ni// dbang po'i chos bzang dran pas sel ba ltar// sdug bsngal mang pos gzir ba'i bdag 'dzin yid// bla ma dran pas de las skyob par byed// lha na mo ratna gu ru badzra ye/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin po che// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med gcig pa'i sku// dus gsum chos rnams spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rtag pa'i sku// mgon po khyod kyis skye 'jig 'gro 'ong spangs// 'gro ba'i mgon po lhun gyis grub pa nyid// mnyam med bla mas bdag cag ci'i phyir spong*// 'bral med mgon po'i sku la skyabs su mchi// thub pa chen po'i gdul bya sems can rnams// dpag med nam mkha'i khams dang shin tu mnyam// de srid bar du mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med gcig pa'i gsung*// gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis// 'gro ba ma lus thams cad smin mdzad pas// ci yi phyir na bdag cag smin mi mdzad// thub mgon rdo rje'i gsung la skyabs su mchi'o// chos kyi rgyal po mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon// yul dang yul can gnyis med ro gcig pa// lhun gyis grub cing skye 'jig kun dang bral// chos kun nye bar zhi ba'i rang bzhin la// bya dang byed pa'i spros pa mi mnga' bas// rtsol ba med par 'gro kun smin par mdzad// dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'i rig pa 'dis// bde gshegs khyod la rtsod pa yong mi mnga'// mgon po de yi zhing ni bsam mi khyab// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam zhing dpag med du// rin chen sna tshogs rgyu las legs grub cing*// dpag bsam shing dang gos kyi shing dag dang*// zhing gi rgyan rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pas// phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan rdzogs byed cing*// byang chub mchog la 'god par gyur pa 'di// rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung phyir shin tu nges// nyid las mi gzhan dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs// kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i mdzod 'dzin pas// nyes tshogs sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg mdzad cing*// 'khor ba'i bde skyid ma lus ji yod dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba zag med kyis// sems can rgya mtsho smin mdzad gnyen gyur pa// khyod sras rnams la bde dang legs 'byung ba// byams pa'i rgyud la 'bras bu 'di 'byung rigs// nga 'o nga rgyal zad par gyur pa dang*// tshad med thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyis// bdud dang bar chad bgegs dang log 'dren rnams// btang snyoms mi mnga' dus las mi 'da' bar// rab zhi khros pa'i hūm̐ sgra rab sgrogs pas// gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul bar mdzad la sogs// zhi rgyas dbang gi smin par mdzad pa yis// dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad la dub pa med// ji ltar nam mkha'i padmo rab rgyas pa// mo gsham bu yis sprul pa mchod pa ltar// gdod nas nye bar zhi ba'i byang chub ni// gdod nas nye bar zhi ba'i sems can gyis// ma skyes spros dang bral ba'i tshogs gnyis kyis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mdzad pa 'di// dngos dang dngos med gang yin skyes chen kun// rdo rje'i gsung 'di rtogs ldan rnams kyis go

/dpal ldan phag mo gru pas bskyangs pa'i bu// nyid dang dbyer med rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// bsags pa mthar phyin skyes chen rgyal ba'i sras// bla ma mchog la rab gus dam tshig can// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad pa// nye bar gnas pa'i slob ma dam pa rnams// bla med dkon mchog de dang mi 'bral bas// srid dang zhi ba 'di las dbugs kyang phyin// glang chen rab myos ri brtsegs 'dra ba la// rin chen rgyan gyis legs par rab brgyan pa// khur gyis non cing lci bar mi 'gyur te// nyam nga med par shin tu brjid par snang*// 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa lta spyod zung 'brel ba// phra ba'i rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung ba// go bar gyur la stong nyid log na med// nam mkha' rab yangs mtha' dbus bral ba la// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrib pa med pa yis// mig ldan skyes bus so so'i bya ba bsgrub// de dag bsam pa rdzogs pa nyi ma'i mthu// kun bzang yangs pa dpal ldan chos kyi rje// lus can kun dang dbyer med gcig gyur pa// byang chub sems nyid dbye ba med pa'i skus// ma lus smin par byed pa bla ma'i mthu// ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po rab zab cing*// rgya che yangs par gyur pa de nyid ni// srog chags 'byung po mang po'i gnas yin zhing*// dpag med rin chen kun gyi 'byung khungs ltar// zab cing rgya che sku gsum dbyer med pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rje rin chen yang*// phan dang bde ba kun gyi gnas yin zhing*// yon tan ma lus kun gyi 'byung khungs yin// ji ltar bskal ba'i me chen rab 'bar bas// sa dang rgya mtsho ri bo mchog rnams kyang*// rab tu mched cing 'bar bar gyur nas kyang*// thal ba'i lhag ma tsam yang ma lus byed// tshad ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs gyur cing*// mos gus mchog ldan slob ma dam pa yi// 'jig rten chos brgyad nyon mongs sgrib pa'i tshogs// bla ma dam pas thams cad 'joms par byed// grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pas// gong ma'i phyag rjes khyu mchog rnam gsum gyis// rnam dag zhing du skye ba ma yin zhes// dge bcu spyad pa'i rten 'brel go bar mdzod// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i rigs las byung*// bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrub byed pa// shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong ri khrod pas// zab cing rgya che 'gro la phan phyir zhus// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba dam pa des// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pas// 'jig rten gsum mgon mnyam med rin po che// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i sku thob shog

/'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i rnam par thar pa/ zhum pa dang yid skyo ba sel bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs gyis bla ma dam pa mnyes pa'i go cha bgos pa sgom pa byang chub grags kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// //

118) ༄// nyams len mi phyed rdo rje'i gsang tshig byang chub grags pa'i zhu chos// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// sku gsung thugs la rab gus pas// rtse gcig sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong ma lus thams cad kun// dus gsum rgyal bas gang gsungs pa// rdo rje'i tshig gis mdor bsdus nas// rgyas par bshad kyis rgyal ba'i sras// nye gnas rnams kyis nyan par gyis// tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog 'dod pas// mnyan nas nyams su blang bar bya// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bka'// kye ma kye ho ngo mtshar che// e ma kye ho ngo mtshar che// re dga' re skyid ngo mtshar che// lta ba rnam dag lha sgom zhing*// sgom pa rnam dag sngags kyang bzla// spyod pa rnam dag bya byed sgrub// 'bras bu rnam dag ro gcig pa// de gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras rnams dang*// 'jig rten ngam gyur padma dang*// brtul zhugs grub pa'i nyams len 'dis// rgyal sras khyed dang gzhan rnams dang*// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis// mchog gi dngos grub thob par shog /mi phyed rdo rje'i gsang tshig 'di// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rigs las byung*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ldom bu pa// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod du// ri dwags stag dang seng ge ltar// nyam nga med par rgyu ba yi// bu gcig byang chub grags pa yis// tshe 'dir dngos grub mchog 'dod pa'i// rnal 'byor rnams kyi don du zhus// mi phyed rdo rje'i gsang tshig rdzogs so// // 119) ༄// ston pa'i gsung la gces par 'dzin pa mi thub rdo rje dar gzhon la gnang ba// gnyis med thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' lta bu las// thugs rje chen po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rab gsal bas// mtho dman phyogs ris med pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kun// smin mdzad bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la// bdag 'dzin rnam rtog glo bur ba// ma rig mun pa'i sprin tshogs gtibs// rtog pa'i sprin gyi kha dog la// bzang ngan sna tshogs cir yang 'khrul// 'khrul pa'i bag chags sna tshogs 'di// bag la nyal ba ldang ba'i dus// rnam pa gnyis su gnas pa 'di// mkhas pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya// de la ldang lugs dang po ni// chags dang sdang ba'i yul la sogs// nang gi bag chags gang che yi// phyi rol rkyen gyis sad par byed// de la ston pa bcom ldan gyis// rkyen gyis yongs su bsgyur zhes gsungs// nyon mongs rnam rtog de nyid kyi// rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag yid// bzang ngan 'bring gsum gang byas rnams// gong ma'i rtog pa'i rang lus la// bde sdug sna tshogs rnams su 'gyur// dga' dang mi dga' chags sdang gi

/sna tshogs rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// khams gsum 'khor ba sna tshogs su// mu mtha' med par 'khor ba 'di// bsam pa rnam rtog 'khor ba las// gzhan pa yod ma mi srid pas// mgon po dpal chen rdzogs sangs rgyas// bcom ldan shākya seng ge yis// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// mgon pos de skad gsungs pas na// 'khor ba rang gi rnam rtog yin// rnam rtog rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rtogs pa'i skad cig de nyid la// 'khor ba chos sku bde chen du// skad cig gcig gis 'gyur ba la// dus ring po gcig gis kha g.yos la// kho thag re ltos chod la thong*// nyon mongs rnam rtog bag la nyal// rkyen gyis ldang ba'i tshul lugs 'dis// rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i 'khor lugs su// ji ltar 'khor ba bstan pa'o// gnyis pa de las ldog pa'i don// ldang ba'i tshul lugs bstan pa ni// sangs rgyas rnams dang sems can gyi// sems nyid rang bzhin rnam dag 'di// lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// che chung bzang ngan ma mchis par// thams cad kun la mnyam par gnas// de ltar yin yang ma rtogs pa'i// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ji bzhin du// bzang ngan phyogs ris ma mchis par// de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje 'jug /sangs rgyas thugs rjes 'jug pa'i tshul// yul dang gnyis su med pa yis// ji ltar ga bur tsan dan la// nyi ma'i 'od zer phog pa'i tshe// dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldang bas// 'phags pa mnyes shing sems can tshim// de ltar ma chags zhe sdang med// gti mug med pa'i dri mchog gis// 'phags pa thams cad mchod pa dang*// sems can thams cad dga' skyed kyis// tshim par gyur pa ngo mtshar che// nyi ma phyogs ris med pa dang*// spos mchog bsam pa med pa las// dri mchog bzang po 'byung ba 'di// rigs kyis yin pa nyid du nges// ji ltar lcong bu chol po

utpal ser po tho re ba la// nyi mas gdungs par gyur pa'i tshe// de la de yi dri 'byung zhing*// dri gzhan 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba// de bzhin 'phags pa'i 'od zer gyis// bsags pa 'bring po'i khams rgyud la// bskul bar gyur pa de 'dra ba// 'di 'ang rigs kyis nges pa yin// ji ltar khyi ro rul pa la// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phog pa'i tshe// mi gtsang dri nga mnam dri bro ba pa yis// thams cad skyug log mi gtsang bas// nad dang gnod pa 'byung ba dang*// 'gro ba mang pos mi 'dod pa// de ltar 'phags pa'i thugs rje'i 'od// nyon mongs gsum gyi rigs can dang*// khyad par zhe sdang rigs can la// gong ma'i byin rlabs bzhugs pa'i tshe// shi 'bras 'byung ba'i tshul lugs 'di// mkhas pa rnams kyis thugs la zungs// dam pa rnams kyis zhe la zhogs// gcig pur sdod pa'i rnal 'byor pas// bla ma mchog la rab btud de// mgo rtsa ma log dam chos gcig /nyams su blangs par gyur pa na// bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems// gnyis med gcig tu 'dres pa'i tshe// rdo rje slob dpon bla ma ste// gal te zhe sdang gnyen por yang*// 'gyur ram mi 'gyur brtag par bya// gal te gnyen po yin srid na// blon po chen po'i grogs po bzhin// 'di yis nga la ngan pa zhig /cis kyang byed du 'ong snyam pa'i// the tshom bsam pa skye bar 'gyur// rgya la gal te rnal 'byor pa// log rtog de yi rjes 'brangs pa// khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis// lha rten btud pa lta bu dang*// gzhan yang gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung*// bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag la// nan tan chen pos bsgoms pa dang*// bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs gyur na// 'dir mang smos pas ci bya ste// gnyen pos spang bya bcom pa yi// rim pa ji ltar yod pa bzhin// 'byung ba nyid du the tshom med// skrod dang 'ching dang gnod pa dang*// smyo dang brgyal dang 'bog pa dang*// gsod dang bsreg dang thal ba dang*// rus pa'i rnam pa rjes med pa// rim par dbye ba mang po rnams// rnal 'byor pa la 'byung bar 'gyur// a ho de tshe dpa' bo rnams// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// brtse chen ma ma la sogs pa// khams gsum sems can rjes su gzung*// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la// ltos pa med par phyad

rtag par kyis gtang*// chags pa med pa nyid du bya// ku sā li yi tshogs gsog 'di// gnad du zab pas gnad du bskyal// man ngag 'di yi rjes 'brang nas// a nan ta bar mtshams med pa yi sbyor ba yis// ku re kyal ka ma mchis par// ring po'i dus la mi ltos par// gces pa bcu yi man ngag ltar// nyams su blangs pa'i dus nyid du// sbrul gyi pags pa brjes pa bzhin// shan shun bye brag phyed par nges// rgya la gal te rnal 'byor pa// rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i ri khrod pa// phar ngan bur ngan mes por ngan// gdams ngag med pa'i long ba dang*// nga dang ngar 'dzin nyon mongs kyi// dbang song 'jig rten 'di pa rnams// nga bdag 'jig rten so tshis rnams// nyams par dogs pa'i bsam pa yis// de yi rjes su 'brangs pa la// rang gi lam dang bral ba dang*// gong ma'i byin rlabs rgyun chad pas// skyabs mgon dpung gnyen kun dang bral// rang gi bden pa'i nus pa shi// gdug pa'i 'dre chen nyal ba yi// mig tu shing bu sug sug byas// 'di la mkha' 'gro'i gtam rgyud yod// tshe 'di'i che thabs sgrub long med// gdug pa'i lha 'dre gtum po yis// sha khrag rus pa hab thob byed// de bas lam la nan tan bya// rang nyid nyams len bstan pa'o// gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa yi// slob ma skyong bar 'dod pa'am// rang la yon tan 'byung 'dod na// gtam col tho co'i rjes 'brangs nas// snod dang gang zag ma brtags par// slob ma mang 'dod che 'dod kyi// log rtog rmongs pa tha chad rnams// ma smin sems can tha chad la// zab pa'i gdams ngag bstan gyur na// nyon mongs dug gsum stobs 'phel nas// gong du bstan pa ji bzhin du// phung bar 'gyur bas dang po 'dir// slob ma'i rgyud rnams sbyang bar bya// 'chi ba mi rtag bsgom pa dang*// rgyu 'bras chos la nan tan bskyed// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// ji bzhin rgyud la skyes pa dang*// smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur nas// grol bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs sbyang*// 'di la 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi// rim pa lnga yi gdams ngag 'di// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// bdag nyid chen po de nyid kyi// ji bzhin nyams myong skyes pa yis// dgongs pa mthar thug 'di yin te// de yi rjes su bslab par bya// yang dang yang du bka' stsal gsung*// spyir ni rim gyis ma gtogs pa// cig car srid pa ma yin dang*// nyon mongs gsum gyis rang rgyud bsregs// 'od kyis gzhan rgyud bsreg pa dang*// bsam pa sa bon grung po las// 'bras bu rnam smin 'byung ba'i phyir// bsam pa sbyang bar bya ba la// nan tan chen pos bka' stsal gsung*// bsam pa sbyangs pa'i slob ma la// zab pa'i gdams ngag bstan pa'i tshe// ga bur tsan dan dri bzhin du// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas nyid kyang mi dka' na// dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos// rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas// las dang skal par ldan pa la// bdud bzhi dgra yis tshugs par dka'// dngos po gsal bar gsungs pa dang*// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab tu// slob dpon slob ma brtag pa dang*// sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams// 'di las med pa nyid du go

/des na rjes 'jug slob ma la// gzhan don 'dod pa 'byung srid na// rang bzhin tho co ma byed par// slob ma'i snod brtag rgyud sbyangs nas// gdams ngag dam pa bstan par bya// de ltar byas na rang nyid dang*// rang gi 'khor du gtogs pa rnams// tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel// bkra shis bde skyid phun sum tshogs// slob ma gcig las med na yang*// stong tsho gsum pas mi dga' re// mang po grangs kyis ci zhig bya// 'phags pa nye sde'i 'khor bzhin du// mdzes pa mdzes pa'i 'khor gyis bskor// nga yi bla ma rin chen la// stag lung thang pa gcig pus chog /slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub la// bzhi zhes grags kyang mang po lags// slob ma khyi ro rul pa yi// nyon mongs dri ngan mnam po yis// rang gzhan phung bar byed pa yi// sbyang thabs gegs sel bstan pa'o// yang cig rab gnas gzungs chog dang*// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /gsang sngags phrin las zab mo yis// rang gzhan smin par 'dod pa rnams// rab gnas gcig pu nyid mtshon nas// thams cad khong du chud par bya// rab gnas byed pa'i gang zag gis// rab gnas bya ba'i bsam pa dang*// gsang sngags phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir// bsnyen pa tshad du bskyal ba ni// bla ma rin chen yang yang gsung*// theg chen gsang sngags rgyud rnams su// bsnyen pa med pa'i las sbyor gyis// tshe 'dir dngos grub mi 'grub cing*// sdug bsngal nyes pas gtses pa dang*// sha za srin pos zos nas kyang*// mnar med dmyal bar 'gro bar gsungs// des na grangs dang
