mtshan ma yi// bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin tshad du bskyal// gsang sngags bzlas pa bya ba'i thabs// dbang bskur mchog gi rgyud chen du// 'jam dbyangs shes rab chen po pa// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig la// gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// bsgyings pa chen po cher bsgyings shing*// gsang sngags myur du 'grub pa'i thabs// nan tan chen pos bka' stsal pa// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid// gcig yin gcig tu shes pa yis// gcig tu byas na myur du 'grub// ston pa rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// nan tan chen por gsungs pa 'di// shi phod gces pas nyams su longs// sangs rgyas brdzun tshig mi gsung ba// bu gcig gces pas nyams su longs// de ltar bsnyen pa thems pa yis// sgrub pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul// rab gnas gzungs chog la sogs pa// 'di 'dra'i las sbyor dgos dogs yod// gsang sngags las sbyor byed pa la// sgrub pa sngon du 'gro bas na// sgrub pa gong gi bzlas pa bzhin// gnad du bskyal ba'i dus tshod du// rang gi las sbyor byed pa dang*// rab gnas zhu ba byung ba'i tshe// gsang sngags phrin las brtsam par bya// rtags dang mtshan ma ngan gyur na// bsnyen sgrub gnad du ma song bas// sngar bshad khyi ro rul pa yi// nyes pa'i dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir// nga 'bus sgrub chung gcig cig nas// rdo rje gzhon nu'i rigs 'dzin rnams// srid pa rdo rje grub mdzod cing*// srid pa rdo rje phur ba'i lha// ye shes khro bor grub par mdzod// bzang po zhig gis de skad gsungs// med kyang rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// phyi snod nang bcud snang srid kun// rang gi lhag pa'i lha nyid dam// nye bar mkho zhing 'jebs

yid du 'ong ba pa'i lha// rnam pa sna tshogs nyid du sgrub// 'di ltar bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas// khyi ro rul pa'i dri ngan rnams// tsan dan ga bur dri mchog tu// 'gyur ba nyid du the tshom med// 'di la dgongs nas he rus kas// bla med theg pa'i rgyud rnams su// khyi ro rul pa de nyid la// sgron ma bdud rtsir gang gsungs pa// rgyud tshod rim pas phye ba yin// thabs dang stobs dang shes rab dang*// dam tshig man ngag med pa yi// tho co pho rgod nor tshol rnams// mig nas lcags phye 'thul na yang*// mkhas bdo btsun bdo bzang bdo la// zhal shangs ldog pa gan na yod// phung 'drer song ba mang po mthong*// lar bdag kyang mkhas pa ma lags te// grogs kyang blo dang mi ldan pa// mthong ba lba can sngo 'khru lags// sgrub pa gnad du skyol ba'i mis// las la sbyor ba'i man ngag rnams// so sor man ngag ji bzhin du// nyams su blangs pas gcig tu mchi// bkra shis bde legs thams cad 'ong*// bsnyen sgrub bya lugs tha dad kyang*// sgrub pa 'di ltar smon pa 'di// kha sna ldog pa 'phangs pas na// nan tan chen por smras pa yin// yang cig bla ma rje btsun pa// nga 'dra nyon mongs zhe sdang can// dpe med sgom chen bzang po zhig /gcig gam yang na mang yang rung*// yul phyogs 'khrugs pa slongs pa yi// zhe sdang can la chags pa 'am// chags dang rjes su 'brel pa yi// lus ngag yid gsum bya byed la// las zhes ston pas gsungs pa yin// sred len gnyis kyi mtshams sbyar ba// zhe sdang rang la 'phos nas 'ong*// 'di yi dus su snying rus kyis// goms pa gang che'i dam chos kyis// gnad du bsnun nas bzlog pa'am// yang na ston pa bla ma yis// gnas dang grogs dang rdzas rnams dang*// bsam ngan nyes pa'i dri ma yi// grib rnams spang bar gang gsungs pa// 'brel ba'i thabs la nan tan bskyed// yang na ston pa bla ma yis// mdo rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab cing*// man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// thabs dang shes rab sbyor bas bzlog

/yang na skyob pa 'gro ba'i mgon// skyob pa bde gshegs mi 'khrugs pa// rang dang sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs zhe sdang la sogs pa'i// nyes pa sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir// thugs bskyed byang chub sangs rgyas pa// dran pa tsam gyis zhe sdang tshogs// rnam dag byang chub sangs rgya ba// mgon po bla ma de bzhin gshegs// snying gi dbus su bsgom par bya// bsgom par mi bya goms par bya// goms par mi bya nges par bya// le lo ku re kyal ka dang*// rnam gzhag tsam por ma song na// chags dang sred len las byung ba// rkyen las skyes pa'i zhe sdang rnams// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// bcom ldan 'das kyis bcom nas mchi// yang cig rang la ku re zhu// 'brug lo dpyid zla 'bring po yi// nyi shu gsum gyi tho rangs las// rang la nye zhing brtse ba la// nges par dgra yi 'du shes skyes// gsod gcod 'dod pa'i bsam pa byung*// 'thad pa byed pa gcig kyang med// nga la 'di byung yus kyis brnangs// mtshams las 'das na smyo smyo 'dra// dus der tshogs dpon phye gtor 'goms// e ma bla ma rje btsun pa// 'gro ba'i mig rten 'dren pa khyod// 'di ltar ma mdzad 'di ltar mdzod// rtsa na 'khor ba'i nye gnas dang*// gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma dang*// ston pa'i dkon mchog dge 'dun gyis// gnod pa byed pa'i nges pa med// sgrin pos spyad cing mkhas na yang*// gnod pa byed dam mi byed la// the tshom som nyi tsam du mdzod// snyam pa'i zhal ta byas pa las// gsol ba tshig gsum 'debs pa yi// go skabs bag tsam byung ba las// snga ma nga bden yus dang bral// phyi ma khong bden nges pa skyes// 'khor la byams dang snying rjes brlan// bu la gdams ngag ston snying 'dod// mtshan mo nam langs ma khom pa'i// tsab tsab tung tung phan sems skyes// ji tsam 'grang cig zos pa dang*// bsam pa de yang mi gda' ste// tha mal chen por phyal gyis thal// lar gyi bu gcig gces se kun// nga yi 'di 'drar ma zad kyis// khyed kyang 'di 'dra yong dogs yod// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// mtho dman gang dang 'grogs na yang*// cis kyang gnod pa byed nges su// bsam par mi bya bka' stsal gsungs// nyes tshogs nyon mongs rnam rtog ni// sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas// gnyen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gdams ngag mang po gsungs pa rnams// ngan rtog gnyen po bzang rtog yin// ston pa'i dam chos rin chen yin// thabs la mkhas pa'i zhags pa yin// thugs rjes 'dren pa'i lcags kyu yin// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa yin// don gyis mi rtag bslu ba yin// mkho ba'i dus su nyams len bya// phal cher bde chen dbyings su nyal// sems nyid lhan skyes 'dus ma byas// 'dus ma byas la 'pho 'gyur med// rtag cing 'pho 'gyur med pa yi// rang rig de la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu yi// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid dang*// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// rnam par bzhag pa grangs mang yang*// de dag gzhi lam 'bras bu yi// gegs dang bar chad sel ba'i tshul// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// bla ma dam pa'i gsung dag la// lus dang srog ltar gces par byed// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun mtsho bzhin du// ston pa'i gsung la gces 'dzin pa// shākya'i dge sbyong dar gzhon gyis// kun la phan pa'i don du zhus// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i byin rlabs las byung ba/
gzhan gyi mi thub pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong dar ma gzhon nus legs par zhus pa rdzogs so// //

120) ༄// bya ba'i rim pa rin chen snying po dge sbyong dar ma rin chen gyi zhu chos// skyes chen gang zhig bskal pa bsam yas su// dka' ba rnam pa sna tshogs rab spyad pas// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la gus pas 'dud// 'dus byas mi rtag blo gtad med pa la// 'khrul pas blo gtad spang zhing ma 'khrul pa'i// phan bde spel phyir rtag pa bde ba'i chos// rin chen snying po bdag gis 'bri bar bya// e ma rang nyid rang la yid ches mi skye na// su zhig gzhan la yid ches skye bar 'gyur// rang gi rang la blo gtod mi phod na// su zhig gzhan la blo gtod phod du re// rtog pa snga phyi mthun pa mi srid na// mtho dman gang dang bdag cag mthun par byed// sdig sdug gtam gyis bsdus pa'i tshe 'dis kyang*// 'gro ba'i mi la ma phan mi stongs te// khyod kyi nye drung bla ma nga yin zhing*// srog la ma bltas rtag tu 'bad na yang*// zhe 'dod cig gam phra ma tshig gcig gis// 'bral zhing spong ba khyod kyis ma shes sam// thub pas gsungs pa'i dam chos rin chen la// g.yo sgyu med par nyams len byas gyur na// bstan pa mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan los kyang ste// dgra rnams gnyen du 'gyur zhes bla mas gsungs// byang chub sems gnyis 'dres pa'i lus ngag gis// cir snang rgyal bar shar ba'i yi dam la// pha rol phyin drug mdzes pa'i me tog gis// mchod pa'i brtul bzhugs chod cig rang gi bu// nor zas srog dang longs spyod yul rnams kyi// padma'i lcug mas sems nyid glang po che// bcings par gyur na shin tu ma legs pas// ji ltar byas kyang btub pa'i brtul zhugs spyod// 'das dang ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu yi// rgyal ba sras bcas bla med dkon mchog gsum// ma lus kun dang mnyam par rang nyid kyi// lus ngag yid gsum dge ba rlabs che ba// nam mkha' ltar yangs gting mtha' med pa rnams// lhun gyis grub pa 'grub pa'i dus tshod 'dir// lus dang srog la mi snyan brjod pa yis// go cha chung zhing sgyid lug mi bya ste// srog la mi blta brtul zhugs chen po yis// bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs tog bsgrub// dpag med don chen bsgrub par byed pa la// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dug gsum dang*// bya dang bya ba ma yin mi shes spang*// rang la gzhan gyis rdzas dang yo byad kyi// dngos po che 'am yang na chung yang rung*// legs par byas sam yang na ma byas pa// 'dod pa'i rjes su nam yang 'brang mi bya// gsod dang gcod dang rdeg dang mtshon gyis 'debs// tshig ngan rgya mtsho gshe dang skur la sogs// rang la nyes pa sna tshogs bsgrub na yang*// khro ba med cing des pas bya ba bsgrub// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi bya ba rnams// byang chub sems sogs rang gi dge sbyor gyis// legs par sgrubs la rtag tu dran pas gzung*// kun bzang bsngo ba 'di la 'bad par mdzod// bya dang bya ba ma yin sna tshogs las// ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul bas// 'dir bde phyi mar bde zhing bder 'dod na// thams cad mkhyen pa'i rjes su 'jug par bya// 'jig rten gsum mgon bla ma'i zhal snga nas// mkhyen pa'i ye shes gsung rab yin zhes gsungs// gsung rab rnams dang de yi don ston pa// chos ldan dam pa spyi bos rtag tu bkur// rgya mtsho chen po chu gter yin pa bzhin// dam pa rnams kyang yon tan kun gyi gter// dam pa bsten pas rang nyid dam par 'gyur// grogs ngan bsten par ma byed rgyal ba'i sras// dad pa med cing chos la sdang ba dang*// nyon mongs dug rgyas gshed ma lta bu yi// go chod blo gtad snying bzhag byed na yang*// dug sbrul khros pa lta bur phung bar 'gyur// mtho dman sna tshogs las la 'jug pa'i tshe// slob dpon gsung dang brtse ba'i gsung yin yang*// legs par brtag nas dpyad cing ma byas na// rang nyid phyogs dang bcas pa phung 'gyur bas// brtag dpyad legs par byas nas bya ba bsgrub// rgyal po gtum po rnams dang 'dra ba yin// brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs kyi// sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlob mi mdzad// khams gsum sems can thams cad bsad pa bas// dran pa nyams par 'gyur pa sdig pa che// 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'das pa las// bya ba thams cad dran pas bsgrub par nges// legs par brtag nas bya ba byed pa ni// nga yi sras zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung*// 'dir mang smos pas dgos pa ci yod de// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa ni// kun mkhyen nyid yin zhe 'dod med pa'i phyir// des gsungs tshig la nan tan chen po yis// legs par brtags nas 'bad pas nyams su blangs// tshad mar gyur pa sangs rgyas nyid yin te// de yi gsung la gces spras chen po bya// bya dang bya ba ma yin shes pa ni// dgag dang sgrub pa'i bslab par sangs rgyas gsungs// ji ltar yin pa khyod kyis bsgrub par mdzod// dad pas bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmo la// yun ring bsten cing gtugs par gyur pa yis// tshogs gnyis rgya chen bsags par gyur pa yi// shākya'i dge sbyong dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis// mnyes par byas nas chos 'di zhus pa yin// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin des// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kun// mnyam med bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par shog

/bya ba nyams su blang ba'i rim pa rin chen snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmo spyi bos blangs shing yun ring du mnyes par byas pa/ shākya'i sras kyi dge sbyong dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 121) ༄// zab pa dang rgya che'i gdams pa dbyer med byang chub sems zhes bya ba// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can la// byams pa snying rje byang chub sems// snying nas rgyud la bskyed pa dang*// bskyed pa skyes par gyur pa yis// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// byang chub sems dang dbyer med par// sems can khams rnams ma lus pa// bde zhing sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob byed pa// ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos// rgya che ba zhes grags pa yin// de nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// rang sems rdo rje 'dus ma byas// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// blo yis dpag par ma nus pas// shin tu zab ces bya ba yin// zab dang rgya che'i gdams ngag 'di// khyed kyis nyams su blang bar zhu// ji ltar bya ba'i 'dun ma rnams// zab dang rgya che'i chos la 'dri// chos dang mthun pa'i 'dun ma de// ji ltar byas kyang bde mor mchi// khyed kyi rin chen gser phye de// bdag la shin tu thugs la btags// rdzogs so// // 122) ༄// thag chod gsum gyi gdams ngag dge bshes shes rab grags la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ sems nyid 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// mtha' brgyad nyes pa'i skyon bral ba// 'khor 'das kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// bla ma rin chen dpal la 'dud// rang gzhan thams cad kyi don nor bu rin po che/ dbang gi rgyal po lta bur 'byung bar 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag rnams kyis/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi 'bab sa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed thams cad kyi grol sa/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems mthar phyin par byed pa'i bdag po/

sems nyid rang byung chen po cir mi mdzad/ lhun gyis grub pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal po chen po 'di'i bka' las spu'i rtse mo tsam zhig 'das kyang*/ thog mar bar dang tha mar mi dge ba 'khor ba'i chad pas 'phog par snang ste/ khyed kyis 'gro ba thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa yang 'di yod na yod/ med na med/ g.yag shi breng chad kyi bsam pa drag po gcig pu gcig la shes pa 'chums pas bsgrub par mi bya ste/ de byas na rgyal po la 'khus pa'i bya ba rlabs po che 'bangs phra mos mi 'grub dang 'dra bar 'grub mi srid pa dang*/ yid chad pa dang*/ sgyid lug pa dang*/ sems zhum pa dang*/ brtson 'grus gtong ba dang*/ phyir ldog par 'gyur bas thams cad kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i ngang du gnyis su med par rnam par grol bar rgyun chad med par goms par bya ba dang po'i blo bcad/ thag chod dang po'o// 'gro ba la phan pa dang bde bar byed pa de yang*/ chos rin po che kho nas yin gyi/ chos ma yin pa ma yin pas/ sbyor ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa lan gcig blangs pa dang*/ dge bsnyen sna gcig tsam dang*/ yi ge drug pa tshar gcig tsam dang*/ bcu chos gsum chos kyi man ngag gi gnad se gol gtogs pa tsam re res nyams su blangs shing*/ de la dga' ba dang*/ spro ba dang*/ rjes su 'jug par byed pa/ gcig pu gcig gi bsod nams kyang*/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i sems can thams cad dus gcig tu 'chi ba'i srog las thar ba byas pa bas/ bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char yang mi phod par/ khong du chud par bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'phags pa rtogs pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/ thang gcig bsam gtan thun bzhugs na// khams gsum gang ba'i sems can la// srog byin bas ni 'di don che// zhes gsungs pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don chos rin po ches grol ba dang smin pa bya'o// de yang mthil du bya ba ni/

sgrub pa snying por byed pa rnams kyi chos dus las mi 'da' ba dang*/ phyi shol med pa dang*/ rjes su chags pa dang*/ khong khro bas zil gyis ma non par snying dang 'dra bar bskyang bar bya zhing*/ gzhan zhor la shugs 'byung du shes par bya ba ni/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ gzhan phan zhen med snying rje 'di// thabs kyi mchog tu btsir gyis zungs// zhes gsungs pa ni nges pa'o// thag chod gnyis pa'o// gsum pa'i thag chod ni/ yul ris dang rgyal khams gar 'dug kyang yul de na kha smras dang*/ 'thab mo dang 'khrugs pa chen po med pa'i yul mi srid pas/ tshan gcig yun ring po nas sdug pa phongs pa dang*/ zhen par gyur pas sdum par 'dod/ tshan gcig rgyal la byung su song bas da gzod pham par dgos pas sdum par 'dod/ kha cig rang pham por gyur nas slob dpon rin po che la bar g.yon dang sdum zhus nas/ sdum 'og der phung cig ci tsug tu 'grub snyam pa'i bsam pas sdum zhu/ kha cig shi bar gyur kyang nga sdum mi byed/ pham gyong nga la che bas 'di'i blo phugs cig brtag la/ sdum byed pa 'dra na sa kha 'dir mi gnas par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pas sdum zhu ba 'ong*/ de'i dus su pho tshod med pa'i rten gyi gang zag kha cig gis/ da yod glags cig che bar 'dug sdum 'di bya dgos snyam nas/ lus ngag yid gsum/ zas snying nor gsum/ khrel sdig gtam gsum/ g.yo sgyu zol gsum/ thabs blo shes gsum gyis/ 'bad pa sna tshogs byas kyang*/ sngon rgyu phyin ci log tu bsags pa'i las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus kyang bya ba'i thabs spu sa le'i 'dab ma tsam yang mi rnyed pa la/ nged kyis prad prad mang po byas pas phan pa ma yin te/ rang nyid gcig pu gnyis su med par dben pa'i gnas su sku mtshams dam por bcad nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems// chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag dang*// rigs sngags gsang sngags snying po dang*// phyag rgya bden pa'i byin rlabs 'dis// snang ba dbang du bsgyur ba 'di// snang ba rang sems rten 'brel gyis// bslu ba med pa ngo mtshar che// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po rnams// so so rang la myong ba yod// chos kyi rgyal po sa yi bdag

/mi dbang ngam shod bzhugs pa rnams// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// gnas dus las kyis ma bskal ba// gdan sa rin po che yi bdag /bu slob rnams kyi yab dang yum// 'khrugs pa shes pa ma bzod pas// lus srog grwa pa zas nor dang*// bde skyid gang la'ang ma bltas nas// yun ring 'bad pa spyad pa bas// sgam po yang dgon zangs zlum du// sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i tshe// grong pas bsdus pa'i phye phud kyi// lha bshos gcig po cig phul nas// char phobs tshig gcig smras pa yis// mu ge sa tshig byung ba la// mkha' las char gyi rgyun bab pas// bkra shis lo legs chen po byung*// gzhan yang bde legs bsam mi khyab// 'di la ngo mtshar chen po skyes// 'gag dang nya ga mi spong ba'i// khyed kyi brtul zhugs spyad par bya'o// sngon gyi drang srong chen po rnams// thabs dang shes rab rjes 'brangs nas// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i thabs// nged rang dbus na yod pa yi// rgyus pa'i sne mo phag ze ltar// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen gyis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i thabs// 'di la bsal bzhag gang yang med// mang drug gnyis po ma bsdums na// de yi 'dug sa nad ka ti// med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// ra lnga med pa'i 'brog rkyang dang*// pho tshod nyams rtogs med pa yi// 'gro ba skyong ba ga la srid// drung na gnas pa'i nye gnas rnams// skyes chen gces shing brtse ba'i phyir// bskul nas bris pa'i yi ge 'di// dgyes su re nas bris pa lags// 'di las byung ba'i dge ba 'dis// ji snyed ma lus sems can kun// thabs dang shes rab zab mo yis// bla med byang chub mchog thog shog /thag chod gsum gyi gdams ngag /rdo rje phur pa ki li ki li ya zhes bya ba rdzogs so// dge bshes shes rab grags la gnang ba// // 123) ༄// bka' dang nyams myong gcig tu gyur pa 'dan ma shes rab 'od la springs pa//

dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dngos gyur cing*// 'phags pa rnams dang lhar bcas 'jig rten gyis// zhabs kyi ze'u 'brur gtsug gis gtugs gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa rgyal gyur cig /phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang 'byor rgyal po yis// 'khor dang 'bangs la ji ltar bkas phab pa// nus mthu chung yang gsung bzhin bsgrub par byed// de bzhin 'dir yang khyed kyi gsung bzhin bgyi// thos dang bsam pas dben pa blo chung ba// rmongs pa bdag la 'jig rten mgon po yis// legs par gdams shing khrid du mdzad pa'i chos// byang chub sems dang yi dam bla ma dang*// phyag rgya chen po rjes la bsngo bar bcas// rdo rje'i gsung 'dis gdams par gyur pa las// gzhan pa'i dam chos bdag la ma mchis te// skyes chen khyed nyid dbang du gyur pa lags// ji ltar gsung ba 'di bzhin nyams su blang*// bla ma mchog la sangs rgyas 'du shes skyes// mtho dman gzhan gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par// rtse gcig sems kyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar byas// dam pa'i gsung la nyams myong bag tsam skyes// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid chos rnams la// mkhas pa thams cad thogs pa med par smra// nyams su myong dang rtogs pa'i 'gro ldog la// rnal 'byor pa yis 'di las 'di byung shes// ku sā li yi gsang tshig gsan par zhu// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// rang sems gcig pu yin zhes bla mas gsungs// dper na zhe sdang drag po skyes pa'i yid// 'khrugs pas lus ngag ji ltar 'gyur ba ltar// snying rje'i yid kyis lus sems 'gyur ba'i tshe// nang gi rten 'brel sems dang sems 'byung dang*// phyi rol rten 'brel rang las gzhan pa dang*// gsang ba'i rten 'brel rang gi lus po 'di// snying rje chen po gcig tu gyur nas mchi// de yi dus su snying rje de nyid las// gzhan pa med pa'i rten 'brel de nyid kyis// zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs ci rigs dang*// zhe sdang las skyes bsam ngan blo gros can// gnas dang dus kyi bskal nas ldog par 'gyur// 'di las bskyed pa'i nad dang sdug bsngal dang*// gzhan yang nyes pa mang po ldog 'gyur ba// lo stong lon pa'i mun pa mthug po yang*// sgron me skyes ma thag pas sel ba ltar// gnas dang dus kyis bskal nas lhan cig tu// mi gnas nges par bdag gi myong bas grub// snying rje de nas skyes pa'i tshangs dbang dang*// brgya byin 'jig rten mgon po bzhi la sogs// snying rje las skyes skyes bu gang yin rnams// lus dang grib ma lta bur gnas gyur nas// zhe sdang las skyes 'joms par gyur pa 'di// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ma lags sam// bral dang rnam par smin dang rgyu mthun dag

/dbang gi 'bras bur rnam par grags pa yi// 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi por gang gsungs pa// mthong chos 'bras bu can du smin par nges// a ma ma ma ma gcig lha rje ma// nam mkha' dang mnyam sems can ma lus kun// bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// byang chub mchog la bdag gis 'god pa yi// lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo dang bral ba 'di// gang gi rgyud la skyes par gyur pa yang*// snying rje zhe sdang dpe dang mtshungs par nges// yi dam lha dang bla ma dam pa yang*// rnam par dag pa'i 'gres dang 'dra 'am snyam// 'das pa ma yin ma 'ongs pa 'ang min// mthon po ma yin dma' bo dag kyang min// bzang po ma yin ngan pa ma yin pa'i// da lta'i shes pa rig rig tur tur 'di// ma brtag ma dpyad bsam mno spangs pa yi// thabs la mkhas pa bsten par byas pa yis// mtha' gnyis mtha' brgyad spros pas dben gyur pa// ma rig nas bzung rga shi'i bar du ni// rang rig shes pa ci'i phyir spros bral min// ston pa'i bka' dang bla ma dam pa'i gsungs// rnal 'byor pa yi nyams myong gcig gyur na// snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa// thams cad chos sku bde chen ci'i phyir min// nyams myong rtogs pa gcig tu gyur pa yi// nges pa'i shes pa snying la zug gyur pas// 'khor ba ma mthong mya ngan 'das ma mthong*// thams cad ma mthong nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// ma mthong snyam pa'i blo yang ma mthong ba// ma lus kun mthong e ma phyag rgya che// 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs pa'i chos 'di go /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba mthar thug gi /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsungs pa kun// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bas blo re bde// 'di yang gong du ji ltar zhus pa bzhin// gnas dang dus kyis ji ltar bskal ba dang*// phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel 'grigs pa'i tshul// 'bras bu bzhi dang bcas par gyur pa yi// tshul lugs 'di dag skyes chen khyed kyis dgongs// gzhan du rtsa rlung thig le mngon shes dang*// rdzu 'phrul rtags dang mtshan ma mtho dman kun// bdag la med pas nga la 'bri rgyu med// bde chen rgyal ba'i gsung dang bla ma'i bka'// rang gi nyams myong gcig tu gyur pa yi// dam pa'i chos 'di 'bri bar mi 'os kyang*// skyes chen khyed kyi gsung bzhin bris pa lags// ston pa'i gsung la blo gros rab yangs pa// shes rab spyan gyis gzigs pa rgya che zhing*// nyi bzhin snang bar gyur dang 'brug sgra bzhin// phyogs su grags pas khyab pa'i bshes gnyen la// snyan du gsol bas thugs mnyes mdzad par zhu// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag
/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /'dan ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po shes rab 'od la springs pa'o// //

124) ༄// sku'i rim gro bya lugs lo gsum du mtshams dam por chod ces pa/ oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ skye ba dang*/ rga ba dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i sku rdo rje 'chang chen po rdo rje'i rgyal po chen po la/ bdag dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// nges par skyabs su mchi'o// bdag cag sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por lhung ba thams cad/ 'chi ba med pa'i gnas su phyin par mdzad du gsol/ bdag sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i ched du/ tshogs pa bskyangs shing 'gro ba la ci phan bsgrub pa yin pa la/ sngon las ngan pa byas pa'i rnam par smin pa dang*/ da ltar gyi bsam pa ngan pa'i dbang du song bas/ spyod pa mtho dman du gyur pa'i stobs kyis de sngon yang bar du gcod pa chen po byung zhing*/ da yang bar du gcod pa 'ong bar 'dug pas/ sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong na// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes pas nyes pa bshags shing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten du/ bdag gi lus longs spyod/ 'khor g.yog 'bangs/ dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad/ 'phags pa dang sems cad thams cad la 'bul gyis/ thugs brtse bar dgongs la bzhes su gsol lo// lar a pho rang gi lugs kyi/ a ru ra'i gcig thang gis ma phan na/ ba ru ra'i skyob kyis mi phan/ dge 'dun spyi'i dge sbyor gyi tshugs dang grabs med na mtho dman tsab tsub mang po byas kyang*/ ltar snang*/ bslu brid/ rang gis rang mgo bskor ba yin pas/ dge 'dun thams cad kyis rang snying dpang por tshugs/

lus srog thed la yal bar thong*/ lto gos gyong la bskur/ nyin mtshan med par dge sbyor la 'bad par zhu/ lar mos gus can bla ma dam pas zin na ci byed tshogs gnyis ma gtogs pa rnyed mi srid/ bsod zad nyon mongs pa'i tsag ram can gar bsdad kyang sdig sdug gi khur khyog tshad rnyed nas 'ongs dogs yod pas/ nyin mtshan med par rang rgyud la blta zhing sbyang bar bya ba gal che/ spyir nga dang khyed rang rnams thams cad kyi rim gro dang bya phyogs/ 'phral dang phugs thams cad du bzang ba/ bu mir skyes na pha la spyang khu bskon pa dang 'dra bar/ nga'i rim gro gsha' mar byed na lo gsar tshun chad tshogs sogs kyi grabs shoms byas nas/ lo gsar phan chad du mtshams bcad sum stong yan chad cig lo gsum du mtshams dam por chod la sku'i rim gro dge sbyor la nan tan du mdzad par zhu/ de rnams kyis brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma rdo rje 'chang chen po rnams kyi thugs dgongs la gnad du bsnun nas/ nga ma shi ba dang*/ bla ma gong rnams kyi mi rabs ma chad pa dang*/ glang sna ma hol ba cig dang*/ rang gi don chen po grub pa gcig dang*/ go chu rug tu ci 'ong gcig mdzad par zhu/ lar thams cad kyis nga'i bar chad 'di rnams ma sol gyi bar du/ kha smras dang kha mchu mi tshol zhu/ mi ltogs phag phag tu ltogs sgur byed du chug ngan rgyags mo ngom dang phyar phyungs byed pa/ nor rdzas dang*/ rang skyong ma nus pa rnams kyi nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gi glud du nga'i srog dang dge 'dun gtong ma nus pa yin pas/ 'dir skung du 'jug par zhu/ chos nyid rang bzhin dag pa na// dbyer med ngo bo nyid mnyam yang*// bdag 'dzin 'khrul pas brtags pa yis// 'chi dang bar du gcod pa yi// 'jigs pa chen po byung ba las// bskyab par bya phyir bsod nams dang*// ye shes tshogs ni gang bsags pas// bdag dang sems can thams cad kun// skye dang rga dang na ba dang*// 'chi dang bar du gcod pa yi// mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sdug bsngal las// thams cad thar bar gyur nas kyang*// skye shi med pa'i gnas thob shog

/mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par shog /nyams su len par thams cad kyi// phyi nang bar chad med par shog /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// phyi nang bar chad bral nas kyang*// chos dang mthun par gnas pa dang*// sgrub pa tshul bzhin byed pa rnams// bar chad med par 'grub par shog/ // 125)༄// rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gi bkod pa'i thugs bskyed kyi smon lam// chos kun gdod nas spros dang bral zhing 'gyur ba med// gang gis thugs su chud nas 'gro ba smin pa'i phyir// thugs rje chen pos rang gzhan skyon dag yon tan rdzogs// mi bskyod rgyal por rnam grags bla ma mchog la 'dud// mnyam med bla mas dang por thugs bskyed pa// shākya seng ge'i gsung gi rjes 'brangs nas// mi 'khrugs zhing bkod ji ltar bstan pa yi// smon lam rgya chen ji ltar btab pa las// rjes su 'brangs bas nyams su blang phyir 'bri// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan chen la// byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pas// btsun pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// bdag ni byang chub sems dpa' yi// bslab pa ji ltar bcas pa la// slob par 'tshal zhes zhus pa las// dge slong byang chub sems dpa' yi// bslab pa ji ltar bcas pa la// deng sang bslab par shin tu dka'// ci'i phyir zhe na sems dpa' yis// sems can kun la mi 'khrugs cing*// gnod sems bskyed pa min phyir ro// ston pas gsungs pa'i rjes thogs la// byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pas// btsun pa bcom ldan bdag gis deng*// slan chad 'di ltar g.yo sgyu dang*// bden dang gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i// tshig gis bla med byang chub tu// sems ni bskyed cing 'dud pa dang*// yongs su bsngo bar bgyi lags so// sems bskyed rin chen 'di skyed de// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob bar// gal te sems can 'ga' tsam la// khro dang gnod sems 'khrugs pa dang*// ldan pa'i sems ni skyes gyur na// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bslus gyur cig

/de dang mtshungs par thams cad la// ji lta ba bzhin sbyar bar bya// gom pa 'dor ba re re la// thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems bral na// nyan thos rang rgyal sems bskyed de// 'dod pa'i 'dod chags sems skyes nas// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// rnam par 'tshe ba gnyid dang rmugs// rgod dang 'gyod par blta ba dang*// the tshom dag dang ldan pa yi// sems ni bskyed par gyur pa na// srog gcod ma byin len pa dang*// mi tshangs spyod dang rdzun du smra// phra ma ngag rtsub kyal ba smra// brnab sems gnod sems log lta dang*// ldan pa'i sems bskyed gyur pa na// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus par gyur// ji skad smras bzhin ma bgyis na// gom pa 'dor ba re tsam la// sangs rgyas yid la byed pa yi// kun mkhyen sems ni ma bskyed na// gal te tshe rabs thams cad du// rab tu byung bar ma gyur na// mngon par rab tu byung nas kyang*// dgon pa pa dang bsod snyoms dang*// phyag dar khrod pa stan gcig pa// zas phyis mi len ji snyed len// dur khrod pa dang bla gab med// tsog pu pa dang gzhi ji bzhin// chos gos gsum pa phying ba pa// 'dod pa chung dang chog shes pa// chos 'dod pa dang chos la dga'// chos la gus dang chos la rton// chos ston par ni ma gyur na// bslab dang sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// yo byad bsnyungs pa'i yi dam dag /blangs te gnas par ma gyur na// gal te tshe rabs tshe rabs su// rab tu byung bar gyur nas kyang*// dam chos ston par ma gyur ram// spobs pa chags pa med pa dang*// spobs pa tshad med ma gyur na// 'greng dang mchis dang 'chag pa yi// spyod lam gsum po ma gtogs pa// gal te nyal bar gyur pa na// gal te sems can 'ga' tsam la// rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba dang*// grong pa'i chos dang ldan pa yi// bud med dag dang ldan pa 'am// de las gzhan smra brjod pa dang*// gzhan la gnod cing spa bkong dang*// ldan pa'i sems can bskyed gyur na// gal te bud med dag la 'dir// mi rtag sdug bsngal ston pa dang*// bdag med pa 'am gzhan dag gi

/chos ni ston par gyur pa na// yan lag la sogs kha dog la// bzang po'i mtshan mar bzung nas kyang*// so yi phreng ba ston gyur tam// rgod dam lag pa g.yob bgyid na// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus gyur cig /chos ni ston par gyur pa na// lag pa bsgyur zhing chos ston na// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes 'brang ba// skra dang kha spu bregs pa la// snod du gyur pa'i gang zag gam// snod du ma gyur mi 'ong ste// ston pa'i chos gos ngur smrig dang*// gon pa mthong na de dag la// ston pa'i 'du shes ma bskyed dam// mchod rten 'du shes ma bskyed na// byang chub sems dpa' gzhan mthong na// ston pa'i 'du shes ma bskyed na// chos 'chad pa na chos ston la// 'dug ste nyan par ma gyur na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs par// 'di las gzhan pa'i dge sbyong dang*// bram ze lha gzhan phyag bgyis na// 'di la sbyin pa sbyin par bya// 'di la sbyin par mi bya zhes// sems can rnams la tha dad du// bya ba'i 'du shes bskyed gyur na// 'di la yon dbul 'di la mi dbul zhes// de 'dra'i 'du shes skyes gyur na// bdag gis thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems// bskyed pa rin chen 'di bskyed de// bla na med pa'i byang chub tu// bsngos shing yongs su bsngos pa la// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu// sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yang*// gal te 'di la dam chos kyi// sbyin pa sbyin par bgyi ba ni// 'di la sbyin par mi bya zhes// de lta bu yi sems bskyed na// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bslus gyur cig /gal te dgum pa'i sems can dag /la la khrid de mchis mthong na// yongs su thar bar bya ba'i phyir// bdag lus yongs su ma btang na// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus gyur cig /sangs rgyas dpang dang tshad mar 'jog /de yang ring por mi thogs par// lhar bcas 'jig rten tshad mar 'gyur// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to// gal te dge slong dge slong ma// dge bsnyen dge bsnyen ma rnams la// ltung ba'i nyes pa byung mthong na// khyed la ltung ba 'di byung zhes// ltung ba glengs par gyur pa na// bdag nyid rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu// sangs rgyas thob pa'i zhing de na// thams cad rnam pa thams cad du// nyan thos rnams kyi ltung ba'i sgra// mi grags mi 'byung de ltar bsgrub// zhing de yongs su dag pa dang*// yon tan yongs su rdzogs par bsgrub// gal te rmi lam tsam du yang*// khu ba phyung bar gyur pa na// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus gyur cig

/de ltar brtul zhugs spyad pa yis// sangs rgyas zhing der rgyal ba'i sras// nyes pa kun dang bral ba dang*// yon tan thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur// // 126) ༄// rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs bskyed smon lam seng ge'i nga ro// skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje// dang po byang chub thugs bskyed pa// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nam mkha' yis// seng ge'i nga ro tshig 'di brjod// 'khor ba'i mtha' ma med pa yi// sngon gyi mtha' ma ji srid pa// de srid sems can phan don du// spyod pa dpag yas spyad par bya// 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan snga 'dir// byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de// 'gro ba thams cad sgrol gnyer te// dbul zhing 'phongs las bsgrol bar bya// de ring phan chad gal te yang*// bdag gis 'dod chags sems bskyed na// phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas thams cad bslus par gyur// byang chub nam zhig thob bar du// tha ba'i khong khro'i sems dang gnod sems dang*// phrag dog dang ni ser sna yang*// de ring phan chad mi bya 'o// tshangs pa'i spyod pa bdag gis spyad// sdig pa'i 'dod pa yongs su btang*// tshul khrims sdom dang des pa la// sangs rgyas rjes su bslab par bya// bdag ni byang chub rings tshul du// 'tshang rgyar mos shing spro ba med// phyi mthar thug gi bar du yang*// sems can gcig phyir spyad par bya// tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// sangs rgyas zhing ni sbyang bar bya// phyogs rnams bcu po thams cad du// bdag gi ming ni thos par bya// bdag gis bdag la lung bstan te// sangs rgyas 'gyur bar dogs pa med// bdag gis lhag bsam rnam par dag /bdag dpang 'di na 'dren pa rnams// lus dang ngag gi las rnams kyang*// rnam pa kun tu bdag gis sbyang*// yid kyi las kyang sbyang bar bya// mi dge'i las ni spyad mi bya// ma 'ongs dus na sangs rgya ste// 'jig rten mgon du 'gyur zhe na// bden pa des ni sa 'di yang*// rnam pa drug tu g.yos gyur cig/

// 127) ༄// phar phyin drug gi gdams ngag rnam gsum gyi nyams len// gdams ngag rnam pa gsum ni/ lus mnyam par bzhag pa med na/ dmigs pa dang bcos thams cad don med du 'gyur bas/ lus rnam par bzhag pa sgrub pa'i man ngag rigs tha dad pa shes pas/ yon tan myur du bskyed bar byed pa'i man ngag thams cad kyi rtsa ba yi ge gsum/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i man ngag gi gnad/ sems can thams cad rang gi srog tu song bas/ rang la ltos pa med pas gsog 'jog la 'bad pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i dus dang tshod shes pa dang*/ sbyin pas don ji tsam 'grub blta ba'o// ston pas gsungs pa'i tshul khrims la nyon mongs pa rnam pa gsum spong ba'i gnad du go ba dang*/ lta sgom gyi grogs su 'gyur ba dang*/ sgrib pa rnam pa gsum gyi byang tshul dang gsum mo// bzod par bya ba'i thabs gsum ni/ rgyu mtshan shes pas bzod par bya ba dang*/ yon tan shes pas bzod par bya ba dang*/ rang bzhin shes nas bzod pa bya ba gsum mo// brtson 'grus gsum ni/ rtsol ba'i brtson 'grus dang*/ ma yengs pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ mi bsgom pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum mo// 'khor ba sna tshogs kyi dmigs pa dang*/ rgyud byin gyis rlob pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ lhag pa'i lha'i dmigs pa'o// kun rdzob shes pa'i shes pa dang*/ don dam shes pa'i shes pa dang*/ zung 'jug shes pas rang gzhan thams cad smin par byed pa ni shes rab bo// nyes pa thams cad rnam spangs shing*// yon tan kun gyi pha rol phyin// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa yis// smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa'i skyon// nyi shu gsungs pa 'di re mad// lhan cig tshogs pa 'di rnams la// rtogs dang nyams su myong ba la/ /cung zad drag pa nga yin yang*// gces spras nyams len ma byung na// bdag pas drag pa su zhig la// bshad pas nyams su len par byed// bsgoms pas gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob// ku re min nam bden srid na// glen pa nyams len snying por gyis//

// 128) ༄// sems las gzhan pa'i rten 'brel ma rnyed zhes pa// nam mkha' 'dra zhing rdul bral gzugs bzang 'chang*// shes rab sras po lus dang mtshan mi mnga'// yon tan rgya mtsho rab zab thugs rje can// mtshungs med phyag ni bdag gi spyi bor zhog /rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ rten 'brel dang sems mi gcig yul dang dbang po la brten nas skyes pa'i rnam par shes pa sems yin gsungs pa la/ mgon po byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ rnam gsum rnam gsum snang ba can// gzhan gyi dbang gi mtshan nyid do// zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan dbang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba thams cad der 'dus par gsungs pa dang*/ yang mdo las/ gnas don lus kyi rnam par ni// mi yi rnam par shes pa snang*// zhes gsung pas/ dbang po lnga yul lnga/ snod kyi 'jig rten du snang ba thams cad sems su gsal bas/ sems las gzhan pa'i rten 'brel ma rnyed/ de dag gi don legs par gsung du gsol/ 'di khyed gsung ba shin tu mad de/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas sems kyi rdo rje bstod pa las kyang*/ sems ni 'gro ba lnga po yin// bde dang sdug bsngal mtshan nyid dag /sems las ma gtogs cung zad med// ces gsungs pas/ sa bcu'i mdo las kyang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis po 'di dag ni sems gcig pu ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad sems so zhes gsungs pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab/ dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams myong ni 'di las med par nges te/ nga'i log rtog la/ rnam par shes pa 'grub pa'i rgyu tshogs pa ni rten 'brel rnam par shes pa nam grub pa'i dus su/ rnam par shes pa'am sems zhes ming 'dogs snyam ste/ 'di log rtog 'ba' zhig tu zad pas/ ngas kyang gsang*/ khyed kyis kyang gsang bar zhu'o// //

129) ༄// sems 'dul gcig pu yin par bstan pa rang sems rdo rje zhes pa// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// zhi ba chags bral rang gi sems// rang sems rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba rnams kyi gdung brgyud 'dzin// g.yo med lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi// dri ngad phyogs bcur ldang ba yis// dam pa rnams kyi yid tshim byed// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// zhe sdang gdug pa'i me dpung gsod// thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab kyis/ /rang gzhan dgra gnyen stong par rtogs/ /bla ma rje btsun dam pa yis// blo phugs 'dun gros zhus pa'i don// rang gzhan skyid sdug thams cad kun// rang gis byas pa'i lag rjes yin// su la dga' la su la sdang*// las ngan sbyangs shing tshogs gnyis bsags// dkar dmar sna tshogs snang ba 'di// sems kyis bris pa'i 'ja' tshon yin// byis pas 'ja' tshon mi bda' bar// 'gyur med sems nyid rdo rje bsgom// stong nyid rgyu 'bras lta kham de// ne tso'i rdo rje gcod pa ltar// 'gag dang nya ga mi spang bar// dgos pa'i dus su nan tan mdzod// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// rang sems 'dul ba gcig pu yin// 'khor 'das nye du gnyen 'brel rnams// dmag mus mi dmigs chags sdang ga la bskyed// bde 'cham yul ka'i dgon par yang*// zhag gsum sdod pa'i rang dbang med// 'dug tshis bsam pa skyes pa yis// khams gsum ru la mi g.yeng 'tshal// tshe gcig bskyangs pa'i slob ma dang*// rtag tu bsgrubs pa'i dam chos dang*// gsol ba 'debs pa'i dkon mchog dang*// bral na snying tshim des ci bya// nyes tshogs bde sdug gang byung la// snying rje chen po'i skam pas gzung*// stong nyid rdo rje tho bas brdung*// bde chen rta 'chag steng kar bskyal// nyon mongs shi ba'i ro 'di mdzes// nyin mtshan med par thugs dam mdzod// nga yi bu chung sman pa rnams// shi chad med par gso bar zhu// sman pa sos pa'i dus tshod du// dgra bo'i bla mchod byas pas chog/

// 130) ༄// nyes skyon spong bar gdams pa nam gzhug chad pa ma tshor ram zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma thugs rje chung na/ snod ldan gyi slob mar gdams ngag mi ster/ slob dpon shes rab chung na/ yon tan rgyud la bskyed pa'i nus pa mi 'byung*/ phra ma mchu snyung la dgyes na/ 'khor mthun mi srid/ zhen yul rnam pa gnyis la chags na/ rang dbang med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi khur rang thog tu 'ong*/ zhwa nag po mgo la gon na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod par 'gyur nges/ chos skyong gi gdan bsngo ma thos na/ yul phyogs su 'khrugs pa 'byung*/ bla bo long gtam 'phros gtam la dga' drags na/ dgos pa'i chos dang don rus mi thon/ srod dang tho rangs la mi nyal ba'i sbyor bas gnyid ma bcag na/ lus ma sbyangs pas ngal dub kyi mthar ltung*/ yon tan che rab yod kyang gces ka'i nyag nyog mang na/ mig yod rgyus shes dang 'khrugs pa 'chor/ ston pa'i gsung dang 'gal na/ tshe 'di phyir sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho thob/ nyams su len pa gding ba'i bcas pa dang 'gal na/ grib kyi nyes pa gsum gyi phog ci byed la rang lugs kyi gzhung ma tshugs nas mi'i kha la nyan drags na/ khyi chu gtor la brgyugs pa dang 'dra bar 'ong*/ 'khor g.yog la 'tshams pa'i las ma bcol na/ gces lo cal col gyi gtam mang na/ mis 'phya rang sdug tu mchi/ mkhas pa gong ma dang bsten sa la gros ma byas na/ rang shes legs kyang gting bye nas 'gro/ legs par brtags nas ma byas na/ krog po thal thung can sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor nyal/ dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ma ldan na/ shes rab rnam pa gsum dang*/ yon tan gang yang rgyud la skye mi srid/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum gyi gnad med na/ gsang sngags 'grub tu mi rung*/ mtshams dam por ma bcad na/ grib ma'i bar chad 'ong*/ phrin las dang bstun nas gnas mal ma bshams na/ rtsa ba'i rnam par shes pa skyer mi 'dod/ rdo rje gsum gyi gnad ma shes na/

bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung*/ bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang bral na/ sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa'i lo 'bras dang 'dra/ dbang po lnga yul la dga' drags na/ tshe thung*/ nad mang*/ yon tan skye mi srid/ phu kha ba'i gangs la bltas bltas nas/ nam gzhug chad pa ma tshor ro// // 131) ༄// dkar po'i dge ba srog ltar srung ba srog rang gis bsrung ba// thub pa chen po 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur pas// de la bar du gcod par 'gyur bar dam bcas pa// de la bar du gcod par mi 'gyur zhes// sus kyang rgol zhing rtsod par mi nus na// 'dul ba rgya mtshor ston pas gang gsungs pa'i// bar du gcod par 'gyur ba'i nyes ltung la// da rung 'dzem pa'i bsam pa ma skyes na// stobs dang mi 'jigs yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshogs// e ma bdag gis nam zhig thob par 'gyur// bdag gi bsam pas rgyu las 'bras bu'i tshul// ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo ji bzhin du// byas pa dran pas sad nas smin snyam na// bdag gis byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu ni// byas shing bsags pa sngon du song ba ste// ri bo rdib pa'i 'og tu song ba ltar// dran bsam med par rang dbang med par 'byung*// las kyi tshul ni 'di ltar zab gyur na// mkhas pa ci'i phyir nags su gnas mi byed// dkar po'i dge ba rnams kyi srog gyur pa// dam pa rnams sam sems can gang la yang*// gus pa spangs pa'i lus ngag yid kyi las// che bar gyur tam yang na phra yang rung*// srog rtsar khab kyi rtse mos btsugs gyur kyang*// mi 'tsho 'chi bar gyur pa ji bzhin du// rang srog rang gis bsrung ba gces gyur ces// rang la snying brtse yod pa'i mi rnams kyis// rang gis rang la ci'i phyir 'debs mi byed// // 132) ༄// tshogs gnyis rdzogs thabs he badzra zhes pa gzhon nu tshul khrims la gnang ba// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mgon gyur bla ma rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi ze'u 'brur gtsug gis 'dud// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yis// shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa// spros med ri khrod rnal 'byor pas// dgongs pa sgrub pa'i slob ma la// gtan gyi srog srid btsal lugs bstan// mi rtag 'chi ba rjes dran pas// 'jig rten bya dang byed pa la// snying por mi blta mos gus can// 'jig rten 'di yi sdig pa dang*// 'jig rten pha rol rnam smin la// nyes par mthong bas spang par bya// bla ma dkon mchog don ched du// sdig pa byas pa'i mi rnams kyang*// 'di dang 'jig rten pha rol tu// bla ma dkon mchog gang gis kyang*// skyob par 'gyur ba ma mthong ste// 'di yis nyes pa 'di byas pas// nga dang 'brel ba med do zhes// 'o dod 'bod par nges pa ste// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan kyang*// lha sbyin nga dang 'brel med gsungs// bcas pa drug sde rnams la mang*// nyer sbas ston pa'i sras yin gsungs// spyod lam gzob dang dam pa kun// nyon mongs ma bsten rnal 'byor pa// bag dang ldan na rab byung yin// gzhan gyi nyes pa bzod na yang*// rje la ngan smras byed pa la// nga la bzod pa'i thabs med de// rin chen mgo la ya zer kyang*// rgya mtsho'i gling la zer bar soms// gang la gnod na bde 'brel ba'i// bla ma mchog dang 'brel pa la// dga' ba chen po yang yang bskyed// bcu gsum po la nan tan bya// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dngos grub blang*// khyed kyi mgo la ya zer na// thog med dus nas da yi bar// phung khrol rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gyi// mgo la rdeg pa'i mthu bo che// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i yi dam lhar// nges pa'i shes pa chen po bskyed// skyabs su mchi'o gsol ba 'debs// bcos ma med pa'i mos gus bya// mngon mtshan rgya mtsho'i gting tu sba// nyams myong ri khrod dgon par skyong*// spyod pa mi mthun phyogs dang bsre// mnga' bdag rgyal po dngos grub mgon// khams gsum dbang du bsdus so zer// ti ser bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bdag po rgyal ba dga' nas mchi// dgongs shig dgongs shig rnal 'byor pa// rem zhig rem zhig dpa' bo kun// rgyugs shig rgyugs shig 'gag la rgyugs// zungs shig zungs shig dgra bo zungs// mos gus can gyi slob ma rnams// bla ma'i ched du sdig mi byed// khal thang brgya dang sum brgyas kyang*// nged rang spad kyi mgo mi khyogs// pha la bu skyes gyad kyi rigs// rje btsun sgra bsgyur lo tsā la// mi la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// zhabs tog byas pa'i phyi rjes snyogs// dus ngan tha ma'i srog chags rnams// 'grogs pa mi sla dka' ba ste// byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin byed pa// srog la ltos pa med pa yi// rgyal sras 'jigs med seng ge mchog

/ma pham rdo rje dbang phyug gis// rgyal ba'i gdung rgyud mi gcod pa// skyes chen tshogs kyi dpon rnams dang*// de yi sras su gang gyur pas// lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// spyad pa spyod pa'i yi ge 'di// tshig gi 'brel pa chung na yang*// don gyi 'thad pa rdo rje 'dra// shākya'i rigs las byung gyur cing*// sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang du len// ri khrod 'grims pa'i brtul zhugs can// gnyis med glang chen spyod pa yis// bla ma'i zhabs tog byed pa yi// dge sbyong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis// sna tshogs las dang bya ba yis// bla ma dam pa mnyes byas nas// tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs// kun la phan pa'i don du zhus// he badzra rdzogs so// // 133) ༄// theg gsum nyams len gnad kyi don kun 'grub par bstan pa// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyabs gcig bla ma dkon mchog la// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// tshad med snying rje skyes pa yis// rang las gzhan gces bsam pa yis// 'gro ba rjes su gzung 'dod na// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la// bla med dkon mchog gsum po las// skyob pa'i skyabs gzhan mi srid pas// gsum pos rjes su gzung bar bya// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yis// dngos grub rnam gsum la gnas pas// sangs rgyas skyob pa'i skyabs chen gyis// phrin las rnam bzhis bsgrub par bya// byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa yis// bden drang gnyis la rab gnas te// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i tshul// bsdu dngos bzhi yis smin byas te// snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes med gsungs// rab tu byung ba gang yin pas// dge 'dun mthun pa'i bya ba yis// thams cad mi 'grub gang yang med// dge 'dun mthun pa bde ba ste// mthun pa rnams kyi dka' thub bde// gang dang gang du gnas pa yi// dge 'dun rnams dang mthun pa yis// don kun 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs brtan pa dang*// gzhi ji bzhin gyis thams cad 'grub//

// 134) ༄// zab mo gnad kyi phreng ba klong thang pa dge bshes be ri'i zhus chos// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig nyes tshogs rab spangs te// yon tan kun gyi rang bzhin chos kyi sku// 'gro ba ma lus smin par mdzad pa'i gnyen// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// dam pa de yi zhabs rdul spyi bo yis// gus par blangs pa'i dge slong shākya'i sras// ri khrod dgon par brtul zhugs spyod pa yi// rnal 'byor pa la gsol ba btab phyir 'bri// spyir bdag cag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por gnas pa rnams kyi 'dug lugs ni/ mi rtag pa'i srin pos spyi bo nas ni bzung*/ skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo chen po bzhi las ni ma brgal/ shes rab don dam pa'i bden pa mthong ba'i mig ni med/ thabs thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer bgrod pa'i rkang pa ni chag 'khor ba dang ngan song las skyob par byed pa'i skyabs jo bo dkon mchog gsum dang ni bral/ ji ltar byas kyang phan pa dang bde ba'i skal pa med par gyur pa yin pas/ deng sang phun sum tshogs pa'i dus 'dir rang gi lus dang srog la ltos pa med par brtson 'grus dang brtul zhugs kyi stobs gcad du med pa'i shugs kyis/ skye ba gtan gyi so nam/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad kyi bde skyid/ bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par bya'o// rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che de tshul ji ltar sgrub snyam na/ lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo sgyu med pas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ yon tan thams cad bskyed par byed pa'i sa gzhi lta bu tshul khrims rin po che la pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rang nyid kyis bgyis pa dang*/ gzhan la bgyid du stsal pa dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis dus gsum du byas shing bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang bar byas shing*/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas byas shing bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ltos pa dang 'khris pa med par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba bya ste/

de ltar zhing dang bsam pa dang dngos po rnam pa gsum gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gnad ma 'chugs pas/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang skyid pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ma skyes pa skye ba dang*/ skyes pa 'phel ba dang*/ 'phel zhing rdzogs pa nyams pa med pa'i chos nyid khong du chud par byas nas/ rin chen dbang phyug ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// gzhan yang nged rang pha spad kyi snying gtam tshig gcig man ngag gi gnad zab mo/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ chos la blo nges pa 'ba' zhig yin/ gzhan gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa med gsung*/ slob dpon bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas/ nges pa'i byin rlabs dbang du byas gsungs pas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang thun mong gi dngos grub bya ba byed pa mtho dman 'bring gsum ci dang ci byed pa thams cad ma grub pa grub pa dang*/ grub pa brtan pa dang*/ brtan pa gong nas gong du 'phar pa dang*/ 'phar nas nyams pa med par rtag pa zhing gi gnad dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su song zhing bslab bya dang ma bral bas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs rgya chen pos bdag nyid byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo ba med pas/ byang chub kyi sems rang gi rgyud la skyes pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gcig tu gyur pa'i byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ rang nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po yi dam gyi lha nyid du nges pas/ yi dam gyi lhas byin gyis rlabs dang*/ de nyid kyi sngags dang phyag rgya dang dam tshig dang 'bral ba med pa'i rigs sngags dang gsang sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs dang*/ rang nyid 'khor 'das/ 'khor 'das rang nyid/ sems nyid phyag rgya chen por gdod nas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa la rang nyid 'gyur 'dod kyang gshis kyis 'gyur du ma btub pa/

rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i byin gyis rlabs dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang drag po'i phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed ces gsungs pa'i don 'khrul 'khor man ngag gi gnad kyis byin gyis rlabs dang*/ byin gyis rlabs 'di rnams thams cad kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi don lhun gyis grub la rgyun mi chad pas de kho na la nan tan shin tu che bar mdzad par zhu/ lar chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kun// rang sems gcig pu ma gtogs pa// dus gsum rgyal bas ma rnyed pas// bsam pa ngan pa thams cad spang*// bsam pa bzang po thams cad bskyed// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas// dbang po sgo rnams bsrung ba las// rgyal bas bgrod pa'i lam gzhan med// des na bag dang ldan pa gces// thabs mkhas shes rab zab mo yis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa yang*// mi nag gdug pa'i sa phyogs su// mkhas pa bas kyang mkhas pa dgos// gnas gcig ther zug sdod pa yang*// kha cig dga' ba skye na yang*// de la zlog pa yod srid pas// brtags nas bag dang ldan par bya// sa phyogs 'di na 'di yod ces// bsam rtog tshig gi rjes mi 'brang*// mthun pa'i gnas dang yul rnams su// rang gzhan don kun bsgrub pa yi// yun ring gnas la 'gal ba med// su dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lha// gang du 'dug kyang gzhal med khang*// dgra gnyen thams cad mnyam por mdzod// rang gzhan thams cad gcig tu bsres// 'byung po kun la byams pa'i yid// brtse bas thams cad bskyang bar bya// bcu chos gsum chos man ngag 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi gter// bya dang byed pa thams cad la// skyes chen khyed kyis nyams su blang*// zab dang rgya che'i gdams ngag kun// bdag la lus pa ma mchis par// thams cad snyan du gsol zin pas// dus 'dir 'bri rgyu ma mchis kyang*// dar ma dbang phyug nan che bas// ji ltar gsungs bzhin bsgrubs pa yi// yi ger bris pa 'di lags so// bris pa'i dge ba gang yin des// 'gro ba byang chub thob par shog
/zab mo gnad kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba klong thang pa dge bshes be ris zhus pa rdzogs so// //

135) ༄// bla med theg pa'i gnad bsdus dge bshes chen po bla brang pa la gnang ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis 'dud// bla ma de yis zhal snga nas// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang dang yang du gsung ba gang*// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang*// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po'i gnad// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// 'di las dam pa'i chos gzhan med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob bar// nyams su longs shig bka' stsal gsungs// dang por byang chub sems kyi gnad// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa yi// bgegs dang bar du gcod pa la// snying rje chen po yang yang bsgom// de yang 'di ltar nyams su blang*// shin tu dben pa'i sa phyogs su// sku mtshams bcad cing bya brel spang*// lus sems g.yeng ba med par bya// gnod par byed pa de rnams la// rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// snying rje bsgom zhing goms pa las// g.yo sgyu med pa'i snying rje skyes// de nas 'gro ba kun la bsgom// gsha' mar snying rje skyes pa'i tshe// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// sdug bsngal kun dang bral ba dang*// mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob bar// lus ngag yid gsum dge la bkol// ma shi bar dang sang gi bar// lus ngag yid gsum dge la bkol// snyam du sems la dam bca' bya// brtul zhugs chen pos de ltar bsgrub// rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms te// gsal la dang ba 'ja' tshon ltar// snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom// de la bsam pa 'jug gyur na// mi skyo'i bar du nan tan bskyed// de nas mgon po rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa de// bdag cag slob 'bangs thams cad kyi// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs byed pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa yin// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ltar// dpyid kyi thig ler gsungs pa bzhin// he ru ka dang phag mo yi// gnas su rgyun chad med par bsgom// he ru kas ni gdug pa 'joms// rje btsun mkha' 'gros phan bde yi// yon tan mtha' yas ster bar mdzad// gzhung tshogs mang po'i rjes 'brangs nas// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas rnams dang*// zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang ni// tshan dho nye ba'i tshan dho dang*// dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod dang*// sangs rgyas lnga yi pho brang du// sgom par 'dod lugs mang yod kyang*// dpa' bo thams cad he ru kaḥ

/mkha' 'gro rigs ni sum cu bdun// kun kyang phag mo'i rigs las skyes// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pas na// gnyis po 'di las ma gtogs pa// khyed kyis gzhan du ma bsgom mdzod// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gdug pa rnams// khros pas phung bar 'gyur du 'ong*// he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma'i// yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyis// khyed la sbyin par the tshom med// gsang sngags thabs kyis yon tan kun// rang la byin gyis rlob pa yi// bla ma rin chen bde legs mdzad// rgyun chad med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// nyin mtshan med par nyams su blang*// mos gus gdung shugs ma gcad dang*// kho bo'i bla ma rin chen gyi// byin rlabs khyed kyis shes nas mchi// da mthar thug phyag rgya chen po'i gnad// rje btsun de yi zhal snga nas// rang sems rang byung lhun gyis grub// dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa la// mnyam rjes rtogs pas ma slad cig /bye brag smra ba'i grub mthar ltung*// 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs pas na// gsungs pa de yi rjes su 'brangs// rang sems rang byung lhun gyis grub// 'das pa'i dus su byas pa med// da ltar dus su dbri ba med// ma 'ongs pa na bsnan pa med// ma byas dbri bsnan med pa yi// rang sems 'gyur med sgom du med// sgom rgyu byung na nor ba yin// lhun gyis grub pa ma bcos pa// dge ba'i bshes kyis shes par mdzod// skyes bu dam pas rtogs par mdzod// rang las gzhan tu ma re mdzod// rtogs ma rtogs gnyis las ma gtogs pa// 'bras bu thob dang ma thob med// mnyam med bla ma dam pas gsung*// yi ger bkod par mi rigs kyang*// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen gyi// bdag po yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// thos bsam sgom gsum nor gyis phyug /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnams// mkhan po chen po bla brang bas// dad cing gus pas gsol btab nas// bris pa'i bsod nams gang yin des// thams cad rdo rje 'dzin par shog

/dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba bya ba'i lugs// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /rdo rje rgyal mtshan mchog gis bsngo ba las// gsungs pa de yi rjes su 'brang bar mdzod// bla na med pa'i theg pa'i gnad bsdus pa zhal gyi gdams pa rin po che zhes bgyi ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bla brang pas zhus pa rdzogs so// // 136) ༄// byang chub sems gnyis nyams su blang ba'i gdams ngag ye shes rtsegs la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la lus gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sems dang bas skyabs su mchi'o// spyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byed pa la/ byang chub kyi sems ma gtogs pa gang gis kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi thob ste/ med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras nges pa lags/ byang chub kyi sems la rnam pa gnyis te/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems nyams su blang ba'i dbang du byas na/ rlabs po che yi dge ba'i rtsa ba byed pa'i dus sam/ snga thun dang po la zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung ste nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ snyam du dus ring thung rnam pa gsum byin gyis rlabs nas/ lag len du lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsam pa de nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs nas bya ba 'am/

yang na nangs par ram/ dal ba'i dus su byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba des mtshon nas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis/ dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya ba ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems/ thabs mkhas pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan thams cad bsgrub par byed pa'i gter chen po yin pas/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems de nyams su blang bar bya'o// de la don dam pa byang chub kyi sems ji ltar nyams su blang snyam na/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems de ni/ kun rdzob de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba de kho na nyid yin te/ de ltar yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ spros pa rab zhi don dam byang chub sems// snying rjes rab brlan kun rdzob smon 'jug gnyis// til dang til mar bzhin du ro gcig pa// zhes gsungs pas/ tha dad med par shes par bya ba ni/ dngos po thams cad rdul cha'am/ rdul cha'i dbye bas phye na stong pa nyid du bsgom pa'i lugs yod kyang*/ bla ma rin po che'i bzhed pas/ bla ma dam pa'i mos gus 'ba' zhig gis rtogs par bzhed de/ de ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal dgyes pa rdo rje nas/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang*/ gong gi bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas/ smra bsam brjod med kyi don rtog ge ba rnams kyi yul ma yin pa spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang shar du 'char nas sems nyid kyi ngo bo rgyun chad med par bzhed/

de ji ltar nyams su blang na/ dang po stan bde ba'i steng du skyil mo krung legs par bca'/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnas par byas nas/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa spyi bo'am snying gar bsgom/ de nas shes pa ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag yod par mi gzung rtag lta yin// med par mi bsgom chad lta yin// 'dzin med mi bsgom blos byas yin// so ma ma bcos lhug par bzhag /gsol ba btab cing goms pa las// rang gzhan snang srid 'khor 'das kun// sems gcig lhun grub gcig tu mchi// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis dang bral// 'bras bu spangs thob re dogs bral// nga bdag gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral// bral dang ma bral rlom sems med// lhun grub ngo bo nyid kyi sku// rgyun chad med par rang nyid 'gyur// rjes sam yang na skabs skabs su// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// bsngo ba'i bsngo lugs 'di lta ste// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o// rin po che yi gdams ngag 'di// skye bu dam pas bskul gyur pas// bris las byung ba'i dge ba des// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /bla ma rin po che dpal ldan 'bri gung pa la sgom pa ye shes rtsegs kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 137) ༄// sgrub pa snying por byed pa'i gdams ngag skyid shod pa dkon mchog 'od la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ skyes chen gang zhig 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs yon tan kun gyi sku// nyes tshogs dri ma'i skyon gyis ma gos pa// bla ma mchog gi zhabs la spyi bos 'dud// na rga 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gting la thug /tshe 'di skad cig glog dang ba mo 'dra// 'dus byas g.yo ba'i rang bzhin rtag pa med// 'jig rten chos brgyad bslu ba'i ri dwags bzhin// 'dod yon grags snyan nam mkha'i 'ja' dang mtshungs// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa nas// sgrol byed gzings ni tshul khrims rin chen yin// 'das dang ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu yi// rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes pa tshul khrims yin// thub pa drang srong rnams dang lhar bcas kyi// 'jig rten smin grol dga' ba tshul khrims yin// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa yi// gdung brgyud 'dzin cing mdzes pa tshul khrims yin// dus gsum 'phags pas bstod pa tshul khrims yin// rang gi lus dang srog 'di yal kyang bla'i// tshul khrims mchog 'di khyod kyis gces par srungs// 'khor dang zas nor phun sum tshogs pa yis// rang nyid chen por gyur pa'i 'gyings pa yis// dam pa rnams dang bla ma mi smod cing*// zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs nas mchod cing bkur// sems nyid lhan skyes smra bsam brjod las 'das// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i spros pas rnam dben pa// chags sdang nyon mongs grib mas ma gos pa// rgyun chad med par khyod kyis goms par mdzod// rang don zhe 'dod dri mas ma gos par// rang bas gzhan gces sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzhung*// bsdu dngos bzhi dang tshul khrims rnam dag dang*// stong dang snying rjes 'gro ba smin par mdzod// mthu chung man chung gdams chung mang po yis// re zhing ltos pa'i slob ma bslu na ko

/mtho dman gzhan gyi blo gtad ga la byed// thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba yi// snying po pha rol phyin pa drug gis skyongs// khyod nyid chos dang mthun pa'i ri khrod du// sgrub pa snying por byed ces bdag gis khums// dad pas zhus pa'i gdams ngag 'di dag rnams// thugs la zhog la nyams su blang bar zhu// dam pa rnams dang bla ma dam pa'i gsung*// dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i dam pa de// drung ngam rgyang na bzhugs kyang bla ma dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams shin tu mnyes// ji ltar bya ba'i lan du bstan pa'o// skyid shod pa dkon mchog 'od la gdams pa'o// rdzogs so// ling mug kha gang dar dkar kha gang dang*// gser gyi chun po 'dra ba'i skud pa dang*// dkon pa'i rin chen gser rnams bskur ba kun// rdo rje seng ges bdag gi lag tu thon// yig rten dbu zhu bskur bas gsol bar zhu// // 138) ༄// zhal ta tshig gsum gyi yi ge mdo smad pa shes rab 'od la gdams pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo dbyer med pa// mnyam med bla ma dam pa rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis legs btud nas// rgyun chad med par phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon gyur pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// shākya'i dge slong ri khrod pa// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bsod snyoms pas// rang gi chos las byung ba'i bu// dam pa khyed la zhu lags na// tshe 'di skad cig glog dang 'dra// mi rtag 'dod pa'i long med pas// 'jig rten bya byed sna tshogs kyis// rang gis rang mgo mi bskor bar// skye ba gtan gyi so nam mchog /dam pa'i chos la nan tan mdzod// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// thub pa drang srong chen po yis// mkhyen cing thugs su chud pa dang*// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyur pa// bkag pa gshis sam ye bkag pa// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// 'dul ba'i sde snod ces grags pas// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa 'di// rang gi srog pas gces par srungs// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// stobs bcu dri med tshul khrims yin// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshul khrims yin// 'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal las// skyob pa'i skyabs gcig tshul khrims yin// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma yi// zhabs tog bsnyen bkur tshul khrims yin// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis// bstod cing bkur ba tshul khrims yin// shin tu phra ba'i phra ba 'ang*// rang snying dpang du btsugs pa yi// dri med tshul khrims bsrung bar bya// byang chub rnam pa gsum nyid dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po yang*// sgyogs dang 'phrul 'khor ji bzhin tu// mthar thug gnas su phyin byed na// gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal// de bas nan tan chen pos 'bad// 'di ltar tshul khrims rin chen dang*// dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba rnams// ri khrod dgon par bsten pas 'phel// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyad pas grub// 'jig rten chos brgyad khe grags dang*// phun sum tshogs pa'i zas nor dang*// 'khor 'das yon tan gang yin pa// bral dang rnam par smin pa yi// yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus kun// ri khrod dgon pa bsten pas 'grub// grub thob brtul zhugs spyod pa yi// bla ma rje btsun gong ma dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// nags khrod ri khrod dben gnas su// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad cing*// kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob// bu gcig ri khrod dgon par sdod// yi dwags sprang po grong myug ma// 'dod chags chags pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// 'bad rtsol rtsol sgrub drag po yis// grong khyer mang po bskor na yang*// khe spogs ji snyed gzigs par bas// des na rtsa ba lo ma dang*// me tog 'bras bu gyi na la// brten nas khyod kyis byang chub sgrub// snying nas byang chub sgrub dus su// chos can chos nyid gang gis kyang*// bya byed nyams su len dus su// de nyid chos su ma go nas// gcig pur sdod la re na yang*// rnam par rtog pa mtho dman gyi// dpung tshogs mang pos bskor nas mchi// bcu dang gsum zhes grags pa yi// dam pa'i chos kyis nyams su longs// nyams len gnad kyis thabs med na// ci byas spros pa'i gag tshud yin// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu gyur pa'i rten 'brel 'dis// ci byas rgyal ba thams cad kyi// thabs kyi rgyal po khyod kyis sgrubs// shes rab stong nyid 'dus ma byas// 'od gsal stong nyid spros bral de// thun gyi tshod la 'di ltar bsgom// kha ta bya rgyu nga la med// gcig pu ri khrod dgon par bsdad// brtson 'grus chen po'i shugs dag gis// nyin mtshan med par bsgom pa na// rgyal bas bsngags pa'i skyil krung gi

/gal te gnad dang bral gyur na// nyon mong rtogs pas g.yengs ba 'am// shes pa skyo zhing mi dga' ba'i// dus su gnad du bsnun gyur na// ro stod gzer zhing mgo bo 'khor// snying mi dga' zhing tshig pa za// smyo 'bog snying rlung can du 'gro// gal te bu dang slob ma la// 'di 'dra'i gnod pa byung srid na// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi// zhabs kyi gdan du gyur pa yi// ri rab lhun po'i zhabs drung du// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'byung po mnan// lhan skyes gdams ngag zab mo yi// gcig shos lugs las bzlog par bya// gnyis po nyams len gang la yang*// dhū ti phra zhing gsal la gces// zhal ta tshig gsum yi ge 'di// gsol ba btab nas bris pa las// byung ba'i dge ba gang yin des// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog// mdo smad pa shes rab 'od la'o// //

139) ༄// snying gtam tshig gcig gi man ngag co za dge slong la gdams pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med dam pa rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs la gus pas 'dud// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mgon skyabs bla na med pa yi// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// shākya'i dge slong ldom bu pa// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs 'dzin pa yi// ri khrod dgon par gnas pa la// rang gi rigs las byung ba yi// dge slong bsod nams shākya yis// zhu don gsol ba btab pa la// snying gtam tshig gcig smras pa'i don// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// rgyal ba rnams kyi dam chos 'di// sus kyang ma byas shes bya'i babs// 'gro ba kun gyi 'dug lugs yin// bu sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che// rang gi 'dug lugs sems la zhog /snga ma'i bsam pa bzang po las// da ltar skyes pa'i lus 'di byung*// las mar khu lta bu zad tsam na// lus mar me lta bu 'jig nas mchi// ring por sdod pa'i long med pas// bu sdod pa'i so tshis mi mdzad zhu// sems 'jigs shing skrag pas nyen pa'i tshe// skyabs gtan bde'i gnas su ma phyin na// las ji ltar byas kyang ku re yin// gnas ri khrod kyi dgon par bzhugs par zhu// ri khrod dgon par gnas bcas nas// blo tshol khro la zhugs na rdzun po yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// lam tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa de// bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen yin// rtsa ba byang chub sems nyid la// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan rnam pa lnga// bsod nams tshogs su thub pas gsungs// bu rang snying dpang du tshugs mdzod la// bsod nams tshogs la nan tan zhu// nyams myong med pa'i kha ta can// rang la snying brtse med pa rnams// sha dang chang gi longs spyod dang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga po la// nyes pa'i skyon du mi blta ba// ngo mtshar legs pa'i yon tan zhes// dpa' bo 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// phag mo gru pas mi gsung bas// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar// ltos pa med par bsam gtan bya// de ltar ye shes tshogs chen ni// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum// smra bsam shes brjod yul las 'das// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa de// 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag nyid sku// yod med spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// lhun grub 'gyur ba med pa'i dbyings// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis med kyang*// nags khrod ri khrod gangs khrod du// gong ma rnams kyi rjes bsnyags nas// sbyangs pa'i yon tan brtul zhugs kyis// rnal 'byor pa yis nyams su blang*// 'jig rten spros pa'i bya ba yis// 'khor ba'i bde 'bras gang yin pa// ra yi o srong tshil yin pas// thar pa'i bde ba bsgrub po zhes// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gsung*// bu thugs la zhogs dang rnal 'byor pa// snying gtam tshig gcig man ngag 'di// gsol ba btab nas bris pa yis// dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub shog

/rdzogs so// // 140) ༄// ting 'dzin rgyal po bsgom pas rang gzhan kun skyid ces pa// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dam pa'i chos 'di// dge dang mi dge gshis sam babs su yod pa// don gyi snying po rang gi mtshan nyid dge ba// mi chos 'dun ma thub pa'i dgongs pa spangs nas// don spyi blo yi yul du byas nas 'dun pa'i// 'bad pa drag pos rtags tsam 'dzin pa ngas bsgrubs// 'bad pa drag ste chu la bsrubs pa 'dra bar// dub cing 'tsher te lcags kyi sran ma mur 'dra// bstan pa nub khar rtags tsam 'dzin pa 'ong zer// yin pa spangs nas min pa bsgrub pa 'di yin// thub pa'i bstan pa nam yang nub par mi 'gyur// kun la gshis su yod pa'i dge ba 'di yin// rtags tsam ma 'dzin dam pa'i chos la khyod 'bungs// ngang pa'i skyes ba'i rabs las rgyal po'i bsnyun 'dri// khyod kyi chos kyi sku la bar chad med dam// rnam par dkar ba bsdus pa chos kyi sku yin// rin chen gsung gis ci byas rang nyid snang gsung*// g.yo rgyu med pa'i drang po rang la yid gces// legs par bsam pa'i dam bca' brtan po med na// phyi nang 'tsho ba mang zhing ltogs pa'i zas 'dra// ting 'dzin rgyal po bsgom pas rang gzhan kun skyid// // 141) ༄// gshis kyi dge ba 'di la khyod kyis 'bungs zhes chos la chos su mi shes pa// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dam pa'i chos// dge dang mi dge mtshan nyid 'dzin pa 'di// rang la yod pa'i bsam sbyor 'di nyid yin// tshig gi zer mchu bzung nas dad pa yi// don spyi blo yis bsgoms pas ngal zhing dub// don med rtags tsam 'dzin pas nga re bslus// don med phung bar 'ong ngo bu slob rnams// gshis nyid dge ba 'di la khyod kyis 'bungs// ri khrod dgon par bsdad pas rna ba 'on// 'jur bus bcings pa glod na rang sems grol// byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// ri dwags smig rgyu bsnyogs pas skom grir shi// rtags tsam 'dzin pa bdud kyi sde yin zhes// dam pa gong mas gsung ba 'di re mad// chos sgor zhugs nas tha ma da lta'i bar// chos la chos su bdag gis ma shes pa// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// bla ma yi dam bla med dkon mchog gis// bdag gi nyes pa'i dri ma sbyang du gsol//

// 142) ༄// byang chub sems dpa' rnams bla ma'i gsung bzhin sgrub par nges pa// oṃ swasti/ shes bya'i gshis la mi gnas pa'i// 'jigs 'jigs bye ba brgya byas kyang*// 'thad cing myong ba med pa'i phyir// gang yang mgu bar 'gyur mi srid// gnas brtan chen po shwa ri'i bu// lus rten bar chad med pa yi// rgyal sras seṅge 'jigs med la// bu longs gsungs pas yon tan rdzogs// bskal pa grangs med mang por yang*// mgo dang rkang lag gtong pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrub par nges// brgya la gal te ston pa yi// mi mnyes skyon pa'i gsung byung na// srog chad re thag chad pa'i phyir// phan med gnod pa ci'i phyir bsgrub// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kun// bsdu dngos bzhi yi spyod pa yis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa las// dam chos gzhan med mkhas pas gsung*// // 143) ༄// rje nā ro'i gdams ngag mi la'i thugs la shar ba rung rgang par springs pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// 'das pa'i dus su sngon byung ba'i// sangs rgyas grangs med mnyes mdzad cing*// bsod nams tshogs chen rab bsags pas// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// lnga brgya'i tha mar rmad byung ba// 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin// bslab gsum rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// mchod cing bkur bar gyur pa'i gnas// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud// thugs kyi dpal be'u rab bkang nas// skal ldan mang po smin par mdzad// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes mchog

/gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis// bag chags sgrib pa zad par mdzad// rje btsun mi la'i zhal snga nas// rgya gar gyi nā ro paṇa chen dang*// bod kyi mi la rnal 'byor gnyis// 'od gsal gyi ngang du gcig tu 'dres// dpal nā ro paṇa chen gyi gdams ngag de// bdag mi la ras pa'i thugs la shar// rdo rje'i mgur du bka' stsal gsungs// bdag ri khrod 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor pa// sprang po dbus na yod pa dang*// khams na yod pa'i dge ba'i bshes// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag ltar// lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu 'dres// 'phags pa ka tā ya na la// yul mthar gnas pa'i gro zhun skyes// 'phags pa rna ba bye ba ris// dgra bcom 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe// mkhan po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// bdag gis chos sku'i zhal mthong yang*// da rung gzugs sku ma mthong bas// ston pa nyid dang mjal don du// gsol ba btab pa ji lta bar// sngon gyi thugs dgongs mnga' ba la// le lo phyi bshol ma mdzad par// ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin du mdzad// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /yig rten du dbu zhu gcig 'bul zhing mchis// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rung rgang pa la springs pa'o// // 144) ༄// mi tshe chos la bskyal ba 'phan yul brtson 'grus dpal 'od la springs pa// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// brtul zhugs grub pa thams cad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// spangs shing skyabs dang bral ba yi// bdag cag mgon skyabs med pa rnams// thugs rje chen pos ma bzod nas// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa// shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa la// sprang po bdag gi rjes zhugs nas// snying nas rab tu byung ba kun// ku re kyal ka ma mchis par// byang chub bsgrub pa yin par go

/lus dang srog la ma bltas par// khyed cag 'ba' zhig bskyangs pa la// tshe gcig bskyangs pa'i drin lan du// sha chang 'dod yon spyod do zhes// thos pas yi chad la gam nas// zhe sdang tshig ngan ngag tu shor// shi na rung ste snyam pa byung*// chos la srung ma med dam ci// da rung gson por 'jog pa de// ci tsug yin nam snyam pa byung*// gshin rje'i dong khar gtong snying 'dod// drag po gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor gyi// sbyor ba dkar nag bya 'am snyam// 'on kyang 'di dang phyi ma gnyis// med pa'i sbyor ba ngas kyang 'grub// 'byams yig shog bu btang pas chog /snyam nas shog bu btang ba de// chu tshol brtag pa tsam du zad// 'on kyang bu la nyes med pas// sprin dkar dag pa bzhin du dkar// nam mkhar zla ba dri med bzhin// nyes pa med pa mtha' nas dag /nyes med rgyan kha lha yis bzung*// bka' brgyud rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs// yon bdag grogs kyis che gzhi phye// bu la mi tshangs kha med byung*// dag go tshangs so shin tu dga'// nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pa// de las dga' ba yod dam med// khyod rang dpang por gyur pa yin// bu la tshangs pa'i rgya ma sbyin// mi shes 'khrul pa'i dbang song bas// khyod la smras pa'i sku yus su// ri khrod nags khrod gangs khrod gsum// khyod la dgon pa 'bul zhing mchis// dad zas bsod snyoms ting 'dzin zas// 'tsho ba zas kyi skal bar byin// gnyug ma ye shes rang drod dang*// gtum mo'i drod dang gos kyi drod// khyed la na bza'i skal bar 'bul// rnam shes rlung gi rta pho dang*// bla med theg pa'i glang chen dang*// zung 'jug yangs pa'i shing rta gsum// bu la bzhon pa'i skal bar 'bul// dpal phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar dang*// sems gnyis 'dres pa'i rin chen dang*// rgyal ba'i gter mdzod bslab pa gsum// bu la nor gyi skal bar 'bul// dbu skra phyag zhabs sen mo dang*// gsol ba 'debs pa'i zhabs rjes gsum// mi 'bral rten gyi skal bar 'bul// ji ltar gsungs shing dam bcas pa'i// rtag tu dam par bzhugs par zhu// mi tshe chos la skyel bar zhu// mtha' sgab bzang po mdzad par zhu// bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par zhu// rdzogs so//

// 145) ༄// dge slong blo gros rin chen dang dge bshes rgon chen pa gnyis la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs kyi ze'u 'brur gtsug gis 'dud// 'jig rten mgon po de nyid kyi// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// shākya'i dge slong ri khrod pas// rang gi rigs las skyes pa yi// bu la gdams pa'i man ngag 'bri// gting mtha' med par 'khor ba yi// rgya mtsho mu mtha' med pa la// 'jigs shing skrag pa'i bsam pa yis// ston pa'i bstan la rab tu byung*// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs dka' thub spyad// yun ring mi sdod
