'chi ba dang*// ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*// 'gro la phan pa sgrub pa dang*// gong ma'i gdung rgyud 'tshob pa dang*// tshul khrims sbyangs pa'i yon tan la// pad mo la ni chu bzhin du// ltem rkyang med par nan tan mdzod// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa la// mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung zhing*// nga tsam med pa'i nga rgyal dang*// rlom sems dug sdong 'phel na ko /mtho ris thar pa'i srog gcod pa// bdag 'dzin mnga' thang rgyas pa yi// tshul 'chos des ko ci bya ste// nyon mongs gsum gyi rjes 'brangs pa'i// lus kyi las dang ngag gi las// yid kyi las dang gsum spangs pas// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// lhun gyis grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin// rtsol sgrub med par skye ba 'di// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa las// lhag pa ting 'dzin bslab pa 'di// skye bar bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' dag dang*// bka' brgyud grub thob gong ma yi// gdams ngag yin no thugs la zhog /sems dul spros pa zhi ba yi// lhan skyes sems nyid rin po che// bde gsal mi rtog nyams myong gi /nyes pa'i sprin dang ma bral na// gnyis med ye shes nyi ma yi// dkyil 'khor snang bar mi nus pas// gnyug ma rang sems bsgom pa dang*// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus kyis// 'gyur med lhan skyes ye shes 'di// gsal bar mdzod cig dge ba'i bshes// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// sgrub pa byas ba'i 'bras bu de// rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa grub// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa yi// sems can rnams la smin gyur cig

/thugs bskyed rgyu las byung ba yi// phun tshogs 'bras bu ngo mtshar che// khyed kyi bslab gsum rin chen la// rgyal bas smin par mdzad pa'i sras// las can mang po tshogs pa la// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi /rjes su 'brangs pa'i nye gnas dang*// bu slob sde pa yon bdag gi /mi chos 'dun ma zab mo yi// kye kye rjes su ma 'brang bar// rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang*// kha lan khur sha yod pa dang*// dma' ba sprang po yin kyang rung*// skyes dang gnas dang mdzes pa yi// bar chad gsum dang bral pa rnams// thabs dang shes rab zab mo yi// khyed kyis rab tu 'byung ba dang*// las can smin par mdzad par rigs// ma brtags cal col mtho dman rnams// bla ma'i rnam thar yin snyam nas// khyi gzhug bcad pa'i rab byung gis// rang nyid ngan sar ltung ba dang*// thub pa'i bstan la gnod pa dang*// tha mal 'jig rten ma dad na// tha mal 'jig rten smin pa'i thabs// ji ltar 'ong ba legs par som// 'jig rten kha na ma tho ba// de phyir khyed kyis bsrung bar bya// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dge ba dus gsum bsags pa rnams// sems can kun la btang ba dang*// de bsrung dag dang spel ba'i thabs// khyed rang nyid kyis dpag med bshad// 'on kyang da res phyag len mdzad// sbrang mas 'bad de rtsi bsags kyang*// sbrang rtsi gzhan gyis spyod par zad// bu lon skyed 'phel thabs rnams kyis// ka ca mang po bsags na yang*// gsog mkhan gces su nye gnas kyi// sha chang kha las mi phyid pas// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yis// rten cing 'brel pa ma 'chugs par// khyed kyis sbyin pa ran par gtang*// de ltar bdag gis sbyin pa 'dis// gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*// bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen sdom pa dang*// dge slong dge tshul sdom pa dang*// theg chen byang chub sems dang yang*// gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa// ji ltar bdag gis 'khod gyur cig

/las su bsags pa yang yang bgrang*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam bzhi yis// sems can smin pa ma gtogs pa// gzhan gyi byang chub sangs rgyas pa// thos sam mthong ngam rnal 'byor pa// bslab pa gsum sogs bya lugs 'di// mi chos yin nam lha dam zhes// khyod kyi thugs la skyes gyur na// ci bya rang gi sems la dris// tshe 'di 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis// nga bzang khyod bzang 'dod na de// 'jig rten 'di pa kho nar zad// rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// thar bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis// dge ba dpag med byas pa yis// nyan thos rang rgyal ma gtogs pa// rgyu 'bras log par 'gyur mi srid// byang sems g.yo sgyu med pa yis// byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// de las gzhan du mi srid pa// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med par nges// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// spros med sems kyi ngo bor gcig /gzung dang 'dzin pa med gyur pa// nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i dpes// byed med rtsol ba mi mnga' yang*// sngon gyi thugs rje'i smon lam gyi// mkha' la nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can gyi// mi shes mun pa sel ba 'di// chos kyi sku yi yon tan dang*// phrin las yin zhes gsungs pa de// kun rdzob don dam mtha' gnyis su// myong ba med pa'i mkhas pa rnams// tshu rol mthong ba'i skye bo yis// tshu rol mthong ba rnams la bshad// chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa// gnyis med rtogs pa rnams kyis go /mdor na rgyu lam 'bras bu'i tshul// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// ji ltar bshad pa de bzhin du// lhag bsam g.yo sgyu med pa yis// nyin mtshan med par nyams su blangs// khyed kyis 'gro ba smin pa dang*// grol bar mdzad pa'i brtul zhugs spyad// dge slong blo gros rin chen dang*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam gnyis kyis// yang yang gsol ba btab nas bris// de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi// 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog
/rdzogs so// yig rten du phyag phreng gcig dang*// dbu zhu gcig /a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba gcig dang gsum 'bul zhing mchis// //

146) ༄// nged spun la byin gyis rlobs zhes pa bkra shis seng ge'i zhu chos// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// 'phongs na thugs rjes mi gtong ba// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs la thogs// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'jig rten zang zing sna tshogs kyis// lus sems dub cing skyo ba skyes// gsol ba 'debs so thugs la thogs// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lnga brgya'i dus kyi sems can la// phan btags lan tu gnod pa skyel// gsol ba 'debs so thugs la thogs// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// nyon mongs rnam rtog rjes 'brangs pa'i// 'jig rten las dang bya byed kyis// rang gzhan don rnams mi 'grub pas// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'jig rten spros pa bcad nas kyang*// gong ma rnams kyis rjes 'brangs te// ri khrod dgon par mchi bar zhu// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// cis kyang thugs la 'dogs par zhu// gsol 'debs zhu 'bul yig rten du// chab dar dmar po yugs gcig 'bul// nged spun la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// // 147) ༄// dga' bde skyid pa'i dam chos bkra shis seng ge'i zhus lan// oṃ swasti/ skyob pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun zhes// gsungs pas rang gi bla ma la// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes byed cing*// bzod pa'i brtul bzhugs go bgos nas// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// ston pa'i rjes su slob byed cing*// rang gi srog la mi blta ba// khyod kyis zhus pa'i zhu tshig rnams// shin tu bden zhing yus lags te// nged kyi pa pha bcom ldan 'das// sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal po 'dis// snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rnams// phan btags lan du gnod skyel zhing*// bzang byas lan du ngan rnams byed// dmu rgod mi bsrun gdug pa can// gdul bar dka' ba'i nyes dus 'di// dran pas thugs rjes ma bzod de// keng shu'i 'dab ltar snying 'dar zhing*// gdong la mchi ma'i rgyun 'dzag pas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// dpang du bzhag nas smon lam btab// deng sang dus 'dir sangs rgyas pa// ston pa de yi rgyal sras rnams// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// mgu bar dka' zhes bstod pa yis// legs par bstod pa rgyal ba'i sras// rkyen ngan nyes spyod de tshod kyis// zhum zhing yi mug skyes gyur na// ston pa'i sras su ji ltar 'gyur// pha la bu skyes rdzun po yin// gnyis med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// sus smras sus thos gang gis gang*// sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// tshe gcig mchog gi sangs rgya ba// mtho dman bag chags sna tshogs kun// gsang sngags sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yis// ngo mtshar ltad mo blta ba ni// lnga brgya'i dus kyi ngan can yin// rgyal sras yab kyi pha phogs spyod// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// rdo rje gdan dang dpal gyi ri// u rgyan ri bo ta la dang*// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod dang*// mngon dga'i zhing dang bde ba can// e ma bzod pa'i yul 'di dang*// sbyin dang tshul khrims brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab rdzogs pa'i yul// 'di 'dra gang du rnyed pa 'gyur// legs par soms dang pha yi bu// thog med dus nas da yi bar// bkur bsti zhabs 'bring zhabs tog dang*// snyan tshig me tog phreng ba yis// bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgyal po 'di// mnyes su re nas 'bad na yang*// 'bad pas co ga'i 'gyur bzhin du// phyi phyir je thu je thur song*// da res mya ngan 'das pa'i gtso// rang sems rang byung bcom ldan 'das// bag chags dri ma sbyong byed pa// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyan thogs nas// mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs// rgyal po rgyan dang gdan bcas pa// thub pa chen po'i brtul zhugs kyis// dus 'dir mnyes par mi byed re// swo re dga' re skyid nga re dga'// bdag 'dzin spangs pa'i mi re skyid// srog la mi blta ba 'di bde// so nam chos la byed pa skyid// dga' bde skyid pa'i dam chos 'di// pha bzang bu yi zhe gdengs yin// bu mos gus can gyi thugs la zhog

/bkra shis seng ges zhus pa'i lan rdzogs so// // 148) ༄// thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa bstan pa rgyas byed ces pa// ston pas thams cad mkhyen pa mnyes pa'i gnas// ma ga dha dang byang chub shing drung dang*// nye bar gyur pa rgyal bas lung bstan pa// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi gnas gnyis po// bsags pa'i las can skyes bu ya rab rnams// rdzas dang yo byad gsog la mi dga' ste// dam pa rnams la bkur bstis bkur gyur pas// dam pa bsod snyoms dag gis brel ba med// rgya mtsho chen po lan tshwa'i ro gcig ltar// kun kyang log par lta bas ma gos te// thams cad dkon mchog mchod pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin// nyams len byed la bsod snyoms brel ba med// rang nyid za dang brgyan par mi nus shing*// bu dang chung ma dag la'ang de lta min// bslab gsum brtul zhugs rgyan gyis mdzes pa la// bkur bsti byed pas bsod snyoms brel ba med// gangs ri'i rtse la nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du// thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la// de dang mthun pa'i bkur bstis mchod gyur pas// yon tan ldan pa bsod snyoms kyis mi brel// sngon gyi dus na ston pas rgyud sbyangs pas// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po'i rten 'brel mkhas// shes rab zab mo blo gros bzang po yis// zhing la mkhas pas bsod snyoms brel ba med// ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bu// legs par bskyangs pas rgyal por gyur pa bzhin// ston pa'i sras rnams legs par bskyangs gyur pas// chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas nyid la 'god// rgyal ba sras kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas te// yon bdag gzugs kyis thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin// dpag med yon tan can dang mi 'bral zhing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog/ // 149) ༄// sku gzugs 'bri bar thub pa'i bka' bzhin tshad dang ldan dgos pa// oṃ swasti/

dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// chos sku bde ba chen po ni// sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan pa// rnam par smin pa'i yon tan yin// bral ba'i yon tan mtshon pa ni// stobs bcu glang po che yi gdan// seng ge mi 'jigs bzhi yin te// chags pa med pa padma'i gdan// thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan// tshad med thugs rje ri dwags yin// chu srin ma 'dres mtshon pa yin// bya khyung srung ba med par bshad// ston pa'i yon tan 'di dag la// 'jig rten phal ba'i kha skad du// rgyan sna bzhi zhes yongs su grags// gang zhig 'di dang mi ldan pa'i// thub pa'i sku gzugs 'bri ba ni// yon tan med pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam// de yi phyir na thub pa yi// gang gis sku gzugs 'bri ba yis// bkur bsti phun sum tshogs pa yis// thub pas gsungs pa'i bka' bzhin du// tshad dang rgyan dang ldan par bya// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad du// yon tan phun sum tshogs par 'gyur// rdzogs so// // 150) ༄// skyabs 'gro dang so thar byang sems bcas kyi sdom pa 'bog chog dang bslab bya// na mo ratna gu ru/ rgyal ba rnams kyi bstan pa kun gyi babs// 'gro ba'i bde skyid sgrub pa'i rten 'brel mchog /skyes bu rnams kyi bsam pa rmad byung ba// sdom pa rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa don du gnyer ba'i skyes bu dag gis/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa blang bar 'dod na/ ngan song dang 'khor ba me'i 'obs bzhin du bsams la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa dang ldan pa stan mthon po la bzhugs/ dkon mchog la mchod pa bshams/ bla ma la yon phul/ thal mo sbyar/ tsog pur bsdad nas rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog

chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum gyi bar du bya'o// skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ dpag tu med kyang mdor bsdus na brgyad de/ nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud pa'i phan yon dang*/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad zad cing bsrab par 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po 'phel ba dang*/ shi nas ngan song dang ngan 'gror mi 'gro ba'i phan yon dang*/ lam khyad par du 'phags pa rgyud la skye ba'i phan yon dang*/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phan yon dang rnam pa brgyad do// phan yon de rnams thob pa la bslab bya 'di rnams la slob dgos te/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas lha gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal/ chos la skyabs su song bas sems can la 'tshe ba spang*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas mi mu stegs can mi bsten pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten tshad dang ldan pa yan chad la gus pa bsgrub pa dang*/ srog dang bya dga'i ched du yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa mi gtong ba dang*/ dgos ched khyad par can byung na yang thabs gzhan mi btsal ba dang*/ dus dang dus kyi mchod pa la bslab pa dang*/ phyogs gar 'gro ba de'i lha la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ spel zhing sbyang ba la bslab pa'o// ༈ //bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa ni/ dkon mchog gi rten la phyag dang mchod pa byas nas/ nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa brtan pos/ byang chub kyi sems yang dang yang du gsos btab nas skyes pa'i dus su/ ba 'jo ba'i tshul du bsdad nas rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog

/chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ slob dpon gyis bsnyen gnas su bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon gyis thabs yin no// slob mas legs so bya/ sdom pa'i rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyid do// yan lag dang po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// gzhan yang sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ma byin pa len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang bcos pa'i chang*/ bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu gar dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ rgyan kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan chen po dang*/ mal stan mthon po dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spangs te/ phyi dro'i kha zas las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong tshes brgyad la/ ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ brdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu dang gar dang*/ rol mo dang*/ rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan chen po dang*/ mal stan mthon po dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spangs te phyi dro'i kha zas las slar ldog par bgyi'o// yan lag brgyad po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// thabs yin no// legs so// phan yon ni de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid yon tan gyi bstan pa la/

bram ze'i khye'u gnyis kyis bsrungs pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis gnod sbyin lnga la rang gi sha byin nas/ khyed kyis nga la dga' bar shes gyis nas// srog gcod dug bzhin rnam par spang bar gyis// gzhan gyi chung ma dag la bsten pa dang*// gzhan gyi yo byad dag la brlam pa dang*// ku re'i ched du rdzun du smra ba spongs// chang gi btung ba phyi dro'i kha zas rnams// nya stong dus bzhi la ni rtag tu srungs// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar byas pas lnga sde bzang por gyur pa dang*/ byams pa lung bstan pa nyid las/ bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang*// de bzhin zla phyed tshes brgyad dang*// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad bsrung na// nga yi bstan pa lhags par 'gyur// ces pa la sogs pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyang rgya cher bshad par bya'o// ༈ //dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa ni/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen nam/ yongs rdzogs sam/ sna gcig bsrung ba'am/ sna 'ga' bsrung ba'i dge snyen gyi sdom pa gang len kyang*/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par byas nas so so'i rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ slob dpon gyis so so gang gang len pa'i dge bsnyen de dang der gzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum bya/ thabs yin no// legs so bya/ de nas bslab bya brjod pa ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyid do// yan lag dang po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// gzhan yang 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang*/ bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ ma byin pa len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang dang*/ bag med pa'i gnas spang te/ bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog par bgyid do// yan lag lnga po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// thabs yin no// legs so bya/ yongs rdzogs dang sna gcig bsrung ba dang*/ sna 'ga' bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen ni/ so so gang bsrung ba de rjes zlos bya ba'o// phan yon ni/ dge bsnyen chen po li tsā byi dri ma med par grags pas/ jo bo byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs la sogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi 'khor dge slong dge 'dun dang bcas pa zil gyi mnan pa dang*/ slob dpon tsan tra go mi dang*/ dge bshes ston pa la sogs pa ste/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gsha' ma shig yod na btsun po'i go yang des chod/ mtho ris dang thar pa yang des thob gsung ngo*// ༈ //byang chub kyi sems rin po che ni/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi bde skyid zad pa med pa'i gter chen po yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed par bya ste/ de skye bar byed pa'i rgyu ni bzhi ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can byas pa dang*/

tshad med pa bzhis blo sbyangs pa dang*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed pa dang bzhi las smon pa skye bar bzhed la/ de yang jo bos rgyu dang po las skye bar bzhed pas/ kun bzang spyod las gsungs pa yi// mchod pa rnam bdun dag kyang bya// zhes pa'i don bsgoms nas/ stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bsngo ba byas nas slob ma'i blo bcos par bya ste/ 'jig rten 'dir yun ring po mi sdod/ 'chi dgos/ 'chi ba'i rkyen du ma gyur pa ni gang yang med/ shi nas med par mi 'gro/ nyon mongs dug gsum gyis mi dge ba bcu spyad na ngan song gsum du skye/ dge ba bcu la brten nas lha dang mir skyes kyang*/ brel phongs dang ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pas/ rigs drug gar skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin/ de yang rang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa ltar sems can thams cad kyis a ma ma byas pa med pa la/ ma 'di rnams kyang sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*/ sdug bsngal ba 'di rnams thar pa'i thabs sangs rgyas min pa gzhan med/ sangs rgya ba la sems bskyed dgos pa yin byas pa la blo bcos so// de nas bla ma de sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa bsam/ sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bzhag nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs rin po che bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ me tog 'thor/ sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes gsha' mar bzhag

bar 'dir yan lag bdun pa rdzogs par byas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas la ston par bya/ theg pa chen po'i chos la lam du bya/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la lam gyi grogs bya snyam du sems la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i khyad par can gyi rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog don dam pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum bya/ me tog 'thor/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bzhag phan yon ni/ khyad par gyi skyabs su 'gro ba byas nas/ theg pa chen po par tshud pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'i rten du gyur pa dang*/ skyes bu khyad par can de lha dang bcas pa'i mchod pa'i gnas su gyur cing*/ rang nyid tshogs gsog pa dang*/ sdig pa zad pa dang*/ myur du byang chub thob pa lta a cang ches te/ gzhan yang tshogs gsog pa dang*/ sdig pa zad pa dang*/ ngan song las skyob pa dang*/ myur du byang chub thob par byed pa'i phan yon no// bslab bya ni thun mong ba dang mthun no// thun mong ba'i yul gsum ni/ chos sku las dang nyon mongs pa dang bral tsam gyi 'gog pa'i bden pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis sangs rgyas pa'i ston pa/ sprul pa'i sku stag dang ri bong la sogs/ chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ dge 'dun gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong yan chad/ skyes bu zung bzhi dang*/ khyad par ba'i yul gsum ni/ sangs rgyas chos sku 'ba' zhig la 'dod pa la/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig ste// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir// tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug yin// zhes pas so// chos ni rtogs pa'i chos so// dge 'dun dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun/

dus snying po byang chub kyi bar ro// ched du bya ba sems can gyi don du skyabs su 'gro ba'o// 'dir sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes lan gsum bya'o// tshad med pa bzhi la blo sbyang ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can 'di rnams ma yin ang snyam du bsgom/ 'o na ma 'di rnams kyis ngan skyugs thams cad ni kha yis phyags/ gsher ba ni bor/ skam pa ni blangs/ rgya mtsho tsam gyi nu zho ni bsnun/ ri rab tsam gyi bza' rgyu ni byin/ lho sprin tsam gyi gos ni bskon pa'i ma 'di rnams drin re che ang snyam du bsam/ da 'o na drin la lan gyis slan dgos snyam du bsam/ ga re ma 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan na dga' ba la/ rigs drug na sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las med pas/ snying re rje ang snyam du bsam/ 'o na ma 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i don du/ sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du bsams la/ yang bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes lan gsum bya'o// gong gi rten sprul pa dang bla ma la mchod pa bdun po rdzogs par bya'o// zhabs la dngos sam yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ slob dpon gyis bdag byang chub sems dpar bzung du gsol/ lan gsum bya zhing me tog 'thor ro// yang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i don du sems bskyed blang snyam du dung nge bsam nas/ rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/

sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs rin po che bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ ma grol ba rnams bsgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya'o// me tog 'thor/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dung dung pa lan gsum bya'o// de nas yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig rdzogs par bya'o// sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag la dga' ston gyis tshim par bya'o// phan yon dang bslab bya ni/ sems bskyed pa ni sa gzhi dang 'dra ste/ sa gzhi ni rin po che'i 'byung khungs lo thog la sogs pa 'bras bu thams cad bskyed pa dang 'dra bar/ yon tan rin po che thams cad bskyed par byed pa'o// nor bu rin po che dang 'dra ste/ dri ma rnam pa gsum phyis nas dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas phyag byas/ smon lam rnam par dag pa'i gsol ba btab na/ yid la ci bsam pa thams cad 'grub bo// thong gshol dang 'dra ste/ sems tha rgod lta bu 'di zhi ba dang 'bol bar byed do// nyi ma dang 'dra ste/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel zhing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad gsal bar byed do// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ste/ bkres pa dang skom pa sel lo// ljon shing dang 'dra ste/ 'khor ba'i tshad pa thams cad sel bar byed do// dmag dpon dang 'dra ste/ theg pa dman pa la sogs pa'i g.yul ngo thams cad sel bar byed do// zam pa dang 'dra ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i gling du phyin par byed do// bslab bya lnga ni/

bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsag par bya ba la bslab pa dang*/ phan yon yang dang yang du dran pa bya ba la bslab par dang*/ sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems spel zhing sbyang ba la bslab pa dang*/ nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab pa bya'o// de la dang po ni sems bskyed byas nas/ btang snyoms sam rang don tsam du skad cig tsam yang sdod du ma gnang zhing*/ tshegs chung ngu tsam gyis kyang chog par ma gsungs te/ rgyal bu thams cad sgrol bzhin bya ba sbyin pa/ nyes byas phra ba yan chad rtsa ba bzhi man chad mi dor bar tshul khrims/ dman pa la mi khro khyad du mi gsod pa ni bzod pa/ sems can gyi don du 'gyur tshad byed pa brtson 'grus/ zhi gnas kyi tshogs sgrub pa bsam gtan/ rig pa'i gnas lnga spyod pa shes rab ste de drug dang*/ mdza' bshes bsten pa dang*/ tshad med pa bsgom pa la sogs pa yengs pa med par byed dgos te/ mgo la sems can khur chen 'khyer ba yi// sems dpa' mchog rnams dal gyis 'gro mi mdzes// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa spyod 'jug las/ dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol gyur pa// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi bsten// zhes pa dang*/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di bsgyur nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas nas// byang chub sems zhes bya ba legs brtan bzung*// zhes pa'i don dang*/ byang chub kyi sems ma skyes na/ sha zas btab pa bzhin du/ nyon mongs pas rang yang smyo zhing gzhan yang bsreg pa la/ sems de skyes na/ rang yang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la gnas shing*/ gzhan yang de la 'jog pa la sogs pa'o// gsum pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khur 'khur bar khas blangs pas/ lus longs spyod pa la ltos pa med par gzhan rjes su gzung dgos te/

bu gcig pa'i ma'i skra 'bal yang*/ bus lto'i ri ni nus zer ba dang 'dra/ blo spangs na byang chub kyi sems kyang 'chor/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyang mi dgyes te/ sems can mgu bya ma gtogs pa// rgyal ba mnyes pa'i thabs gzhan med// ces pa dang*/ nga dang sems can rnams ni bde sdug mtshungs pas na/ nga'i gzugs sku gnyis po sems can du bsgrub pa ste/ sems can gnod na nga la mchod pa byas pa ma yin/ zhes pa dang*/ jo bo rjes sems can blos mi spong nus na/ sdom pa dang bslab pa thams cad mi thub med/ myur du byang chub kyang thob gsungs/ sems can blos spangs pa'i tshad zhus pas/ ngan pa 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du mi 'phrad dgos snyam pa yin gsung*/ dus nyin zhag cig gi drug cha yin gsungs/ bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la// byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum dus drug bya/ spel zhing sbyang ba ma byas na/ bsam pa bzang po ni mun rum gyi glog pas nyung*/ nyon mongs dang zhe sdang ni rags/ sems bskyed pa ni dus de ring tsam yin gsungs so// nag po'i chos bzhi spang*/ dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab pa ni/ bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa bslu ba ni nag po'i chos yin pa la/ mi bslu ba'i steng du tshigs su bcad pa gcig yan chad kyis/ bla ma la blo lhan gyis gtad cing nga ci shes khyod de shes su bya'o// gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa skyed na nag po'i chos yin pa la/ mi bskyed pa la bslab par bya ba ni/ rang ngam gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ba las 'gyod pa skyer mi 'jug pa ste/ gang zhig dge ba spyod mthong na// 'phya zhing bskur te ma mos na// dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs kyang gcod// ces pa dang*/

gang gis dge ba byed pa la// phrag dog dbang gis bskur btab na// mtshams med byas pas dmyal bar 'gro// zhes pas so// sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ zhe sdang gi sgo nas tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa mi brjod pa dang bslab par bya ba ni/ zhing de la gzhi zhe sdang gi sgo nas nyes pa mang po brjod na/ skad cig ma re res kyang dmyal bar 'gro dgos te/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi// sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs// legs spyad de kun gang yin yang*// khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed// ces pa dang*/ yul byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang na dmyal ba'i bud shing dngos yin/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gang yin cha med/ 'o skol ni smra ba la dga'/ thur du 'gro ba'i rgyu mi gsag mi'i nyes skyon thams cad mig bzhin du ni mi bsrung gsungs/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa mi brjod kyi steng du yang yon tan phyogs bcur bsgrags par bya'o// sems can la g.yo dang sgyur brid na nag po'i chos yin pas de spang zhing drang po'i chos kyis 'tsho bar bya'o// drang po'i chos kyis 'jig rten kun tu bde// g.yo sgyu gya gyus mdza' bshes sun par byed// phrad na lha 'dra 'grogs na sha za 'dra// g.yo dang sgyus ni srid pa gsum yang phung*// zhes so// bslab bya bshad pa thal nas dpon slob thams cad kyis yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig bya/ jo bo'i lugs kyis bsngo ba bya'o// shi kha ma la sogs pas rgyas par len mi nus pas/ me tog la sogs pa mchod pa grub tshad byas nas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba slob dpon gyis byang chub sems dpar bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum bya/ slob dpon gyis sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar soms shig byas la rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/

sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la lan gsum bya'o// shin tu bsdus par len na/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam du yang nas yang du soms shig bya'o// yon tan rgya mtsho'i sangs rgyas kyang*// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yi// bsam pa rnam dag de dag dang*// med na mi 'byung 'brel pa 'o// //

151) ༄// gshin po dang gson po'i bsngo ba mu tig phreng mdzes zhes bya ba// bsngo ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ bsag sbyang rnam pa gnyis dgos la/ tshogs gsog pa la zhing dang dngos po dang bsam pa gsum rnam par dag pa dgos/ de la zhing ni dkon mchog gsum dag la/ de la yang longs spyad pa dang phul ba'i bsod nams yod pas dge 'dun zhing dag pa ni/ zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// dge slong zhing dag pas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen sgron/ 'bar ba'i snod ni ngur smrig can// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa shākya'i sras// dge slong rnams ni yin phyir ro// zhes so// byang chub sems bskyed pa zhing dag ste/ gang la sems kyi dam pa rin po che// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba'i// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes so// kun rdzob tu chos thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu/ don dam par nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsgoms pas zhing dag ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzims mal dga' dang bde// btung bar ting nge 'dzin te bshos su bsam gtan mchog /stong nyid dgon par bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// sngags dang mtshan nyid thams cad nas/ lam nyams su len pa thams cad kyi bla ma zhing dag ste/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ bskal pa dus gsum thams cad du// dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang*// srog chags bye ba'i tshe skyabs pas// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas mi thob ste// yon tan rgya mtsho'i bla ma la// dang ba'i yid kyis mnyes byas na// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ni// tshe 'di yis ni thob par nges// zhes pa la sogs pa'o// dngos po brkus pa dang 'phrogs pa ma yin/ dug dang mtshon dang ma 'dres pa'o// bsam pa ni tshe 'di'i bsam pas bslang nas byas na ma dag ste/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// zhes pas so// 'jig rten pha rol gyi bsam pa yod kyang*/

'khor los bsgyur pa'i bde rgyas/ tshangs pa rgya byin lha dang mi'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'dod na bsam pa ma dag bsam pa dag kyang shin tu rnam par ma dag pa/ nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kyi bsam pa rang zhi bde 'dod na ma dag pas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi don du/ bla na med par yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o// ma bsngos na 'dzad pa'i rgyu/ log lta skyes pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang gis tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjod pa dang*/ 'gyod pa skyes nas 'dzad pa'o// khyad par du gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rgyu ni/ dkon mchog dang*/ bla ma'i drung du bsngos pa dang*/ byang chub kyi thugs mnga' ba'i drung du bsngos na 'phel ba'o// zhes pa la sogs pa yon bshad kyis spro zhing*/ byang chub tu bsngo bar byas nas/ bdag gis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig snyam du dung nge bsams nas/ rjes zlos bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma med pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ jo bo lha dkon mchog gsum mchod pa dang*/ 'byung po la gtor ma btang ba dang*/ long sprang la yon byin pa dang*/ bla ma dge 'dun la zhabs tog bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi rgyan/ sems kyi yo byad/ rnal 'byor gyi tshogs/ don gyi mchog des/ pha dang ma dang mkhan po dang slob dpon thog mar byas pa'i/ mtha' yas pa'i sems cad thams cad kyi don du/

bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig de ma thob kyi bar du yang*/ mi'i lus rin po che thob nas/ tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ tshe ring ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur cig nad med pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur cig longs spyod che ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur cig btsan 'jing gnyen che ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur cig yid du 'ong ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur cig gzugs mdzes pa rnams kyi mchog tu gyur cig tha mal pa'i bsngo ba'o// ༈ //sgom chen pa'i bsngo ba ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des 'dod chags kyi bsam pa mi 'byung bar gyur cig zhe sdang gi bsam pa mi 'byung bar gyur cig nga rgyal dang phrag dog rnyed pa dang bkur bsti/ grags pa dang snyan pa/ tshe 'di'i bsam pa mi 'ong bar/ byams pa dang snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud brlan nas/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur nas/ bdag tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur cig dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ nam 'chi ba'i tshe/ gnad gcod pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'ong*/ shis ngan du 'chi ba mi 'byung*/ dus ma yin par 'chi bar mi 'ong bar/ 'chi ba la dga' ba dang*/ bde ba dang bcas nas/ sems nyid shin tu gsal ba dang*/ chos nyid shin tu gsal ba dang 'grogs nas/ 'chi kha dang bar dor cis kyang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur cig/ ༈ //gshin po'i bsngo ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tshe 'das pa la dgongs su gsol/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams tshe 'das pa la dgongs su gsol/ tshe 'das shing lus brjes pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du/ sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ bsgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal pa dang*/

gzhan bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bdag cag nye du gnyen 'brel shul na 'dug pa rnams kyis/ tshe 'das shing lus brjes pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i don du lha dkon mchog gsum mchod pa dang*/ 'byung po la gtor ma btang ba dang*/ long sprang la yon byin pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i bka' bsgrags pa dang*/ dge 'dun la chos ston drangs pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen bkur byas pa dang*/ tsha tsha btab pa dang*/ chu gtor btang ba dang*/ yul mi nye ring rnams la ston mo rgya chen po drangs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ tshe 'das shing lus brjes pa ming 'di zhes bya ba/ 'gro ba rigs drug gang dang du skyes kyang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dang de'i rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su zhugs par gyur cig rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su zhugs nas tshe 'das shing lus brjes pa 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces lan gsum bya/ dge 'dun rnams kyis/ de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig lan gsum bya'o// mu tig phreng mdzes lta bu las/ bdag nyid blo gros dman pas bsdus pa las// nor dang 'khrul par gyur pa ci mchis par// rje btsun mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// rgyal sras rnams kyi bsam pa rin po che// skye ba'i rim pa mu tig phreng ba ni// zab cing rgya che rgya mtsho cher zhugs nas// dbang gi rgyal po don dam byang chub sems// bde ba'i 'byung gnas gter chen mi zad pa// rang byung dri ma med pa'i sems nyid ni// chos rje klu yi rgyal po sbyin par nges// rdzogs so// // 152) ༄// bsnyen gnas dang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bog chog shes rab ye shes la gnang ba// 'das dang ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu yi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi// lam mchog sdom pa rin chen de nyid la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi'o// bla ma yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan don dang mthun/

'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi zhes grags pa'i spyan sngar/ ku re dang kyal ka med par/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ snying gtam lo rgyus su zhu ba/ spyir khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po/ gting mtha' med par lhung ba'i sems can rang gi ma yin nges pa 'di rnams la/ skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen ni zhe thag pa nas med nges pa yin pa la/ 'di dag thams cad skyob par byed pa'i mgon po/ sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab cing dpag tu med pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi mthu chen po dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi gnas dang mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa/ khyed lta bus sems can gyi don ma mdzad na/ sems can la mgon skyabs med pas/ 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ de la don mdzad pa'i tshul lugs ni/ da ltar 'dzam bu'i gling rin po sna tshogs kyis bkang nas/ sems can 'ga' zhig la byin yang 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur 'gyur ba las/ thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dka'/ skyabs su 'gro ba'am sdom pa sna gcig tsam la bzhag na yang*/ theg pa gsum gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas pa la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung rab dpag tu med par gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang dmyal ba dang*/sa yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro'i 'jig rten stong par byed pa dang*/ lha dang mi'i go 'phang thob par byed pa dang*/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par byed pa po skyabs su 'gro ba dang sdom pa ma gtogs pa gzhan med/ de la sdom pa'i dbang du bgyis pas/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ni dbang bskur ba'i bla ma las thob/ byang chub sems pa'i bslab pa ni sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' las thob/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni so sor thar pa dang ldan pa de las thob pa las/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'i dbang du bgyis pas/

sngon rgyal po byams pa'i stobs zhes bya ba rgyal po'i srid la mnga' mdzad cing*/ 'khor dang btsun mo'i tshogs phal po che dang ldan pa des/ gnod sbyin lnga la rang gi sha dang khrag gis tshim par byas shing bslab pa'i gzhi lnga phog pas/ da ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi lnga sde bzang po yin par gsungs pa la sogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung rab dpag tu med par khyim pa rnams kyis kyang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog par gsungs pa dang*/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'dul ba lung nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin bu dang chung ma'i tshogs dang ldan pa'i des bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phog pa'i rkyen gyis phyi dro'i kha zas shor ba'i sdom pa nub cig bsrungs pas/ lha'i bu gso sbyongs ral du skyes par gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid yon tan gyi bstan pa la/ mi'i rgyal po gcig gis bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa bris nas klu'i rgyal po gcig la byin par/ klu rnams kyis bsrungs pas mi'i rgyal po dang klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa lha'i gnas su skyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'bras bu thob par byas pa la sogs pa gsungs na/ khyed lta bu byang chub sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug gis sems can thams cad smin par mdzad pa/ sgos tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa dang*/ bslab pa'i gzhi rnam pa lnga la 'god pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ gnad ka dang rgyu mtshan des na bdag nyid chen po khyed kyi bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa dang*/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la sems can dpag tu med pa 'god par zhu/ de yang 'di ltar bya ste/ stan mthon po'i steng du dkyil mo krung legs par bca' ba la sogs par byas nas/ bla ma rin po che'i lugs kyis/ ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/

myur du bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung ste nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ de'i ched du dge bsnyen nam bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa blangs la bsrung snyam du bsam pa sa gzhi dang 'dra ba sngon du song ba 'dis/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar ma shi'i tshe/ dus de ring nas bzung ste nyi ma sang da tsam tshun chad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dang*/ byed pa lung du ma bstan pa thams cad dge bar 'gyur la/ bsnyen gnas dang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la sogs pa dge ba thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur te/ de yang 'phags pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ g.yo dang sgyus sam/ ku re dang kyal kas byang chub tu sems bskyed na yang*/ byang chub tu sangs rgya bar gsungs na/ thabs la mkhas pas sangs ma rgyas kyi bar tshun chad kyi lung du ma bstan pa thams cad ni dge bar 'gyur la/ dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur nges pa 'di shin tu yang ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung bar 'dug pas/ dpon slob gnyis kas 'di ltar ngag tu brjod cing sems bskyed nas/ skad cig gis rang nyid rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu bsams nas/ rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad dbyangs kyi tshig gis go bar byas shing*/ so sor chos gang ston par byas shing*/ so so'i chos gang ston par byed pa de'i rigs can rnams la de nyid dam/ yang na gdul bya tha dad skad tha dad pas/ chos tha dad pa gang la gang 'dul ba de dang der thos pas/ lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad// grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji snyed pa// de snyed skad du bdag gis chos bstan to// zhes pa dang*/

yang*/ gsung gcig tu ni gsungs mod kyang*// du ma nyid du so sor go /zhes pa ltar go bar byas shing byin gyis brlabs nas sdom pa 'bog par bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog /'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// slob dpon gyis bdag bsnyen gnas su bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du rjes zlos bya/ tha mar slob dpon gyis/ thabs yin no// slob mas/ legs so zhes brjod/ bsnyen gnas gyi sdom pa thob nas/ bslab bya rjes zlos bya ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong la srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong la srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o// yan lag dang po 'dis/ bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// gzhan yang sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong la ma byin len par dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang*/ bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu gar dang*/ rol mo dang*/ rgyan kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan chen po dang*/ mal stan mthon po dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spangs te/ phyi dro'i kha zas las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya dang gnam stong la ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/

rdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang bag med pa'i gnas dang*/ glu gar dang*/ rol mo dang*/ rgyan kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan chen po dang*/ mal stan mthon po dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spangs te/ phyi dro'i kha zas las slar ldog par bgyi'o// yan lag brgyad po 'dis/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// slob dpon gyis/ thabs yin no// slob mas/ legs so// zhes brjod/ de rnams kyi bslab bya ni bslab pa brjod pa de nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o// ༈ //da dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// slob dpon gyis bdag tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyi bar du bya/ slob dpon gyis/ thabs yin no// slob mas/ legs so// zhes brjod do// dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob nas bslab pa brjod pa ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o// yan lag dang po 'dis/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// gzhan yang 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba dang*/

'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang*/ bag med pa'i gnas las slar log pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ brdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang bcos pa'i chang*/ bag med pa'i gnas spang ste/ bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog par bgyi'o// yan lag lnga po 'dis/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su bsgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// slob dpon gyis/ thabs yin no// slob mas/ legs so// zhes brjod do// yang 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang*/ log par lta ba spang te/ log par lta ba las slar log par bgyid do// zhes pa ni phal che ba la dgongs nas lag len du byas pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'o// tshul de dang 'dra bar yongs rdzogs kyi dge bsnyen dang*/ sna 'ga' bsrung ba dang*/ sna gcig bsrung ba la yang sbyar bar bya'o// mdor na ston pa sangs rgyas kyi// dam chos bdud rtsi lta bu ni// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// phan dang bde ba'i gzhir gyur la// kham chod hub chod gang byas pa// che 'bag che ru 'tshengs pa yin// chung 'bag chung ngu 'tshengs pa yin// gang zag so so'i rgyud tshod dang*// ji ltar mthun par gyur pa'i chos// skyabs 'gro bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen dang*// kun rdzob smon 'jug don dam gyi// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi dang*// bla med gsang sngags theg pa yi// thun mong ma yin gdams ngag mchog /rje btsun bdud rtsi rgya mtsho las// thugs rje chen po sprin bsdus nas// 'gro ba thams cad smin pa yis// char pa chen po dbab tu gsol// bla ma rje btsun nyid kyi sras// shākya'i rigs las byung ba yi// dge slong shes rab ye shes kyis// gsol ba btab nas bris pa las// nyes 'khrul byung na bzod par gsol// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// de yang sangs rgyas phal po che dang*/

rgyal ba'i yum rgyas pa nas/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsngo bar gsungs pas/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis/ dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig bsngo ba bya'o// rdzogs so// //

153) ༄// ngan song sbyong ba mi 'khrugs pa'i mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi sgom bzlas// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen dang*// sems can kun gyi gnyen gyur pa// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod pas mchod/ 'di ltar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sras kyi dam pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo sgyu med pa'i shugs kyis/ sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i go cha bgos shing*/ dam bca' brtan por gyur pa/ yi dam gyi lha bskyed rdzogs gnyis la nges pa thob cing ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa/ bar do gsum gyi de nyid la mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ tshe 'das shing lus brjes pa smin pa dang grol bar byed pa'i dus la bab par shes nas rang nyid gcig pu'am/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs su gzhan gyis zhus kyang rung*/ ma zhus kyang rung ste/ tshe 'dir pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel rnams/ a jo dang a nu'i ngo dga' zlo ba mang yang*/ tug gis thug shi ba'i 'og tu skyabs dang re sa bla ma dkon mchog min pa gzhan med pas/ cho ga 'di ltar bya ste/ dang po kho nar 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe 'das pa la sogs pa'i ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgom zlas bya snyam du bsams la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃḥ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pas/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid du bsgom pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po bai ḍūrya bcag pa'i 'phro lta bu/

dbu reg dang zhabs rjen du bzhugs pa/ rab tu byung ba'i tshul can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis rab tu brgyan pa/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ phyag g.yas pa sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dkyil mo krung gi bzhugs par skad cig gis bsam pa'am/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang nyid ji ltar bsgom pa lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa spyan drangs shing gnyis su med par bstim pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ dbang rtags bsgom pa'i mthar thug pa byas nas/ rang gi thugs kar sna tshogs padma dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i yi ge hūm̐ la shel gyi kha dog lta bu mgo gyen du langs pa'i yi ge sngags 'dis bskor bar bsam zhing de la dmigs nas/ na mo ratna tra ya ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ akṣo bhya ya/ ta thā ga ta yā/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ kaṃ ka ṇi kaṃ ka ṇi/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na prā ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me swā hā/ zhes brjod pa las/ yi ge hūm̐ sngags dang bcas pa las 'od zer byung nas gshin pos gtso bo byas pa'i sems can thams cad la phog nas/ las dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ thams cad bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod par gyur te/ rang nyid ji ltar zlos pa bzhin du snying po 'di gsungs par bsam zhing*/ de la sems mnyam par bzhag nas ci tsam nus kyi bar du bzlas pa bya ba ni mtshan ma can gyi bzlas pa'o// de nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas sangs rgyas thams cad la thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang 'od zer du gyur nas/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar thim/ bcom ldan 'das sngags dang bcas hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ ha la thim/ ha zhabs kyu zla tshes/

zla tshes thig le/ thig le nā da cha phra bar gyur nas/ de yang nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin du gyur te/ rnam par mi rtog pa de nyid kyi ngang las sems ma yengs par bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mtshan ma med par bzlas pa'o// de ltar rang dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin las ma yengs par byas nas/ gshin po'i bsngo ba bya'o// // 154) ༄// gshin po'i bsngo ba dang smon lam phyogs bcu ma// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe 'das pa che ge mo 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa la dgongs su gsol/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe 'das pa che ge mo 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa la dgongs su gsol/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe 'das pa che ge mo 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba la sogs pas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal pa dang*/ gzhan bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bdag cag nye du gnyen 'brel shul na 'dug pa rnams kyis/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe 'das pa che ge mo 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa'i don du/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po dpag tu med pa bgyis pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa dang dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu rnams la/ bsnyen bkur dang*/ zhabs 'bring dang*/ zhabs tog dang*/ dad gus dang 'bul ba rgya chen po dpag tu med pa bgyis pa dang*/ dkon mchog la mchod pa byas pa dang*/ 'byung po la gtor ma btang ba dang*/ long sprang la yon byin pa dang*/ bdun tshigs byas pa dang*/ klog 'don byas pa dang*/ yul mi nye ring thams cad la ston mo drangs pa la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba/ sbyin pa dam pa/

sems kyi rgyan/ sems kyi yo byad/ rnal 'byor gyi tshogs/ don gyi mchog des 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe 'das pa che ge mo 'di dang 'di zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa 'gro ba rigs drug gang dang gang du skyes sam/ skye 'am/ skye bar 'gyur ba'i las can zhig yin kyang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad/ de dang de'i rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su zhugs par gyur cig rjes su 'brangs shing rjes su zhugs nas/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral nas/ myur du bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig ces rang nyid dang dge 'dun gyi tshogs thams cad kyis lan gsum gyi bar du brjod cing*/ yon bdag pa ni snying nye ba gcig pu gcig gis rjes zlos bya ba las/ gzhan thams cad kyis rjes zlos bya ba ni mi gnang zhing byed du mi ster bar 'dug rtsa na yod pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis mthun 'gyur ma byas na ni bka' skyon par 'dug pas thams cad kyis mthun 'gyur bya'o// smon lam mthar phyin bcom ldan 'das// 'gro ba'i mgon po gnyen gcig pu// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs sangs rgyas la// kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis// ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud chen du// shar phyogs ngan song kun 'dren zhes// dpag med bstod pas bsngags pa yi// bcom ldan mgon po'i byin rlabs dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas dge 'dun gyi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gsang sngags kyis// gnas skabs bde 'gro a cang ches// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang*// thob par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu go ba'i rnal 'byor pa// 'khor gsum yongs dag shes pa yis// bar do gnad kyi man ngag gis// rnam par grol bar cis mi 'gyur// des na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// sangs rgyas dgongs pa rdzogs par bya// thabs dang shes rab mkha' 'dra ba// 'gro la phan pa'i snying rje can// snying stobs brtson ldan sku 'khor bzhin// rje btsun 'khor bcas bzhugs pas na// 'bri gung dpal gyi dgon pa 'dir// bsngo ba bya rgyu mang po byung*// de yi ched du bris pa yi// dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin des// bdag dang bdag gi de rnams dang*// mtha' yas sems cad thams cad kun// smon lam btab pa de ltar shog/

// 155) ༄// mgon po mi 'khrugs pa'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi sgom bzlas// bcom ldan 'das skyob pa mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i bzlas bsgom byed par 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ dang por sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i bzlas bsgom bya snyam du bsams la/ skad cig gis rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po bai ḍūrya bcag pa'i 'phro ltar sngo ba/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan cing*/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i khri'i steng na/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can du bsam/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ gcig bsam/ hūm̐ de la/ na mo ratna tra ya ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ akṣo bhya ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te/ sam myaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ṇi tro ṭa ṇi/ trā sa ṇi trā sa ṇi/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me swā hā// zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis g.yas skor du bsams la/ de klog par bsam zhing ngag tu bzlas pas/ hūm̐ sngags dang bcas pa las 'od zer byung nas/ ba spu'i bu ga dang sku thams cad nas 'od zer 'phros pas sems can ma lus pa thams cad la phog ste/ sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas thams cad bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod par gyur par bsam/ de nas rang nyid kyis gsang sngags brjod pas/ de thams cad kyis kyang gsung bar bsam zhing ci nus tshad bzlas pa ni mtshan ma can gyi bzlas pa'o// de nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'ja' tshon lta bus sangs rgyas de thams cad la thim/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'od zer du gyur nas rang gi snying gar thim/

rang nyid sngags la thim/ sngags hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ gi ha 'a la/ 'a zhabs kyu la/ zhabs kyu zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le na da shin tu cha phra bar gyur nas/ nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar gyur te/ dmigs pa med pa de nyid kyi ngang la ci nus tshad kyis sngags bzlas pa mtshan ma med pa'i bzlas pa'o// de ltar bzlas bsgom yun ring du bya ste/ ma nus shing 'jog pa'i dus su dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba la 'bad par bya'o// // 156) ༄// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas bum pa sgrub pa'i gzungs chog/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun gyi gzungs chog byed par 'dod na/ maṇḍal dang bum pa bcas dang*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bum pa'i cho ga gzhan dang mthun/ rnal 'byor pa stan bde ba'i steng du kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag gis gnas par byas nas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ yi dam lha'i sgom bzlas ci nus shig bya/ de'i rjes la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā ཿswa bhā wa shud dho3haṃḥ zhes brjod pas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i stong pa nyid du bsam la/ stong pa nyid de'i ngang las yi ge bhrum̐ gcig bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las phyi rin po che sna tshogs kyi bum pa/ nang lha'i gzhal med kyi khang du bsam/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i steng du bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa bsam/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ de dang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa spyan drangs zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur ba'i mthar thug par byas nas/ phyag dang mchod pas yang dag par mchod de/ rang gi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros te/

bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i yi ge hūm̐ sngags dang bcas pa la phog pas/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs par bsam zhing*/ gzungs thag lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas bzlas pa ci nus tshad du bya ste/ thun thon pa'i rjes la mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag dang mchod pas yang dag par mchod de/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir ltem gyis zhu bar bsam/ de nas snga ma'i gtor ma de chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams la bsngo/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o// 'gro mgon bla ma'i zhal snga nas/ lnga tshan lnga yi bcud rnams dang*// bum pa maṇḍal bcas rnams la// sla chos g.yo sgyu med pa yis// tshogs shing legs par bya ba gces// // 157) ༄// rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas gsungs pa'i bla ma rin po che'i maṇḍal gyi khrid// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ bla ma rin po che'i phyag bzhes gyi maṇḍal 'di ni/ rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas gsungs/ slob dpon chen po birwa pas mdzad pa yin gsungs/ dang po maṇḍal legs par phyis nas tshom bu bdun bkod pa'i rjes la/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ yi dam gyi lhar gsal bar bsgom nas/ maṇḍal de sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi zhing khams/ nyes pa'i skyon med pa/ legs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug thams cad kyis gang bar bsams nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bla ma dam pa dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ jo bo dkon mchog gsum bsams la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa'i tshogs thams cad dang bcas pa phul ba'i rjes la/ gsol ba gdab par bya'am/ yang na bla ma dam pa gcig pu nyid// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// zhes pa dang*// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas/

dkon mchog gsum po bla ma yin pa'i nges pa'i shes pa yod na/ gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa bzhugs par bsam nas/ gsol ba lan gsum btab pa'i rjes la/ spyi bo nas rang gi lus la bstim par bya ste/ de lta bu gsum mam/ bdun nam/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa byas pa'i rjes la/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom ste/ de la ji srid nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gi mtshan mas ma g.yengs kyi bar du/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i de nyid bskyangs nas/ yang zing gis byung*/ snying mi dga'/ tshig pa za/ 'gro snying 'dod par byung na yang maṇḍal dang gsol ba gdab pa snga ma bzhin du bya te/ de ltar rgyun du bskyangs na ting nge 'dzin bzang po mi 'ong kha med/ thabs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba shes rab kyis bogs 'don/ shes rab kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thabs kyis bogs 'don/ thabs dang shes rab ya ma bral/ zung du 'jug pa'i nyams len 'dis/ bya rgod nam 'phang gcod pa bzhin du/ zab pa dang rgya che ba mthon po'i don rtogs par 'gyur ro// //

158) ༄// lhag mthong gi bogs 'don mos gus bla ma'i gsol 'debs// na mo ratna gu ru/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu byas la gsol ba gdab// bar chad gsum dang bral gyur na// gang 'dod 'bras bu myur du smin// rje rin po che yi byin rlabs kyis// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba la// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba dang*/ shin tu gang ba dang*/ smin pa dang*/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa dang*/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ni// bla ma yin pa'i go ba la// gnas na bla ma rang la 'pho// rje rin po che yi sku gsung thugs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs/ mnyam pa nyid lhun grub rgyun chad med pa'i gter du gyur pas/ bdag dang bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag cing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mnyam pa nyid lhun grub rgyun chad med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa ni lhag mthong gi sgom bag tsam yod kyang bogs ma thon na/ bla ma'i mos gus tshad du ma bskyal bas/ lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas sam/ bcos ma tshun chad kyis/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs lugs 'di'i don bsam zhing*/ nges pa'i shes pa bskyed la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// // 159) ༄// thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par gyi gsol 'debs dang bsngo ba// spyir sangs ma rgyas pa bsngo ba ma shes pa gcig pus lan pa yin pa gsungs/ smon lam gyi nyes pas tshogs bsags kyang*/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras dang*/ drag na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas su smin kyang*/ byang chub ma thob pa'i bar chad du 'gyur bas/ bdud dang bar chad de dag par byas pa'i ched du/

zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba gdab pa dang bsngo ba bya ba ni/ dam pa rje btsun rin po che/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs phyogs bcu dus gsum rnam pa thams cad na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ ye shes kyi chos skyong ba'i srung ma/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ bdag gis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad/ 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas su smin par mi 'gyur bar/ bdag dang bdag la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mi mthun pa'i phyogs sgrub pa thams cad kyi gtso bo byas pa'i ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig dge ba'i rtsa ba des lus kyis sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig ngag gis sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig yid kyis sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cig nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi bsam pa mi 'ong bar gyur cig zhe sdang gi bsam pa mi 'ong bar gyur cig nga rgyal dang phrag dog rnyed pa dang bkur sti/ grags pa dang snyan pa/ tshe 'di'i bsam pa mi 'ong bar byams pa dang snying rje/ byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud brlan nas/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur nas/ bdag tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur cig nam 'chi ba'i tshe gnad gcod pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'ong*/ gshis ngan du 'chi bar mi 'byung*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba mi 'ong bar/ 'chi ba la dga' ba dang bcas/ bde ba dang bcas nas/ sems nyid shin tu gsal ba dang*/

chos nyid shin tu gsal ba dang 'grogs nas/ 'chi kha dang bar dor cis kyang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig ces brjod par bya'o// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ thugs rje dang stong pa ro mnyam pa/ dri ma gsum gyis ma gos pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// skyabs che la byin chags pa'i jo bo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// mthu dang nus pa phun sum tshogs shing*/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams kyis bsrung ba dang*/ skyabs pa dang*/ byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam gyi lha la skyabs su mchi'o// slob dpon gyis dbu mdzad pa'i bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ tshe'i bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ srog gi bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol// // 160) ༄// tshe bsod las gsum gyi yon tan 'phel byed 'chi ba bluu ba// oṃ swasti/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// dpa' bo dgra las rnam rgyal ba/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan gyis// tshe dang las dang bsod nams gsum// zad par gyur na 'chi ba dang*// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal tshogs// dpag tu med pa 'byung zhes gsungs// las kyi rnam par smin pa ni// zad cing gtugs par gang gyur pa// sangs rgyas mthus kyang mi bzlog zhes// thub pa'i gsung rab rnams su gsungs// bsod nams zad par gyur pa'i nad// mar me 'chi khar phyin pa la// mar khu bsnan par gyur pa ltar// mkhas pas bsod nams bsags pa yis// tshe dang longs spyod dpal 'bras rnams// phun sum tshogs par 'gyur bar nges// des na skyes bu dam pa khyed// bsod nams tshogs la 'bad par zhu// bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dang*// rdo rje spun grogs ming sring dang*// dbul phongs snying rje'i 'gron rnams la// byams dang snying rje byang sems dang*// lhag bsam g.yo sgyu med pa yis// bsod nams rgya chen bsags par bya// nyes pa'i skyon las grol bar nges// tshe zad 'chi bar bslu ba ni// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*// de bzhin nyid kyi 'chi ltas rnams// rim pa bzhin du bzlog par bya// phyi yi 'chi ltas phyi nyid kyi// tshogs gsog sbyor bas bzlog pa yin// nang gi bskyed pa'i rim pa ste// gsang ba bdud rtsi'i sbyor bas bzlog

/stong nyid bde chen dam pa ni// 'chi ba bslu ba'i mchog yin ces// grub thob gong ma rnams kyis gsungs// bla ma rin chen bka' stsal gsungs// de yi rjes su 'brang bar bya// lar gyi tshad ldan bla ma dang*// mos gus can gyi slob ma gnyis// sa thag nye ring ma mchis pas// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs dang*// dad pa can gyi mos gus kyis// rten 'brel 'grigs par gyur pa'i tshe// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs te// sangs rgyas nyid kyang mi dka' na// gzhan pa smos kyang ci dgos pa// bu gcig khyed kyis ma go 'am// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang*// bral bar ma byed rnal 'byor pa// snying gtam yin gyi sems la zhog/ // 161) ༄// rang sems bsgom na 'khor 'das lag pa'i lto rgyab bzhin bsgyur ba// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di/ rang la skye bzhin pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'di la zer ba yin/ rtog pa de rtogs na 'khor ba nyid mya ngan las 'das par shar ba yin pas/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa na// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs pas so// de rang nyid kyis nyams su blang ba'i dbang du byas na/ dang po kho nar bsam gtan gyi yan lag rnam pa lnga bcas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de yi ched du sgom pa 'di bsgom snyam du bsams la lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa spyi bor bsgom/ de nas sems rang gi rig pa rig rig tur tur po 'di la bltas te/ sems 'di dang po gang nas skyes/ bar du gar gnas/ tha ma gang du 'gag snyam du bsams pas/ sems 'di dang po gang nas kyang ma skyes/ bar du gang na yang mi gnas/ mtha' mar gang du yang mi 'gag cir yang grub pa med pa/ de'i ngang la ci yang yid la mi byed par bzhag

yid la mi byed pa de'i ngang la yun ring du bsgom pa de'i rjes la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags shing yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba la 'bad par bya'o// rin po che yi gdams ngag 'di// go na 'khor 'das lag pa yi// lto rgyab bsgyur ba ji bzhin du// myur du don chen 'grub nas mchi// des na bla ma'i mos gus dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing*// rang sems bsgom pa shin tu gces// // 162) ༄// gtor ma cha bcu thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor sgo nas nyams su len lugs// skyabs chen 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// 'khor ba theg pa dman pa las// skyob mdzad bla ma rin chen la// phyag 'tshal gus pas skyabs su mchi// bdag gi gtor ma cha bcu 'di// bcu por nges pa'i lung rigs med// rang nyid gnod par 'jigs pa las// nyams su blangs pas phan pa lags// 'di ltar rten gyi gang zag rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis/ nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor ro// de dag kyang gang zhe na/ snga thun dang po la 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa/ las rgyu dang 'bras bu/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud bsgos te/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis sgom pa bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ bsgom pa de las skyo bar gyur na man ngag bzhin du bzlas pa bya ba ni bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ bzlas pas dub cing skyo na gtor ma gtang ba ni gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma btang nas yi dam gyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar spyod lam bya ba ni spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// 'dir gtor ma cha bcu ni/ dang po bla ma yi dam jo bo lha dkon mchog gsum la gcig

de nas chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po gnyug mar gnas pa ma mgon gnyis la sogs pa gcig de nas de dang chos skyong ba'i srung ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa la gcig dang gsum po 'di ni nang gtor gyis 'bul bar bya'o// de nas gcig 'gro ba rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar byas pa la 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor mas 'bul/ de nas rang gi 'khor dang yon bdag gnyen 'brel du gtogs pa rnams kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i lha 'dre rnams la gcig de nas klu'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' sog ma med pa la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba la gcig des gtso bor byas pa'i klu dang sa bdag gi rigs ma lus shing lus pa med pa la gcig de dang khyad par bla lhag tu yul de na gnas pa'i mi ma yin la gcig de nas yi dwags thams cad la gcig de nas lan chags thams cad la gcig ste drug po 'di kha 'bar ma'i gtor mas 'bul/ e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par las// mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi chos// snang srid dbang du bsgyur ba 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems// chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag dang*// rig sngags gsang sngags snying po dang*// phyag rgya bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// phra rab rdul la sogs pa yang*// byin gyis rlabs par gyur pa yis// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi// 'gro ba thams cad bde ba dang*// sdug bsngal kun dang bral ba dang*// mthar thug byang chub thob pa dang*// dus gsum 'phags pa mchod pa yi// sprin phung sna tshogs 'byung ba rnams// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pas na// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pas na// ngo mtshar che rgyu ga la yod// soms dang chos kyi mig can rnams// ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas// bskal pa grangs med mtha' yas su// tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i 'bras bu de// sangs rgyas yin zhes grags pa ste// 'di lta bu zhig ma lags sam// 'di lta bu zhig ma lags na// rgyu 'bras phyin ci log tu nges// byin rlabs phrin las med pa yi// sangs rgyas bzang po su zhig bsgrub// de nas rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// nges shes bskyed la phrin las brtsam// gtor ma cha bcu rdzogs so//

༈ //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dus kyi gtor ma 'di la mang nyung gi grangs dang che chung gi tshad 'di yin med/ ji ltar 'byor pa bzhin du byed pa yin/ zur tsam so sor smos par byed pa'i dbang du byas na/ sman btab pa'i gtor ma dgu 'am/ ji ltar yod pa nang gtor rlung me bud sbar gyis/ bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ jo bo dkon mchog gsum dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol dur khrod na gnas pa rnams dang*/ rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' dag bsrung ba chos skyong ba'i srung ma ma lus pa spyi la gong ma bzhin du rim gyis 'bul lo// de rjes 'byung po'i gtor ma dang*// byang chub sems dpa' ma dros pa// sog ma med par grags pa la// klu brgyad 'khor gyis bskor ba dang*// yul phyogs gang na gnas pa dang*// klu yi dge bsnyen thams cad la// ngor byas tshul du gtor ma ni// gsum la sogs pa ci 'os 'bul// dbang du bya dang yi dwags dang*// lan chags rnams ni rim pa bzhin// kha 'bar ma yis sbyin par bya// bden pa la gnas rnal 'byor pas// rin po che yi dgongs pa yis// nan tan chen pos bsgrub byas nas// thams cad phyag rgya chen por bsgom// mdo dang smon lam la sogs pa// de yang de nyid kho nar bsgrub// dam pa rje btsun rin po che rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rnam pa thams cad na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ ye shes kyi chos skyong ba'i srung ma dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa/ chos nyid kyi bden pa las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi spyan can/ rmad du byung ba'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pas/

nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar mdzad pa thams cad kyis/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas kyang bdag dang bdag la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mi mthun pa'i phyogs sgrub par byed pa thams cad kyis gtso bo byas pa'i ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par mdzad du gsol// //

163) ༄// rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po bdun gyi phan yon// ston pa bdag nyid chen po la// gnas brtan chen po bskul byed kyis// dad dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams// rgyu 'am gnas sam nyal ba 'am// mi nyal ba la sogs par yang*// rtag tu rgyun mi chad par ni// bsod nams 'ba' zhig 'phel ba dang*// bsod nams 'ba' zhig skye ba yi// rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams gzhi// shin tu 'bras bu che ba dang*// phan yon che dang snang ba che// rgyas pa che ba gdags rung ngam// de skad zhu ba zhus pa las// ston pas 'di skad bka' bstsal to// bskul byed rung ste bdun po 'di// rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams 'phel// bdun po de yang gang zhe na// phyogs bzhi'i dge slong dge 'dun la// kun dga' ra ba 'bul ba dang*// kun dga' ra ba de nyid du// gtsug lag khang pa brtsigs pa dang*// gtsug lag khang pa de nyid du// gnas mal sna tshogs 'bul ba dang*// gtan gyi rkyen ris 'bul ba dang*// glo bur 'ong dang 'gro ba la// gzhan la smin par byed pa dang*// nad pa dang ni nad g.yog la// sbyin pa sbyin par byed pa dang*// rlung las yul ngan char lhags la// 'o brgyal dogs pa'i bsam pa yis// chos ston bskyal bar gyur pa 'di// rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun// 'bras bu phan yon snang ba dang*// rgyas pa shin tu che zhes gsungs// rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i// bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po yang*// gong du smos pa kho na ltar// rgyun chad med par byung ba ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos ni// sa phyogs 'di na bzhugs so zhes// thos par gyur nas dga' ba dang*// mchog tu dga' ba skyes pa dang*// de nyid tshur gshegs thos pa dang*// shul du zhugs pa thos pa dang*// rang gi grong du byon pa dang*// blta dang bsnyen bkur bya ba dang*// dam pa'i chos ni nyan pa dang*// thos nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*// bslab pa'i gzhi rnams len pa dang*// de ltar bdun po 'di dag rnams// rdzas las byung ba ma yin pa'i// bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po mchog

/rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*// mngon par 'phel ba skye ba dang*// gzhir gyur 'bras bu che ba dang*// phan yon che dang snang ba che// rgyas pa che ba yin no zhes// ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa yis// gnas brtan chen po bskul byed la// rnam 'byed sgo gtan gleng gzhir gsungs// // 164) ༄// shag po shag mo 'dis bslu ba yin pa nye drung brtse ba'i bstan bcos// rje bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// skyabs 'gran zla med pa dkon mchog gsum// skad cig yud tsam thang cig kyang*// yid la byed pa mi skye bar// pha ma nye drung gnyen 'brel dang*// 'khor dang shag po shag mo rnams// rtag tu sems la mi 'gog pa// 'di tsam sems la brtsi tshod 'dis// bla med skyabs gcig yin par nges// bla med skyabs gnas yin srid na// pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel dang*// shag po shag mo khyed rnams la// re ba'i sems kyis gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'dir mi sdug tsam zhig zhu// rgas nas mi 'phongs tsam re zhu// gtam ngan mi phog tsam zhig zhu// grags pa mi nyams pa zhig zhu// shi kar mi 'gyod tsam zhig zhu// gong mas mi khrel tsam zhig zhu// rtag tu chags pas bsams pa yi// pha ma nye drung gnyen 'brel dang*// nyams dga'i shag po shag mo rnams// khyed kyis nga 'bu ma dran kyang*// nga yi sems la tshugs pa med// skyo gdung yid kyis zhu don gsol// phyi mar dmyal ba'i tsha grang dang*// yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal dang*// byol song gcig la gcig za la// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// lha min 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal dang*// lha
