yi 'chi 'pho ltung byed dang*// mi yi brel 'phongs la sogs pa// rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nye drung shag pos bskyab tu gsol// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// khyed kyis bdag cag ma bskyabs na// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// skyabs gnas tsam du ma bltas par// lus ngag yid gsum thams cad kyis// so nam nye 'brel don du byas// ci bsam ci mno thams cad kyi// bsam pa khyed las gzhan ma bsams// gar 'gro gar 'dug thams cad du// khyed kyi so tshis byas pa las// gzhan la ci phan ma bsams na// snying nas bdag cag mi skyob bam// nges par skyob pa'i mthu med na// nam yang skyabs gnas min par zad// byas pa thams cad don re med// log pa'i shes pas nga re bslus// da ni 'gyod kyang phan pa med// legs par soms dang bsam yod rnams// 'di la ma 'thad ma zer bar// nye 'brel shag po shag mo 'dis// bslu ba yin par thugs la zhog

/nye drung brtse ba'i bstan bcos 'di// gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// ngan skyon a kha'i phung po la// bzang 'dod phyar bas ma bkab pa// gal te thugs dang 'gal gyur na// 'gal ba de la bzod par gsol// // 165) ༄// mdo sngags kyi bslab pa 'gal 'du mi rung bar bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje 'chang zhabs padmor 'dud// snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun// spros dang bral ba'i sems nyid du// dbye ba med cing ro gcig pa// dag pa'i sa la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpas rtogs pa yin// gnyis med dbye ba med tshul du// rnam par rtog pa skye ba ste// mthar thug mkhyen pa'i ye shes la// sgrib pa shes bya'i sgrib par gsungs// gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa yi// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa ni// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum du// 'dzin pa'i rig pa brtul nas su// sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs nyid du// zhugs par gyur pa de nyid la// rig pa brtul zhugs zhes su brjod// rgyun chad med par nyams len na// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa yin// de dang 'dul ba'i bslab pa gnyis// gal te so so yin srid na// so sor thar pa'i brjod bya ci// sngags dang tshul khrims bslab pa gnyis// gal te so so yin srid na// bde gshegs bka' 'das ltung ba zhes// skyes chen gang la zer ba soms// gang 'dir 'dul ba'i bslab pa las// gsang sngags gzhan zhig yod srid na// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pas na// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos// de 'dra med pa'i sangs rgyas la// sngags kyi sangs rgyas zer ram ci// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud rnams su// legs par gzigs dang go ba skye// rdzogs so// // 166) ༄// lus srog la ma chags par brtul zhugs sgrub dgos par bstan pa// na mo ratna gu ru/

dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// drang srong chen po ma pham pa// mnyam med mi yi seng ge mchog /tshangs pa'i lha dang me sbyin gnyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa 'o// dge ba'i rtsa ba drag po bskyed// 'di lta bu yi bsam pa skyes// 'di ltar bdag cag bud med dang*// lhan gcig gnas par gyur pa na// 'dod chags rgyu las byung ba yis// bslab pa dag dang 'gal bar 'gyur// kun 'dzin pa dang bcas pa dang*// lhan cig 'grogs par gyur na yang*// ngan sems rgyu las byung ba yi// bslab pa dag dang 'gal bar 'gyur// kun 'dzin pa dang bcas pa 'am// kun tu 'dzin pa dag la ni// nyes par mi lta ba dag dang*// lhan cig 'grogs par gyur na yang*// gti mug rgyu las byung ba yi// bslab pa rnams dang 'gal bar 'gyur// snyam du bsams te de lta bu'i// nyes pa mang po mthong nas ni// dgon pa las ni dgon pa dang*// nags nas nags dang gshong nas gshong*// nags khrod stug nas stug por rgyu// de tshe rgyal po'i chad pa yis// rkun po nyen pa mthong nas ni// drang srong chen po me sbyin ni// tshangs pa'i lha la 'di skad smras// lus dang srog la chags pa rnams// byung nas byung ba'i zag pa yis// sems ni zin par 'dug pa ste// dper na snum gyis gos pa yis// gos la rdul gyis mi gos bzhin// lus dang srog la mi chags pa// 'di dag dag ni byung ba dang*// byung ba'i kun tu zag pa yis// sems ni kun tu mi zin cing*// 'dug par yang ni mi 'gyur te// yongs su dag pa'i gos la ni// rdul gyis reg kyang de ma thag /sprugs pa tsam gyi med pa bzhin// des na lus dang srog la ni// nam yang chags par mi bya ste// lus dang srog la chags rnams kyis// brtul zhugs grub par 'gyur ro zhes// sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gsungs so// de lta bu yi brtul zhugs kyis// bdag med gnyis kyis don bsgoms pas// dpag med bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa yis// phyogs bcu 'jig rten dpag med tu// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mthong*// la la byang chub 'tshang yang rgya// la la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// la la rdzu 'phrul cho 'phrul ston// la la zag med mya ngan 'da'// de dag kun gyi zhabs drung na// drang srong chen po me sbyin ni// rgyal ba rnams kyi rim gro byed// dpag med rdzu 'phrul cho 'phrul gyis// bde gshegs de dag bstan pa ni// sems can rnams la ston byed cing*// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa yang*// 'gro ba kun la brjod gyur nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// dri ma med pa'i spyan dang ni// spyan mchog de bzhin gshegs nyid du// drang srong chen po bdag nyid gnyis// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas so// su zhig drang srong mi yi mchog

/nyon mongs rgyas pa'i mi rnams kyis// thub pa'i bslab pa 'bral 'gyur zhes// dben zhing dgon pa'i nags tshal du// bdag gzhan ma mthong don bsgoms pas// myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob// drang srong mi yi seng ge ltar// bdag ni nam zhig 'gyur zhig gu// drang srong chen po'i rnam thar gyis// bdag gzhan thams cad smin par shog /thabs mkhas thugs rje chen po can// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// skyob mdzad bla ma rin chen gyi// zhabs la gtsug gis rtag tu 'dud// lha khyod la ni phyi phyir zhing*// dad cing gus pa thob gyur te// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar// bla ma khyed dang mi 'bral zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar gyis// rang gzhan thams cad smin gyur cig /sha ba spyang khus zos pa'i 'phro// 'chi bar nges pa bsad pa 'di// sdig pa shin tu che lags te// dpon slob dam tshig gcig gyur cig /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob tshe// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub mchog tu smon pa yi// 'bum phrag cig kyang mi tshad tsam// bde dang thar pa'i srog bcad nas// mnar med bud shing byed pa 'di// sdig pa de bas che lags pas// dpa' chen mkhas pa'i skyes mchog la// glen pa sdar zhes mi gsungs zhing*// gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba thob// kun mkhyen dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// khyed kyang slob par shin tu rigs// long ba brgya phrag mang po yi// long khrid gcig las med pa de// thams cad 'dus nas bsad pa dang*// long ba rkang grangs mang po rnams// bde bar 'gyur ram dgongs dang kye// rig pa'i gnas lnga sbyang pa yi// mkhas pa bye ba khrag khrig gis// byang chub sems dpa' gcig cig gi /grangs dang char yang mi phod de// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang ni// rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis// gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod// kun mkhyen ye shes ma thob par// mkhas par 'gyur ba mi srid pas// mkhas par 'dod pa'i skyes bu rnams// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub par bya// bla ma mkhas pa btsal nas kyang*// tshogs gnyis bsag cing smon lam gdab// 'di yang thabs la mkhas pa yin//

// 167) ༄// nyams len gnad kyi dogs gcod mang rje zhig pos zhus pa// mnyam med bla ma dam pa rin po che// 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can// bdag blo shin tu dman pa dang*// sa thag ring por lus pas na// dpe 'di dgos par gyur pa yi// zhu ba 'ga' zhig mchis pas na// thugs kyi dgongs nas gnang bar zhu// dgon par dge sbyor mi 'phel bar// g.yeng bas 'phel na ji ltar bgyi// 'khor 'das sems su thag chod nas// blo bskyed 'byung rgyu yod dam med// rgyun du ngang la 'gro ba la// sems bskyed bsngo ba dgos ma dgos// nor med tshogs sogs ji ltar bya// rtogs ldan smyo nas shi na ci// zhi gnas yod pa'i sgom chen gyis// bar do dang po zin mi zin// rtogs ldan bar do gzung dgos sam// bla ma nyid dang ma mjal bar// nyes ltung ji ltar bshags par bgyi// bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa ji ltar bgyi// phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa la// bskyed rim bzlas pa 'tshal mi 'tshal// shi khar gnad gcod 'dre dmag la// ji ltar bya ba gsung bar zhu// yi dwags dngos su byung na ji ltar bgyi// lha 'dre gtum po yod pa'i sar// dbang med sdod na ji ltar bgyi// rmi lam sbyong ba'i dus tshod du// shes pa rengs na ji ltar bgyi// tshwa tshwa sbyin sreg chu gtor rnams// so so gang la ji ltar mchi// mang po'i yi dam lhar bsgom pa// rin po che la zhu ba lags// thugs la btags nas gsung bar zhu// // 168) ༄// rin po che gser gyi phreng ba mang rje zhig po'i zhus lan// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med dam pa rin po che// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs la 'dud// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// zhabs kyi pad ma la btud nas// zab pa'i gdam ngag zab mo yi// spros pa snying nas chod pa ni// lung dang rigs pa man ngag gi /yig nag blo la blangs pa min// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// mthar thug gdams ngag zab mo ni// da lta'i bsam pa 'gro ldog yin// ngan pa'i bsam pa spang ba dang*// bzang po'i bsam pa 'phel ba yi// gnas dang grogs dang dgon pa dang*// tshogs dang mtho dman thams cad du// dge sbyor 'phel la gtsigs su che// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// rang gi sems su thag chod nas// lto gos gnyis la gyong bskur cing*// gcig po ri khrod dgon par bsdad// mtho dman bsam mno ma byas na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan 'char// lhan skyes lhan cig skyes gyur cing*// lhun gyis grub pa'i dge sbyor la// de dang gnyis su med pa yi// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel zab mo dang*// sems bskyed bsngo ba med kha med// rtag tu bzlas pa ma thos sam// thun mong min pa'i chos 'di yin// sems nyid gnad du bskyal ba la// gtum mo a thung man ngag gces// gsang sngags phrin las sgrub pa la// bskyed rim sgyu lus man ngag gces// zung du chud pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rang la gang mkho nyams su len// bar dor thim lugs 'byung lugs rnams// 'jig rten mgon pos zhib tu gsungs// 'pho ba'i dus su lus kyi gnad// kha lta za zi'i kha na med// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa bzhin// rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun// ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du bya// lag na zang zing ma mchis na// byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus// sha khrag rus pa rkang dang snying*// btsongs nas bla ma mchod pa ltar// yon tan 'dod na de ltar bya// rtogs pa yod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel phra bas na// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la// mtho dman rnam rtog gang skyes rnams// smin par 'gyur ba chos nyid yin// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas gsungs// shi na 'od gsal gnyis po 'dre// sus kyang ma byas gshis su 'dug

/gnas pa bzang po yod tsam gyis// bar do dang po zin pa ni// zhi gnas lhan cig skyes pa min// man ngag zab na ma 'tshal lo// rtogs pa yod pa'i gang zag gis// bar do gzung lta mi 'tshal te// gal po che la ngos dga' med// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// nyon mongs chos skur chod pa la// ji bzhin 'bras bu byung bar gsungs// sangs rgyas gsung yang 'di ltar gda'// blos byas kha lta'i rjes 'brang ba// dam chos byed snying ma 'dod pas// dge sdig med do zhes kyang zer// rtsa ba yan lag ltung ba dang*// mtho dman nyes pa gang byung yang*// bla ma dus gsum bde gshegs rnams// mdun du bsams nas bshags par bya// bshags pa tshad du ma bskyal na// tshe 'di phyi ma bar do ru// a la la dang a dzi dzi// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las// yul dang bsam pa dngos po rnams// ji ltar 'dod pa'i bzlas pa bya// sgyogs dang 'khrul 'khor ji bzhin du// 'bras bu 'grub par the tshom med// phyag rgya chen po go ba la// bskyed rim bzlas pa'i sbyor ba rnams// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug nges pas na// sa bcu man chad rnams la dgos// shi khar gnad gcod 'dre dmag la// kha 'bar ma yi gtor ma gtang*// ku sā li yi tshogs gsog bya// yi dwags dngos su byung ba la// tshad med snying rje chen po bskyed// bla ma yi dam dge sbyor du// nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa la// ji ltar byas kyang bde mor mchi// rmi lam dus kyi 'jigs pa ni// don brgyud man chad gdam ngag la// rgyud srungs mkha' 'gro 'khor bas na// mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs yin pa'i phyir// ma cig kun tu bzang mo sgoms// lha 'dre gtum po yod pa'i sar// de na gnas pa'i yi dwags la// tshad med snying rje chen po sgoms// gnas 'dir rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje chen por nan tan bskyed// dge sbyor kho yi don du bya// rang gi dge sbyor brtan pa dang*// ma yengs bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yis// nyams grib thams cad dag pa dang*// tshugs par yang ni mi 'gyur ro// ban dhe dam nyams sad ma thog

/de yang gong gi de dang 'dra// rmi lam sbyong ba'i dus tshod du// shes pa shin tu rengs pa la// gsang ba'i rdo rje bug sgo ru/ /thig le nag po bsgom na phan// tshwa tshwa chu gtor sbyin sreg rnams// bsod nams tshogs kyi bye brag yin// sbyin sreg las kun 'grub par byed// chu gtor gnod pa zhi bar byed// tsha tshas gdug pa 'joms par nges// khyim khyi ri dwags 'ded pa dang*// byis pa a tho thu ba ltar// a khu bod kyi yi dam la// dga' dga' dge dge nges pa med// sangs rgyas yi dam lha yis thom// bar chad chos skyong srung mas sel// nor ni nor lha rnams kyis ster// klu gdon phyag na rdo rjes thub// lha gdon rje btsun mi g.yo bas// ku ru ku les dbang du byed// dkar bcos thugs rje chen pos bya// rno so be yab rtsang gsum myur// de 'dra re re re la yang*// mang po mang po yod pas ni// bong bu'i mgo por dbyug pa phob// nged rang bod kyi chos lugs yin// thag rul sna yi 'breng rul dang*// byis pa ldum bu sna thug byed// grong chog rnyed pa tshol ba dang*// snying tshim dga' ba snyam byed kyang*// gzhan la phan pa mi 'ong bas// dre'u rgyab bcu yi man ngag kyang*// ra tshang dor ma'i 'og tu bdal// skas skar nyi ma de tsam na// 'ud khur

zhal shob kha g.yos bzlo rgyu yan// yon tan 'byung gnas rgya gar du// byed lugs mkhas pa'i a tsaryas// las 'phro gar mthun brtag brtag nas// yi dam gcig la sa the btsugs// de la rtags mtshan thon pa dang*// skyon dag yon tan kun rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas gcig la thams cad 'byung*// thams cad sangs rgyas gcig yin pas// a tsarya yi sgrub lugs yin// bus kyang de ltar nyams su len// ji ltar dug po hral hrul nas// gser thum mang po 'ong ba ltar// de bzhin mtho dman tshig rnams la// zab mo gnad kyi man ngag rnams// gser la spyod pa bzhin du bya// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog /rin po che gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ mang rje zhig pos zhus pa rdzogs so// // 169) ༄// dpal stag lung thang pa khams su mi bzhud par gsol ba'i zhu yig bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// 'jig rten mgon la skyabs su mchi// 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs kyi sras// sku gsung thugs kyi gdung rgyud 'dzin// dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che// rje btsun stag lung thang pa la// zhe 'dod zhu don zur tsam zhu// mkhos ka chung zhing ma 'thad kyang*// khyad gsod bka' bkyon mi mdzad par// gsan zhing thugs la bzhag par zhu// bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na// spyan 'dren byung nas bzhud par thos// bzhud par thugs dgongs mnga' ba na// cis kyang khams su mi bzhud par// yul 'dir bzhugs par zhu ba 'bul// dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni// nam mkha' yangs la mdzes pa ltar// de bzhin bdag nyid chen po rnams// 'brel ba med pa'i yul na mdzes// nyi ma dong du lhung na ko /gling bzhi snang du ga la btub// mkhas pa nor bu rin po che// nye du mi gtsang 'dam rdzab tu// tshud par gyur na dgos 'dod lha// 'byung bar 'gyur ba cang srid dam// 'brel ba spangs pa'i sa phyogs su// snying rje chen po'i rgyal mtshan rtser// sku gsum dbyer med rin po che// 'gro ba'i mgon po khyed bzhugs na// 'khor 'das kun gyi yon tan rnams// 'gro ba kun la smin gyur pas// pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel la// chags pa'i snying rje mi mdzad par// cis kyang mi bzhud bzhugs par zhu// chos rje bla ma rin chen la// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan can// dpag tu med pa bzhugs na yang*// dag pa'i gdul bya mgu dka' bas// dbu ru byang gi phyogs cha 'dir// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa'i rje// 'jig rten mgon po khyed nyid las// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas// khams su bzhud par grags na yang*// khong nas mi dga' gdung ba skyes// dbus kyi rgyal khams stong sam sems// dam pa rnams kyi mig 'dren khyed// pha yul bsnyags na ma legs pas// cis kyang mi bzhud bzhugs par zhu//

// 170) ༄// gnyis 'dzin spongs bar gdams pa gnyis med bde ba chen po// 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// dgag rgyu gcig dang sgrub rgyu gcig /spangs blangs gnyis kyis nga re bslus// ma lus sems nyid chos sku la// sgom mkhan gcig dang sgom pa gcig /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis mgo re bskor// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la// sgom rgyu gcig dang spong rgyu gcig /spang bya gnyen po sgrog tu bcug /'gyur ba med cing lhun gyis grub// rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin la// re ba gcig dang dogs pa gcig /chags sdang gnyis kyis nga re brlag /gnyis med bde ba chen po la// zhe 'dod med pa gtsigs su che// bya ba thongs dang rnal 'byor pa// zhes so// // 171) ༄// sdig grogs spong bar gdams pa sangs rgyas gsung la nan tan bya ba// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lus bya nyes/ ma byin pa len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ srog gcod pa dang gsum/ ngag smra nyes/ rdzun dang*/ phra ma dang*/ tshig rtsub dang*/ ngag 'khyal dang bzhi/ sems bsam nyes/ brnab sems dang*/ gnod sems dang*/ log par lta ba gsum/ yul bzung nyes/ 'khrug pa'i gzhi dang*/ chags pa'i gzhi dang*/ gti mug cing rmongs pa'i gzhi dang*/ nga rgyal ba'i gzhi dang*/ phrag dog pa'i gzhi dang*/ bya byed dang zang zing g.yeng ba'i gzhi dang drug grogs bsten nyes pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po nyon mongs dang rnam rtog bskyed par byed pas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad du rang dang gzhan dngos dang brgyud pa thams cad tu drag cing rtsub pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad bskyed par byed pas/ yab cig ston pa thugs rje chen po ldan pas bkag cing ma gnang ba dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad du spang bar gsungs so// kwa/ a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// mi mkhas sdig grogs dbang song bas// phra zhing phra ba'i nyes pa yis// dngos dang brgyud pa thams cad du// rang dang rang la gtse ba dang*// rang gzhan thams cad sdug bsngal gyi// rgya mtsho chen por 'jug par byed// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// thabs mkhas thugs rje chen po yi// bka' las rmongs pa gang 'da' ba// dngos dang brgyud par sdug bsngal thob// de phyir bde bar 'dod pa dang*// sdug bsngal spong bar 'dod pa yis// sangs rgyas gsung la nan tan bya// rdzogs so//

dad pa med pa la gsang ngo*// mi go ba la gsang ngo*// don du mi gnyer ba la gsang ngo*// // 172) ༄// khe grags log rtog spong ba'i gdams pa sgrub pa bya lugs kyi zhus lan// pha mnyam med bla ma dam pa la// sgrub pa bya lugs zhus pa la// sems dang rdo rus ma 'phrod cing*// ya zi ma zi'i skyid chos la// sa re su re'i spyod 'gros kyis// khe grags sangs rgyas bsgrub pa de// log shes rtog pa'i dbang song bas// rang la rang phye gtor ba dang*// nga rgyal rang mthong bsgom pa bas// bu de ltar mi bya 'di ltar bya// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho yi// 'byung khungs bdag 'dzin ma rig pa// chags sdang gnyis kyi rkang lag can// khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer du// sdug bsngal drag po'i stobs kyis rgyu// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i spu gri yis// bde dang thar pa'i srog gcod pa// mi bzad gsod pa'i gshed ma las// dben pa'i dgon pa btsal bar bya// gnyis med ye shes ri bo la// lhun gyis grub pa'i bla ma de// zhen med thugs rje'i gdan la bzhugs// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes// grub thob brgyud pa'i dbu rgyan can// byang chub sems kyi lcags kyu yis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can 'dzin// rtogs pa'i ye shes me chen gyis// khams gsum 'khor ba'i bud shing bsreg /de 'dra'i bla ma rin chen dang*// skad cig tsam yang ma 'bral dang*// rnal 'byor gyi mdun ma bzang nas mchi// rang byung kun bzang bde ba de// zhi ba byang chub 'dus ma byas// bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud// dpa' chen byang chub sems dpa' rnams// dkon mchog gsum gyi bran phyir dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi g.yog phyir dang*// bdag tu 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dge ba dus gsum skyes pa rnams// gang gi don du g.yog gyur la// su zhig bdag tu 'dzin pa skye//

// 173) ༄// dpal sa ra ha'i phyag rgya chen po thog babs kyi sgom thabs bstan pa// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon chen po sa ra ha'i phyag rgya chen po 'di la don bzhi ste/ dang por lus sems khong glod/ gnyis pa yid kyi yul du mi bya/ gsum pa rten gang yang mi bca'/ bzhi pa sems rang sor glod/ de la dang po lus sems khong glod pa ni/ slob dpon bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas// 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems 'di ni// glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces pas/ lus sems khong glod par bya'o// gnyis pa yid kyi yul du mi bya ba yang*// yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i sku// 'bras bu gang la yang re bar ma byed rnal 'byor pa// zhes pas/ bzang ngan gyi rnam par rtog pa gang yang yid la mi bya bar bzhag pa'o// gsum pa rten gang la yang mi bca' ba ni/ rtsa dang rlung dang thig le la sogs pa gang la yang rten mi bca' bar bzhag pa'o// bzhi pa rang sor bzhag pa ni/ bya byed dang rtsol sgrub thams cad dang bral bar rang so kho nar bzhag pa nyid do// slob dpon chen po bram ze sa ra ha'i phyag rgya chen po thog babs rdzogs so// // 174) ༄// sgo gsum nyes pa spong ba rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs thob tshul// gzhan gyis thos su dogs pa'i tshig /gzhan la gnod par 'gyur ba rnams// ngo 'am lkog tu gang bzlo ba// sdig to'i 'bras bu tshang bar 'gyur// des na thub pa chen po yis// rdzun la sogs pa rnam pa bzhi// sdig to'i ngag rnams spang ba yis// gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu thob// rgyal ba'i sras su khas len pa// bdag cag lhan cig 'tshogs pa rnams// rang gzhan kun la gnod pa'i tshig /mi dge sdig to spangs nas kyang*// sangs rgyas gsung du bsgrub par bya// gzhan la gnod par 'gyur ba'i lus// gzhan gyis tshor ram ma tshor yang*// srog gcod pa la sogs pa gsum// sdig to'i 'bras bu 'byin pas na// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis spangs pa yis// mtshan dang dpe byad ma lus thob// rgyal ba'i sras su khas len pa// bdag cag lhan cig 'tshogs pa rnams// lus kyi mi dge spangs pa yis// thub pa chen po'i sku thob bya// rang ngam gzhan la gnod pa'i yid// rang gis gsangs shing bcabs na yang*// gtan gyi skyabs gnas rnams kyis mkhyen// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed// de yi phyir na sangs rgyas kyis// log par lta la sogs spangs nas// mkhyen pa gnyis la mnga' yang brnyes// des na bdag cag 'tshogs pa rnams// bzang byed ngan par go ba dang*// ngan byed bzang por go ba yis// log pa'i shes pa la sogs pa// yid kyi mi dge gsum spangs nas// sangs rgyas thugs su bsgrub par bya// go'u tam rigs las skyes pa yi// skyob pa shākya seng ge yi// bstan pa'i snying po dam pa la// dal 'byor thob pa'i dus tshod 'dir// sgrub pa snying por ma byas na// 'chi bdag bdud kyis zin nas kyang*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med du// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo yis// rang dbang med par khyer nas kyang*// ngan song gsum du sdug bsngal gyis// rtag tu g.yen spyos sdug bsngal na// de la che 'dod bzang 'dod pa'i// kha tshis so tshis la sogs pa// khe grags nga rgyal mi byed dam//

// 175) ༄// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag zhus tshig gsum pa'i phrin lan// 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// chos rje bla ma rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi padmor rab btud de// zhus tshig phrin lan 'bri bar bya// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag 'di// gsungs ni rin chen bla mas gsungs// nyams su rnal 'byor bdag gis myong*// bzhugs pa mdo rgyud kun na bzhugs// tshad ma gsum gyis gtan la phab// ji bzhin nyams su blangs gyur na// ji ltar bzhed pa'i yon tan de// the tshom med par 'byung bar nges// bka' 'phrin gcig gi lan po 'o// yang gcig snyan du gsol ba ni// nang par tho rangs snga dro dang*// phyi 'bred srod dang mthun bzhi yi// thun gyi mgo bo gang rung du// 'khrul 'khor gsum gyi man ngag dag /tshad med snying rje bskyed nas ni// myong ba bag tsam skyes pa dang*// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du// dmigs pa'i sbyor ba 'ba' zhig gces// srin po'i zhal gyi thad ka nas// drang por dmigs pa gtsigs su che// bka' 'phrin gnyis pa'i lan po 'o// yang gcig gsung ba'i 'phrin lan ni// ji srid sangs rgyas ma lus kun// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs par 'dus// ji srid sangs rgyas rdo rje'i rigs// ma lus bskyed pa'i sa bon hūm̐// kha dog nag po 'ba' zhig yin// 'on kyang don gyi gdams ngag ni// hūm̐ dang rdo rje la sogs pa/ kha dog nges pa med pa ste// dmigs pa gang bder byed pa yin// de ltar nyams su blangs pa las// dmigs pa dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// ji ltar 'o ma khol ma la// chu grang blugs pa ji bzhin du// nye bar zhi nas 'ong ba yin// ji bzhin nyams su blangs pa las// thun du thu zhing ma bde na// snying rje bskyed nas dmigs pa na// mar la bsrings shing bsrings shing bsgom// zug dang na tsha sdug bsngal la// thugs bred mi 'tshal dag nas mchi// cis kyang myong bas grub pa yin// zhus tshig gsum pa'i phrin lan no// rdzogs so// yig rten bur rdog nyi shu rtsa lnga yod//

// 176) ༄// gang yag gi 'dun ma bya bar gces pa dga' ldan chos kyi rnga chen// spyir tshe 'di'i bsam pa ma btang na// mi mthong khyim tshor gyi 'dag sbyar yang*// 'jig rten chos brgyad sgrub bam snyam// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la// spang blo'i 'dun pa ma skyes na// ji ltar byas kyang 'khor ba'i rgyu// byams snying rjes rang rgyud ma sbyangs na// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge bas kyang*// byang chub thob la bar du gcod// sems nyid ston pa'i bla ma la// ston pa'i 'du shes ma skyes na// sems nyid rtogs pa mi bskyed cing*// mthar thug 'bras bu mi 'byung bas// byas pa thams cad don med yin// sems la gnad du ma bsnun na// lus ngag dge ba phal cher yang*// rang gzhan gnyis kyi mgo skor yin// tug gis thug pa'i nang bar na// bla ma mkhan slob gang la yang*// zhe 'dod gang yang yod pa min// rang la gang yag rang gis shes// gang yag gi 'dun ma bya ba gces// tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi// chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag cing*// dge ba'i bshes dang 'phrad cing dal 'byor rnyed dka' bas// mtho dman bya ba thongs la sgrub pa snying por gyis// 'bod pa'i 'gro sa shan pa la yang 'ong*// e ma rang gi ye shes ni// rtogs par 'dod na bshes gnyen bkur// rang gi de nyid sad par byed// snying gi padmo kha 'byed pa// gnyis med 'od gsal gcig tu 'dres// 'bral ba med pa ngo mtshar che// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can 'di// ma rig las byung ma lags sam// rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// rtogs pa'i ngo bo ma lags sam// rtogs pa yon tan mi 'byung ba// mkhyen pa can rnams dgongs la gsungs// so so rigs ni gang la dad pa de yin pas// gzhan gyi 'dun pa bsgyur na phrag dog can de phung*// rtsa bcu bla mas so so'i yon tan bstan pa yis// tshes gcig zla ba nor bzang nya la rab tu rgyas//

// 177) ༄// gzhan skul rin chen 'bar ba sgam por gdugs phul dus mdzad pa// oṃ swasti/ nam mkha' rgya mtsho nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// sdug bsngal zad byed bdud rtsi dwangs ba'i rgya mtsho me long g.ya' dang bral// yon tan mtha' med dpag bsam ljon shing dgos 'dod re ba bskong*// sku gsung thugs la rdul tsam mchod pa yis// mun par zhugs pa'i sdug bsngal rigs drug rnams// gnyis med lhun grub sku gsum thob par shog /gang zhig chos kun gdod nas byang chub sangs rgyas pa// nyid kyis thugs su chud nas ma rtogs sems can rnams// rjes su bzung nas bzod par dka' ba'i brtul zhugs kyis// 'gro rnams smin mdzad bla ma mchog gi zhabs la 'dud// byang chub thugs gnyis dbyer med ro gcig pas// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo mchog 'dzin pas// 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur dus gsum rgyal ba dran// 'dir 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis ni rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje dang ni gcig tu gyur/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad skyed par byed pa'i rgyu/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis ni dbyer med/ thugs rje chen po rmad du byung ba'i ston pa shākya'i rgyal pos bstan pa rmad du byung ba'i theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di ni mnga' brnyes/ sngon gyi smon lam rnam par dag pa'i shugs rlabs po ches dad pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag dpag tu med pa mang po ni drung du lhags/ rang rkan gtsang zhing rgyal ba'i sras dam pa// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i pha phogs/ khams gsum gyi sems can smin par byed pa ni pha las bus byed pa yin pas/ cis kyang 'gro ba gzhan smin pa dang grol ba la 'bad par bya ste/

de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu de// rang gzhan gnyis kyi 'dod pa grub// 'khor ba mu mtha' med pa yi// sems can rnams la smin gyur cig /ces gsungs pa dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo las kyang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pas ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyud mi gcod do// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ lha mo dpal phreng gi mdo las kyang*/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yin la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i nang du ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad 'dus par 'gyur te/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du chu thams cad 'du ba dang 'dra'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang dam pa'i chos dang dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa po ni gnyis su ma mchis te/ dam pa'i chos pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de nyid/ dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa po de nyid yin no zhes gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dam pa'i chos/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum du 'dus la/ de nyams su blang ba'i rim pa bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum yin te/ de yang dang po lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab par rang gi srog bas phangs par 'dzin pa/ dper na rgya mtsho'i phar kha na mi gcig la rgya mtsho brgal ba'i rkyal pa gcig yod pa srin pos rkyal ba rangs bslangs pa ma byin pa dang*/ phyed dang*/ sum cha dang*/ lag mthil tsam gcig dang*/ tha na bsnyung bus gzugs sa tsam cig bslangs na yang*/ rkyal pa che chung ji tsam god kyang rgya mtsho brgal bar mi nus pa dang 'dra'o// zhes nas mi sbyin pa ltar/ ltung ba sde lnga gang gi nyes pa byung yang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal bar mi nus pa bcom ldan 'das kyis/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdor gsungs pa lta bu lags pas/

rang gi lus srog bas kyang phangs par 'dzin pa ni gzhir gyur pa yin te/ chang phor pa gang dang*/ ka ca sna sne'u gcig tsam la/ thub pa'i bstan pa rang gzhan gyi don tshong byed pa ni bya ba ma yin pa dang*/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg par/ sems 'dzin pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs pa spyi dang bye brag rdo rje'i theg par/ ma smin pa smin par bya ba'i go ba/ phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ phyi rol gyi 'byung ba rnam pa lnga/ gsang sngags rdo rje bla mas bstan/ go rtogs shes mthong ba re re la/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ spyir dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mnyam par bzhag pa phun sum tshogs pa re re'am/ lngas bsgrub par bya ba la mkhas pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin la sogs pa'i gsung rab rnams su/ 'gro na 'gro 'o zhes rab tu shes so// 'greng na 'greng ngo zhes rab tu shes so// zhes bya ba la sogs pa shin tu phra ba'i dngos po thams cad sems rtse gcig tu mi 'gyur bar med par bstan na/ da ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i dus 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba de spangs nas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi dga' bde lta bu don du gnyer ba lta ga la srid pa dang*/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ rgyu la brten nas 'byung ba/ rkyen la brten nas 'byung ba/ gsob/ gsog mi rtag pa/ phan tshun rten cing 'brel te 'byung ba/ kun rdzob byas pa la mi rtag pas khyab pa 'di'i skye bar byed pa'i rgyu/ gnas par byed pa'i gzhi/ 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la mkhas pa dang*/ de ldog par byed pa jo bo dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas/ 'khor ba la ji ltar ldog par byed pa'i tshul nyams su blang ba'i rim pas/

chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs/ lugs las ldog pa bstan pa dang*/ phra ba'i dbang du byas na zan kham gcig mngar ba dang*/ btung ba hub gcig zhim pa tsam yang*/ phywa dang*/ dbang phyug dang*/ byed pa po dang*/ nga dang*/ bdag dang*/ pho rgod dang*/ rang mthong gis byas par mi blta zhing*/ de rgyu gang las ji ltar byung ba dang*/ de ldog na mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa thams cad dpag tu med par snyan du gsol zhing*/ zhib rgyas su thugs su chud la/ yi ge snga ma ltar dgongs par bya'o// mdor bsdus na 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ni rang gi sems yin/ sems can thams cad rang gi bsam pa'i nang du bsdus nas/ bsam pa de dang gnyis su med pa'i spyod pa bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis/ sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa 'di rang gi rang gzugs la sangs rgyas zer ba lags pas/ khyed kyis sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa la 'bad par bya'o// slob ma'i rgyud la yon tan bskyed par mi nus pa rnams kyang tshogs skyong bar snang ste/ bla ma rin po che la nga'i mkhan pos/ sgom chen pa'i bstan pa nam nub par 'gyur zhus pas/ bla ma rtogs pa med pa gcig gis/ slob ma khrid pa de'i dus su bstan pa nub par 'gyur gsungs pa lta bu yin te/ phan pa med pa'i mi rnams kyang*// 'bad pa med par 'gyur na ko /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpal// ci yi phyir na btang snyoms mdzad// snying po med pa'i sbun pa la// rtog ge ba rnams rdung byed pa// mkhas pa chen po lo tsā bas// dbu ma'i phung pos bslus zhes gsungs// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal ba// 'dus byas ma yin snying po'i don// 'chi med bdud rtsi dam pa yis// sems can thams cad gso bar zhu// shes bya'i babs la mi gnas pa// rang sems stong nyid byang chub sems// bla med theg pa rab spangs nas// grangs med gsum gyi pha rol tu// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'ong ngo zhes// kha g.yos rkyang pas dus 'das na// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rtog pa thams cad spangs phyir ro// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa yi// sems nyid lhun grub byang chub de// phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun la// ci yi phyir na ngo mi sprod// chags sdang rmongs gsum dkyil 'khor du// ngo tsha med pa'i khyo ga dang*// sgom ma ngo tsha med pa rnams// sha chang sgog pa'i tshogs 'khor la// dam chos snying po yin zer nas// ngan 'gro log par ltung byed pa'i// mi yang pa por rloms byed na// mkhas dang btsun pa bsgrub pa dang*// dad dang gus dang dam tshig ldan// zang zing lus dang srog la yang*// mi lta ci gsungs byed pa yi// phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'dzin// rgyal ba'i sras rnams ci yi phyir// btang snyoms yal bar 'jog par byed// mthong dang thos dang dran pas kyang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bskyed// mi bzad 'khor ba'i rba klong du// sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i grogs rnams la// mi gtsang sred pa'i khyi bzhin du// sems can thams cad gnas gyur na// mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang*// reg pa dang ni dran pas kyang*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs byed pa// phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams// mi spang cis kyang skyong bar zhu// 'di dag thams cad gzhan don yin// rang don rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni// dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub snyam na// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// thub pa sras dang bcas rnams kyis// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du// sems can smin pa ma gtogs par// dben pa'i gnas su bcas pa yis// byang chub thob par gsung re rkan// drang srong chen po brtul zhugs spyod// dus gsum rgyal ba'i rjes su slob// khyed rang nyid kyis bcas pa yi// gnas brtan chen po bcu drug po// chos la gnas shing chos dang ldan// chos skyong bdag nyid chen po yis// thub pa'i bstan pa'i bar chad bdud// chags sdang rmongs gsum rgyu rkyen rnams// hūm̐ phaṭa pheṃ gyi 'brug sgra yis// dpong sar gnas pa'i khwa bzhin du// dal bus gsang nas bsgrub par bya// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// yun ring dar drag ldan par bya// dge 'dun rgyal ba ji bzhin du// lo re bzhin du brje ba 'am// bzang ba legs par rtogs pa yi// brtul zhugs thabs la ma gnas na// bcu drug po la yid mi brtan// med kyang ku re byas pa lags// legs par brtags nas byed pa 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// thabs la mkhas pa'i gsang tshig ces// thub pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// tshogs pa cis kyang bskyang bar zhu// zhu don gsol ba'i yi ge 'di// rgya gar yul du mi bzhud pa'i// gtsigs chen bzhi yi dang po la// tshogs pa skyong ngam dben pa bzhugs// khyed rang ji ltar dgongs pa las// nga yi zhe 'dod mi bsgrub pa// chad byas gtsigs su phul ba des// rigs shing 'thad pa ma lags kyang*// nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dus tshod du// nyi ma 'char bar 'gyur ba dang*// u dum wā ra'i me tog skyes// de tshe sangs rgyas 'byung bar 'gyur// phun sum tshogs pa'i dus tshod 'dir// dge 'dun tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bskyang*// gzhan bskul rin chen 'bar ba rin po che sgam por gdugs phul dus su mdzad pa rdzogs so//

178) ༄// gnyis med gcig tu gyur pa'i rnam thar lha pa mon sgom gyi slob mar springs pa// sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa yi// gang zag log shes dri ma yis// nyes tshogs sbyong bar mi nus pas// stong pa nyid la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas mya ngan yong mi 'da'// chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur zhing*// dge 'dun rgyun chad med pa zhes// nyid kyis gsungs shing dam bcas pas// bdag cag rjes zhugs thams cad la// thugs rjes brtse bar nyer dgongs la// nyes pa'i skyon rnams dag pa dang*// bslab pa mchog la gus pa dang*// shes rab rnam gsum skye ba dang*// zhi gnas lhag mthong 'brel ba dang*// rang byung phyag rgya chen po yis// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad gsol// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud// phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud// rdo rje 'chang nas nga yi bar// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi sras mchog ri khrod pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dam pa khyed// bdag la gsong por gsung ba yi// bka' bstsal shin tu thugs la btags// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa dang*// 'bras bu bdar sha gcod pa'i tshul// 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// gnyis med gcig tu gyur pa'i tshul// gong ma'i gsung gi gdams ngag la// nyams su blangs pas gnyis med pa// skyes chen khyed la rjes yi rang*// khyed kyi thugs dgongs de tsho dang*// bdag kyang gnyis su med par gnas// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag dang*// gnyis med ye shes gcig pa lags// 'on kyang bdag gi brtul zhugs ni// snang sems gnyis med gcig gyur pas// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje yis// mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad dran// 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa yis// pha rol phyin drug bsdu dngos bzhi// bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang phyag rgya ches// 'gro ba smin par byed pa yi// sems bskyed bsngo ba'i brtul zhugs bzung*// sred can bdag gi rnam thar 'di// skyes chen khyed la zhu ba lags// lha pa mon sgom gyi slom ma la springs pa'o//

// 179) ༄// rgya gar du gar log dmag gis gnod 'tshe byed skabs gsungs pa'i mgur// snang srid 'di dag chos kyi sku yin te// yon tan phrin las dag dang lhan cig ces// thub mgon bla ma rnams kyis gsungs pa las// bdag cag 'di ltar phongs shing sdug pa dang*// gnod pa bye ba mang pos gtses pa 'di// e ma ji ltar bya zhes bsam par rigs// log lta ma rig mun pas sgribs pa'i yid// bdag tu lta las nges par byung gyur pas// nam mkha'i padmo rmi lam bung bas 'jibs// sgrib gsum ri bos bsgribs par gyur pa la// sangs rgyas sku gsum snang bar ga la 'gyur// sangs rgyas bstan pa nub par mi 'gyur zhing*// rtag cing bde ba mi 'gyur gnas yin zhes// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs na yang*// deng sang dus su 'jigs pa chen po byung*// gdug pa'i skye bo stobs 'phel bzlog tu med// bslab gsum me tog phreng ba rnyid par gyur// shes rab rnam gsum bskyed pa'i skye bo dkon// bdag 'dra rmongs pa 'jig rten chos kyis khyer// rnal 'byor ming can 'dod yon chang gis myos// kye ma kye hud bstan pa gang na yod// rgyal ba'i bstan pa srid mtsho sgrol ba'i gru// 'dod yon chu srin gre bar tshud na ko /mya ngan 'das pa'i skam sar nam zhig phyin// brtson 'grus chen po rtsoms shig rang gi bu// thub pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// sems can thams cad nye bar zhi ba yin// sangs rgyas byang chub nyid dang mnyam pa dang*// zag pa zad pa skye shi spangs pa'i phyir// dge 'dun dkon mchog nam yang rgyun mi chad// gsungs pa'i don 'di nges pa bla na med// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi// gsung la nyams len snying por ma byas na// bdag cag 'khor ba pa rnams gang gis sgrol// chu bur rdol 'dra srog la ma chags par// rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin nyams su blang bar bya// rgya gar du gar log gi dmag gis gnod pa byas nas/

paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bod du byon pa'i dus su gsungs so// // 180) ༄// thugs kyi sras mchog ri khrod dbang phyug la gdams pa'i nyams mgur// 'gro kun sgrol bar dam bcas pa'i// rgyal sras bsam pa'i rjes su spyod// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// lta sgom spyod pa gcig pa'i phyir// dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la// mchod cing bsnyen bkur dga' bar byed// bsam pa gcig par gyur pa na// 'gro la phan par gyur na ko /phrag dog bya bar 'thad re na// chos la dpe mkhyud spang bar ni// thub pa chen pos gsungs pa'i phyir// 'jig rten mgon po'i rjes su bslab// gsang sngags gnad kyi man ngag rnams// rang gi bu la smin par bya// bsam gyis mi khyab rgyal ba'i gter// dpag tu med pa'i dam chos rnams// gdung rgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma la// sba bcab mi mdzad gnang bar zhu// nga la 'od zer yang yod de// de ming don rab ston ces bya// stong nyid rab tu rtogs pas na// de phyir de las skyes pa yin// nga la gdams ngag yang yod de// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// sku gsung thugs kyi brdas mtshon pa// nyams dang rtogs pa zhes bya ba// gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa yod// // 181) ༄// bag yod gsum dang ldan pa shin tu gces par byed dgos pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po skyob pa thugs rje can// chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan 'gro mgon rin po che// skyob mdzad bla ma de yi zhabs kyi padmo la// 'gro bcas bdag cag kun gyis rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar ma ni bu la rab tu brtse ba ltar// grib ma chu yi nang du 'bab pa ji bzhin dang*// nyi ma gser dang rin chen me dang bdud rtsi bzhin// bla ma rnams dang rgyal sras rje btsun ma yis skyob// lus can rnams la dge ba'i blo gros gang 'byung ba// gong ma rnams la nye ba'i byin rlabs mthu yin te// dad gus bsod nams bsag la brtson par gyur pa la// phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis nam yang stongs mi 'gyur// thub pa'i bstan pa ji ltar bskyang ba'i thabs// 'gro ba'i mgon po bcom ldan 'das kyis bsngags// rgyal pos sras kyi thu bor dbang bskur zhing*// nu bo la sogs 'khor ni rim bzhin bkod// 'jig rten blo yis khyod la ci bya ste// phyi mi nang mi mkhas pa rnams kyis shes// bdud kyi las ni shes nas bzlog par bya// bag yod gsum dang ldan pa shin tu gces// dpa' bo bdud bzhi grib rnams dbang du bya// rje btsun ma yi byin rlabs rtag tu bsten//

// 182) ༄// ting 'dzin rdzogs pa'i gdams ngag oṃ gyis ye shes las rdzogs// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to// phyag na rdo rje ras sam rtsig pa la sogs pa la gzugs brnyan bsgrub pa/ dmigs pa gang gis gsang sngags 'chang rnams kyi ye shes rdzogs par 'gyur zhing*/ ye shes rdzogs pas sangs rgyas nyid bde blag tu thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos pa'i gsang sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin/ gsang chen bshad par byas nyon cig oṃ gyis ye shes las bsgrubs pa// rgyal chen rnam par snang mdzad dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang*// rigs kyi lha mo yum rnams dang*// khro bo 'jig rten 'das pa dang*// 'jig rten pa yi lha rnams kun// ston pas rgyud las gsungs pa ltar// bris nas bsgom na ting 'dzin rdzogs// bdag gi bla ma dam pa yis// rab gnas shin tu gces zhes gsungs// rang gi rnam par rtog pa la// sprul sku bdag nyid chen po rnams// mkhyen brtse sgrib pa mi mnga' bas// bzhengs pa'i lha sa la sogs pa// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa gsum gyi gdams ngag dad pa'i dpe bstan pa// a re 'dod/ a re 'dod/ nyams len med pa'i tshig rkyang la swa hā// zhes pa ni dge bshes stag ston gyi sngags so// dad can yin phyir chos la brten// shes rab ldan phyir yang dag rig /'di gnyis gtso bo shes rab ste// 'di yi sngon 'gro dad pa yin// slob dpon 'phags pa nyid kyis gsung*// rin po che yis bka' bstsal pa// mngon par ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin// dang dang 'dod dang yid ches pa'i// dad pa rnam pa gsum yin te// dang po dang ba'i dad pa ni// bla ma dkon mchog rten sogs la// dang ba'i dad pa skye bar bzhed// dad pa 'di ni mi brtan te// chu la ri mo bris pa 'dra// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// 'bul ba bsnyen bkur zhabs tog gis// mnyes par byed cing ngo mtshar yang*// tshig ngan sun cig kham gang gis// de ma thag tu med nas 'gro// chu la ri mo 'di re mad// 'dod pa'i dad pa gang zhe na// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma las// dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan thos// de la 'dod pa'i blo skyes pas// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// lus dang srog la mi blta bar// bsgrub bya sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs// dam chos rgya mtsho 'tshol ba 'di// zhe 'dod drag pos gdungs pa yin// gnam lcags thog gi char babs cing*// mnar med dmyal bar song na yang*// zhe 'dod drag pos gdungs pa des// rang gi zhe 'dod mi gtong ba// snying stobs can gyi spyod yul yin// nga yi gces se dge 'dun rnams// dang po zhe 'dod mi mnga' bas// dbu bsnyung zhabs bsnyung thugs mi 'gro// nga la de zer zhog la thongs// gti mug mun pas ldongs pa'i phyir// a bo gces so shin tu bden// dad pa 'di yi dpe bstan pa// sa la ri mo bris pa 'dra// bka' bstsal gsung ba 'di re mad// brgya la gal te brtul zhugs can// mtho dman phyogs bcu gang du yang*// mi blta brtul zhugs 'dzin pa des// 'dod pa'i don la ro myong ba// khyed kyi pa pha rje btsun gyi// zla dgu tha ma'i tshig gi don// nyams su myong na man ngag yin// shin tu zab pa'i gdams ngag 'di// rang gi bu la mi ston na// gzhan la phod pa ga la srid// snying rje phul byung bcom ldan 'das// shākya'i rgyal po chen po yis// rang gi thugs su chud pa'i chos// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal ba// 'dus ma byas pa bdud rtsi'i chos// su la bstan kyang mi phan pas// nags kyi nang du gnas bya zhes// bka' bstsal gsungs par gyur pa 'di// bden don thugs su chud pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// yid ches 'gyur ba med pa yi// rdo rje'i brag la bris pa yi// dpe yis legs par mtshon gyur pa// yid ches skyes pa'i dad pa la// 'gyur ba med pa'i 'di re mad// sku khams dwangs pa'i dus su mdzad pa'o/// /

184) ༄// don gyi snying po sems nyid dbyer med kyi gros 'debs kun tu bzang po'i dgyes gar// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// mnyam med bla ma dam pa rin chen dang*// bla med dkon mchog gsum dang chos skyong gis// bstan pa rgyas shing bkra shis bde legs shog /skyes chen gang zhig thub pa'i bstan pa la// bslab gsum dri med rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin// rnam dag tshul khrims dri ngad rab ldang bas// 'phags pa'i rigs can dam pa'i yid tshim byed// thub pa'i bstan la khyod kyis bya ba byas// bde gshegs gsung rab rab 'byams rgya mtsho las// nyi zla lta bu'i shes rab rtsal mnga' bas// mi shes mun pa'i tshogs rnams sel mdzad pa// mkhas pa chen po khyod ni lhang nger mdzes// rgyud dang 'grel pa man ngag ji bzhin don// rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa rgya mtsho rnams// thugs su chud cing 'gro ba smin mdzad pa// mnyam med bla ma khyod ni gsang sngags bdag /sangs rgyas dngos nas don brgyud ma chad pa// thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gis// rin chen gter kha 'byed cing rnam grol bas// khyed kyis 'gro ba dpag med smin par mdzad// byang chub sems gnyis dri ma med pa'i sku// nam mkha' ltar yangs dbye ba med pa yis// 'gro rnams smin cing dus gsum rgyal ba'i tshogs// bla mar bcas pa bla med mchod pas mchod// skyes chen khyed kyi thugs dang dus gsum gyi// bla ma bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs yid gcig /bdag nyid smin cing gzhan rnams grol mdzad pa// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral med do// rgyal ba rnams kyis yul dang yul can rnams// ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur bzhin// khyed kyis bzang ngan phyogs ris gzigs min te// kun tu bzang po dgyes pa'i gar mdzad lags// rgyal ba rnams dang de sras chen po rnams// ri yi rgyal po rab mdzes ngos yangs par// gdul bya padmo rgyas pa'i nags tshal du// mi yi seng ge dpa' bo rol cing brjid// dbang phyug 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mnga' bdag ni// mtshan ldan sras kyi rgyal sa 'dzin pa la// dgyes par 'gyur gyi padma hastas min// glang chen spyan gyis legs par gzigs par zhu// sa steng 'dzam bu gling 'dir 'jigs chen byung*// bstan pa'i dgrar gyur gar log stobs 'phel bas// ma ga dha sogs rgya gar shar phyogs bcom// phyi nang gnyis kyi rten rnams med par byas// bod la 'ong bar brtsams shing dogs pas 'jigs// rgya nag khyi than ji ltar yod pa dang*// chos kyi rgyal po mi nyag 'dug lugs rnams// dpa' bo khyod kyis thugs su chud par bas// dbus gtsang gnyis kyang sde yi 'khrugs pa bdo// phan par 'dod pa'i ljon shing rtsa nas 'gyel// don gyi snying po sems gnyis dbyer med pas// 'gro ba smin pa'i dus la deng sang babs// lung dang rigs pa man ngag rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa rgya mtsho yis// tshe thung yud tsam dus 'dir long med de// ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar// dang po kho nar don chen sgrub bo zhes// mnyam med 'jig rten mgon pos de skad gsungs// lo brgya nyi shu lon pa'i rgan po bdag

/khyed rnams kun gyis brten cing 'gro ba 'di// stobs ldan skyes bu lta bur snang na yang*// dran pa shes bzhin ldan pa'i yid mi brtan// ma g.yel ma g.yel deng sang dus la babs// bstan pa'i khur chen snoms shig glang po che// gdul bya rgya mtsho skyongs shig chos kyi rje// nyam nga bag tsha med pa'i seng ge bzhin// lhun po ri dbang lta bu khyod mdzes so// yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag po klu dbang bzhin// khyed nyid kun gyi tshad mar gyur na yang*// bla mar gyur pas brtse zhing gdung ba yis// yid la tshugs pa med par 'dug lugs brjod// nongs par gyur na mkhas rnams bzod par gsol// // 185) ༄// ngo mtshar ba'i dmigs pa gnyis pos slob ma skyong ba zung 'jug nyes sel// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab kyi// nyams dang rtogs pa mngon gyur pas// bslu ba med pa'i dam chos kyis// skal ldan smin pa'i thabs mkhas pas// bu la gdams pa dam pa'i chos// chos can bsam pa'i rang gzugs dang*// chos nyid mi bsam rang gzugs gnyis// bu yis thugs su chud mod kyang*// 'dus byas mi rtag g.yo ba yi// rnam par rtog pa yid mi brtan// rnam par rtog pa'i rgyu 'bras 'di// chu yi chu bur ji bzhin du// skad cig skye zhing skad cig 'jig /rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i tshul// mi rtag skad cig nyid du gzigs// lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// 'gyur med don la mi 'bral mdzod// 'dul bar bya ba'i slob ma la// dmigs pa gnyis po ngo mtshar che// 'khrul pa med pa yin mod kyang*// phyag rgya chen po khrid mdzod la// dmigs pa med pa skyong du chug /dmigs pa byung na gnyis po bya// zung 'jug gnad 'dis nyes kun sel// khyod kyi byams dang snying rje la// 'dzin pa'i mdud pa bsdams pa yis// dga' dang mi dga' skyes gyur na// chags dang sdang ba'i dug chen po// de las gzhan na med pa dgongs// gzhan phan zhen med snying rje zhes// dpa' bo bdud las rgyal bas gsungs// khyod kyis de ltar nyams len mdzod//

186) ༄// bsdus don tshig bzhi'i nyams len rje btsun ras pa la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ jo bo lha bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che gsum/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams kyis/ rgyal ba dang shin tu rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /bla ma rin po ches/ rje btsun ras pa'i spyan sngar zhu ba/ khyed sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po bsags pas/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che ni thob/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i gnas/ yul dbus kyi snying por ni sku 'khrungs/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che la tshul khrims kyi dri ngad kyis/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs pa dang*/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi thugs yid ni tshim par mdzad/ thub pa'i bka' la shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas pas/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad kyi don ni thugs su chud/ bla ma yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis/ bshad brgyud dang sgrub brgyud kyi gdams ngag rin po ches thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni gtams/ don gyi snying po sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa bar ma chad pa/ dpal nā ro pa chen po'i rjes su 'brangs pa yi/ bla ma nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu ni spyi gtsug gi rgyan du mdzes/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu'i dam pa'i chos rin po che sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs par gtams pas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur mi shes pa'i mun pa sel bar bzhugs pa la/ bdag kyang shin tu blo ba dga' zhing mchis/ slad kyis don zhu ba la/ nga 'bu yang na so rgas pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs kyang shin tu che zhing 'phel drags pas/ khyed yar la byon pa'i re ba shin tu che ba zhig yod pa yin pa la/ sgom pa chos mgon la dris pas/ spyan sngar thon pa shin tu dka' bar yod zer/ 'on kyang*/ 'das dang ma byon da lta dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum gshegs pa yi// gzhung lam dam chos rin po che// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa 'dis// rang rgyud smin cing gzhan rgyud grol// chos kyi rgyal po bla ma de// 'dod yon chang gi ros bzi nas// mkhas btsun thams cad khyad du gsod// bslab bsrung tshul khrims lhod par song*// 'bras bu chos brgyad don du gnyer// rang la re ba'i gnyen bshes dang*// re ba chen po'i chos kyi rje// bstan pa'i khur snoms bla ma rnams// yid shi re thag ma chad par// mnyes par mdzad pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// khyed kyis lhag pa tshul khrims la// gces spras mdzad ces bdag gis thos// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// bla ma rnams dang 'bral med pa// pha bu gnyis kyi bsam pa 'dis// gnyis med gcig tu gyur pa yis// 'bral ba med par thugs la zhog

/yang gcig khyed la zhu lags na// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kun// byang chub sems 'di yod na 'byung*// med na mi 'byung rgyu 'bras pas// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde ldan sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod pas// bla med rin chen sems 'di las// rang la ltos khris med pa yis// brtul zhugs chen po'i go bgos nas// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad// brgya la gal te rgyal ba'i sras// chen po mang pos bla mar bkur// rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun gyis// mtshar snyan tshig gis bstod pa rtsom// yul ris rgyal khams thams cad kyis// rnyed bkur char bzhin phab pa'i tshe// mi pho a po rang nyid yin// khyi pho gzhan na yod dam sems// dma' ba rnams la rngan chen byed// mtho ba rnams la phrag dog skye// gzhan gyi bzang thabs mi bsam par// rang gi che thabs lhur len pa// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa'i// byang chub sems kyang gzhan nyid na// bla ma dus gsum bde gshegs dang*// chos skyong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// rang la re zhing ltos tshad rnams// sun phyung sgyid lug mi bskyed par// thugs dam ting 'dzin rgyal po dang*// rang rgyud zhu gtug mdzad nas kyang*// rang gi srog dang bsdos nas kyang*// thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba mnyes par byas// yab sras gnyis med gcig pa yin// rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa mchog /bla med gsang sngags theg pa la// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan 'das// 'gran gyis zla med rin po che// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// dus ngan dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir// gsang sngags log par spyad pa yis// nyon mongs drag po dug 'phel bas// rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro ba la// thugs rje chen pos ma bzod nas// gsang sngags ji ltar spyad pa'i thabs// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa la// bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa yi// rtsa ba'i ltung ba spangs pa'i gnad// ji ltar sgyogs dang 'khrul 'khor bzhin// rin chen tshul khrims gcig pu yis// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa// mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gsung*// rtsa ba'i rgyud dang phyi ma dang*// phyi ma'i phyi ma 'grel pa dang*// bla ma'i thugs dgongs gcig pa 'di// dpa' bo khyod kyis nyams len mdzod// brgya la gal te rnal 'byor pa// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi gnad spangs nas// dbus gtsang khams gsum mi nyag dang*// rgya nag khyi than 'dug lugs kyi// yul gyi bdud rtsi nyab nyab nas// sbrang ma rtsi la 'byar ba 'am// ri dwags rgya la 'thums pa bzhin// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 'di// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyi// sku gsung thugs su ma gyur na// rang dang rang gi gnyen 'dun dang*// chos kyi rgyal po rje blon dang*// snang srid byin gyis rlob mdzad cing*// bde ba chen por bsgyur byed pa// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// de las gzhan pa rin chen gsung*// nyon mongs gsum gyis bdag bsreg na// 'od kyis gzhan rnams mi bsreg pa// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gnad// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// nyon mongs sha chang tshogs 'khor rnams// rings pa rings par bsrings spangs pa yi// brtul zhugs 'di dang ma 'bral dang*// rdo rje 'chang chen rin chen dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad dang*// 'bral med gcig tu 'gyur ba la// nga dang mi 'bral smos ci dgos// bla med 'gro mgon chos kyi rje// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan gyis// tshad med thugs rje chen po yi// sangs rgyas gzhan gyis spangs pa yi// snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i zhing*// 'jig rten khams 'dir sku 'khrungs nas// thub pa'i gdul bya bdag cag rnams// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob mdzad pa// bla med rdo rje theg pa yi// yang snying phyag rgya chen po la// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yis// bstod pa rgya mtsho'i sprin bsdus nas// zab yangs 'brug gi gsung gis bsngags// grub thob rnams dang mkhas pa rnams// thams cad gong ma'i rjes su 'brangs// stong nyid rgya mtsho chen po yi// klong du 'o ma'i thigs pa ltar// rtsa ba'i gnad kyi man ngag stor// dus 'dir bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug tilli pa// mkhas pa chen po paṇḍi ta// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing*// 'phags pa na gardzu na dang*// bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i tshul 'dzin pa// rang sems rig pa'i rdo rje la// skad cig gcig gi shes rab kyis// skad cig gcig gis don rtogs pa// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyi// mkha' 'gro rdo rje'i gzeb chen las// skye 'dir sangs rgyas mchog nyid du// sems bsgoms pas ni sangs rgya 'o// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// thub pa chen pos gsungs pa de// tshig gcig gnad kyi man ngag gis// nā ro chen po grol bar mdzad// nā ro paṇa chen nyid kyi grogs// bram ze rin chen rdo rje dang*// kha che dgon pa ba gnyis kyis// tilli chen po'i zhabs la gtugs// rjes su gzung bar gsol ba btab// bdag nyid chen po'i zhal snga nas// ārya de ba klu sgrub dang*// bcom ldan 'das dang nga gtam byas// chos nyid bden pa nga yis mthong*// sa ra ha ni chen pos kyang*// rtogs pa nga la 'gran du med// sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya byung*// mi brjed gzungs thob nā ro pas// bcu gnyis bar du nga mnyes byas// nga yi rtogs pa kho la yod// phyi rabs sems can don gnyer rnams// rtogs par 'dod na kho la mthud// lung bstan bka' bstsal gsungs pa dang*// yang cig rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// nā ro chen po'i rjes 'brangs nas// mos gus rgya mtsho cher bsnyags te// rtogs pa nor bu rin po che// klu dbang gtsug nas len pa yi// ji ltar stong pa'i stong lugs kyis// pha tsha phye sgye'u bkang nas kyang*// dre'u rta'i rgyab khal longs par byed// mang po gcig la bshad snyam ste// ji ltar yin pa shes par dka'// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa// nā ro chen po'i brgyud pa 'di// tshig don gnyis la skyon med grags// tshig gi brgyud pa mang na yang*// don brgyud mos gus can gyis shes// thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa yi// thugs rgyud nor bu rin chen 'dis// skal ldan rgya mtsho lta bu yi// nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis med pas// dge 'dun smin cing grol mdzad zhu// ci zhig ltar ram re shig na// mos gus can gyi slob ma yis// dam chos zhu ba'i gnas skabs med// 'dod yon zang zing sna tshogs dang*// rgyal po yul khams zas nor dang*// bre mo gsang tshig man chung dang*// res 'ga' zhang zhung bshad pa skad// rgyal ba'i yum du gsungs pa yi// bdud kyi las tshogs thams cad kyis// blo gtad snying bzhag byas pa yi// slob ma mgo skor byed pa 'di// e ma snying yang mi rje 'am// khyed kyi pa pha rje btsun de// dka' thub kyis ni lus gdungs te// 'gro ba'i don gyis bsam pa gdungs// brtul zhugs kun gyi kun nas gdungs// thang chad 'o rgyal gyur na yang*// khrid dang dam chos zhu ba'i tshe// ja sun phyi ma mi len ltar// dus las mi 'da' brtul zhugs kyis// rjes 'jug slob ma smin mdzad zhu// 'di na 'di de 'di nyid ni// thub pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa yin// dus gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa yin// gong ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyud kyang*// mi gcod 'phel bar byed pa yin// 'di las gzhan pa'i zhabs tog med// rdzas dang nor gyis do ya min// nyams rtogs gnyis med bsgom pa yi// seng ge rgyal po lta bu yis// ri khrod gangs khrod 'gengs par zhu// rin po che yi zhal snga nas// rin po che yi ske reg gnas// rnyed bkur gyi wa gzan za za nas// nyams rtogs gnyis med kun ma brjed dam// skyes bu chen pos gsungs pas na// khyed kyis skal ldan smin mdzad zhu// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// ma lus bsdus don tshig bzhi la// nyams len nges shes gzhung shor na// bshad bshud man chung rig byed kyi// rkang grangs mching bu'i phung por yang*// nor bu rin chen re ba min// dbang gi rgyal po 'di bzhi dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhu// 'phags pa rnam par grol ba dang*// bla ma grub thob gong ma yi// gshegs shul rin chen tshig bzhi dang*// skyes chen khyed la 'bral ba med// mi 'bral chos kyi snying po 'di// skyes bu dam pa'i thugs la zhog

/'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid la// nyams len snying por byed par shog /brgyud pa gong ma gsol ba yi// na bza' ras kyi phyam rtse 'di// nyid kyi sku la mnams nas kyang*// 'gro ba sems can smin mdzad gsol// bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig/ // 187) ༄// tshogs drug dag byed rten 'brel bstan pa shes rab sgron me// na mo ratna gu ru/ badzra rā dza dharmā ka ya ni// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med bcom ldan 'das// ngo bo nyid sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// mnyam med bla ma rin chen 'gro ba'i mgon// yon tan 'byung gnas de la gtsug gis 'dud// bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas// tha ma'i shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag nas bde chen rgyun mi 'chad// byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// sgom du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /ces gsungs pa 'di ni/ chos kyi rgyal po rin po che sprul pa'i sku rtsod pa med par grags pa de dang*/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po tog tse pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'o// de la 'dir rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig sgrub pa yun ring po yang byas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa yang yod/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ khyod kyi 'di sgom gsha' ma yin gsung ba la/ yon tan ye ma skyes/ cis len pa snyam na/ tshogs drug ma dag pa gcig pus yon tan ma skyes pa yin te/ de dag bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad du yang*/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug gam brgyad dag na/

sangs rgya ba dang mi mthun pa ci yod de mthun pa kho na'o// de la tshogs drug gi dang po mig gi rnam par shes pa gcig pu la mtshon na/ dang po mig gis gzugs rab 'bring rnam pa gsum po gang yang rung ba gcig mthong ba'i dus su/ sngon gzugs sdug gu mthong ba la chags pa'i bag chags sad par byas nas/ 'di ni sdug cing yid du 'ong ba'o// zhes chags pa'i rnam par shes pa skye ste/ de la sred cing len pa'i sred len gyi lha mi la sogs pa ci rigs su skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ gzugs mi sdug pa mthong ba'i rkyen gyis sngon yid du mi 'ong zhing mi sdug pa'i zhe sdang gi bag chags sad par byas shing*/ 'di ni bdag gi dgra'o// bdag mi 'dod pa'o// zhes de ltar zhe sdang la chags pa'i sred len des dmyal ba la sogs pa rigs drug ci rigs su skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ de thams cad rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa las skyes zhing*/ tshogs pa med na mi skye ba mi shes pas gti mug pa'o// rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa lugs las 'byung ba ni/ sngon chags pa dang sdang ba la sogs pa bag chags kyi sa bon rgyu nges pa dang*/ rkyen mig dang gzugs la sogs pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ dgra'am gnyen du 'dzin pa'i rnam par shes pa byung ba mi shes shing*/ ma shes pas gzugs sdug pa blang byar byed pa dang*/ mi sdug pa dor byar byed pa dang*/ yang 'dis nga la gnod pa 'di byas/ nga snying re na/ brang re tsha/ tshig pa re za/ ngas 'di la pha sha snying nad cig ma lon na/ nga pho khyo ga ma skyes pa yin snyam pa dang*/ yang 'dis nga la phan 'di btags/ phan 'di lta bu gcig btags pa'i lan ma lon na shi yang dbugs 'gror mi btub snyam pa la sogs pa chags pa dang*/ zhen pa dang*/ 'chums pa rnams ni/ rgyu bag chags kyi sa bon mig dang gzugs kyis sad par byas nas/ mig gi rnam par shes par 'gyur ba/ rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa las skyes pa/ rkyen las skyes pa/

glo bur ba/ mi rtag pa/ nga dang bdag med pa/ sus kyang ma byas shing byed pa po med pa de ma go bas gti mug par 'gyur ba dang*/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ mig ni mig gis stong*/ gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong*/ mig gi rnam par shes pa ni mig gi rnam par shes pas stong*/ zhes gsungs pa ma shes nas/ bdag gi mig gis gzugs rnam par shes so snyam pa ste/ don du bdag gi mig gis dgra mthong zhing dgrar shes pa la sogs pa ni mig gis rnam par shes pa'o// tshul de dang 'dra bar rna bas sgrar rnam par shes pa dang*/ snas drir rnam par shes pa dang*/ lces ror rnam par shes pa dang*/ lus kyis reg byar rnam par shes pa dang*/ yid kyis chos rnam par shes pa rnams ni snga ma dang 'dra bar rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa las skye ba dang*/ gdod nas ma skyes pa spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba ma rtogs pa la gti mug ces bya ste/ chags sdang rmongs gsum 'dis rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi tshul du 'khor ba ni tshogs drug ma dag pa'i dbang du byas pa'o// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi chad/ ces pa ni rnam par shes pa tshogs drug po de nyid phyag rgya chen po rtogs shing rab 'byams rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug 'ba' zhig tu song bas/ chags pa'i yul la mi chags/ zhe sdang ba'i yul la mi sdang*/ gti mug pa'i yul la mi rmongs pa ni dag pa'o// bde chen ni gnyis te/ mnyam pa nyid bde ba chen po de nyid spros pa'i zug rngu thams cad dang bral bas bde ba chen po rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ de nyid kyi yon tan/ dbang po lnga rnams gzhan gyur na// don kun 'jug dang thams cad kyi// yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung*// 'byor ba dam pa thob par 'gyur// zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ bral ba'i yon tan mngon par shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa dang*/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu rgyu'i dus na bsod nams kyi tshogs ji ltar bsags pa'i 'bras bu/

byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi dbang du byas pa de gnyis dang mnyam du 'bras bu 'byung ba'i bde ba chen po rgyun mi chad pa shin tu yang 'byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ byang chub la yon tan dang phrin las 'byung ba dang*/ bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad las kyang chos kyi sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ sprul pa'i sku ji ltar 'byung ba dpag tu med pa rnams kyis shes so// des na 'di ltar rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// mig med pas ni gzugs rnams mi mthong ltar// tshogs drug ma dag par ni yon tan rnams// mthong zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ba mi srid de// chags dang sdang dang rmongs par gyur pa yi// sgrib pa'i ri bos sgribs pas ye shes mig /mkhyen gnyis tshul gcig ro mnyam chen po las// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i yon tan rnams// chags sdang rmongs gsum bral na mngon du gyur// de ltar bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung gis kyang de ltar nges/ nga rang yang yid ches pa la/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags su gsang ba kho nas 'grub pa gcig gsungs pa dang 'gal ba ma yin nam snyam pa na/ de ni gong ma dang 'gal ba ma yin te/ gsang sngags pas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba lung nas kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi bkas/ dge ba ni spyoms par mi bya/ sdig pa ni bcab par mi bya'o// zhes bcas shing gsungs pas/ sdig dang mi dge ba gang yang rung ba// bcabs shing gsang na 'phel ba dang*// spyoms shing bshags na 'dzad pa la// dgag sgrub gnyis kyi bslab pa yi// gzhi rnams phal cher gsungs pa yin// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab par yang*// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i// rtsa ba byang chub sems nyid kyang*// gya tshom du yang mi bsgrags cing*// gsang ba nyid du gsungs gyur na// rang spyod bslab pa'i gzhi rnams kun// spyoms shing bshags par gyur pa yis// zad par gyur ba gshis su nges// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa las// rang rgyud byin gyis rlob pa yis// lha dang bla ma gsang ba dang*// lta ba sgom pa spyod pa dang*// grogs dang rdzas dang sngags dang ni// phyag rgya bgrang phreng la sogs pa// thams cad thams cad gsang bar gsungs// rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas// rnal 'byor pa yi lus dang gcig

/gzhon nu ma yi nu ma dang*// rang la skyes pa'i nyams myong gsum// 'di gsum sbas shing gsang na legs// snying por bka' stsal gsungs pa dang*// chos rgyal bla ma'i zhal snga nas// mi spyoms gsang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung*// dpag tu med pa gsungs pa yis// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs shing*// gegs sel bogs rnams thon pa yi// rgyu mtshan zab mo gang yin pa// legs par nyon la thugs la zhog /dper na gser srang lnga brgya tsam// dpung med nus pa chung ba'i mis// dgra yi yul du bsdad nas kyang*// nga la 'di dang 'di yod ces// ngoms shing spyoms par gyur pa ni// nor dang tshe srog bar chad du// cis kyang 'gyur ba de bzhin du// lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma 'dir// snyigs ma bdo ba'i dus la babs// thub pa'i bstan pa 'jig dus su// gdug pa'i lha 'dre gdug pa can// bgegs dang bar du gcod pa rnams// glags lta bar du gcod pa la// lha dang bla ma la sogs pa// gsang sngags nor bu rin po che// gsang bar bya ba ma gsang na// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// bgegs dang bar du gcod pa yis// 'phrog cing bar du gcod par nges// 'di ni phyi yi rten 'brel lo// de la nang gi rten 'brel ni// 'og min gnam gyi yang steng du// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// ye shes bdud rtsis mnyes byas nas// rdo rje 'dzin pas gang gsungs pa// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong ma lus ji snyed pa// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i gnad// thabs dang shes rab zab mo yis// ma lus ji ltar 'gyur ba rnams// gsang bas 'grub pa kho na dang*// ma gsang de las bzlog pa ni// nges pa kho na ma yin nam// mdor na gsangs dang ma gsang las// skyon dang yon tan gang yin pa// gzhan du med par mkhyen par mdzod// nang gi rten 'brel bstan pa'o// ༈ //gsang ba'i rten 'brel bstan pa ni// dper na lteng ka rnyog ma can// dkrugs shing rnyogs par gyur pa yis// btsog cing snying du mi sdug cing*// btung ba'i bya ba mi byed de// shin tu dwangs zhing gsal ba yi// nyi zla skar ma la sogs pa'i// gzugs brnyan 'char du mi btub ste// 'di ltar sna tshogs longs spyod du// rung bar 'gyur ba ma yin ltar// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le rnams// rdo rje'i lus su gang gsungs pa// nyon mongs gsum pos gang dkrugs pa// bral dang rnam smin yon tan gyi// rang gzhan ji ltar smin par gyur// 'di yang sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum la// sbas shing gsangs par gyur pa yis// thub pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'di// gsang ba gcig pus 'grub pa yi// gsang ba'i rten 'brel zab mo 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// des na rang skyid gang 'dod pa// lus nyams sems nyams rmi nyams sogs// bzang por gyur pa srid tshad rnams// srog la babs kyang mi bzla ste// nam mkha'i dbus su sba bar bya// nam mkha' dang mnyam yon tan gyis// rang gzhan smin par gyur pa 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// yon tan dgongs dang rnal 'byor pa// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs nas mchi// gsang sngags gsang ba bstan pa yis// gsang ba'i rten 'brel bstan pa 'o//

༈ //bu 'dus byas thams cad glog dang chu bur 'dra// tshe srog mi brtan yun ring sdod long med// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho gting mtha' ring*// snying phur chen po tshugs shig rnal 'byor pa// bu snying gtam tshig cig khyod la 'chad pa ni// gshin rje mgul khug sro ma can// khyod la bde legs thams cad ster// seng ge rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub sbyin// glang

shing mkhar khang bu par cha gdan dug po ngan ngon gsum// sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub// gcud pa gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor gyis// gang 'dod gnas su phyin par byed// khyod ni nga yi nye gnas yin// snying khrag gnad kyi gdams ngag 'di// nye gnas khyod kyi thugs la zhog /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bogs gong nas gong du 'don par byed pa/ sgrib pa'i bud shing thams cad bsreg par byed pa'i me chen po/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs las 'byung ba dang*/ lugs las ldog pa snang bar byed pa/ shes rab sgron me zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 188) ༄// phyag chen bstan bcos don nges par bkod pa'i rgyal mtshan// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mig gcig pu// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun// thams cad mkhyen pa mnyam med rin po che// 'gro ba'i dpal du gyur la 'dud byas te// blo gros ngan pa 'khrul pas rab bsgribs pas// sangs rgyas gsung rnams khyad du bsad pa yis// thams cad mkhyen pa shin tu ring gyur pas// bla ma'i gsung sgros rang la gdams phyir bri// gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams gsang sngags kyi rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu mi shes pas/ bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba ni nam mkha'i me tog bzhin te/ de'i phyir na tshe 'di dang bar do dang phyi mar phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis de'i rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu la gnas par bya ste/ de la rgyu gang zhe na/ gnyis te/ gzhi 'am rtsa bar gyur pa'i rgyu dang*/ nyams su blang pa myur du 'grub pa'i rgyu'o// lam la yang gnyis te/ dbang bzhi'i lam rim gyis pa dang*/ cig car ba'o// 'bras bu la yang gnyis te/ rang don phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'o// de la gzhir gyur pa ring ba'i rgyu ni skyabs su 'gro ba thun mong ba nas bzung ste/

so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi sdom pa dang smon 'jug gnyis kyi sdom pa rin po che dam bca' brtan po las byung ba/ srog gi phyir yang mi gtong zhing*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi dus dang rnam pa thams cad bde ba dang skyid pa'i 'byung gnas 'di gcig pur ma go na/ gsang sngags kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa'i rtsa ba dang gzhi med par gyur pas gsang sngags kyi yon tan 'byung ba gtan mi srid do// nyams su blang ba myur du 'grub pa'i rgyu ni dbang rnam pa bzhi ste/ de yang rgyu'i dbang ni bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gcig la dbang rnam pa bzhi ngo 'phrod pa gcig dgos te/ dbang bskur ba des dbang gi go ba dang mngon par rtogs pa ma skyes na mgo thog tu bum pa bzhag nas/ chu bo chen po gang gā la bshan gshal pa dang*/ khyi dang phag pa'i spyod lam dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bud med thams cad la 'dod pas log par g.yem pa rgyun ma bcad kyang*/ dngos grub rnam pa gnyis lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ 'dod chags nyid kyis 'dod chags 'dag srid pas srid pa 'dag par byed pa'i rgyur ma song bas lha mi'i go 'phang tsam yang thob mi srid de/ phal cher dpon slob thams cad rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro dgos pa dgongs pa 'dus pa la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams su gsungs so// de la dbang rnam pa bzhi'i lam ni smin par byed pa'i dbang*/ rgyu'i dus su bla ma la ngo 'phrod pa de/ lam dus su grol bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis su 'dus te/ de yang bskyed pa'i rim pa lta bu zhig la mtshon na/ lus yi dam lhar gsal bas tha mal pa'i lus dag lus de la brten pa'i na tsha dang 'dre dang*/ 'go bar byed pa'i lha dgu dang*/ lus srung bar byed pa'i chos skyong thams cad dang*/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang*/ pha ma dang gnyen 'dun thams cad dang 'bral bar 'gyur te/ de skad du a mo gha pa sha chen po'i rgyud las kyang*/

gang tshe dngos grub 'byung ba'i tshe// de tshe las kyang ldog par 'gyur// zhes pa la sogs pas mdor na las kyi sgrib pa mtha' dag spong bar 'gyur te/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad kyang rang shugs kyis 'dag par 'gyur ro// slob dpon chen po dpal ldan birwa pa'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ tha mal ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dang bral ba'i 'bras bu bzhi thob nas zhes pas/ spang bya gang spong*/ dri ma gang 'dag mi shes par res 'jig rten pa'i bya bzhag mthar thon pa zhig sgrub/ res thos pa dang bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa'i 'bras bu thams cad kyang khe bkur dang rnyed pa phran tshegs zhig tu sgrub/ res 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad rtsol sgrub la ma ltos par lhun gyis grub par 'ong bar 'dod pa'i nged kyi bsam pa de lta bus/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags de sngon sus bsgrubs/ da sgrub pas sus 'grub ste/ de yang*/ 'khor ba res su 'dre byed na// sa thob pa la yun ring thogs// zhes so// des na da res sgrub pa de ltar mi bya ste// tshe 'di ltos pa rab bcad nas// sha khrag sdug bsngal phung po la// nye bar 'khor ba'i na tsha dang*// rang dbang med pa'i gshed ma ni// gdug pa'i lha 'dre gtum po rnams// nyon mongs gdug pa'i dug rnams kyis// rang gzhan thams cad brlag byed cing*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal mtha' med du// rang dbang med par khrid pa dang*// yul dang phyogs ris gnyen 'dun yang*// bdag 'dzin mnga' thang rgyas par byed// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ru// rang dbang med par khrid pa la// bdag lta dga' bar ji ltar 'gyur// 'jigs pa 'di la skyob pa'i skyabs// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// ku re kyal ka ma lags par// snying nas skyabs su 'gro ba na// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /rang byung khros pa'i rgyal po ni// bskal pa'i me ltar rab 'bar bas// khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi// sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg mdzad pa// che mchog dpa' bo he ru kaḥ

/yid smon yul du ma shor bar// rang nyid lhun gyis grub par bsgom// de goms par byed pa'i dus su mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad bsgrub cing 'gal ba'i rkyen thams cad spong bar bya ste/ de yang rgyu'i mthun rkyen tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang*/ stong pa nyid dang*/ gnas kyi mthun rkyen bkra shis shing*/ 'du 'dzi dang ca co dang ga zha la sogs pas dben pa'i nags tshal la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas su/ grogs kyi mthun rkyen tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan po dang ldan pa/ tshul khrims dang lhag pa'i bsam pa la g.yo sgyu med pa'i rang rgyud zhi zhing dul bar gnas pa dang 'grogs pa'am/ yang na gcig pu'o// rdzas kyi mthun rkyen pan tsa a mṛ ta// nyams myong 'bar bar byed pa'i rdzas// thabs dang shes rab la sogs pa// bcud kyi len dang sman gyi tshogs// bza' bar bya ba thams cad dang*// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud rnams su// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa yi// rdzas kyi mthun rkyen thams cad bsten// yang 'gal rkyen spang bar bya ba ni// mthun rkyen rnams dang 'gal ba ste// de la gnyis/ dngos grub 'jig cing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar byed pa/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ bsgrub pa byas kyang yun ring por dngos grub mi thob pa bza' bar bya ba'i dam tshig rnams log par rtog pas ma bzos pa dang*/ gzhan nye bar 'grub pa'i mthun rkyen de bzhin gshegs pas rgyud rnams su gsungs pa shin tu phra bar mngon pa rnams ma bsrungs pa dang*/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig rang gi rgyud byin gyis rlob par byed pa'i yi dam gyi lha dang bla ma'i rten dang bral ba dang*/ mdor bsdus pa'i gnad dam tshig thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig chen po ni rang gi sems yi dam gyi lha dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral ba'o// de ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa des yi dam gyi lha rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor 'di las/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin du gnas par/ theg chen gsang sngags thams cad dang*// rnal 'byor bla med rgyud rnams dang*// khyad par ma rgyud thams cad du// rgyal bas gsungs pa ma mthong ngam// rang nyid nyams myong med pa dang*// gsang sngags don go ma go zhing*// log shes nying 'khrul gyur pa rnams// gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs gnyis po de// lhun gyis grub par gnas pa la// don spyi sgom par 'dod pa rnams// don rang gi mtshan nyid gang la byed// sangs rgyas gsung dang mi 'gal lam// med kyang ku re bgyis pa lags// ku sā li yi rnal 'byor rnams// chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyis// rgyun chad med par bsgoms lags na// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs nas mchi// tshig gum nyo yang mi dgos par// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rnams// ngang ngam shugs kyis go nas mchi// sbas pa'i gsang sngags zab mo rnams// grangs med gsum la mi re bar// skad cig gcig gis rtogs nas mchi// bum dbang bskyed pa'i rim pa yi// rnam par bzhag pa zur tsam lags// zhib tu bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis go /de ltar bum pa'i dbang 'di dang*// gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang*// bzhi pa dbang 'di thams cad kyis// phra rags lus ngag yid gsum dang*// gnyen po rang sar dag pa la// bum dbang la sogs so so yis// gtso bo byas pa'i dbang bzhi rnams// gong nas gong du na 'pho zhing*// sangs rgyas sku lnga thams cad la// rgyun chad med par len pa la// 'gro ba'i mgon po birwa pas// dbang lam gyi 'khor lor bzhed pa yin// don rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la// sku gsum lhun gyis grub par bzhugs// birwa chen po'i dgongs pa ste// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor na// rang bzhin rnam dag rigs lnga bzhugs// dbang bskur bzhed na de la mdzod// zab mo zab par gsungs pa lags// dbang rang la len par ma go na// gzung 'dzin bum pa'i sbreng chu yang*// mkhas pas rmongs par mgo skor yin// dbang bzhi mthar thug rdzogs pa de// sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa yin// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// rim gyis pa yi rnam bzhag go
