/rim gyis pa yi sman chen 'di// cig car ba yi dug tu 'gyur// cig car ba yi sman chen 'di// rim gyis pa yi dug tu 'gyur// 'di gnyis bsre bslad med par gces// cig car ba zhes bya ba ni/ gang zag dbang po rab kyi chos yin la/ dbang po rab de bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa rab tu gyur pa la zer gyi/ kha cig ltar na rgyu med las skye ba dang*/ gong du tshogs gsog mi dgos pa'i de bzhin gshegs pas gsung pa'i chos thams cad kyang don med cing*/ kha rje'am stes dbang gis rtogs par 'dod pa'i rgyu 'bras la skur ba btab pas de mi rung ba kho na'o// 'o na pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg par brtson 'grus dang dbang po'i bye brag gis bskal pa grangs med pa gsum dang*/ sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs par sangs rgyas par bshad/ dge bshes ston pas slob ma mos gus can dang bla ma tshad ldan dang phrad na sngags kyi sgor ma zhugs kyang tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas thob tu rung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu lta bu gsung skad/ gsang sngags su tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas thob pa dang*/ nyi ma gcig dang*/ gnyis dang*/ gsum gyis thob pa dang*/ skad cig ma gcig gis thob pa la sogs pa mtho dman dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad kyang don gcig ste/ kha cig ni rgyu la dgongs/ kha cig ni lam la dgongs/ kha cig ni 'bras bu la dgongs pas mi mthun pa med do// de la la la dag ni mir gyur tshad thams cad bsags pa gcig tu thag bcad nas nged so so'i skye bo bskal pa grangs med pa gsum la sogs par bsod nams kyi tshogs da gzod gsog dgos pa yin zer te/ de ltar gyur na rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa yang mi yin pas da gzod bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog dgos par 'gyur ba dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa gong du song na/ rgyu sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu la longs spyod pa tshe 'dir sangs rgya ba la 'gal ba med do// yang bstan pa gcig la ston pa gnyis mi 'byung zhes zer ba 'dug ste/

de ltar gyur na sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun chad cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor yang mi 'gro/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i 'bras bu med/ gzhan de lta bu'i gtam de de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab na yang mi bzhugs/ bon 'bum na yang dang yang du gtam gyin 'dug ste/ de de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la phrag dog byed par go bas lung du mi che'am snyam/ don gyis na bsags pa sngon du ma song ba'i cig car ba ni mi srid pa kho na yin no// de la bsags pa sngon du song ba'i bye brag ni/ smon 'jug gnyis la sngon du sbyang ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi bum pa'i dbang la sngon du sbyangs pa dang goms pa de mthar phyin pa dang*/ gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes dang*/ dbang bzhi pa la sngon du sbyangs pa de'i 'phro la rnal 'byor pa de 'chi ba'i dus byas nas gar skyes kyang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje dang smon lam de de'i las sad par byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rtswa dang shing dang nags tshal dang*// 'od dang 'od zer dag dang ni// lha dang klu dang mi 'am ci// gnod sbyin srin po lha ma yin// snod dang bcud kyi sems can dang*// sangs rgyas zhes bya sems can dang*// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas tshul gyis// sngon gyi las 'phro sad par byed// de la cig car bsam mi khyab// tshu rol mthong ba'i rmongs pa rnams// cig car ba zhes bzhed gyur kyang*// bsags pa sngon du song ba yi// 'bras bu dus 'dir sad pa yin// rten gyi gang zag de dag la// pho tshod med pa'i bla ma rnams// mdo rgyud zab mo ma mthong zhing*// nyams rtogs khong nas ma shar ba// rmongs pa mang po mgo skor mkhan// tshe 'di'i che thabs skyong ba yi// gos bgab ring po'i dge bshes rnams// yon tan ngo sprod mi shes pas// bsags pa'i las can gang zag la// bdud kyis khyer zhes skur pa 'debs// rang gzhan thams cad sreg par byed// yon tan bogs 'don ma shes pas// 'di yin des chog gdams ngag bstan// yon tan bogs 'don ma shes pas// phal cher ngan sar ltung nyen che// rten gyi gang zag de dag la// dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas// sngon sbyangs goms pa'i stobs yod kyang*// bsod nams bsags pa chung ba 'am// mos gus ltem rkyang byung gyur pas// rgyud smin pa'i bla ma ma 'dzoms na// zhe 'dod tung tung gi kha na med// lham zhabs zad pas kyang phan pa min// rgyal khams bskor bas kyang rnyed pa min// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can la// snying rje chen po las byung ba// byang chub sems kyis bslangs byas nas// mos gus rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs kyis// gdong mchi mas brlan pa'i ngu shugs kyis// rgyud smin par byed pa'i bla ma de// thugs mi bskyod rgyal po'i ngo bo ru// gdan bzhi brtsegs pa yi steng du bsam// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang*// gnyis su med pa thams cad la// mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag med pas// rgyun chad med par mchod bya zhing*// dbang bskur rgyun chad med par longs// yi ge brgya pa la sogs kyis// dam tshig nyams pa'i dri ma sbyang*// yon tan bskyed pa'i bla ma dang*// 'phrad pa'i gsol ba btab byas na// nged kyi bla ma gong ma ltar// rgyud smin pa'i rje dang mjal nas kyang*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs gyur cing*// mchog gi dngos grub thob par nges// sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu yi// bla ma dam pas bka' bstsal gsung*// de cig car spyi yi rnam bzhag go

/rang byung phyag rgya chen po ni// blo yi yul du ma gyur cing*// kun brtags spros pas stong bas na// rgyu dang rkyen gyis bskyed pa med// gdod nas lhun gyis grub par gnas// 'gro drug 'khor bar 'khyams gyur kyang*// sems nyid gshis la 'pho 'gyur med// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis kyang*// sems kyi ngo bo mtshon du med// dpal ldan phag mo gru pas kyang*// dbang bzhis bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas su// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// blo yi yul du ma gyur pa// skyed byed pha rol phyin pa la// phyag 'tshal 'dud pa'i mdo nas gsungs// dpal sa ra ha yi zhal snga nas// sa dang lam dang sangs rgyas thams cad ro gcig pas// gnyug ma'i yid ni yid kyis yid la dris// blo las 'das na phyag rgya chen po ste// sa dang lam dang sangs rgyas sku gsum dang*// chos dang dge 'dun che bar grags pa rnams// blo yis mtshon na thams cad kun rdzob ste// de la mtho dman sna tshogs gang phye yang*// byis pas rang gi gnas lugs ma mthong bas// kun tu 'bad kyang 'bras bu ga la thob// gal te brjod du med pa'i don mthong na// 'di la mi mthun gang yang yod ma yin// bsam med phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs pas// rnam rtog 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras sna tshogs ni// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa sangs rgyas sems can zhes// bzang ngan chags sdang re dogs bdud rnams kyis// gnyug ma'i rgya mtsho chen po dkrugs gyur pas// rigs drug 'khor ba'i dba' klong chen po yi// rtag tu bde ba med par gyur ta re// kye ho/ spang bya dang ni gnyen po'i chos rnams kun// byas pa thams cad don med gyur pa ste// rtag tu mnyam nyid phyag rgya chen por sdod// de ltar rgyu'i dus su skyabs su 'gro ba thun mong ba nas bzung ste/

so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi sdom pa dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa smon pa dang 'jug pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dbang rnam pa bzhi la sogs pa rnams nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu mthar thug pa'i dus su/ sngon nyams su blangs pa'i lam de rnams thams cad kyis/ bdag nyid kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad sbyong zhing*/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad dag nas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i shugs kyis zhugs pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi go ba de thos pa dang bsam pa ma byas shing*/ chos kyi mig med pa'i rten gyi gang zag kha cig ni 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i dus su/ blo byas kyi stong pa dmigs yul du bzhag pa zhig la chos kyi skur byas shing*/ sems nyid gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa ngo ma shes pa'i skyon gyis/ nam 'chi ba'i dus su stong pa nyid du 'ong ba yin zhes zer/ 'o na stong pa nyid ci 'dra byas na nam mkha' lta bu yin te/ rang nyid kyang nam 'chi ba'i dus su/ sems nyid stong pa nam mkha' lta bu de dang*/ phyi rol gyi nam mkha' stong pa nyid dang dbyer med du phrugs kyis 'dres nas 'gro ba de las gzhan med de/ de yang sku gsum rnam par bzhag pa'i mdo lung 'dren cing*/ chos kyi sku ni nam mkha' dang 'dra'o zhes zer te/ mdo de'i dgongs pa yang gzung 'dzin mtha' dag gi spros pas stong pa'i ngos nas nam mkha' lta bu zhes dper bzhag kyang*/ chos kyi sku de la jo bo byams pas byang chub zhes ming du btags nas byang chub de la yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa thams cad kyang mdor bsdus na/ bral ba'i yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad rnams kyis 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar gyi dus thams cad nor 'khrul med par mngon du gyur pa mkhyen pa la sogs pa dang*/

rnam par smin pa'i yon tan sum bcu rtsa gnyis/ sngon rgyu'i dus su bsod nams kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsags pa thams cad kyi rnam par smin pa las grub pa/ sku la zhing khams thams cad snang zhing*/ zhing khams thams cad la skus khyab pa gdul bya'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad smin par byed pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa/ sa dang lam la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la snang ba dang*/ rab tu snang ba dang*/ shin tu rab tu snang ba'i sku de la yon tan gyi sku zhes bya bar lung dang bstan bcos thams cad du grags pa dang*/ yang chos kyi sku de yi phrin las bdag rkyen chos kyi sku spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba ste/ ji srid zhig par ma gyur gyi bar dang*/ gzhan rkyen sngon byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ smon lam gyi stobs kyis ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stong gi bar du/ lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun chad med pa'i tshul gyis/ chos kyi sku de nyid gdul bya'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/ sku'i rnam pa dang*/ gsung gi rnam pa dang*/ thugs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs su snang ste/ rta dang glang po shing rta dang*// glang po seng ge ri bong bya// snod dang bcud kyi rnam pa dang*// zhi ba khro bo sna tshogs kyis// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad// grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji snyed pa// gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis// gsung gcig du ni gsungs mod kyang*// du ma nyid du so sor go /kun gyis sems can smin par byed// sems can blo yi bye brag rnams// rgyal ba de la rnam par go /tshangs pa dang ni khyab 'jug dang*// lta ba drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*// 'gro drug so so'i bsam pa rnams// thub pa de la rnam thar snang*// nyan thos rang rgyal lta ba dang*// sems tsam dbu ma la sogs pa// 'dod blo bye brag thams cad kyang*// rgyal ba rnams kyis shin tu gsungs// lha yi theg dang tshangs pa'i theg

/de bzhin du ni rang rgyal gyi// byis pa rnams ni yongs drang phyir// theg pa sna tshogs ngas bstan te// ji srid rnam rtog yod kyi bar// theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med// lta ba'i rnam pa de dag gis// lta ba rab tu zhi bar sbyor// chos sku phrin las zab mo ste// bdag rkyen gzhan rkyen rten 'brel gyis// nges par 'byung ba lung rnams dang*// bstan bcos rnams su bshad pa ste// grangs med rnam pa gsum la sogs// 'bad pa drag pos bsgrubs pa yis// bla med byang chub rin po che// yon tan phrin las mi mnga' na// bsgrubs pa thams cad don med cing*// mdo rgyud rnams dang mi 'gal lam// yang nged mdo rgyud rnams la thug reg med// mgon po byams pa la sogs pa// bstan bcos mkhan po rnams kyis bshad// don gyi snying po phyin ci ma log pa bstan bcos su ma bkod snyam na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma dang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ mdo ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po dang gsum yin gsungs pas/ de gsum du sku gsum rgya cher rnam par bshad pa dang*/ dpal sa ra ha dang 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa rnams kyis sku yi rnam pa gsum rgyu 'bras kyi tshul du/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi 'bras bur gsungs pa rnams dang yang 'gal bas/ lta ba phyin ci log des rang gzhan thams cad phung bar zad do// yang mnyam pa nyid kyi don ma rtogs pas/ tshu rol mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag blo phyogs ris su lhung ba rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba zab mo blo las 'das shing*/ blo'i yul du ma gyur pa so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis 'jal bar byed pa rnams ni/ 'di ltar nam mkha' 'di la 'dom gang yod ces pa dang*/ mtho gang yod ces pa dang*/ sor gcig dang sor gnyis la sogs pa 'di yod mi mthun pas rtsod pa lta bu'o// de la thugs kyi gsang ba la rtsod pa rnams ni ye shes rgyun chad dam ma chad rtsod de/

kha cig na re dran rig 'di nyid rgyun ma chad pas je gsal du song nas sangs rgyas pa'i dus su mkhyen pa gnyis de la 'byung zhes zer te/ dran pa dang rig pa yin nam ma yin/ yin na dran rig de nyid 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi 'byung khungs ma rig pa chen por 'gyur zhing*/ des ni sangs rgyas kyi sa lta ci smos te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa yang mi thob ste/ dran rig dngos po yin pas/ dngos po 'dus ma byas kyis rab tu phye bas 'bras bu nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas yin par gsungs so// yang zla ba sgron ma la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rnams su sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ spros pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub par gsungs pa dang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las kyang*/ dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing*// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas dang po nas ma skyes pa ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa de'i pha rol na/ dran rig 'byung bar 'dod na ni ha cang yang dngos po la mngon par zhen drags pas dran rig 'dod pa kho na'o// yang blos byas kyi stong pa/ blo'i yul du byas pa'i stong nyid la mngon par zhen pas/ yang dag pa'i don ma mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag kha cig ni/ stong pa nyid nam mkha' la byas shing*/ sems dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyang nam mkha' la sbyor zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pas yang dag pa'i don byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams la nam mkha' rtogs sla ba dper brjod pa ma go nas rang gi blos brtags pa'i nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid blo la go bde ba byung nas des de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyi gsang ba ye shes la yar bkab ste/ ye shes med ces thag bcad nas des de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes la skur ba 'debs te/

ye shes zhes bya ba ni ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa tsam la skur ba btab pa dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes sems can gyi khams dang*/ bag la nyal ba dang*/ bsam pa'i tshogs dang*/ 'phags pa rnams kyi sa dang lam dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la sogs pa yin pas/ de dag thams cad la yang skur ba btab par 'gyur ba dang*/ log par rtog pa'i blo ci yang med pa yul du byas pas tshul khrims dang*/ sdom pa thams cad kyang glod par 'gyur zhing ngan song gsum du 'gro bar 'gyur te/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ yod pa po ni bde 'gror 'gro// med pa po ni ngan 'gror 'gro// gnyis la mi brten thar pa thob// ces pas/ med par 'dod pa'i blo gros can de gzung ba'i yul la 'khrul par gyur pas/ 'dzin pa'i shes pa 'khrul ba dang*/ 'khrul pa nyis brtsegs des skur ba 'debs pa'i mtha' la mngon par zhen pas med par 'dod pa ngan 'gror 'gro'o// yod pa bde 'gror 'gro ba ni/ dngos por 'dzin pa'i dug tu dran rig sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su 'dod kyang sems las byung ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel la tshig tshag shin tu dam pas/ spang bya dang gnyen po'i go cha bgos pa'i stobs kyis rgyu 'bras la nan tan byed/ tshul khrims gsha' mar bsrung*/ des bde 'gror 'gro ba'o// gnyis la mi brten thar pa ni// gang tshe nga la khas len yod// de tshe skyon dang bcas pa yin// gang tshe nga la khas len med// de tshe skyon med kho na yin// blo yi mtshon du ma btub pa// don dam brjod las 'das pa de// sgro skur gnyis dang rnam par bral// bsam med brjod du med pa de// brjod pa'i tshig gis mi rtogs pa// mkhas pa'i skye bos ma go 'am// brjod bral don gyi dbu ma de// sangs rgyas nyid nas da yi bar// nyams dang rtogs pa brgyud pa la// lhad dang bar chad ma zhugs pa// thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa yi// nyams rtogs ldan pa'i bla ma la// mos gus dus mtha' bsten pa yis// brjod med lhan cig skyes pa de// rtogs par 'gyur ba rgyal bas gsungs// sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che// rnal 'byor pa yi 'dzin par nges// gsang ba gsum gyi rnam bzhag kyang*// gnyis med go na go bar zad// gzhan du dmus long zla ba la// sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu yi// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// mdor na 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag ni// chos sku yon tan med pa dang*// phrin las 'byung ba stong pa yang*// brgyud pa'i bla mas ma gsungs shing*// chos sku dngos 'dzin chen por yang*// lung dang rigs pas mi 'grub cing*// rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i nyams la yang*// ha cang bde bar ma tshor te// mtha' gnyis bral ba'i dbu ma yang*// don dam spros pa med pas na// 'phags pa'i gang zag ma gtogs pa// rigs pas rtogs snyam mi bgyid pas// grub thob sprul pa'i bla ma la// mos gus bya ba ma gtogs pa// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang ba la// brtag dpyad bya ba'i gnyer ka med// 'on kyang bag chags bzhag pa yi// ma 'ongs byang chub thob pa ni// ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu la// kun nas dwang bas yi rang ngo*// smon lam yod kyang bsags pa chung ba yi// so so'i skye bo stong nyid dga' rnams dang*// dngos por 'dzin pa 'bras bur 'dod pa yi// bdag blo ngan pa'i phyogs su lhung gyur na// bla ma'i gsung 'dis bdag blo bskul phyir bris// nor cing 'khrul par gyur pa gang yod rnams// bla ma rnams dang chos mig can la bzod par gsol// dge ba dri med bdag gis gang bsags pas// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kun// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa// mthar thug phyag rgya chen po thob par shog
/bstan bcos don nges par bkod pa'i rgyal mtshan rdzogs so// //

189) ༄// gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan sgrub byed kyi rten 'brel// oṃ swasti/ tshogs gnyis mthar phyin bla ma rin po che// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po thugs rje can// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med don ston pas// 'gro ba ma lus smin par mdzad la 'dud// bu khyod drung na gnas pa rnams kyis/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis gsog pa gal che ste/ de la tshogs bsags ma bsags zhes bya ba'i go ba de yang bsam pa bzang ngan gyi rjes su 'jug pa las gzhan med de/ zhe sdang gi bsam pa'i rjes su zhugs na ni tshe 'di dang phyi ma gnyis kar zhe sdang gi bsam pa de'i las tshan che chung dang*/ yun ring thung gis gshags pa dang*/ gcod pa dang*/ gtub pa dang*/ dmyal ba dang*/ sdug bsngal rnams kyang ring thung du 'gyur ba dang*/ 'dod cing chags drags pa dang*/ 'chums pa pos yi dwags su 'gyur ba dang*/ glen zhing rmongs pas 'bu dang dud 'gror 'gyur ba dang*/ mi dge ba bcu spangs pa tsam gyis mir skye ba dang*/ gzhan la phrag dog pas gzhan dben par khrid nas sbyin pa byin nas lha ma yin dang*/ byams pa dang dge ba bcus lha dang*/ snying rje dang bsam gtan gyis gzugs kyi khams dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pas gzugs med kyi khams dang*/ sangs rgyas la dad pas de'i zhing khams dang*/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor shes shing*/ rang nyid mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ kun 'byung gi 'khor ba spong zhing*/ 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam rgyud la skyes pas ni nyan thos/ khams gsum gyi 'khor ba thams cad rten 'brel gyi tshul du 'khor ba las/ thabs mkhas pa zab mo lugs las bzlog pa'i tshul lugs ma rig pa 'gags pas/ rga shi'i bar du 'gag pa rtogs shing mngon du byas pa ni rang byang chub/ rgyu byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas lam pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa drug nyams su blangs pas/ sangs rgyas pa ni mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa/

mthar thug sangs rgyas gzugs kyi sku dang chos kyi sku da ltar dus gcig nyams su len pa ni gsang sngags 'bras bu lam du byed pa yin pas/ 'di rnams thams cad la sngon ji ltar goms pa dang*/ da ltar yang goms par byas shing byed pa dang*/ blo nges pa dang ma nges pa yun ring thung gi bye brag gis/ bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa'i tshogs bsags pa che chung dang*/ yun ring thung du 'gyur ba la bsod nams kyi tshogs dang bsod nams ma yin pa'i tshogs bsags pa che chung zhes zer ro// bu de la 'di rnams thams cad ni bsam pa 'ba' zhig yin la/ bsam pa ngan pa'i rjes su lus ngag zhugs pa rnams la ni/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung po khams gsum gyi 'khor bar 'khyams zhes 'phags pa rnams kyis smod pa'o// bsam pa bzang po dge ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa lus ngag gis ni mtho ris lha mi'i go 'phang thob cing*/ bde ba dang skyid pa de la ni mngon par shes pa thob pa'i drang srong rnams kyis bstod do// dge ba dang mi dge ba dang lung du ma bstan pa'i sems nyid nye bar zhi zhing ma skyes pa la ni/ ma skyes pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad nyams su len pa rnams la ni/ khams gsum las nges par 'phags shing mya ngan las 'da' ste/ de ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba ste sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs so// bu de rnams kyang rang gi bsam pa yin la/ 'gyur ba mi rtag pa ji ltar bsams shing byas pa de ltar 'gyur ba de rigs shes zer ba yin/ ji ltar byas byas su 'gyur bas dpe med pa'i ha cang dka' bar yang mi 'dug bsam pa yin pa ni 'dra/ bsgrub pas chog bsam ngan gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i sdug bsngal yang bzod par ni dka'/ chu 'bog brgal ba lan gcig la brje bcang lan gnyis kyang mi nus pas/ da lta nas theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sgor 'jug par bya'o// de gang yin yang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis kyis nyams su blang ste/

de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ nged kyi lugs kyi tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu bzhed pa yin gsungs/ de yang nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ rgyu'i zung 'jug sbyor ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas skyed rdzogs gnyis nyams su len pa dang*/ rjes kyi gnas skabs su lus ngag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba la 'bad cing 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i mi dmigs pa'i bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa de yin/ lam gyi dbang du byas na rang nyid la dge sbyor cig rgyud la skyes pa'i dus su ci dang ci byed pa thams cad rang gi dge sbyor dang dbyer med par/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ brtags pa'i bag chags snang grags 'di// chos sku yin par btsir gyis zungs// rang la skyes pa'i rnam rtog 'di// don dam yin par btsir gyis zungs// zhes pa ltar gnyis med 'ba' zhig tu nyams su myong ba'i dus su lam gyi zung 'jug gsha' ma yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba smin pa'i rten 'brel bsgrub ste/ rten 'brel de gang yin snyam na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ spyir yon tan gyi rgya mtsho zhig skye bzhed na// rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i tshogs// rgyun chad med par gsog na yin// zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdus na// rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'byung*// gzugs kyi sku ni mdor bsdus na// bsod nams tshogs las 'byung ba yin// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog par gal che/ de yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum/ shin tu rnam par dag pa gal che gsung*/ zhing la rnam pa gnyis/ gsang sngags 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i lugs dang*/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs yin pa las/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs ni/ yan lag bdun pa'i rten sprul pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ sems can gyi zhing byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod rnams su/

dam pa rnams kyis rgya cher gsungs pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyang zhing ni phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mo/ sems can re re yang sangs rgyas sku gsum ye shes rnam pa lnga'i bdag nyid/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang chos kyi sku dang yon tan phrin las thams cad mnyam par nges par byed pa ni dam tshig yin te/ de lta bu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags na/ de lta bu'i yon tan tshe 'di nyid la mthong chos su 'byung ba ga la yang dka' ste/ 'di lta ste dper na 'phags pa gang pos nyan thos kyi theg pa zhig la bran mo'i bu zhes brjod pas/ sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba'i las bsags shing skye ba dpag tu med par bran mo'i bur gyur nas/ dgra bcom pa srid pa tha ma'i lus kyang bran mo'i bur grub par gyur na/ sems can thams cad buddhā nyid yin pa la sangs rgyas su nges shing blta ba'i lta ba rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa la sangs rgyas rnyed par 'gyur ba ga la dka' ste/ zhing rnam par dag pa bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o// bsam pa rnam par dag pa ni/ ji tsam du rgyud tshod mtho por gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sems kyis bar du gcod ces pa'i don yang yul ma rungs pa la phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa skyel ba byung ba la yi chad nas/ nga yang sems can ma rungs pa 'di lta bu'i don byed pa yang shin tu dka' bar 'dug rang nyid mya ngan las 'da' bar 'jug dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa 'dis/ zhing bzang po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang sems can rnams bskal pa grangs med pa gsum mam/ brgya 'am stong la sogs par/ mgo dang*/ rkang lag dang*/ bu dang*/ chung ma dang*/ rdzas dang*/ yo byad thams cad kyang mchod cing*/ dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad kyang*/ rang ji ltar 'dod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa de rdzogs par byed pa ma gtogs pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi srid de/

rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu mi srid pas so// des na bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sems can rnams 'di 'dra ba nyid kyis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yin mod/ de la yi chad du ci yod snyam du bsams nas khyad par du 'dis gtso bo byas pa'i ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i ched du/ go cha chen po bgos nas rang nyid dge sbyor 'bad par byed pa de gal che/ 'di 'dra ba la slob dpon kun yang slob ma la yi chad dogs yod gsungs pas/ bsam pa shin tu rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che la gnas par byed pa shin tu yang gal che'o// zhing dang bsam pa gnyis 'dzoms nas dngos po ni rang gi lus ngag yid gsum mtha' dag dge ba'i rtsa ba sha stag tu ngang ngam shugs kyis kyang gyur te/ brtson 'grus drag po brtsams pa la gnas dgos pas 'o na brtson 'grus de gang la zer snyam na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ lus ngag gi dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs gtso bor byed pa la phyi rol mu stegs pa byed zer ba yin/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa ni sems 'dul ba gtso bo byed pas nang pa sangs rgyas pa zhes zer ba yin te/ de yang rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ dran pa ma yengs pa 'ba' zhig gi brtul zhugs la gnas par bya ste/ sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa// brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya// zhes pas/ sems bsrung ba'i brtul zhugs la nan tan gyis gnas par bya'o// 'o na sems bsrung ba 'ba' zhig gis lus dang ngag dang phyi rol gyi yul 'di dag thams cad bsrung ba cang 'gyur ram snyam na shin tu yang 'gyur te/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin gsungs te/

'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi bsam pa ji ltar yod pa de ltar snang bas sems bsrung ba'i brtul zhugs kyis ni brtul zhugs thams cad spyad par 'gro la/ sems dag pas ni 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag cing*/ sems skye ba med pas ni 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad skye ba med pa yang*/ tshe 'dir sangs rgyas mchog nyid du// sems sgom pas ni sangs rgya 'o// rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces pa la sogs pa bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyi brjod bya 'di yin pas dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams kyis kyang 'di ltar yin par rang gi nyams su myong bas shes zhes grags so// gsum pa de ji ltar nyams su blang zhe na/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas rang la zhe 'khris spu'i rtse mo tsam yang med par/ bdag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod pa byed pa'i bgegs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad kyis gtsos byas pa'i ma nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i ched du/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung ste/ nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ de'i ched du bdag gis theg pa chen po gsang sngags nyams su blang snyam du bsams la/ snga thun dang po bsgrub thabs rgyas pa nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ sa bon gyi yi ge las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas rang gi lhag pa'i lha sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su gyur par zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas dmigs shing nges par byas la/

de yang rang gi sems nyid chos kyi sku 'ba' zhig dang gnyis su med pa yin pa la yin par shes shing nges par byas/ de la gnyis su med pa'i zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog mchod pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod par bya ste/ de ltar yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rnams su badzra puṣpe zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bya ba dang byed pa thams cad badzras thog drangs pa nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams dang*/ bya ba byed pa thams cad sems nyid rdo rje zhes gnyis med 'ba' zhig tu nges par byas pa yin pas/ khyed bla ma dam pa dang dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu dang lhan cig gnas pa rnams kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs de ltar bsags shing*/ ye shes kyi tshogs rang gis ji ltar rtogs shing go ba de ltar nyams su blangs na/ yun ring por mi thogs par su dang 'grogs kyang yi dam gyi lha/ gnas gang du yang 'dug kyang gzhal yas khang 'ong ba la tshegs med de/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum gyi rten 'brel 'grig pas/ mthong chos su 'bras bu can gyi las tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa gang zag dbang po rab ces bya'o// gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dbang po 'bring po rnams kyis ni/ shin tu dben pa'i gnas su 'bol ba'i stan gting*/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga bcas/ lus sems thams cad cha mnyam nas zhing rnam par dag pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dmigs nas dngos po rnam par dag pa blos sprul pa la bslabs shing mnyam rjes med par goms par gyur nas/ gzod gong ltar 'phags pa thams cad mchod cing sems can smin par byed pa yin no// 'dir mang smras pas ci zhig bya// lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir// lta ba sna tshogs rtog pas g.yengs// tshe thung nad mang mi rtag pas// phyin ci log gi bsam sbyor rnams// rgyab kyi phyogs su dor byas nas// gcig pu bla med byang chub bsgrub// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// rgyu lam phyin ci log pa yis// bsgrub kyang 'grub par mi srid pas// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes tshogs// rang gi blo yi nus pa ltar// gnyis po nyams su blang bar bya// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// ma dag ya bral gyur pa la// theg pa chen po gsang sngags sam// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas mi srid pas// la ka'i bya sgro ji bzhin du// yin min tshig gis ma yengs par// nges shes skyes pa'i rjes 'brangs na// rang gi bsam pa'i gzugs su 'gyur// kha tsho sna tsho ma lags te// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pas gsungs// shi gtam tshig tu brjod pa yin// rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma la// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad kyi// yon tan bsgrub pa'i rten 'brel 'di// snyig khrag kha ru skyugs pa yin// shi na kha chems bzhag pa yin// 'di las byung ba'i dge ba des// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas// mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog
/gnas skabs mthar thug gi yon tan bsgrub par byed pa'i rten 'brel rdzogs so// // 190) ༄// zang zing spangs ba 'di ni shin tu mdzes zhes mkhas grub 'bri sgur la gdams pa//

oṃ swasti/ dus gsum bla ma rnams dang rgyal ba dang*// de yis thugs su chud pa'i chags bral chos// chags med brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin rgyal sras dang*// bla med dkon mchog tshogs la spyi bos 'dud// chos kun gdod nas nyer zhi mkha' 'dra la// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa glo bur bas// khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams shing mgon med pa// 'gro la brtse bas byang chub thugs bskyed phyir// dpag med dka' bas byang chub sangs rgyas pa// dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas dang*// shākya'i rgyal pos thugs su chud pa'i chos// shes rab pha rol phyin dang gzhan dag kyang*// bskal pa bzang po'i dus gsum rgyal ba yi// gsung rab rgyas pa'i gnas 'di byang phyogs su// thub pas lung bstan kha ba can ljongs su// bstan pa'i bdag po sangs rgyas 'dra ba yi// dam pa dpag tu med pa byung gyur te// deng sang dus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams// sangs rgyas nyid 'dra sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed// kun la phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi'o// 'gran gyis zla med rtsod pa kun dang bral// thub pa'i bstan pa bslab gsum rgyal mtshan 'dzin// thos dang bsam pa'i blo gros rab yangs pa// lung rigs dbang phyug che ba'i che ba nyid// 'jig rten chos brgyad ljan ljin skyon rnams las// rab tu dben pa gangs ri'i rtser gnas shing*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi byas pa gzo ba dang*// shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i phyir// rgyal sras mi 'khrugs pa yi brtul zhugs kyis// zang zing spang khyod 'di ni shin tu mdzes// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad dang*// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs bdag cag thams cad kyi// mig rten khyod ni yun ring 'tsho bar shog /rtag tu rgyal ba nyid du shin tu smon// nga 'o nga rgyal nges par thugs chud cing*// bdag med don la nges pa'i blo gros kyis// thub pa'i bstan par bya ba mdzad bzhed pas// rgyal po nor gyi chog pa med pa ltar// kun la nga rgyal mi mdzad yon tan len// rgyal ba'i yon tan spogs par byed pa la// rjes su yi rang gsung bzhin bsgrub par bgyi'o// 'di 'dra'i yon tan dpag med gzhir gyur pa// ku re kyal ka phye gtor ma lags te// ji ltar smras pa de ltar kun gyis go

/'di 'dra'i mdzad pa rlabs chen rab yangs pa// 'di ltar 'di dag thams cad gang gis byed// byed pa'i gzhi la mkhas pa khyed kyis rtogs// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo gros kyis// dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba gang byas kyang*// nga bdag mnga' thang rgyas par byas nas kyang*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med rnams su// bde 'gro'i gnas su 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi// rnam par g.yengs shing 'khor bar 'khor na ko /'khor ba'i rgyur gyur bdag 'dzin che thabs la// mkhas pas nam yang 'dod pa med par bya// mi rtag sdug bsngal stong dang bdag med pa// bsgom pa'i rnam bzhag spangs la rtag tu bsam// bsams pa nges pa thob cing 'gyur med na// phywa dang dbang phyug byed po bdag nyid kyis// dge dang mi dge byas pa'i 'ching ba las// rnam par grol ba nyams su myong nas mchi// bdag nyid khams gsum gang du skye zhes pa'i// skye ba'i rgyur yang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i yid// yin pa'i nges shes skyes pa'i mkhas pa yis// bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i 'byung khungs spang bar bya// bdag med zhi bar gnas pa'i blo gros kyis// bskal pa grangs med gsum sogs 'bad pa yis// lus ngag dge ba dpag med gang byas kyang*// nye bar zhi ba'i byang chub thob pa las// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par ma gyur pa// shā ri'i bu dang 'phags pa mo'u 'gal zhes// ma skyes dgra yi 'gyod pa bsal bar gsungs// gang gis smon lam ji ltar btab pa bzhin// de ltar 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs pas na// sred pa len pa'i rgyu 'bras shin tu mad// rang nyid zhi bar 'dod pa'i thugs dgongs kyi// nyan thos theg par khyed la smon pa med// lus can mar gyur 'gro ba mig med pa// skyabs mgon bral bar gyur pa thams cad kun// bdag nyid bu yis smin par mi byed pa// lung dang rigs pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho yis// legs par gzhigs shing bsam pas rnam bsams te// gdung ba cher bskyed go cha rnams bgos te// smon 'jug gnyis kyi sdom pa rab blangs nas// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' chen po ltar// pha rol phyin drug spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// da lta 'gro ba smin par mi byed cing*// deng sang dus su nged 'dra sems can gyis// 'gro la phan par gyur pa ga la srid// sangs rgyas thob nas 'gro don shugs las 'ong*// sa dang lam la gnas par gyur pa yi// byang chub sems dpa'i che ba'i che ba nyid// brgya phrag stong phrag bcu gnyis la sogs 'gyur// rnam bzhag mang po kha g.yos byed pa yis// mi tshe stong par skyel ba'i gtam rnyid mkhan// snying nas bya blo med pa'i mi rnams ltar// mkhas pa khyed kyis nam yang mi mdzad de// snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gzhan don gyi// brtul zhugs drag pos thams cad bsgrub par bya// log par goms pa shin tu yun ring zhing*// dman pa'i bdud kyis rang la khyab gyur na// bdag tu 'dzin dang dman pa'i bsam pa skye// 'jig rten chos dang nyan thos bsam pa yis// rang gi nye du slob ris gnyen 'dun gyis// log par 'khrid par byed pa'i bdud byung na// snying rje chen pos de dag gzung bya zhing*// dman la 'dod pa'i bsam pa rtag tu spang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dpang por gzugs// lus ngag yid kyi bya ba thams cad kyi// bdag po byang chub sems su nges gyur na// byang chub sems las byung ba'i lus ngag dang*// yid kyis bya ba sna tshogs ci byed pa// chu rnams rgya mtsho chen por gzhol ba bzhin// byang chub sems su thams cad ro gcig 'gyur// theg chen rgyal ba'i gsungs rnams dus 'dir go

/lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa re res kyang*// 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin par byed// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang ji bzhin du// yon tan bskyed pa'i bla ma rnams dang phrad// bskal pa chen po bye ba mtha' yas su// bsgrubs kyang 'grub par dka' ba'i yon tan rnams// ring por mi thogs rang gi rgyud la skye// 'di la sogs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa// bdag nyid chen po khyed kyi thugs la gsal// lus ngag yid kyi bya ba thams cad kyi// bdag po byang chub sems las ma 'tshol cig /bsngo ba sems bskyed gnyis la 'bad par mdzod// bsam pa byang chub sems su nges gyur na// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa sgra bo che// phung po khams dang skye mched 'di dag kun// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'gyur ba'i tshul// rdo rje theg par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// gdod nas yod dam glo bur gang yin zhes// brtag dpyad mang por dri ba rgya mtsho'i tshul// rgyud sde de dag kun ni gtan la phab// theg chen gsang sngags rdo rje'i nyams len la// tshad ldan bla ma dgos zhes gong mas gsungs// 'on kyang lan zhig yi dam lhar bsgoms nas// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid sku// dpag med yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma dam pa ni// snying khar rtag tu bzhugs par bsam byas nas// mos gus rgyun chad med par 'bad par bya// mos gus rten 'brel mthu yis rang nyid kyi// sems kyi 'dug lugs ngang gis shes par 'gyur// bla ma'i mos gus tshad du ma bskyal na// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi rnams dang*// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*// btsal thabs bzhag thabs man chung kar kor dang*// ya ta ma ri'i kha lta sprin 'khrigs kyang*// bden pa'i don la nges shes mi skye bar// bla ma'i mos gus tshad du bskyal zhes gsungs// bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i yid dang theg dman gyi// blo yi nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos shing*// byang chub sems dpa' yi dam lhar bsgoms nas// bla ma'i mos gus tshad du phyin pa des// rang byung phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i tshul// rang sems mi sgom sems kyi yul mi sgom// sgom du med pa yang ni mi sgom ste// ma bsgoms pa yi sgom zhig 'ong ba yi// re ba de yang bsgom par mi bya'o// chos can mi bsam chos nyid mi bsam ste// chos dang chos can gnyis su med pa yi// don de blo yi 'dzin pas mi bzung zhing*// 'di ni dbyings nyid 'di ni ye shes te// gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong pa'i rang rig la// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba'i tshul// stong par song gis dogs pa'i 'jigs pa yang*// lung dang rigs pas gtan la phab pa yis// ye shes rang rig 'di la re thag chad// ji ltar chu la chu ni bzhag pa dang*// mar la mar ni bzhag pa ji bzhin du// sems la sems nyid bzhag par gyur pa yi// dbyings nyid zhi ba de yang bsgom mi bya// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis kyi rnam dbye kun// blo yi yul du mi bya blo 'das kyang*// blo 'das bshad pa'i mkhas pa ji bzhin du// gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu rnams kyi tshul// spros pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug par mi bya bar// sems nyid rang byung spros pa med par bzhag

/lhun gyis grub cing rgyun chad med pa'i don// ring por mi thogs mngon du 'gyur nas mchi// yin lugs rnam bzhag mang po de nas go /mos gus tshad du skyol dang dge ba'i bshes// gnyug ma 'od gsal lhun gyis grub pa ni// dus gsum 'gyur med lhun grub rtag pa nyid// de la skye zhing 'gag pa'i rnam rtog kyang*// chu la chu bur ji bzhin dbyer med gnas// byang chub sems dang rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis// gzugs sku gnyis kyi gzhan don 'byung ba'i rgyu// thabs la mkhas pa rnal 'byor rnams kyi gter// rgyal bas nyon mongs sangs rgyas gdung du gsungs// slob dpon 'phags pas zung 'jug bstod pas bstod// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa rmad po che// chu rnams thams cad rgya mtshor lan tsha bzhin// bsal bzhag med par thugs su chud nas mchi// thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab ri dbang la// spros pa'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i srub thag gis// shes bya rgya mtsho che la bsrubs gyur kyang*// chu la mar gyi snying po ji bzhin du// rtog med 'od gsal rtogs pa ga la srid// gnyug ma nyid du zhog cig rnal 'byor pa// bla ma'i mos gus gces zhes rin chen gsung*// don 'di snyan du gsol bar byed pa yi// nus pa bdag la yod pa ma yin te// bdag nyid chen pos ji ltar zhus pa'i don// gsung mi bcag phyir bdag gis bris pa las// 'gal zhing 'khrul par gyur pa ci mchis pa// dam pa rnams dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// bzod par bya ba'i yul rnams thams cad kyis// bzod par mdzad cing byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /'bri sgur la gdams pa rdzogs so// // 191) ༄// rang sems skye med la 'khor 'das byung na ltas ngan yin pa sing ras la gdams pa//

oṃ swasti/ pha 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig pu// chos rje bla ma rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bdag spun la re sa rje las med// byin rlabs can gyi rje btsun pa// ci mdzad mnga' ba rin po che// mthar thug thugs rje mchog mnga' ba// dge 'dun tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal tshogs// chu sna rbud pa bzhin du byung*// mi ro lud phung bzhin du bskyal// rgyal khams gzhan la ngo yang tsha// 'tsho mdzad rnams kyi sman kyang rdugs/ zad /bdag kyang dra sha chad par byung*// skyabs mgon dpung gnyen ma mchis pas// re sa gzhan na med pa yis// bdag cag thams cad bskyab tu gsol// zhes de ltar zhus pa'i zhus lan du// pha rje btsun de yis 'di skad gsung*// nga yon tan med pa'i sprang po la// go ba med pa'i mi tshogs 'dus// de la 'di las 'os med pa// glen pa khyod kyis ma go 'am// 'on kyang bdag gi bla ma bzang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yin// rje btsun de yi zhal snga nas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// skye rga na 'chi med do zhes// rin chen zhal nas mi gsungs bas// nga la de yi khas blang med// nga yi drung du tshogs pa'i mi// pha ma nye du gnyen 'brel dang*// mi chos nye ring thams cad kyi// 'bri gung dpal gyi dgon pa der// mi chos che thabs slob la shog /khur cig pang gang 'khyer cig ces// sus kyang drung du btang ba med// skye rga na 'chis 'jig pa'i mi// nam yang 'chi bar shes pa rnams// nga yi drung du 'ongs pa la// ma shi shi dang 'dra rtsis pas// 'chi ba'i mya ngan byed pa med// 'on kyang mkhas pa'i gang zag rnams// ji ltar nor bu rin po che// rnyed nas khyim du phyin pa ltar// tshul khrims rnam dag bsrung ba'i mi// 'chi ba'i dus su sems rten yod// ji ltar 'chi med bdud rtsi ni// 'thung na bde zhing skyid pa ltar// rang sems skye ba med rtogs pa// shi 'am yang na gson yang bde// ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bu// 'phongs pa yab kyi dbang bskur bzhin// bla ma bzang po'i slob ma yang*// 'chi ba'i dus su mnga' thang rgyas// skye shi'i gnas lugs shes pa'i mi// dper na nam mkha'i sprin tshogs la// dang po skye dang gnas pa dang*// 'jigs par 'gyur ba yod med de// 'di ltar 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel la// skye 'gag gnas pa med pa ltar// kye ho rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa yang*// las dang nyon mongs rnam smin tshogs// skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba 'di// mkhas pa rnams kyis gang rtogs pa// dper na ri bong rwa bzhin du// yod dang med pas stong pa la// rtse mo rno 'am brtul lam zhes// khyad par chos la rtog pa med// 'di go 'am rtogs sam rnal 'byor pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yis// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// ji snyed chos rnams ma lus kun// rang gi sems su bka' bstsal yang*// sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos// 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin sna tshogs su// log par brtags pa'i skye bo rnams// mdzub mos zla ba mtshon pa bzhin// thabs kyis drang ba'i don yin gyis// sems skye ba med ces mi gsung ngam// rang sems skye ba med pa la// 'khor 'das byung na ltas ngan yin// sems nyid nam mkha' stong pa la// rgyu 'bras byung na log lta yin// skye 'gag med pa'i gshis nyid la// skye dang 'chi bar gang rtogs pa// byis pa log par 'khrul pa yin// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa la// tshig dang yi ge sna tshogs su// phyin ci log tu rtog na 'khrul// gzung dang 'dzin pa sna tshogs kyi// nyes tshogs dgra yi dmag byung na// blo las 'das pa'i rdzong du bsdad// lhun gyis grub pa'i mal du nyal// gnyis su med pa'i na bza' gsol// nyes tshogs dgra yi dpung rnams kyang*// dgag sgrub med pa de nyid la// mkhyen pa'i ye shes sna tshogs su// bya byed med par mkhyen pa de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan zhes// rang byung mgon pos gsungs pas na// de la su yis dgag tu yod// skyid do dga' bo shi gson rnams// dga' bo yar ro rnal 'byor pa// ku re yin na rang la sdig

/ji ltar byas kyang bde mor gda'// cha la je bde je bder 'gro// byang chub sems kyi rjes 'brangs na// nga yi bu slob 'dir shi zhes// log shes zhen pa'i rjes 'brang zhing*// sems can thams cad mi bsams pa// 'di yang 'thad pa ga la srid// de bzhin nyid kyi rjes 'brangs na// gong du smos pa kho nar zad// thabs mkhas skyes bu chen po yis// 'gro ba'i sems kyi rjes 'brangs nas// sems can rnams dang mthun par 'jug /ji ltar 'dam skyes padma ni// 'dam gyi skyon gyis gos pa med// sems can khams rnams thams cad kyi// bag la nyal dang bsam pa'i tshogs// ji snyed yod pa de srid du// dpa' bo rnams kyi rnam thar yang*// kye ho bsam gyis mi khyab pa// de la ngo mtshar cis mi skye// bde chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'dis// sems can thams cad smin par mdzad// dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sing ras kyis zhus pa rdzogs so// //

192) ༄// skyes mchog smar pa mchog la phul ba'i bstod phrin chu shel dbang po// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod 'dzin pa// dag pa gnyis ldan dri med chos kyi sku// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// skyes bu chen po de dang dbyer med pa// dpag med yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i sku// bdag gis bstod par nus pa ma yin kyang*// gus pa'i shugs kyis cung zad tsam zhig brjod// skyes chen gang zhig bsags pa mthar phyin pas// chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rigs dag tu 'khrungs// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir thub pa'i bstan pa la// dka' ba dpag med rlabs chen brtson 'grus spyad// dus gsum rgyal ba'i tshul khrims rin chen phreng*// stobs dang mi 'jigs bral ba'i yon tan rgyu// g.yag rnga ne'u gsing bzhin du bsrung mdzad pa// tshul khrims mchog ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// nyes tshogs spangs pas dge ba goms pa las// zla ba sgra gcan skyon las rgyal ba bzhin// 'phags pas bsngags pa'i bsam gtan bzhir ldan pa// ting 'dzin zhi mchog brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo// thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab mchog gyur pas// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid thugs su chud// thub pa'i bstan pa blo gros rab yangs pa// mkhas pa chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho ltar yangs pa// lhun po ltar mdzes dge 'dun tshogs dbus na// 'gran gyi do zla med la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma dam pa yis// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rnams// bum pa gcig nas gcig tu ji bzhin par// dbang bskur mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// mi g.yo sems kyi dkyil 'khor 'od gsal ba// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes blo las 'das// mtha' brgyad spros dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo// nye bar zhi ba'i sems nyid nam mkha' las// stobs dang ma 'dres yon tan ma lus kun// gnyis med lhun gyis grub pa'i ro gcig pa// rgyal ba'i yon tan brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo// skyes chen khyod kyi sngon gyi dam bcas pa// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba sgrol ba'i thugs dgongs rnams// deng sang dus 'dir thams cad lhun gyis grub// chos rgyal ded dpon khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// shākya seng ges ma pham dbang bskur bas// thub pa'i gdul bya padmo kha 'byed ltar// snyan pa'i gsung dang dngos po dpag med kyis// khyed kyis bdag cag shin tu thugs la btags// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag

/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /mnyam med bla ma dam pa de yi thugs// gdung dang ring srel dpag tu med pa dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dpag med pa// legs par bzhugs pa'i ratna tsa ra yi// mchod rten ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba la// gdan khri gcig gi zhabs tog bya snyam yang*// de sngon lag tu lon par ma gyur te// bla ma nyid kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// bal po'i lha bzo mkhas pa'i mthar thug cig /byung nas da ltar bzhengs shing mchis pa lags// khyed rang nyid kyi yab dang gdan khri la// bsam gyis mi khyab 'bul ba rgya chen 'di// bdag la brtse bas khyed kyis thugs la btags// shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu bla mas kyang*// khyed kyi thugs dgongs bzhed pa bzhin du gyis// rin po che dang de yi sras rnams dang*// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyang*// srog la mi blta dka' las byed pa yi// nye gnas de rnams shin tu dga' bar byas// bla ma rin po che yi thugs kyi sras// stag lung thang pa de dang nga 'bu la// gnang ba'i pha 'bab rnams kyang lag tu thon// 'jig rten mgon po de dang skyes chen nyid// dbye ba med par bzhugs par gyur pa dang*// bdag la'ang gus shing gdung ba'i sems yod pas// khyed dang mjal bar shin tu spro na yang*// sa thag ring zhing rgas pa'i lus po 'dis// zhabs kyi drung du thon par ma gyur kyang*// sku gsung thugs nyid dbye ba med pa'i phyir// rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams ma lus pa// bla ma de dang dbye ba med tshul gyis// 'bral ba med par rtag tu mjal bar bgyi// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa// skyes chen khyod kyis bla ma rin chen la// ji ltar mdzad pa'i rlabs chen thams cad kyang*// rin chen de dang mnyam par gyur ba'i phyir// mar me la sogs ji ltar dgongs pa rnams// gru bzhi logs brgyad rtse mo dbal dang dgur// ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin du 'grub par bgyi// yab dang sras kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa rnams// deng nas bzung ste 'khor ba ma stong bar// mi 'bral rtag tu g.yog po byed pa dang*// yab sras rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par smon// bdag gi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang*// tshogs chen gnyis po yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir// bzo gnas rdzogs pa rma bya mdzes pa'i gdugs// nyid kyi dbu la rtag tu dbub par zhu// na bza' 'di yang sku la gsol ba dang*// kha che gur gum thun cig 'bul zhing mchis// zho grangs bcu dgur nges pa mchis pa lags// bla ma smar ba la bstod pa dang springs yig rdzogs so//

// 193) ༄// snying po don gyi lam rim dge sbyong rgyal ba yon tan la gdams pa// na mo ratna gu ru// rang bzhin rnam dag don dam byang chub sems// dri med gang gi rgyud la skyes gyur pa// skyon dag yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i dpal// bla ma byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud// rang bzhin rnam dag don dam bden pa ni// skye 'gag spros pa'i mtha' dang rnam bral zhing*// dus gsum dbyer med mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku// skyob mdzad 'jig rten mgon po sangs rgyas rnams// thugs rje chen po'i thugs brtses nyer bzung nas// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras rnams// spang bar bya phyir gsungs pa gang yin pa// bde ba'i 'byung gnas byang sems rin po che// sems nyid rdo rje 'di la skyabs su song*// rgya mtsho rba rlabs chu yi chu bur dang*// mkha' la sprin bzhin mig nad skra shad bzhin// yid brtan mi rung mtho dman rnam rtog rnams// bden dang bral ba'i rdzun rnams sna tshogs kyis// shin tu ma rungs gyur cing rtag tu g.yen spyod nas// skyug nag log pa'i skyes bu mkhas pa rnams// sems nyid rdo rje de la skyabs su song*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa rnams// nyon mongs rgyu las byung ba'i sdug bsngal lus// skye rga na 'chi sdug bsngal chen po 'di// gsod pa'i btson bzhin yang yang nyon mongs pa// gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor bas skyug log pa// sems nyid rdo rje 'di la skyabs su song*// dus rnams rtag tu bde ba 'phrog byed cing*// gnod pa'i gzhir gyur ral gri'i nags tshal ltar// phan zhing bde ba thams cad 'joms pa'i ngag /brjod pas zad pa med pa'i long gtam la// skyo ba skyes pa'i mkhas pa gang yin rnams// sems nyid rdo rje de la skyabs su song*// bdag nyid chen po pha ma gnyen 'dun dang*// bde ba skyid pa'i mdza' bo ji bzhin du// 'jig rten mgon po sems nyid rdo rje yis// bdag cag rnams la phan zhing bde bskyed pa'i// bshes gnyen dam pa de dang cis mi 'phrad// gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho der// skyabs dang bral bas yun ring 'khyams gyur cing*// bde dang bral bas sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba// rang dbang med par dmyal ba yi dwags dang*// byol song lus kyis rtag tu dub gyur cing*// rigs drug nyes pas rtag tu gtses gyur nas// ma rig mun pas shes rab mig ldongs pa'i// bdag cag mgon skyabs bral ba'i gang zag rnams// bde chen byang chub sems kyi gzhal yas na// rtag pa'i rgyal po mi 'gyur bla ma yis// phan dang bde ba'i tshogs kyis smin mdzad pa'i// bdag gi pha dang ci'i phyir 'phrad mi srid// 'jig rten mgon po sems nyid rdo rje dang*// phrad nas bral bar byed pa'i blun po rnams// ngan song gsum gyi chad pas rab bcad nas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus kyis// rang dbang med par rtag tu gtses pas na// skyabs chen rang gi sems dang 'bral mi bya// 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// skyabs mgon dam pa de nyid la// skyabs su song ba'i gang zag gis// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// sems nyid rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du// dbye ba med pa'i sems bskyed bya// gnyis su med pa'i don mthong bas// smon pa'i sems bskyed brtan pa dang*// gnyis med spyod pa'i brtul bzhugs kyis// 'jug pa'i sems bskyed blang bar bya// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rnams// don dam ston par byed pa'i dpal// cir snang chos skur ston mdzad pa// skyob pa gang chen rgyal po la// chos sku bde ba chen po yis// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yis// gnyis su med par mchod nas kyang*// 'gro kun byang chub snying po yi// go cha chen po rab bgos nas// pha rol phyin drug rang bzhin mchog

/rtsol sgrub med pa'i ngang shugs kyis// 'gro drug rang gi dbyings su 'jug /'jug pa'i sems bskyed brtan pa dang*// gsang sngags dbang gi man ngag gis// rang gzhan thams cad smin par bya// 'gro drug sems cad thams cad kyi// lus dang lus kyi de bzhin nyid// stong dang mi stong mtha' las 'das// lhun gyis grub pa rdo rje'i sku// dbang bskur dang po thob par 'gyur// dbang bskur dang po de nyid las// 'khrul pas bsdus pa'i sems can rnams// rgyal ba lnga dang de yi rtags// 'khrul pas bsdus pa'i sems can gyis// 'khrul pa'i dbang bskur thob pas kyang*// brgya la gal te re shig na// drug pa rdo rje 'chang ba'i dbang*// rang sems sangs rgyas rtogs par 'gyur// zab mo dbang bskur dam pa ni// gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i sems can dang*// blo mig dag pa'i 'phags pas kyang*// blo yi yul du ma gyur pa// blo las 'das pa'i dbyings la gnas// 'khrul pas bsdus pa'i sems can la// khu khrag gnyis kyi rten 'brel gyis// rnam rtog zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin// bde gsal mi rtog bskyed par 'gyur// de la brten nas bla ma la// brgya la mos gus skyes gyur na// zab mo dbang bskur thob kyang srid// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// gnyis med gdod nas dag pa ni// gdod nas dag pa nyid yin te// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// shes rab bstan pa'i ye shes ni// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i rgyu rkyen bral// gnyis su med dbang thob par 'gyur// 'khrul pas bsdus pa'i sems can gyis// nyon mongs gsum gyi mthar gnas pa// 'dzin pa'i nges shes brtan yang srid// brgya la gal te rnal 'byor pas// bla ma'i mos gus shes gyur na// gnyis med ye shes thob par 'gyur// smra bsam shes brjod bral ba'i dbang*// bzhi pa zhes ni rnam grags pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// ma gsungs ma bshad ma bsams pa// 'khor 'das kun gyi gshis nyid kyi// dbang bskur rgyal po bla med de// lhun gyis grub pa'i bla ma la// rgyun chad med par blang bar bya// 'khrul pas bsdus pa'i sems can rnams// 'dod chags gsum gyi mthar gnas pa// nyi tshe ba yi stong nyid kyis// mthar thug sangs rgyas thob tu re// rten gyi gang zag de dag gis// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus kyis// rang rgyud tshim par byed nus na// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa'i don// phyag rgya chen po rtogs par 'gyur// dbang bzhi thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// lus ngag yid kyis bsdus pa yi// sems can rgya mtsho smin bzhed na// lus dang lus kyi de bzhin nyid// dbyer med rtogs pa'i man ngag gis// lus can sdug bsngal phung po rnams// chos sku bde ba chen por skyong*// sangs rgyas sku yi dbang thob pa// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// chos sku dri ma med pa yis// lus can thams cad smin par bya// khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// ngag la zhen pa'i mtha' can rnams// rdo rje gsung gi rigs yin te// rigs can smin par mdzad pa na// ngag dang ngag gi de bzhin nyid// dbyer med rtogs pa'i man ngag gis// chags zhen spros pa'i dbang song ba// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// smra bsam brjod med dbyings su 'god// sangs rgyas gsung gi dbang thob pa// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa'i sa// ngag gis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams// rdo rje'i gsung du bsgyur bar bya// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi// bsam rig can gyi sems can rnams// rdo rje thugs kyi rigs yin te// sems dang sems nyid dbyer med pa// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa yis// rtog pas bsdus pa'i sems can rnams// rang byung lhan cig skyes par sbyong*// sangs rgyas thugs kyi dbang thob pa// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun// byang chub sems kyis rgyal bar bya// gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag pa// 'od gsal nam mkha' stong pa la// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa rnams// mgon po 'khor 'das kun gyi bdag

/rdo rje 'chang gi rigs yin te// 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i sems can rnams// gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag pas// lhun grub rdo rje'i dbyings su sbyong*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// phyag rgya chen po'i dbang thob pa// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// gzung dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa yi// khams gsum sems can ma lus pa// phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du grol// snying po don gyi lam rim 'di// 'jig rten bde 'bras thams cad la// dug gi snying po ltar gzigs nas// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yis// byang chub mchog la zhugs pa yi// dge sbyong rgyal ba yon tan gyis// bsdus pa'i snying po zhus pa des// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kun// rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par shog/ // 194) ༄// snying po don gyi lam rim dge sbyong rgyal ba yon tan la gdams pa'i sa bcad// bstan bcos 'di la dbu nas zhabs su don gsum gyis ston te/ klad kyi don sems nyid byang chub sems kyi bla ma la mchod par brjod pa dang*/ gzhung gi don byang chub kyi sems gcig pus pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa'i lam cig car sbyangs nas rang don dang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa dang*/ mjug gi don dge slong gis zhus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba'o// ༈ //mchod par brjod pa la don gsum ste/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa lhun gyis grub par gnas pa bstan pa dang*/ de gang zag gi rgyud la gnas pa rtogs dgos par bstan pa dang*/ de rtogs shing goms pas skyon dag yon tan thams cad rdzogs par bstan pa'o// gzhung don la lnga ste/ lus ngag yid gsum mi rtag pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de las skyob par byed pa'i skyabs 'dus ma byas pa sems nyid rdo rje la skyabs su 'gro ba bstan pa dang*/ ngo bo rtogs pa drod thob pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa la gnas pas chos thams cad gdod nas ma skyes par byang chub kyi snying por sems bskyed pa bstan pa dang*/

gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs pa brtan par gyur cing snang ba chos skur ston pa'i bla ma rnam par snang mdzad la spangs thob med pa bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mchod nas 'khor 'das thams cad gdod nas sangs rgyas par rtogs pa sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi khur gyis dub ba med pa'i go cha chen po bgos nas/ gnyis snang med pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sems can rnams rtsol sgrub med pa'i thugs kyis smin par byed pa bstan pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa rin po che de thob nas chos kyi sku rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa bum pa'i dbang gis lus dang snang ba'i dngos po 'dag pa dang 'dag pa'i rgyu dang mi 'dag pa bstan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba smra bsam shes brjod las 'das pa gsang pa'i dbang gis gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ 'dag pa'i rgyu dang mi 'dag pa bstan pa'o// gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gsum pa'i dbang gis gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bag chags thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ 'dag pa'i rgyu dang mi 'dag pa bstan pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa bzhi pa'i dbang gis/ lus ngag yid gsum 'dzin pa'i dri ma thams cad 'dag pa dang 'dag pa'i rgyu dang mi 'dag pa bstan pa dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum 'dzin pa'i skyon dang*/ dri ma rnams rang bzhin dbyer med par rtogs pa'i man ngag gis/ sems can thams cad rang nyid kyi dbyings su 'god pa bstan pa'o// mjug gi don la gsum ste/ don gyi snying po thams cad bsdus pas sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan bcos kyi ming smos pa dang*/ zhu ba po'i mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa bstan pa dang*/ bstan bcos byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba'o// //

195) ༄// sgam po'i gdan sar bca' khrims mdzad dus thugs mnyes pa'i skyid skyid ring mo'i zhal gdams// oṃ swasti/ don 'grub bsam pa grub pa po// kun don yon tan gsum gyi bdag /grub pa mthar phyin 'khrul pa med// rin chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ rje btsun bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ jo bo bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum po chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pa'i byin gyis rlabs dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen pos dbu mdzad/ sgam po pa gzhis byes yon mchod sku 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' drin gyis/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che gong ma rnams kyi gdan sa/ ri bo shan ti'i rtse mo/ sgam po dpal gyi yang dgon/ brag rgod tshang can gyi g.yas gong*/ can cen brag gi g.yon zur/ thad kar 'phur ba'i gong rol/ khri gdugs bdal ba'i 'og rol/ zangs zlum chos kyi pho brang*/ phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog mdzes sdug nags tshal gyi dkyil mthongs/ skad snyan bya yi tshogs sa/ spang ljongs ne'u gsing gi dbye thang*/ lo 'bras me tog gi bkod sa/ rang byung byin rlabs kyi skyabs 'og thub chen mchod rten gyi zhabs drung na/ shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa/ ldom bu dpal gyi ming mtha' can// re dga' re skyid nga re dga'// bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'di// khyed dang khams gsum sems can dang*// thun mong nyid du 'gyur bar nges// nges lta nges te bsngo yang bsngo// bu khyed kyi zhabs 'bring zhabs tog 'di// gdod mtha' bar gsum thams cad du// bsam pas bsam gyis mi khyab lags// dang po chos la bskul ma btab// de nas grwa pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrubs// bsgrub pa byed pa'i dus tshod du// ci dgos dgos dgu char du phab// tshogs pa skyong ba'i dus tshod du// nga 'bu mi ngan zhan mod kyang*// 'di phyi lus srog thams cad kyis// bsam pa 'das par yang phyag byas// gong ma rnams kyi zhabs tog tu// sgom na dga' bar byung ba'i tshe// pha ma gnyen 'dun nor rdzas dang*// bla med rdo rje spun grogs kyi// chos dang zang zing longs spyod rnams// 'bral ba sems kyis ma bzod nas// snying khrag kha ru skyugs na yang*// bla ma mnyes pa gcig tu bsams// gong ma'i rnam thar ri khrod bsnyags// nor rdzas ma btsal dgon pa bsten// srog la ma bltas gcig pur bsdad// bza' rgyu med de sngo rngad zos// pha drin can dang mjal bar skyo na yang*// 'di phyi gnyis kyi ngo tsha bskur// gus pas drung du phyin na yang*// 'ug pa nyin la byung ba 'am// mkhas btsun ra rnyi brkus pa bzhin// a tse the le dos gcig byas// 'on kyang tshig gi kha na med/

khyed rnams snying gi dkyil du yod// nga 'bu'i sgrub dang brtul zhugs 'di// dmigs pa khyed la dmigs pa yin// khyed kyi tshul dang sgo bstan nas// 'gro kun smin cing grol ba dang*// bar chad zhi bar byed pa la// khyed rnams thog mar byas pa yin// mang po brjod pas ci bya ste// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob de// khyed ri khrod pa la 'ong du re// sangs rgyas brgyud pa ma chad pa// 'jig rten mgon po yan chad dang*// rdo rje 'chang chen man chad kyi// bla ma sangs rgyas byin rlabs can// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs pa rnams// bu brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma rnams// sangs rgyas spyan gyis gzigs nas kyang*// bu gces se smin par mdzad par nges// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyis// padma'i mtsho la ngang pa bzhin// ring du gnas kyang 'du bar 'gyur// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams su// yon tan bsngags pa'i phreng ba rnams// bu sgrub pa byed la gsung bar mdzad// rdo rje 'chang dang sangs rgyas kyi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// mthun rkyen chos kyi srung ma dang*// lha klu gnod sbyin srin po'i tshogs// lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du// sdong grogs byed pa dam tshig yin// bu sems zhum mi dgos rnal 'byor pa// dga' ba mang ngo ngo so can// byas pa don yod gdung 'tshob rnams// bka' drin bsgrubs so dam tshig can// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i ri khrod pa// smon 'jug thob bo rgyal ba'i sras// bu khyed kyi mdzad spyod gang yin la// shākya'i dge slong ri khrod pa// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i sdom bu pa// khyed las bsam rgyu ma mchis so// sgam po'i ri la bzhugs pa yi// gzhis byes dbyer med dge 'dun rnams// 'di ltar sgrub pa byed pa la// thugs brtse thugs kyis dgongs nas kyang*// bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs// 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad la// thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yis// gang gsum gang gi phyogs nas kyang*// rtag tu 'di ltar thugs la thogs// ma 'da' ma 'da' phrang ma 'da'// spyir zhag gsum 'grogs pa'i grogs po dang*// gzug gcig byin pa'i skyel mas kyang*// srog la mi blta grogs byed na/

khyed kyi yul na gnas pa dang*// bla ma yin pa'i gnyer kas kyang*// nga yi sdong grogs cis mi 'bab// lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// sgrub pa byed pa shin tu nyung*// byang chub sgrub pa shin tu dka'// bla med sgrub pa shin tu dkon// sgrub pa'i 'bras bu grub pa'i tshe// rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pas// byin gyis rlob pa'i bla ma dang*// mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i yon bdag dang*// bar chad srung ba'i chos skyong dang*// rgyud tshod mnyam pa'i grogs dang yang*// mos gus byed pa'i slob ma rnams// tshom bu gcig pu byed pa yi// 'brel ba zab mor gyur tshad dang*// lhan cig byang chub sangs rgyas pa// 'gro mgon dpal ldan de yis bzhed// de phyir nga dang 'brel ba yi// mtho dman nye ring thams cad kyis// nga dang sgrub pa byed pa rnams// sa phyogs gang dang gar gnas kyang*// brtse bas thugs la gdags par zhu// glang gi lo dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes bcu bdun la/ sgam po zangs zlum gyi dgon par/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbu mdzad rnams kyis bskyal/ 'phang phol bca' khrims mdzad nas zhag brgyad mnyel bsos/ nyi shu lnga'i nang par gsung bcad mdzad par bzhed pa'i dus su/ dge 'dun rnams kyi zhabs tog tu bca' khrims bsdams pa gsan nas mnyes nas mdzad pa'i skyid skyid ring mo dga' la drin chags zhes bya ba rdzogs so// kwa nyi shu la gsung bcad nas// da rung 'byed du ma gnang ngo*/// / 196) ༄// nye gnas rnams la dus gtan gyi so nams byed dgos par gdams pa// oṃ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas pa// thugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan lags// tshe gcig mchog gi sangs rgyas pa// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gi gsang sngags lags// rang sems chos sku ngo sprod pa// dri med brgyud pa'i dam chos lags// rang gzhan sku gsum lhun grub 'di// dpal phag mo gru pa'i sgos chos lags// rgya dkar po yon tan che ba de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa lags// bod ngang gis snying rje che ba 'di// phyag na padmo'i byin rlabs lags// rgya nag po rig byed mkhas pa de// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi phyag rjes lags// bod la gsung rab rgyas pa 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las lags// bla ma mnyes pa'i mos gus de// brag dgon rnams la yod pa lags// gnas gang du phyin yang bde bde po// yul gang du phyin yang skyid skyid 'dra// chos ji ltar byas kyang chud mi za// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// 'phags pa'i thugs rjes mi gtong ba// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// dam chos 'di yi gleng langs ni// byang chub sems kyi dga' byed yin// 'dod chags nyid kyis 'dod chags 'dag

/srid pas srid pa 'dag par byed// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa de// 'di mi dpa' bo gcig gis spyod pa yin// mchid pa can gyi nyams len yin// nga rgyal can gyi 'gyings sa yin// pha bzang po bu yi zhe gdeng yin// dge slong gcig gi tshangs spyod yin// btsun po gcig gi khyer ka yi// tshul khrims sbyangs pa'i yon tan yin// chos mang po'i khri la bzhugs pa yin// thabs mkhas pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa yin// dgongs te gsungs pa'i nying khu yin// rdo rje theg pa'i yang snying yin// yon tan bskyed pa'i ma ma yin// 'di la yin lugs mang po yod// nyon mongs drag po'i dbang song zhing*// 'dod chags spyod pa'i gang zag gis// 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras sgrub pa yi// snying rus med pa'i spyod yul min// bu lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la// so nam khe grags kun la yod// nyon mongs med na khe grags yin// bdag 'dzin thongs dang rnal 'byor pa// sbyang sdom bsten dang dam pa kun// rang rgyud sbyongs dang sems dpa' che// brtul zhugs spyod dang snying rus can// rgyal ba sras bcas ma gtogs pa// 'di tsho sus kyang ma byas pa'i// spyod pa yin no dam pa kun// bu go 'am shes sam dgos se kun// nam yang 'dus byas kyi rang bzhin la// rtag pa nam yang yod min te// chu bur lta bu'i 'dun ma la// blo gtad byed pa byis pa'i lugs// mkhas par rloms pa'i byis pa la// 'dun ma'i blo gtod mi mchi bas// nga rang byang chub kyi sems la re// dkon mchog gis 'dun ma ston te mchi// bag med pas ni rang gzhan phung*// mi kha ma nyan rje btsun pa// ti col ma mdzad rnal 'byor pa// legs par soms shig rgyal ba'i sras// gla pa gla med kyi nye gnas rnams// gces se lod pa'i nye gnas rnams// sems dmu rgod rang mthong nye gnas rnams// dus gtan gyi so nam go lags sam//

// 197) ༄// dka' spyad ky-is nyams len byas pas chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ mos gus dang byang chub sems bskyed du med pas lus la sri zhur med par 'bad pa byas na thabs lam dang dge sbyor la rtsol sgrub med par bsgom du btub cing*/ yon tan yong nges/ de nga bden nam mi bden da res tshad bu mdzad par zhu/ lhag pa tshul khrims lhag pa'i sems// lhag pa shes rab bslab pa yi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gtam rgyud bcas// nyams len bden pa rnams lnga bsdus// chags sdang rmongs gsum gang skyes pa// de yi rang gzugs bsdu ba bzhin// de nas ci rigs ci bzhin gnas// ma bred ma dngangs rnal 'byor pa// hūm̐ ho/ ri khrod gyis dang spyil med rnams// thabs la gnad du 'gro bar nges// maṇḍal med na sa la mdzod// rgyags phye med na na bza' btsong*// rang byung lhun grub chos kyi rje// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad pa// mgon po rin po che la 'dud// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa yi// shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i ri khrod pas// bka' drin rjes su dran pa yis// gong ma'i zhabs tog byed pa'i tshe// shākya'i rgyal po'i rjes 'brangs nas// dka' dang sdug bsngal dang du blangs// lus dang srog la mi blta zhing*/ /'jig rten chos brgyad khyad du bsad// snying stobs rdo rje'i brtson 'grus kyis// bsam gtan ro la ma chags par// 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i tshe// nyi ma mkha' la 'char ba 'am// chu dwangs rnyog gseb bcug pa ltar// gzhan gyi khrud shing byed pa'i tshe// rkyen sna tshogs gzhan gyis nos pa la// bzang po'i dbang bskur len pa yi// drung na bzhugs pa'i nye gnas kun// rnam rtog gi tshas 'thum la gzab gzab par// bdag 'dzin gyi gdos su chud pa kun// nye gnas kyi chos bzhin ma thos pas// mi nga la mche ba ma gtsigs par// mtho dman gyi grib kyis phog tsam na// yun ring po'i sems khral mi byed par// skad cig ma yi spyan phug brtag

/tshan chen gyi grib kyis phog pa'i tshe// g.yag chad kyi rnga ma mi brdzi bar// khyed 'o brgyal thugs la ma bab kyang*// pho tshugs med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// bla ma cung zad bsgom du gzhug /mig brda ngag brda lag brda yis// cung zad bar chad bsal ba yis// nyi ma sprin las rgyal ba 'am// chu dwangs rnyog ma dwangs pa 'am// khrud shing bshal chus bshal ba ltar// bu skad cig de la 'gro ba lags// gnas skabs 'di la dgongs nas kyang*// bla ma bsten pa'i tshul lugs rnams// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa lags// ha cang nye min ring ba min// bsten pa dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di// ngar 'dzin pho tshugs med pa la// ston pas bran ltar bsten zhes gsungs// khams kyi 'dug lugs shes pa yi// gcig po bka' bzhin byed ces gsungs// ci mdzad don dang bcas mthong bas// slob ma shes rab can zhes gsungs// rlabs chen spyod par go ba la// theg pa chen po'i rigs zhes gsungs// sangs rgyas mdzad spyod yin snyam pa// mos gus can zhes brjod pa yin// rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang bzhin// 'jig rten khams na dkon pa yis// bla ma dam pa mnyes pa yin// thabs stobs sbyor ba sna tshogs kyis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa yin// gsang ba'i gnad rnams mthong ba yis// gsang ba'i bdag po 'gyur ba yin// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// 'di 'dra'i skyes bu thub pa de// dman sa bzung ba'i rgyu mtshan de// 'gro ba kun gyis smad na yang*// bla ma dam pa mnyes pa yin// nam zhig chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsungs// ji ltar 'byung ba rlung gi khams// zhags pas bcing bar mi nus ltar// rtog pa'i dbang song mi rnams dang*// mthun par mi nus rnal 'byor pa// ji ltar chu yi chu bur dag /bcangs pas snying po med pa ltar// rtog pa snying po med pa yi// 'gro la snying po ma re mdzod// rtswa khar chags pa'i zil ba ni// rtag cing brtan pa ma yin ltar// 'gro ba'i bzang ngan rnam rtog kyang*// mkhas pas de ltar shes par bya// med kyang ku re byas pa yin// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// 'khor ba nyon mongs rnam rtog 'di// sangs rgyas sku gsum lhun grub tu// bsgyur bar byed pas don dang bcas// dbang phyug chen po byed pa pos// snang dang mi snang brtan g.yo kun// 'dod pa bzhin du sgrub 'gyur ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gom stabs 'di// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi// nges par 'byung ba'i dam chos 'di// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi min// dge slong rnams la mi rung ngo*// gser la sogs pa'i rin chen te// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yis// rin chen thams cad ka ra gcog/

// 198) ༄// chos gnad du phog na gcig gis chog zhes pa'i gsung mgur// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po byang chub kyi sems bsgom// lus yi dam kyi lhar bsgom// bla ma dam pa spyi bor bsgom// de nas gegs dang bar chad la// rang gi rtsa ba'i bla mar bsgom// de yi ngang la ma yengs na// gegs dang bar chad gang yin pa// rang sems skye med 'od gsal du// mtsho la kha ba bab pa bzhin// gnyis med ngang du 'gyur ba nges// 'jig rten mgon po'i byin rlabs kyis// byang chub sems kyi gdeng zhig byung*// rang gi sems la nges shes skyes// snang sems zung du 'jug par gda'// skyes na gang skyes bsod nams tshogs// ma skyes skye med ye shes tshogs// gnyis ka 'dzom na zung du 'jug /rtogs pa'i phyogs su blo re bde// byas na byas tshad thabs yin te// ma byas byar med lhun gyis grub// 'dzom na gnyis med bde ba che// lus kyi phyogs su blo re bde// smras na rang gzhan don rnams 'grub// ma smras smra bsam brjod las 'das// ji ltar byas kyang 'gyur med ngang*// ngag gi phyogs su blo re bde// gzhan la smras pa ma lags te// ku su lu yi gsang tshig 'di// rang gis nyams su myong ba yin// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid chos// tshig dang yi ger ma song bar// mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan a ti sha// phyi rol mu stegs byed las pham pa'i tshe// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rje btsun sgrol ma la// sa yi maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab// mu stegs pham byed rig pa thugs la shar// mu stegs pham byas e ma ngo mtshar che// rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la// sa yi maṇḍal de ko ci bya zhes// bdag cag rnams la gsungs pa 'di re mad// chos gnad du phog na gcig gis chog /tshig mang po smras pa'i kha na med// bu nyams su longs dang rnal 'byor pa//

199) ༄// bdag 'dzin spong bar smon pa'i man ngag gi gsung mgur// kye ma kye ma kye ma ho// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i shes pa la// nga bdag ci mtho byed pa yi// 'jig rten chos brgyad bsgrub rnams dang*// nam zhig ring bar 'gyur zhig gu /nga yir 'dzin pa'i yul rnams kyi// chags sdang rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// 'jig rten thams cad phung ba yi// ded dpon 'di dang nam zhig 'bral// 'khor bar chags pa'i yid can gyi// lto gos sna tshogs 'tshol gsog gis// lus sems dub par byed pa yi// rang spyod ngan pa nam zhig spong*// kye ma bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems// nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba la// bdag med shes rab mig bskyed nas// mkhyen pa'i ye shes nam zhig skye// kye ma dngos por 'dzin pa'i sems// rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// sgrib byed log pa'i shes pa dang*// nam zhig 'bral bar 'gyur zhig gu// sha thud gnyis dang ja chang gi /ro yi sred pas bcings pa yi// longs spyod 'di la mi blta bar// nam zhig bsod snyoms spyod par 'gyur// khang bzang yid 'ong rtsod pa'i gzhi// rmongs pa chags pa'i gnas dag dang*// bral nas ri bo dur khrod dang*// shing gi drung du gnas grang rung ba ngo*// 'jig rten rin thang chen po yi// gos dang nor rdzas nyes pa'i gzhi// spangs nas skyes chen mkhas rnams kyis// rgyal mtshan phyag dar khrod 'chang 'gyur// gzung dang 'dzin pas ma gos pa'i// gnyis med byang chub sems bsgoms shing*// sbyang pa'i yon tan la gnas pa'i// rnal 'byor pa dang nam zhig mthun// chu drag bslab pa'i dri ma can// rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dge slong dang*// lhan cig spyod pa mtshungs gyur nas// rang gzhan phung bar ma gyur tam// grol nas grol ba'i 'khor dang ldan// mdzes dang de bzhin zhi ba dang*// seng ge glang chen rgyal po yi// bdag dang 'khor dang ldan zhig gu// yul dman pa gsum gces par gzung ba/

'gag mi spong bas bogs thon pa/ bogs thon pas bdud skyengs su gzhug pa/ gnyen po ma bsten byol bzur ma byas pas/ skyon yon tan du slong zhing bar chad dngos grub tu gyur pa gsang sngags kyi lam a la la ho// // 200) ༄// sangs rgyas dang mu stegs pa'i las 'bras kyi tshul lugs mi mthun pa'i gtan tshig/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs pa'i// las kyi 'bras bu'i tshul lugs ni// byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu 'di// gnyen pos zad par mi 'gyur ba// mu stegs byed kyi grub pa'i mtha'// rgyal po u tra ya na yis// pha dang dgra bcom bsad pa yis// 'bras bu rnam par smin pa de// gnyen po dge ba'i chos spyad pas// zad dam bsrabs par 'gyur ro zhes// nyan thos theg par bstan pa dang*// mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga// nyes tshogs shin tu mang po yang*// sangs rgyas mtshan gyi bye brag dang*// rig sngags gsang sngags khyad par dang*// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*// 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi khyad par dang*// rigs sngags 'dzin pa'i sgrub pa po// mthong dang thos dang rlung gis reg /nyes pa byang par gsungs pa na// theg pa che chung thams cad du// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// gnyen po gsum gyis bcom pa dang*// khyad par mi shes shes pa yis// nyes pa rtsad nas 'dag pa'i tshul// rgyu mtshan gnad ka gtan tshig gis// nyi ma dang ni mun pa bzhin// lhan cig gnas su mi btub pa// skyob pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs// // 201) ༄// sgom chen pa'i mtshan nyid dang dge 'dun gyi las gang yin bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ sgom chen pa zhes bya ba ni/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba btang ba zer ba yin no// rnying pa zhes bya ba ni rtogs pa yod pa zer ba yin no// mtshams bcad ces bya ba ni gong ma rnams kyi zhabs tog tu/ yon tan ngoms pa med par brtson 'grus me bzhin du spar ba la zer ba yin no// de nas sgom chen rnying pa mtshams bcad pa rnams kyis rgyags len pa dang*/bsod snyoms bya ba dang*/

thabs rdugs pa rdo rje seng ge las longs la/ sgrub pa tshul bzhin du mdzad par zhu'o//dge 'dun gyi las zhes bya ba ni/ 'dod chags kyi dbang du ma song ba dang*/ zhe sdang gi dbang du ma song ba dang*/ gti mug gi dbang du ma song ba dang*/ gang byed pa'i bya ba de'i bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa la mkhas pa la zer ba yin pas/ chags sdang rmongs gsum dang 'jig rten gyi bsam pa dang skad cig kyang 'dres med par/ mkhas shing bag dang ldan par ma byas na/ mi mang po'i nang du rang dma' bab/ byin pa'i mis tshur zhe khrel/ byin pas 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu byed pas/ sgom chen rnying pa mtshams bcad la 'bul bar zhu'o// chos mi byed pa dang mtshams mi byed pa la do cig sbyin rgyu med pa yin no// spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho la ni gting mtha' med/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i g.yang sar ni lhung bde/ phan pa dang bde ba'i skyabs mgon dang ni bral/ rgas pa dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba ni gting la thug tshe 'di ni mun nag gi glog dang 'dra ste/ mi rtag pa 'di la/ pha dang bu dang nye du gnyen 'brel gang gis kyang mi skyob pa khyod kyis ma go bas/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba mtho dman zhag gcig gi g.yeng sa rnyed kyang*/ gtan gyi skyabs gnas dang rten sa med pa rang mdo gzhung chung ba yin pas bla ma rin po che'i drung du cig shog shog /oṃ swasti 'di tsam du khro ba de/ de tsam du khyod la sus ci bcol/ mi na re lhun gyis grub ba'i dus su ci tsam du btud cing mos gus byed pa de tsam du je khro je khro la gcan gzan khro bor gyur/ je 'jigs je 'jigs la 'jigs byed gtum por red/ slob dpon re ba'i 'gro ba la phan pa 'ong ba'i mi ni khyod min/ khe grags dang bzang 'dod sgrub pa'i mdzes po dang sprang po mang po rab tu phyung nas/ dang po mi bkur kha med byed de bkur pa'i zhal snga nas/

mi ngan phyam la bskyur na lo gsum rgyags su chug ces pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ zhabs la gtugs na til phung bzhin du brdung*// mtshang rnams tshigs pa'i mig nas 'dru bar byed// sgog skya dug sdong lta bu'i slob dpon spangs// yang yang bka' bstsal gsungs pa 'di re mad// maṅga laṃ// //
